article.articleHeadline: 流行季提前、症状似感冒！有这些症状速就医_中国经济网 -- -- 国家经济门户
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu season arrives early, symptoms resemble a cold! If you have these symptoms, seek medical attention promptly. China Economic Net -- National Economic Portal
article.articleSummary: China is seeing the RSV season arrive early, with humid southern regions reporting earlier activity; nationwide respiratory infections remain at low levels but show a gradual uptick. Respiratory Syncytial Virus is highly contagious, spread by droplets and contact and primarily invades the lower airways. Incubation is about 2–8 days. Early symptoms resemble a cold: nasal congestion, runny nose, cough, sore throat, with or without fever; some children develop wheeze, shortness of breath, chest retractions, nasal flaring, or irritability and poor feeding in infants. The very young and the elderly are most at risk for severe disease; antibodies may offer only brief protection, making reinfection possible. Antibiotics have no proven benefit against RSV; common cough/cold remedies do not eradicate it. No specific antiviral exists. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, covering coughs, avoiding crowds, proper tissue disposal, and, for eligible infants and high‑risk children, RSV monoclonal antibody prophylaxis after consultation.

triage.headline_ja: 流行シーズンが前倒しに、症状は風邪に類似！これらの症状があれば速やかに受診を_中国経済網 -- 国家経済ポータル
triage.triage_reason: RSVは季節性の既知疾患であり、中国全体の呼吸器感染は低水準で推移している。公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重症例急増の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 基础模型助力结核病筛查一线战场
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foundation models bolster frontline tuberculosis screening.
article.articleSummary: TB screening with chest X-ray AI tools moves from research to clinics. Google AI and Nexus AI deployed a chest X-ray screening tool across six countries in about 40 facilities, processing over 25,000 X-rays with more than 90 clinicians and cutting turnaround to under 45 seconds to speed triage while clinicians retain final diagnoses. The effort covers South Africa, Sierra Leone, and Côte d’Ivoire, with expansion planned in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Zambia, and Cameroon; including on-site screening at the Mponeng gold mine in South Africa. MedGemma, open-weight multimodal models (4B and 27B parameters), together with MedSigLIP, are open-source via the HAI-DEF program, enabling local, offline deployment with downloads over 10 million. Indonesia’s Health Ministry aims to screen 50 million people annually using locally fine-tuned MedGemma/MedSigLIP to keep data in-country. HeAR cough-based acoustic triage is piloting in Zambia (CIDRZ), Ghana (Aurum Institute), and HELINA, complementing imaging in underserved areas.

triage.headline_ja: 基礎モデルが結核スクリーニングの最前線を支援
triage.triage_reason: AIを用いた結核スクリーニング技術の導入に関する技術・医療支援の話題であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はTBスクリーニングAIツールの展開に関する技術・医療イニシアチブの報道であり、疾病流行や公衆衛生危機を報じるものではない。南アフリカ、シエラレオネ、コートジボワール、カメルーンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Caos en el epicentro del ébola: "Atacan e incendian centros médicos cuando mueren niños"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaos at the Ebola epicenter: "They attack and burn medical centers when children die."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15, 2026, has resulted in over 4,600 deaths and 9,552 confirmed cases as of October 27, 2026. MSF teams operate eight Ebola treatment centers across Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele. In Butembo’s Kitatumba center (with the Ministry of Health), about 30 children were admitted this summer and 24 died; median age 17 months, with a few older children. Mortality among under-fives at the center exceeds 80%, while the overall rate is about 50%. Dr. Rupa Narra notes many arrive late and reports that in more than 82% of pediatric cases no other family member was infected, possibly due to parental immunity from a prior 2018 vaccination. Trials reportedly exclude children and pregnant women—therapeutic orphans—while stigma, fear, and attacks on health centers undermine response. The outbreak has spurred surveillance in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with neighboring countries imposing border and airport controls.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の震源地で混乱：「子どもが死ぬと医療センターを襲撃・放火する」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部で死者4,600人超、症例9,552件に及ぶ大規模エボラ流行が継続中。医療施設への攻撃や近隣国での国境・空港管理など、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでもサーベイランス強化と国境・空港管理が実施されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生地はDRC北東部（イトゥリ、北キブ、オート・ウエレ）。

article.articleHeadline: 64 Warga di Kulon Progo Terjangkit Leptospirosis Sepanjang Tahun Ini, 7 Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 64 residents in Kulon Progo contracted leptospirosis throughout this year, 7 died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Kulon Progo District Health Office in Indonesia records 64 leptospirosis cases and 7 deaths in 2026. Most affected are workers in wet environments, notably farmers and day laborers. Prompt antibiotic treatment is urged to avert renal and hepatic complications and death. PHBS (Clean and Healthy Living) and environmental sanitation are emphasized to reduce exposure, especially in areas with standing water, water storage, and wells. Leptospira bacteria are shed in rat urine and contaminate water bodies such as flooded rice paddies. Historical data show annual leptospirosis fatalities since 2012, peaking in 2023 with 12 deaths; a reduction occurred in 2021 (11 cases, 1 death).

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴ県で今年64人がレプトスピラ症に感染、7人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一地方（クロンプロゴ県）で毎年発生している風土病的なレプトスピラ症の年次報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はない。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は動物（ネズミ尿）由来の人獣共通感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染なし。2012年以降毎年死亡例があり、2023年がピーク(12人死亡)。地方保健局が衛生啓発を実施しており、地域内で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Enfermeiro é atacado e morto durante atendimento a caso de ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nurse attacked and killed while attending to an Ebola case in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola response team in Bafwasende, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, was attacked on Saturday the 24th, leaving a nurse dead and another health worker seriously injured. The assault comes as Congo’s Ebola outbreak—now the world’s deadliest—surpasses 9,800 cases and 4,700 deaths since May. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi condemned the violence and urged protection for frontline workers. Distrust of authorities, misinformation, and resistance to control measures complicate containment, with reports of tents burned at health posts and threats to safe-burial teams in remote areas. A North Kivu politician was beaten to death last month after backing the government’s response, highlighting the broader safety challenges facing outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応中の看護師が襲撃され死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は9,800症例・4,700死亡に達し世界最大規模となっており、医療従事者への暴力も発生し対応が困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長およびアフリカ地域局長が暴力行為を非難する声明を発表。医療従事者への襲撃、不信感、誤情報、安全埋葬チームへの脅威など対応阻害要因が複数報告されており、既存の大規模流行の深刻化を示す続報。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana not adequately prepared for Ebola threat -- Dr Kingsley Agyemang
article.articleSummary: Ghana's preparedness for a potential Ebola outbreak is insufficient, says Dr Kingsley Agyemang, MP for Abuakwa South and member of Parliament's Health Committee. He warns that weak border health surveillance and scarce public education could leave the country vulnerable amid concerns over Ebola spread in parts of Africa, particularly given extensive Ghana-Nigeria cross-border trade and travel. He notes that movement of people and goods via commercial transport requires stronger surveillance and coordinated public-health response, stressing that Aflao, Akanu, Paga, Nkwanta and Hamile border towns have not shown meaningful strengthening of the health system. He calls for lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic and sustained investment in disease surveillance, emergency preparedness, and health facility capacity. He also questions the lack of public education on Ebola, urging intensified awareness campaigns by media and health authorities. An official authorities assessment is needed to gauge current readiness.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナはエボラの脅威に十分な備えができていない——キングズリー・アジェマン博士
triage.triage_reason: 記事はガーナ国内での実際のエボラ発生を報じたものではなく、国会議員による準備態勢への懸念表明であり、アフリカの一部地域での流行状況や発生国の具体名も不明なため、続報を注視する段階にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおけるエボラ準備態勢への懸念表明であり、具体的な発生国（アフリカのどこで発生しているか）は明示されていない。ナイジェリアとの国境往来への言及はあるが、実際の感染事例発生地は不明なため、対象国リストに基づく発生国は特定できず verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt cao vài ngày do sốt xuất huyết, nam thanh niên 23 tuổi suy hô hấp nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High fever for several days due to dengue fever, a 23-year-old man in critical respiratory failure.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old man from Tuyên Quang, Vietnam, developed severe dengue fever with shock and progressive respiratory failure, requiring VV-ECMO for 13 days. He presented with high fever, abdominal pain, and diarrhea, deteriorated to hypotension and hypoxemia, and was intubated before transfer to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases in Hanoi. Dengue infection was laboratory-confirmed, with liver, kidney, and coagulation abnormalities, diagnosed as dengue shock progressing to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). He received vasopressors, continuous renal replacement therapy, and other intensive care measures. Gradual improvement in oxygenation and hemodynamics allowed removal of ECMO and the endotracheal tube on 26/10; the patient regained consciousness and remained under close monitoring before discharge. The hospital reports 18 dengue patients currently under care. Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and can affect young, healthy individuals.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で数日間の高熱、23歳男性が重篤な呼吸不全に陥る
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症デング熱報告であり、ベトナムでは流行性疾患だが大規模アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなく、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 単一の重症例報告（VV-ECMO使用、18名が入院中との記載あり）。地域的な流行拡大や異常な増加を示す疫学データは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يفاقم أزمة الجوع في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. الأغذية العالمي يحذر من تفاقم انعدام الأمن الغذائي مع انتشار الفيروس في 8 مقاطعات.. ويؤكد: 3.5 مليون شخص يواجهون الجوع الشديد.. و97% منهم بحاجة إلى مساعدات عاجلة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola worsens hunger crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... The World Food Programme warns of worsening food insecurity as the virus spreads in eight provinces... It confirms: 3.5 million people are facing severe hunger, 97% of whom need urgent assistance - Youm7.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens hunger crisis as the virus spreads across eight provinces. The World Food Programme warns that about 3.5 million people face severe hunger or worse, with 97% of those affected in need of urgent food assistance. Ebola disrupts markets, livelihoods, and mobility, compounding hardship as families follow treatment and isolation protocols. Ongoing conflict and displacement leave households less able to cope with the shock. WFP is providing food aid to patients and their families during treatment or isolation and is assisting frontline health teams with transportation of responders and supplies. The agency stresses the need for flexible, timely funding over the next six months to sustain food assistance, air transport, cargo movement, and treatment infrastructure as the outbreak reaches underserved communities in the east.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国の飢餓危機を悪化させる…世界食糧計画、ウイルスが8州に拡大する中で食料安全保障の悪化を警告…350万人が深刻な飢餓に直面、うち97%が緊急支援を必要としていると確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが8州に拡大し、公衆衛生・人道危機（350万人の深刻な飢餓）を伴う深刻な事態であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものより人道的・食料安全保障への影響に焦点を当てているが、8州への感染拡大と紛争・避難民の状況を踏まえ、公衆衛生リスクとしての監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria not yet free, WHO insists as FG targets Dec 7
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Nigeria is not Ebola-free after evacuating the index patient and her husband to Switzerland; 52 contacts remain under surveillance as four states—Kebbi, Plateau, Yobe, and Delta—activate emergency measures. Nigeria and international regulators push ahead with vaccine development against Bundibugyo virus, which has caused deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Federal Government targets December 7, 2026 as the earliest date to declare the outbreak over if no further infections are detected, pending validation by the NCDC and WHO, and a 42-day countdown after the last confirmed infection or after evacuation. The 37-year-old index patient, a Swiss citizen, was evacuated with her husband; the husband is asymptomatic and negative. A suspected Rivers State case tested negative; 53 contacts identified, 52 still in follow-up. The Academy urges intensified tracing and vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアはまだ終息していない、WHOが強調、政府は12月7日を目標に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大事例であり、スイスへの患者搬送や複数州での緊急対応措置の発動など、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生地はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）だが、Bundibugyoウイルスによる死亡例がコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で確認されているため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として記載。ナイジェリアでは指標患者とその夫がスイスへ搬送され、52名の接触者が追跡調査中、4州（Kebbi、Plateau、Yobe、Delta）が緊急対応措置を発動。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia lý giải vì sao bệnh do não mô cầu ít gặp, vẫn cần chủ động kiểm soát từ đầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A specialist explains why meningococcal disease is rare, but still requires proactive control from the outset.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) was reported at a school in Ho Chi Minh City. Healthy individuals can carry the bacteria in the oropharynx (about 5–10% at a time, higher among teens) and spread it via respiratory droplets during close contact. Settings like schools or dormitories can facilitate spread, but a single case does not guarantee an outbreak. The disease can progress from fever and headache to invasive illness such as septicemia or meningitis, with death possible within 24 hours and sequelae including hearing loss, neurological or renal injury, or limb loss. Vaccines target serogroups A, B, C, W, and Y, but coverage is incomplete and not universal under the Expanded Program. Prevention relies on hygiene, not sharing items, ventilated spaces, and minimizing close contact during respiratory illness; case assessment and contact tracing are essential, with fever plus severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, altered consciousness, or purpuric rash.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が解説:髄膜炎菌感染症はなぜ稀少な疾患なのか、それでも初期からの能動的管理が必要な理由
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のアウトブレイクが報告されているが、感染者数・重症度・死亡者数など具体的な規模が不明であり、専門家による疾患解説的な内容が中心のため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は学校でのアウトブレイクに言及しつつも、主に髄膜炎菌感染症の一般的な病態・予防・ワクチンに関する専門家解説記事であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の詳細は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Ghana must track incoming travellers, not rely on temperature checks - Prof Amuasi
article.articleSummary: Ghana should prioritise effective surveillance and tracking of incoming travellers for Ebola, not rely on airport temperature checks and hand sanitiser, says Prof John Amuasi of KNUST. He argues visible screening offers limited assurance since infected individuals may arrive asymptomatic. Ghana should collect accurate traveller data, verify contact details, and ensure they can be reached quickly if symptoms develop, with reliable post-arrival follow-up. Emphasis is placed on surveillance beyond the airport and locating exposed travellers promptly. Airport measures may reassure travelers but do not reliably detect cases, and broad PCR testing for all arrivals is impractical. Authorities should geolocate and direct travellers to designated facilities via verified phone lines. In regional context, WHO reports no active Ebola case in Nigeria after evacuation of an infected person.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ガーナは体温チェックに頼らず、入国旅行者の追跡を行うべき-アムアシ教授
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ症例発生は確認されておらず、ガーナの専門家による水際対策強化の提言記事であるため。ナイジェリアも『アクティブな症例なし』とされており、現時点でのシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナ国内でのエボラ症例発生を報じるものではなく、専門家による水際対策（サーベイランス強化）の提言。ナイジェリアについてもWHOが『アクティブな症例なし』と報告しており、実際の発生国は特定できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼野火烟霾危机 三个月逾30万人患呼吸道感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia's wildfire-smoke haze crisis: over 300,000 people suffer from respiratory infections in three months.
article.articleSummary: Wildfire smoke in Indonesia triggers widespread respiratory infections, with over 300,000 cases recorded across seven provinces from August to October. Palangka Raya, the capital of Central Kalimantan, is among the hardest hit, reporting more than 11,000 residents treated for respiratory infections; many present cough, shortness of breath, and headaches. The government has established about 500 free oxygen and treatment stations nationwide, nearly 300 of them in Central Kalimantan, to provide oxygen and medical care. The hazardous smoke contains formaldehyde, hydrogen cyanide, ammonia, and fine PM2.5 capable of penetrating the lungs and bloodstream, according to health authorities and the WHO. Nusantara Atlas estimates more than 1.9 million hectares burned in the first nine months, though government confirmation is pending. Smoke drift has affected neighboring countries, provoking diplomatic protests and domestic discontent.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの森林火災による煙害危機：3カ月で30万人以上が呼吸器感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 7州で30万人超の呼吸器感染症患者が発生し、煙害が近隣諸国にも及び外交的懸念を引き起こしているため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大）を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 本事例は感染性病原体によるものではなく、森林火災由来の煙害（PM2.5、ホルムアルデヒド等）による非感染性の呼吸器健康影響である点に留意。感染症シグナルとしてのフルRRA実施の可否は要検討。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports second Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to four countries in Africa, with Kenya reporting its second Ebola death. 65-year-old woman developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died earlier this month; Kenya’s first case was a traveler from Congo who died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Kenya has traced 135 contacts, all quarantined, with nine confirmed cases. Latest fatality was a direct contact of index patient; seven other patients remain in two isolation facilities and there is no evidence of community transmission in Kenya. The United States advised delaying travel to Kenya, raising its travel risk level. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case this week, in a patient who had not traveled to DRC. Reported symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and bleeding. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for this rare species.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアなどアフリカ4カ国に拡大し、死亡例・渡航制限（米国の渡航勧告引き上げ）も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの発生源はDRCであり対象国リストに該当。ケニア・ナイジェリア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。治療薬・ワクチン未承認の稀少な種のエボラであり、ヒト-ヒト感染（濃厚接触者9例確認、135人隔離）が進行中で国際的関心・対応が急がれる状況。

article.articleHeadline: 黄南尖扎：筑牢包虫病防治基础 提升动物疫病防控能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jianzha County, Huangnan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture: Fortify the foundation of echinococcosis prevention and control, and enhance the capacity for animal disease prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-27, Jianzha County in Huangnan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai Province, intensified echinococcosis (hydatid disease) prevention and animal disease control by holding a targeted training. The event supports the province’s 2026–2030 comprehensive echinococcosis control action plan, aiming to standardize grassroots prevention workflows and boost village-level epidemiology capacity. A total of 107 township veterinary staff and village prevention workers participated in phased sessions. The program combined policy interpretation, case analysis, practical demonstrations, and on-site Q&A, with bilingual instruction from Li Jing of the Qinghai Provincial Animal Epidemic Control Center and Shen Qingyi of Dingxi Vocational Technical College (Gansu). Core topics included the 2026 prevention plan, dog deworming management module implementation, field administration for wild canids, disposal of dog feces, biosafety, and safe storage/use of biological veterinary medicines. The training strengthens frontline responsibilities and emergency response, underpinning ongoing echinococcosis control and safeguarding animal husbandry and public health.

triage.headline_ja: 黄南尖扎：包虫病防治の基盤を強化し、動物疫病防控能力を向上
triage.triage_reason: 通常のルーティン予防トレーニングに関する行政報道であり、新規の症例増加や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は青海省黄南チベット族自治州尖扎県における包虫病（エキノコックス症）予防のための研修活動を報じたもので、新規感染拡大や異常発生の記述はなく、既存の2026-2030年行動計画に基づくルーティン対策活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Verify travellers' phone numbers to help trace Ebola cases - Prof Amuasi
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness in Ghana hinges on verifying travellers' phone numbers to trace those who develop Ebola symptoms after arrival. Prof John Amuasi argues accurate passenger data, including phone verification, is central; airport temperature checks offer limited protection. Imported Ebola cases are in Nigeria (Abuja) with a case confirmed on October 20 in a woman who traveled from Uganda; she arrived October 3 and developed symptoms four days later. Kenya had nine Ebola cases by October 20, with the first patient travelling from DR Congo through Uganda; the eight additional cases were known contacts of that patient. Amuasi says visible-illness screening will miss pre-symptomatic travellers; PCR screening for all arrivals is not feasible. He calls for detailed arrival records, methods to locate travellers when needed, and clear reporting instructions—designated facilities and helplines—and for educating arrivals as Ghana's priority.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航者の電話番号確認でエボラ症例の追跡を支援すべき - アムアシ教授
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラウイルスがウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大し複数国で確定症例が発生しており、国際的拡大と渡航対応の必要性という重大なIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおけるエボラ水際対策（渡航者追跡）に関する内容。実際の確定症例はナイジェリア（アブジャ）とケニアで報告されており、感染源はDRCからウガンダ経由とされる。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外したが、感染拡大の実態把握にはこれら3カ国の状況確認が重要。ガーナは症例未確認だが記事の主題国として準備体制強化の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nam thanh niên 23 tuổi khỏe mạnh bất ngờ nguy kịch vì sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthy 23-year-old man suddenly in critical condition due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old man from Tuyên Quang Province, Vietnam, with no prior health issues, developed dengue fever that rapidly progressed to dengue shock syndrome and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). Despite invasive ventilation on 100% oxygen, his SpO2 remained ~80%. Dengue was laboratory-confirmed, with concomitant liver, kidney, and coagulation abnormalities. He required veno-venous ECMO (VV-ECMO) with continuous renal replacement therapy and extensive supportive care. Initial shock persisted with blood pressure ~80/40 mmHg on vasopressors and tachycardia of 120–140 bpm. After prolonged ICU management, oxygenation and hemodynamics improved, allowing removal of ECMO and endotracheal tube. Doctors warn dengue can be severe even in youths without comorbidities; the dangerous phase typically occurs days 3–7 from onset. The National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi is treating 18 dengue patients; emphasis on vector control and vaccination where indicated (Aedes mosquitoes as primary transmission).

triage.headline_ja: 健康な23歳男性、デング熱により突然重篤な状態に陥る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで常在する疾患であり、本記事は重症化した一例の臨床報告に過ぎず、アウトブレイクや異常な流行拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一の重症デング熱症例に関する臨床報告記事。ハノイの病院で18名のデング患者を治療中との記載はあるが、通常の流行期における常在疾患の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में डेंगू-मलेरिया का डेंजर जोन: 1 महीने में दोगुने हुए मामले, ये बना हॉटस्पॉट; 53 हजार से ज्यादा को नोटिस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger zone for dengue and malaria in Haryana: cases have doubled in a month, this has become a hotspot; notices issued to more than 53,000.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria, mosquito-borne diseases, are spreading in Haryana with dengue cases now exceeding 774 confirmed this year and having more than doubled in the past month; no dengue deaths have been reported so far. Panchkula district shows the highest share of cases, followed by Gurugram (75), Sonipat (68), Faridabad (65), and Jhajjar (62). Authorities issued 53,051 notices under municipal sub-rules—51,729 by the Health Department and 1,322 by Urban Local Bodies—to curb lax preventive measures. Mosquito larval presence was detected in 112,000 homes during inspections. For dengue testing, 27 laboratories are operational. Civil hospitals and other government centers have 267 wards and 1,070 beds reserved for dengue patients. Private laboratories are capped at Rs 600 for testing. Current as of 27 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でデング熱・マラリアが危険水域に:1か月で症例倍増、ホットスポット形成;5万3千件超の通知
triage.triage_reason: インドの一州における季節性のデング熱・マラリア流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例急増と行政対応の規模から継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱死者はこれまで報告なし。感染はハリヤナ州内の複数地区（Panchkula、Gurugram、Sonipat、Faridabad、Jhajjar）に拡大しているが、季節性の媒介動物感染症であり、インド国内の公衆衛生当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Increasing dengue outbreaks in temperate Brazil are associated with Aedes aegypti invasion and infestation levels
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increasing dengue outbreaks in temperate Brazil are associated with Aedes aegypti invasion and infestation levels.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks are increasing in temperate regions of Brazil, and the study links this rise to invasion and infestation levels of Aedes aegypti, the primary vector. The authors represent a broad, interdisciplinary collaboration across Brazilian institutions, including the Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul, Fiocruz, UFPE, UFSM, and partners in Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Amazonas, and other states. The findings emphasize sustained Ae. aegypti establishment in temperate zones as a key factor associated with higher dengue activity, informing vector surveillance and control strategies in non-tropical areas. The work is published under an open-access Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, with funding from FAPERGS, Fiocruz programs, CNPq, and related agencies; corresponding author is Gabriel da Luz Wallau.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル温帯地域におけるデング熱流行の増加は、ネッタイシマカの侵入・蔓延レベルと関連している
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既知の媒介蚊による既存流行地域の拡大傾向を分析したもの。新規性・緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Communications誌に掲載された学術研究であり、デング熱の急性アウトブレイク速報ではない。ブラジル温帯地域（リオグランデドスル州、サンタカタリーナ州等）でのネッタイシマカ定着とデング熱流行増加の相関を分析した科学的知見。既知の媒介蚊・既知の疾患であり、IHR通報対象となるような新興感染症・異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Red tide hits Carigara Bay; shellfish ban stays in 2 Samar bays
article.articleSummary: Carigara Bay, Leyte, shows red tide with Pyrodinium bahamense detected in seawater, prompting BFAR to warn against gathering, selling, or eating shellfish from the bay. BFAR-8 laboratory tests confirmed paralytic shellfish toxin (saxitoxin) in shellfish meat from Irong-Irong Bay, Catbalogan City, Samar. A shellfish ban remains in effect in Matarinao Bay, Eastern Samar, and in two other Samar/Eastern Samar bays. Affected municipalities include General MacArthur, Quinapondan, Hernani, and Salcedo. BFAR urges the public to refrain from shellfish and alamang from the affected waters until areas are declared safe. Red tide toxins can cause paralytic shellfish poisoning; cooking does not reliably destroy toxins. Fish, squid, shrimp and crabs from these waters are safe to eat if fresh, properly washed, prepared, and with internal organs removed.

triage.headline_ja: 赤潮がカリガラ湾を襲う、サマール州の2つの湾で貝類禁漁が継続
triage.triage_reason: 毒素（サキシトキシン）による貝類汚染の季節的・定例的な赤潮警報であり、ヒト感染症ではなく、人的被害の報告もないため、感染症シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本件は赤潮（Pyrodinium bahamense）による貝類の麻痺性貝毒（サキシトキシン）汚染に関する食品安全上の注意喚起であり、感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）ではない。フィリピンでは季節的に繰り返し発生する事象であり、ヒトの発症例の報告もないため、感染症イベントのEBSシグナルとしては優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Machete-wielding mob attacks health workers responding to Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: Two health workers in Bafwasende, Tshopo province, Congo, were attacked by a machete-wielding mob while conducting Ebola awareness outreach. One nurse, an experienced staff at the town's general hospital, was killed on the spot; a colleague, a teacher, survived. The crowd alleged the workers were spreading Ebola by contaminating water. The Friday assault comes amid a fast-spreading Bundibugyo-species Ebola outbreak spanning eight Congo provinces, with 9,964 confirmed cases and a 48.6% case fatality rate since the outbreak was declared in May. Health workers in Bafwasende are sheltering under police guard as the army was deployed to the area. Earlier in the week, another community worker was attacked and his house set on fire. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis condemned the killing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応中の医療従事者が山刀を持った暴徒に襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行（確定9,964例、致死率48.6%）が進行中であり、公衆衛生対応を妨げる暴力事件（医療従事者殺害）が発生していることから、国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本件自体は医療従事者襲撃事件の報道だが、背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ種エボラ大規模流行（8州、9,964例、致死率48.6%）がすでに国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事案であり、既存のフルRRA対象である可能性が高い。対応活動への妨害（暴力・治安悪化）は流行制御の実効性に影響するため継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ ơi: Bác sĩ cảnh báo dấu hiệu lao phổi nhiều người dễ bỏ qua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor: Warning signs of pulmonary tuberculosis that many people easily overlook
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) warning signs include a cough lasting more than two weeks, sputum with blood, fatigue, weight loss, and low-grade evening fever. Many people misinterpret these symptoms as common respiratory infections, delaying diagnosis and treatment. The Thanh Niên newspaper program 'Doctor' features Prof. Dr. Nguyen Nhu Vinh, Head of the Respiratory Endoscopy Department at Ho Chi Minh City University of Medicine and Pharmacy, who explains typical signs, transmission pathways, and risk factors that raise TB susceptibility, as well as treatment and prevention considerations to curb drug-resistant TB. The interview emphasizes early recognition, infection control, and reducing transmission in the community. This Vietnamese program aims to empower individuals, families, and the wider community to protect health through practical medical knowledge.

triage.headline_ja: 医師に聞く：見逃されやすい肺結核の警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、一般向けの結核啓発・教育記事であり、新規事例や異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の症状啓発を目的とした医療情報番組の内容であり、具体的な発生状況やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : ZRL Takes 21 Passengers To Health Facility For Suspected Cholera Cases
article.articleSummary: Twenty-one passengers aboard Passenger Train No. 601, from Kitwe to Livingstone, were taken to a health facility for assessment after reports of suspected cholera. The train was stopped in Chilanga to screen passengers in collaboration with health authorities. Zambia Railways Limited says precautionary measures and public health guidance are being followed as assessments proceed. The company is intensifying surveillance on its trains to bolster early detection, including passenger screening, symptom monitoring, and timely intervention to prevent spread. The move seeks to safeguard passengers and railway staff. The public should stay calm and rely on official communications for verified information, with further updates provided as confirmed details become available, while privacy is protected.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：ザンビア鉄道、コレラ疑い事例で乗客21人を医療機関へ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コレラ疑い例が鉄道乗客集団で発生し、当局がスクリーニング・監視を強化しており、報道による社会的関心も見られるためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 確定診断情報なし（疑い例段階）。検査結果等の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 'Ghana was very high risk, but we were fortunate' - Prof Amuasi on 2014-15 Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: During the 2014-15 West Africa Ebola outbreak, Ghana was deemed very high risk yet recorded no cases, according to Prof John Amuasi, Global Health Leader at KCCR. He questioned airport temperature checks and stressed that screening detects possible symptoms but requires laboratory confirmation, noting headaches and fever are non-specific. The regional experience showed rapid cross-border spread: Nigeria's outbreak began July 2014 with 20 cases and eight deaths; Senegal had one confirmed case and no deaths. Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone bore the greatest burden as the broader epidemic persisted into 2016, totaling 28,610 cases and 11,308 deaths per the US CDC. Amuasi urged stronger post-arrival traveller monitoring, proposing mandatory check-ins for basic signs every two to three days, acknowledging it could be painful but potentially more efficient than mass testing. At the interview time, Ghana reported no confirmed or suspected cases; emphasis on public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 『ガーナは非常にリスクが高かったが、幸運だった』―アムアシ教授が語る2014-15年エボラ出血熱流行
triage.triage_reason: 2014-15年の西アフリカエボラ流行を振り返る回顧的インタビュー記事であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は2014-15年エボラ流行についての歴史的回顧・専門家インタビューであり、現時点での新規感染確認や発生は報告されていない。ガーナは当時も現在も症例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Takes Root in Temperate Southern Brazil as Aedes aegypti Spreads
article.articleSummary: Dengue now endemic in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil’s southernmost state, as Aedes aegypti expanded across municipalities between 2015 and 2023 and dengue cases rose sharply from 2020 onward. A Nature Communications study integrating entomological, epidemiological and environmental data with 665 newly sequenced DENV genomes shows local persistence of viral lineages across years, rather than single-year importations driving outbreaks. By 2023 nearly half of Rio Grande do Sul’s municipalities exceeded 20 cases per 100,000 residents per year, indicating sustained transmission. Genomic analyses map the outbreak to the Northwest and Metropolitan regions as hubs from which lineages dispersed to other areas. The findings illustrate a north-to-south expansion of dengue risk into temperate zones of the Americas and stress the need for intensified vector control and surveillance in newly endemic areas to curb the burden.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、エジプトヤブカの拡散に伴いブラジル南部の温帯地域に定着
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部でのデング熱定着・拡大を示す学術研究の報告であり、急性の異常事態ではないが気候変動に伴う温帯域への流行拡大という継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、動向を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はNature Communications誌に発表された学術研究の紹介であり、2015〜2023年の長期的データに基づく分析。急性のアウトブレイク報告ではないが、デング熱の温帯域への地理的拡大という新興リスクを示しており、気候変動関連のベクター媒介感染症拡大の観点から継続的モニタリングが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 3 milhões de adolescentes estão sem segunda dose contra dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 3 million adolescents are missing their second dose of the dengue vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Brazil reports about 3.4 million adolescents aged 10–14 who received the first dengue vaccine dose have not returned for the second dose of Qdenga. The SUS has administered 11.8 million doses (7.6 million first, 4.2 million second), with 4 million doses inactive in municipal stocks. Completing the schedule requires a three-month interval, and the approaching summer under El Niño raises dengue transmission risk. Vaccination is constrained by Takeda’s limited supply: 9 million doses this year and 9 million in 2027. Meanwhile, Butantan’s domestically developed dengue vaccine, designed for single-dose use (40–60 million/year), remains suspended since June for safety review after severe cases in over 500,000 doses. With no scaled national production and limited international supply, public vaccination is restricted to a smaller segment of the population at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 300万人以上の青少年がデング熱ワクチンの2回目接種を受けていない
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン接種率の低さと供給制約が報告されているが、新規アウトブレイクや重症例急増の情報はなく、季節性流行拡大の懸念として継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: ワクチン供給不足とブタンタン製ワクチンの安全性審査による接種停止が、エルニーニョによる夏季デング熱流行リスク増大と重なる点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ஒரே கொசுவால் 3 கொடிய நோய்கள்! பருவமழையில் இருந்து தப்ப மக்கள் செய்ய வேண்டியது என்ன?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A single mosquito can spread three serious diseases! What should people do to stay safe during the monsoon season?
article.articleSummary: During Tamil Nadu's northeast monsoon, Chennai health authorities warn that standing water boosts Aedes mosquitoes, raising dengue, chikungunya, and Zika risks. The Chennai Municipal Corporation urges residents to prevent stagnation: clean and cover water containers weekly; remove unused tires, coconut husks, and flower pots that collect water; promptly discard any accumulated water; avoid walking in rainwater without protective footwear; boil drinking water; cover wounds; and seek medical care for fever rather than self-medicating. For urgent help, contact urban primary health centers or government hospitals; call 1913. One vector, three diseases: Dengue fever (low platelets; severe body pains and retro-orbital pain), Chikungunya (severe joint pain and swelling lasting days), Zika virus (joint pains, conjunctival redness, skin lesions; pregnancy can risk fetal brain development). Blood tests confirm; treat under medical guidance if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 一匹の蚊が3つの危険な病気を媒介!モンスーン期に人々が安全を守るためにすべきこととは?
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の報告はなく、既知の季節性リスクに関する注意喚起にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生数・流行状況の記載なし。地方自治体（Chennai Municipal Corporation）による通常の公衆衛生対策の呼びかけ。

article.articleHeadline: Nurse killed, colleague injured in attack on Ebola response team in north‑eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: In north‑eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, an Ebola response nurse was killed and a second health worker seriously wounded while responding to an Ebola alert, attacked by youths who accused them of contaminating water sources and spreading the virus (Radio Okapi). WHO condemned the assault, with Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressing health workers must operate safely and with dignity. Uganda announced a travel ban on non‑essential travel to and from DR Congo, with returning citizens quarantined for 21 days at their own cost to prevent cross‑border spread. Since the outbreak began in May, DR Congo has reported over 4,800 deaths and nearly 10,000 infections. The incident adds to a pattern of violence against responders, including a politician killed last month and multiple Red Cross attacks earlier this year. Kenya and Nigeria also reported their first Ebola cases linked to the DR Congo outbreak this month, highlighting regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国北東部でエボラ対応チームが襲撃され、看護師1名が死亡、同僚1名が負傷
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者4,800人超・感染者約1万人に達し、ウガンダの渡航制限やケニア・ナイジェリアへの飛び火が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例や渡航制限が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。対応者への暴力多発も流行制御上の重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt cao, rối loạn tiêu hóa, nam thanh niên nguy kịch vì sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High fever, gastrointestinal disturbances, young man in critical condition due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old man from Tuyi Quang Province in Vietnam developed dengue fever that rapidly progressed to dengue shock syndrome with shock and fulminant respiratory failure. After three days of fever and abdominal symptoms, he deteriorated with diarrhea, nausea, hypotension, and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). He was intubated and transferred to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, where dengue was laboratory-confirmed and abnormalities in liver, kidney, and coagulation function noted. With persistent hypoxemia despite maximal ventilation, venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) was initiated, alongside continuous renal replacement therapy and vasopressors. After 13 days of intensive care, ECMO was discontinued and the patient was extubated and conscious, remaining under close monitoring. Dengue can be severe even in young adults with no underlying disease, and fever resolution does not guarantee safety. A four-serotype dengue vaccine (for ages 4+) requires two doses 3 months apart and reduces, but does not eliminate, disease risk. Da Nang reports over 4,200 dengue cases this year, many due to a virulent serotype; about 18 dengue patients are being treated at the central hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 高熱、消化器障害―若い男性がデング熱で危篤状態に
triage.triage_reason: 個別重症例の報告だが、ベトナムでは季節性デング熱が流行中で地域での流行拡大の兆候がある。国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ダナンでは今年4,200件超のデング症例が報告されており、毒性の強い血清型の流行が示唆される。個別重症例は季節性流行の一部と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Researchers assess antimicrobial resistance in Salmonella
article.articleSummary: Researchers from King's College London and the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention analyzed genetic traits linked to antimicrobial resistance in drug-resistant Salmonella across China's food chain, identifying AMR characteristics most likely to spread over the next 25 years. The study investigates how Salmonella resistance genes may move through segments of China's food system, reflecting China's status as a major meat producer and consumer. Findings imply potential global implications for food safety, signaling the need for enhanced surveillance of Salmonella resistance determinants and targeted interventions to slow dissemination along the food chain. By mapping likely transmission pathways of resistance genes in Salmonella within China, the work supports international risk assessment and informs policies to mitigate the spread of antimicrobial resistance tied to foodborne illness.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らがサルモネラ菌の薬剤耐性を評価
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染イベントの発生ではなく、中国の食品チェーンにおけるサルモネラ耐性菌の将来的拡散を予測した研究論文の紹介であり、急性の公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究論文の紹介記事であり、実際の症例発生や流行を報じるものではない。英国（England, London, UK）は研究機関の所在地であり、発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana Dengue Alert: डेंगू के 774 से ज्यादा केस, पंचकूला बना हॉटस्पॉट; 53 हजार लोगों को नोटिस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haryana Dengue Alert: More than 774 Dengue cases, Panchkula has become a hotspot; notices issued to 53,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria threats have risen in Haryana, India, with dengue cases exceeding 774 so far this year. Panchkula is the main hotspot, followed by Gurugram, Sonipat, Faridabad, and Jhajjar, recording 75, 68, 65 and 62 cases respectively. No dengue deaths have been reported yet. To curb transmission, health authorities issued 53,051 notices (51,729 by the health department and 1,322 by urban local bodies) targeting households and public spaces; larval surveys found mosquito larvae in about 112,000 homes. Preventive guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water in coolers, planters, tanks, and other receptacles. Healthcare preparedness includes 27 testing laboratories, 267 wards and 1,070 beds reserved in public facilities, with dengue tests in private labs/hospitals capped at Rs 600. Seek medical care for fever, severe headache, or body pains.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州デング警報：774人以上の症例、パンチクラがホットスポットに;5万3000人に通知
triage.triage_reason: インドのハリヤナ州でデング熱774例超と季節的増加が報告されているが、死亡例なく医療体制も整っており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。例年の季節性感染症の範囲内と考えられ経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は死亡例なく、当局による対応（検査体制、病床確保、通知発行）が機能している。季節性の感染症拡大であり、現時点でフルRRAへの移行は不要と判断。続報で症例数の急増や死亡例発生があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola funding gap widens as outbreak spreads to new countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading from Congo-Kinshasa to West, Central and East Africa; eight provinces affected; Nigeria and Kenya have reported cases, with Kenya recording the first death outside the core zone. As of 23 October, UN agencies reported 4,727 deaths in Congo-Kinshasa. WHO assessments note persistent shortcomings in contact follow-up and early detection. Fatality rate in Congo-Kinshasa nears 50%. An online meeting of African health ministers on 28 October aims to agree a response, while funding for testing, surveillance, and preparedness remains scarce. There is no approved vaccine; a Bundibugyo-strain vaccine is months away. A Phase 2/3 vaccine trial began in Bunia, DRC. The infection's source for the Nigerian case is unclear; the patient is Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, with Kampala denying Uganda as the source. WFP warns nearly 3.5 million people face hunger; US$214 million needed over six months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の資金不足が拡大、アウトブレイクが新たな国々へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を起点としたエボラ出血熱が複数国に拡大し、致死率約50%、死者4,727人に達するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大・資金不足・管理体制の課題が顕著なためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を中心に、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大を報じているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penyakit Kambing yang Sering Muncul Saat Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Wary of Goat Diseases That Often Occur During the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: During Indonesia's rainy season, goat health faces heightened risk. Common ailments include diarrhea, tied to damp environments and wet forage; farmers should avoid spoiled, moldy, or contaminated greens and watch for persistent diarrhea, weakness, or inappetence. Bloat is another concern when fresh, wet forage is fed improperly; greens should be wilted before feeding. Parasitic infections, especially Haemonchus contortus, can cause anemia and weight loss, with affected goats appearing thin, lethargic, or less productive. Respiratory disorders arise from damp housing and poor ventilation, presenting coughing, fever, reduced appetite, breathing difficulty, or nasal discharge. Scabies (kudis) causes itching, skin irritation, hair loss, and crusts; affected animals should be isolated until cleared. Slippery, wet housing increases injuries and lameness; ensure drainage and drying of yards. Authorities in Kupang (BBPP Kupang), Bali Province, and West Nusa Tenggara Province issue guidance on these risks.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に多発するヤギの病気に注意
triage.triage_reason: 動物（ヤギ）の一般的な飼養管理に関する注意喚起記事であり、人への健康影響やヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）はヤギの皮膚病として言及されており、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生リスクについての記載はない。季節性の家畜飼養管理ガイダンス記事。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Ghana has not dropped the ball on disease screening - Prof Amuasi
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening in Ghana remains aligned with risk, says Prof John Amuasi of the KCCR, rejecting claims that screening has slipped since COVID-19. He argues that testing every arriving traveller is impractical and that screening must reflect current risk. The comments follow Nigeria’s October 20 confirmation of an imported Ebola case; the patient developed symptoms four days after arriving from Uganda, with the WHO noting investigations into the infection source. As of October 25, Kenya had nine confirmed cases and two deaths; Uganda’s outbreak status is listed as ended by the ECDC. Amuasi urges stronger data collection on every entrant and improved traveller guidance, acknowledging privacy concerns but stressing its importance. He proposes leaflets explaining symptoms and care; a confirmed case would require a different response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ガーナは疾病スクリーニングで手を抜いていない－アムアシ教授
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来のエボラ感染者がナイジェリアで確認され、ケニアでも9例・死亡2例が報告されるなど複数国にまたがる国際的拡大が見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主な舞台はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでのエボラ発生状況であり、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。ガーナは自国でのエボラ発生ではなく、スクリーニング体制についての国内議論が主題であるため、実際の発生国としては verified_locations に含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 肺隱球菌病｜男子愛車常「中雀屎」頻洗車後確診肺炎　醫生警告：變乾後藏惡菌　教3招正確清理【附預防禽流感6大貼士】|香港經濟日報 TOPick
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulmonary cryptococcosis | A man who loves his car often gets bird droppings on him; after frequent car washing he is diagnosed with pneumonia. Doctors warn: bacteria hide when it dries. 3 tips for proper cleaning [Includes 6 tips to prevent avian influenza] | Hong Kong Economic Daily TOPick
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen’s Songgang People’s Hospital reports a single case of pulmonary cryptococcosis linked to a man who frequently washes his car amid pigeon droppings, illustrating infection from dried bird feces. The fungus Cryptococcus neoformans inhaled as aerosolized dust can cause pneumonia, nodules, or patchy lesions on imaging. Clinically, patients may have chronic dry cough, scant sputum, low fever, fatigue, and weight loss; some present with high fever, chest tightness, or dyspnea, while early disease can be asymptomatic. The fungus can disseminate to the central nervous system, causing meningitis with headaches, nausea, neck stiffness, vision changes, or confusion; usual antibiotics have no effect. Prevention includes three cleaning steps: wear a KN95 mask and disposable gloves, moisten droppings before wiping, avoid dry rubbing, then rinse and seal waste and wash hands. High-risk groups include immunosuppressed individuals and long-term steroid users. The article also includes six avian influenza prevention tips.

triage.headline_ja: 肺隠球菌症｜鳩の糞で車を頻繁に洗う男性が肺炎と診断　医師が警告：乾燥後に悪菌が潜む　正しい清掃法3選【鳥インフルエンザ予防6大ヒント付き】
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例（肺クリプトコックス症）に関する一般向け健康情報記事であり、鳥インフルエンザは予防啓発として付随的に触れられているのみで、公衆衛生上の異常事態や感染拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は鳥の糞由来の真菌感染症（クリプトコックス症）の単発症例であり、鳥インフルエンザ（Avian Influenza）に関する実際の発生報告ではない。付録として一般的な予防ヒントが掲載されているのみ。Bluedotの疾患分類（鳥インフルエンザ）は誤りと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao bệnh não mô cầu ít gặp nhưng vẫn có thể bùng phát thành ổ dịch?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is meningococcal disease rare, yet can still flare up into an outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Southern Vietnam has recorded 42 meningococcal disease cases this year with 7 deaths; 2025 saw 39 cases and 6 deaths, while 2024 had 12 cases and 1 death. Neisseria meningitidis can silently colonize the nasopharynx of healthy individuals and spread via respiratory droplets, particularly in crowded settings such as schools and dormitories, enabling outbreaks despite low incidence. Transmission risk depends on exposure, serogroups, immune status, and control measures. Serogroups A, B, C, W, and Y commonly cause invasive disease, and vaccines offer varying protection against these groups, so vaccination with one type does not guarantee broad coverage. To reduce spread, emphasize hygiene, avoid sharing items, and maintain well-ventilated environments. Seek urgent care for fever with severe headache, vomiting, lethargy, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, or petechiae. Vaccination remains key; discuss appropriate vaccines and schedules with healthcare providers. In older adults, presentation may be atypical.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は稀であるにもかかわらず、集団感染に発展することがあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部で髄膜炎菌感染症の症例数・死亡者数が年々増加しており（2024年12例/1死亡→2025年39例/6死亡→2026年42例/7死亡）、致死率も高く、学校・寮などでの集団感染リスクが指摘されているためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発的な解説記事だが、南部ベトナムでの症例数・死亡者数の増加傾向（3年連続）という具体的データが含まれており、公衆衛生上の懸念として継続監視・評価が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana activates Ebola preparedness system, conducts simulation exercises -- GHS
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ghana Health Service activated Ebola preparedness and began simulation exercises to strengthen response capacity. Monitoring across affected countries—DRC and Uganda—with concerns about cross-border spread via indirect routes to Kenya and Nigeria; emphasis on testing response arrangements through three simulation exercises since concern emerged in the region. The Public Health Emergency Operations Centre in Pantang operates 24/7 to scan global developments and coordinate actions. Preparedness involves 33 agencies across health, security, education, welfare, local government, and emergency management, including FDA, NADMO, National Commission for Civic Education, Ghana Education Service, Veterinary Services Department, National Peace Council, and the Ghana Armed Forces. Ghana also engages Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire, with tripartite meetings to align cross-border information and responses.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、エボラ出血熱への備えシステムを稼働させ、シミュレーション訓練を実施 ― ガーナ保健サービス(GHS)
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行を受け、ガーナが33機関を動員した大規模な準備態勢を発令しており、越境拡大への懸念と行政・社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はガーナにおける準備態勢の稼働に関する内容であり、ガーナ国内での実際の感染確認は記載されていない。実際にエボラが発生しているのはDRC（および対象国リスト外のウガンダ）であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。ガーナ・ブルキナファソ・コートジボワールは越境対応の協議相手として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Stravičan napad u Kongu: Mladići naoružani mačetama ubili zdravstvenog radnika zbog dezinformacija o eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A horrific attack in Congo: machete-wielding youths killed a healthcare worker because of misinformation about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In Bafwasendeu, a general hospital in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a seasoned medical technician tasked with Ebola awareness was killed by machete-wielding youths Friday afternoon, driven by misinformation about Ebola accusing him of spreading disease by contaminating water. His colleague, a teacher involved in community outreach, survived. The attack highlights violence against health workers amid an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Tshopo, one of eight affected provinces. The Congo’s National Institute for Public Health reports 9,964 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 48.6% case fatality since the outbreak was declared in May. Attacks have targeted hospitals, vehicles, and staff, complicating response efforts; health workers in Bafwasendeu have sheltered at the general hospital under police protection as the army was briefly deployed. Earlier, another outreach worker was attacked and his house burned.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの戦慄の襲撃：マチェーテで武装した若者たちがエボラに関する誤情報を理由に医療従事者を殺害
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）のアウトブレイクが進行中で、致死率約48.6%、9,964例の確定症例があり、医療従事者への暴力が対応を妨げている重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者への暴力事件を中心に報じているが、背景にあるエボラアウトブレイクの規模（8州、約1万例、致死率48.6%）が深刻であり、対応活動の妨害が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Trapped in isolation: Inside Kenya's high-stakes Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) outbreak has nine confirmed cases and two deaths; seven patients remain in treatment with a case fatality rate of 22.2%. The first imported case was confirmed on Oct 6, 2026, triggering surveillance and contact tracing. A Nairobi-area quarantine facility housed contacts in shared blocks; when new positives emerged inside, the 21-day quarantine clock was reset, prompting a move to private rooms after advocacy from detainees. A visitor from the DRC via Uganda and an international traveler from Uganda endured prolonged isolation, with blood draws and temperature checks and restricted access. On Oct 26, 2026, the first 20 contacts completed 21 days without symptoms and were discharged; 98 remain to be released in four waves starting Nov 3. Three sequenced samples linked to Bundibugyo virus lineage, underscoring ongoing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 隔離の中に閉じ込められて：ケニアの緊迫するエボラ隔離施設の内部
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の確定症例・死亡例があり、輸入症例を契機に国境を越えた接触者の隔離措置が続いている。致死率22.2%で、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイク自体はケニア国内で発生しており、DRC・ウガンダは接触者の渡航経路として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生を示す記述はないため対象国リストには含めない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana explores AI to predict Ebola and other health threats -- GHS
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service (GHS) is exploring artificial intelligence to help predict disease outbreaks and strengthen emergency planning amid Ebola threats. Dr Samuel Kaba Akoriyea said discussions focus on using emerging technologies to assess public health risks and support timely decisions when infections could cross borders, following Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa and concerns about international travel. AI could analyze disease trends, population movement and environmental conditions to identify emerging risks and guide surveillance and resource allocation, complementing existing systems; it would not replace laboratory diagnosis or established outbreak response. Effectiveness requires reliable data, technical expertise and authorities’ capacity to act. Ghana remains in preparedness mode, conducting simulations and coordinating across agencies, with the Public Health Emergency Operations Centre at Pantang monitoring developments. Cross-border engagement and information sharing are emphasized as surveillance remains critical; Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of a symptomatic person or contaminated materials, with symptoms 2–21 days after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、エボラ出血熱など健康リスク予測にAI活用を検討 -- GHS
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ国内でのエボラ発生は報告されておらず、AI活用による予防準備体制の取り組みに関する記事であり、現時点で実際の感染拡大事例は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおけるエボラ発生事例ではなく、AIを用いた疾病予測・公衆衛生準備体制強化に関する取り組みの紹介。アフリカ他地域でのエボラ発生に言及しているが具体的な国名・症例数は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Lan tỏa kiến thức phòng, chống bệnh dại đến hơn 65.000 học sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreading rabies prevention and control knowledge to over 65,000 students
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a public health challenge in Vietnam, with more than 90,000 dog- or cat-bite/scratch exposures and 323 rabies deaths reported during 2022–2025, and 54 rabies deaths in the first nine months of 2026 across 21 of 34 provinces. Globally, WHO estimates about 59,000 rabies deaths annually and underscores dog vaccination of at least 70% in risk areas. The STOP Rabies social-responsibility initiative expands in 2026 education in Tay Ninh and Dong Thap provinces, aiming to reach over 65,000 primary and secondary students and train 240 teachers and school-health staff. In Tay Ninh, 30,000 students and 116 educators; in Dong Thap, 35,000 students and 124 staff. The program uses Train-the-Trainer approach, with age-appropriate materials, and promotes dog/cat vaccination and rapid post-exposure actions, encouraging families and communities to adopt protective behaviors. Coordinated by University of Medicine and Pharmacy, Ho Chi Minh City; University of Agriculture and Forestry, Ho Chi Minh City; provincial agriculture/environment departments; local schools; and Boehringer Ingelheim Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 65,000人以上の生徒に狂犬病予防・対策の知識を普及
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の地方病であり、本記事は教育啓発プログラムに関する内容で、新たな異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで継続的な公衆衛生課題として存在するが、本記事は予防教育プログラム（STOP Rabiesイニシアチブ）の展開に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや急激な状況変化を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác nguồn lây não mô cầu từ những "người mang trùng ẩn mình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant about meningococcal transmission from asymptomatic carriers.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a cluster of four students with meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B, including one death, underscoring silent transmission by asymptomatic carriers. The bacterium can reside in the throat of healthy people; about 5-10% carry it, rising to 20-25% among adolescents. Carriers can shed bacteria through droplets or shared items, enabling spread in schools in crowded settings. Disease can progress rapidly to septicemia and meningitis, with death possible within 24 hours. Case fatality may reach 10-15%; 10-20% of survivors suffer permanent sequelae such as limb loss, deafness, brain injury, epilepsy, or chronic kidney disease. Prevention emphasizes vaccination against serogroups A, B, C, W-135, Y; many children lack full protection. Public measures include ventilation, hand hygiene, masking with symptoms, and not sharing items. Vaccinate early, especially before entering crowded settings; seek urgent care for fever with headache, neck stiffness, confusion, seizures, rapid breathing, or purpura.

triage.headline_ja: 無症候性キャリアからの髄膜炎菌感染に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で学生4名の髄膜炎菌感染症クラスター（死亡1名）が発生し、無症候性キャリアによる学校内感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、重症度・流行性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌感染症は既知の疾患でIHR国際通報相当ではないが、学校での集団発生・死亡例・無症候性キャリアによる潜在的拡大リスクがあり、国内公衆衛生上の注意喚起として社会的関心が高いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ramalan Zodiak 28 Oktober 2026, Waspadai Penyakit di Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Horoscope for October 28, 2026: Beware of diseases in the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Indonesia is in the rainy season, with multiple regions experiencing wet weather that can weaken immunity and accelerate virus transmission. The article flags diarrheal disease, abdominal bloating, and influenza as key health risks amid the downpour. It urges routines to bolster defenses: regular vitamin intake, consistent rest, and avoiding outdoor activities during heavy rain. If possible, stay indoors and minimize prolonged exposure to rain showers. The forecasted content frames these health cautions within the October 28, 2026 zodiac predictions, emphasizing personal health vigilance across all signs. No specific outbreak counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources are reported. The guidance centers on preventive measures, hydration, nutrition, and prudent timing of activities to curb seasonal illnesses during Indonesia's monsoon period.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年10月28日の星座占い：雨季の病気に注意
triage.triage_reason: 占いコンテンツの一部として一般的な季節性疾患への注意喚起をしているのみで、具体的な発生事例や症例数の報告がなく、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は星座占いコンテンツであり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。インフルエンザは季節性の一般的注意喚起として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Các trường tại TPHCM tăng cường phòng bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City schools strengthen meningococcal disease prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City schools strengthened meningococcal disease prevention amid local cases. Dang Tran Con Primary School in Vinh Hoa ward intensified cleaning, ventilation, and hand hygiene; daily health checks at the first period, with teachers coordinating with school health staff and parents. Students are taught to recognise warning signs, wash hands, cover coughs, avoid sharing drinks, and wear masks in crowds; vaccination history and antibiotic prophylaxis are reviewed with authorities. On Oct 26, Bình Đông Health Station conducted outreach at five elementary schools, reaching over 7,200 pupils and staff with guidance on symptoms and hygiene. Chợ Lớn ward Health Station held sessions at seven schools, focusing on meningococcal disease and respiratory infections, listing serious signs and using websites, social media, and Zalo to engage parents. Hai Bà Trưng outbreak: Hiệp Phước Health Station reports end of 10-day surveillance on Oct 25; no new positives; ongoing surveillance. Door-to-door teams in Hiệp Phước continue outreach.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の学校、髄膜炎菌感染症の予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市内の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症への予防策が強化されているが、Hiệp Phướcの監視は新規陽性なしで終了しており、現時点では深刻な拡大は確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市の学校における髄膜炎菌感染症の予防教育・衛生対策の強化を報じており、Hiệp Phướcでの10日間の監視は新規陽性者なしで終了している。深刻な拡大や国際的影響の兆候は見られず、ローカルな公衆衛生対応として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Nơi có sốt rét, người dân cần làm ngay những điều này để phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In areas where malaria is present, residents should immediately take these steps to prevent malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria detected in Khánh Hòa province, Vietnam, during a 100-day control campaign launched Aug 17, 2026 to screen, prevent, and eliminate malaria in high-risk forested and farmed areas. From Aug 17 to Oct 8, 2026, health teams reached about 1,827 at-risk individuals and found 35 cases of malaria (Nam Khánh Vĩnh 18; Tây Khánh Vĩnh 14; Trung Khánh Vĩnh 2; Khánh Vĩnh 1). Measures include checkpoints near forests, mobile screening teams, twice-daily radio alerts on disease hotspots, leaflets, and distribution of net screens; residents in high-risk groups signed consent to participate. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; common symptoms are chills, fever, sweating, and thirst, with fever daily or every other day. Without timely treatment, malaria can become severe, particularly for pregnant women and children. Prevention emphasizes insecticide-treated nets, indoor residual spraying, environmental cleanup, sleeping under nets when in forests or at farms, and repellents. An imported malaria case was reported in Hue in a separate SKĐS note.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア流行地域では、住民はこれらの対策をすぐに実施して予防する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カインホア省で既存の100日間マラリア対策キャンペーンの一環として35例が確認されたが、重症例や異常な流行拡大の報告はなく、国内の既存プログラムで管理されている状況。
triage.notes: マラリアはベトナムの一部地域で地域流行的に見られる疾患であり、本記事は啓発・予防キャンペーンの一環として報告されたもの。重症度や国際的拡大の情報は確認されていない。フエでの輸入症例についても言及あるが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola survivor clinics strengthen the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Survivor clinics in the Democratic Republic of the Congo extend Ebola care beyond treatment centres. In Bunia, Ituri Province, the first survivor clinic has been operational since 19 September 2026 and has treated over 400 survivors, with more than 2,700 cured requiring post-recovery follow-up. A second clinic opened in Beni, North Kivu, on 17 October 2026. Clinics provide general medicine, psychology, nutrition, laboratory testing, and follow-ups averaging about two hours, addressing long-term physical and cognitive effects (joint pain, fatigue, memory issues) and psychological stress, while supporting social reintegration and reducing stigma. They also conduct biological surveillance due to persistence of Ebola in certain fluids, notably semen; condoms are distributed to mitigate transmission risk. WHO emphasizes survivor follow-up to prevent resurgence and deliver holistic care. Community mobilizers report high engagement, with more than 90% of contacted survivors attending follow-up consultations, integrating these clinics into the broader outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱生存者クリニックがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知のコンゴ民主共和国エボラ流行における生存者フォローアップ体制の強化を伝える内容であり、新規症例急増や国際的拡大等の新たなシグナルは示されていないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO AFROによる既存エボラ流行への対応強化（生存者ケア・精液等による持続感染リスク管理）の報告であり、新規発生や急激な感染拡大を示す情報ではない。継続的な流行監視の一環として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Stella Dimoko Korkus.com: NCDC Hints On Election Postponement If Ebola Spreads In Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Nigeria prompts consideration of postponing the 2027 general election. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) on 2026-10-27 said the polls, scheduled to begin in January 2027, could be postponed if Ebola spreads widely enough, though there is currently no need. NCDC Director General Jide Idris, speaking on Channels Television's Politics Today, emphasized that no government will use Ebola as a political tool. Nigeria has reported Ebola cases in recent days as authorities monitor the situation. Idris noted the outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and could enter Nigeria due to population movement, flights, and ports of entry. For now, authorities are monitoring and no decision on postponing elections has been made, even as campaigns proceed ahead of the January start date.

triage.headline_ja: Stella Dimoko Korkus.com: ナイジェリアでエボラが拡大すれば選挙延期の可能性、NCDCが示唆
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱がナイジェリアへの越境拡大の懸念を招き、選挙延期まで検討される事態となっており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの対応（選挙延期の是非）だが、アウトブレイクの発生源・実際の流行地はDRCであり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。ナイジェリア国内での症例報告についても言及があるが、DRCでの発生が一次情報源であるため、DRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sulawesi Selatan Jadi Sorotan: Kasus Kusta Tinggi, 10.000 Orang Diberi Obat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sulawesi Under the Spotlight: High Leprosy Cases, 10,000 People Given Medication.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) remains a major focus in South Sulawesi, Indonesia, as the Ministry of Health reports 13,297 suspected cases identified among 25.2 million people aged one year and up screened under the Free Health Check (CKG) program in 2026. Sulawesi Selatan is among provinces with the highest newly detected leprosy cases, prompting intensified surveillance and early-detection efforts to accelerate Indonesia’s elimination target. During a ceremony marking Sulsel's anniversary on 27 October 2026, Director General of Disease Prevention and Control Andi Saguni emphasized that early detection improves cure chances and urged the public not to fear higher case counts. The plan includes screening 10,000 people and providing chemoprophylaxis to close contacts of confirmed leprosy patients to interrupt transmission. The government aims not only to reduce trend but to eliminate leprosy in Sulawesi Selatan and nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシが注目:ハンセン病の症例が多数、1万人に薬剤を投与
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症で急性の公衆衛生危機ではないが、インドネシア南スラウェシでの高い検出数と政府の積極的なスクリーニング・予防投薬の取り組みが報告されており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は長期潜伏・慢性疾患であり、突発的な公衆衛生危機ではないが、国家の排除目標に向けた政府の積極的対応が社会的関心を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: Швейцарка с ебола е транспортирана от Нигерия в Женева, следят десетки контактни
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Swiss woman with Ebola has been transported from Nigeria to Geneva; dozens of contacts are being monitored.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) case: A Swiss woman treated in Nigeria for Ebola has been medically evacuated to Switzerland with her husband, a Swiss diplomat. Abuja health authorities authorized the departure; the patient had tested positive after returning to Abuja from Uganda. They arrived in Switzerland on a medical evacuation flight; the woman is hospitalized at Geneva University Hospital, while her husband is in isolation at Zurich University Hospital. Nigeria reports no active Ebola cases after evacuation, but 52 contacts remain under observation. The patient’s condition has improved; she is stable, conscious and communicative, but remains potentially infectious, and strict infection-control measures continue. The infection source is under investigation; Swiss authorities say she did not visit DR Congo, with infection suspected during travel to Uganda. As of 27 October 2026, Kenya reports nine Ebola cases (two deaths) and the DRC outbreak exceeds 9,900 cases and 4,800 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に感染したスイス人女性、ナイジェリアからジュネーブへ搬送、数十人の接触者を追跡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱患者の国際的な医療搬送事例であり、感染経路調査中かつ接触者52名を監視中。加えてDRCで9,900例超・4,800人超の死者を出す大規模流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例自体はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスで発生しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、記事中で言及されているDRCの進行中のエボラ流行（9,900例超、4,800人超の死亡）は対象国であり、文脈上重要なため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, non solo contagi: infermiere ucciso, la disinformazione mette a rischio le cure
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, not just infections: nurse killed, misinformation puts treatments at risk.
article.articleSummary: By Oct 27, 2026, Ebola Bundibugyo continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with 9,964 confirmed cases and over 4,800 deaths as of Oct 26, spanning 66 health zones in eight provinces. In Bafwasende, Tshopo, an Ebola-awareness nurse was killed on Oct 23 during an assault linked to contamination fears; a colleague was injured. Misinformation worsens outcomes: a Congolese mother delayed hospital care for her six-year-old, who died after fever and vomiting were misattributed to malaria. The health ministry and WHO trained 100 traditional healers, 20 influencers, and 150 helpline operators; Ituri province countered over 1,000 misinformation voices. Cross-border activity includes Kenya with nine cases (four health workers, two deaths) and Nigeria with one imported case; the Swiss citizen patient from Uganda was repatriated after stabilization. On Oct 23, Bunia began the Tumaini vaccine trial with a first dose; Uganda tightened border controls.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、感染だけでなく:看護師殺害、誤情報が治療を危険にさらす
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は9,964例・4,800人超の死亡に達し、国際的拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス人患者）や渡航制限（ウガンダの国境強化）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行が主題。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境事例も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。誤情報による医療従事者への暴力や治療忌避が公衆衛生対応を複雑化させている点が特記される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola a ajuns din nou în Europa. O femeie infectată, transportată din Nigeria în Elveția. Autoritățile explică riscul de răspândire - Aktual24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has arrived in Europe once again. An infected woman transported from Nigeria to Switzerland. Authorities explain the risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has reached Europe as a 42-year-old Swiss citizen infected with the Bundibugyo variant was transported from Nigeria to Switzerland by air medical transport. The patient was admitted to an isolation unit in Geneva; her diplomat husband in Zurich was quarantined as a close contact. She was diagnosed with Ebola on October 20 in Abuja, Nigeria, Nigeria's first confirmed case in over a decade. The patient is stable, aware, and communicative, but potentially contagious; conditions improved before transfer. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated objects, not through air travel; strict protective measures are in place. Switzerland notes no population risk. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments. As of October 20, Congo reports 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths; Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria have also recorded cases. Source is under investigation; she travelled to Uganda but did not visit DRC. Nigeria monitors 52 contacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが再びヨーロッパに到達。感染した女性がナイジェリアからスイスへ搬送される。当局が拡散リスクを説明
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年ぶりに確認されたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）患者が国際医療搬送によりスイスへ運ばれた事例であり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ患者のスイスへの国際搬送事例。ナイジェリア・スイス・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中のエボラ流行の規模（9,704症例、4,687死亡）が具体的に記載されているため発生国として記載。ナイジェリアでの10年ぶりの症例確認という異常性、国際医療搬送による越境事例という点で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые рассказали об особенностях штамма-ультрамутанта коронавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists described the features of the ultra-mutant coronavirus strain.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, an ultra-mutant coronavirus variant actively circulating in Canada, the United States, and Europe, could reach Russia soon. It carries numerous mutations, especially in the spike protein, and shows markedly higher binding to the human ACE2 receptor. German researchers identified PJ.2.1 in May 2026, noting it differs substantially from predecessors and predominantly affects people aged 60 and older; Chinese researchers call it “jumping” due to the large number of changes. While it currently does not exhibit immune evasion, the enhanced receptor binding provides a “buffer” to accumulate mutations aimed at escaping immune protection, according to Izvestiya. Expert Albert Rizvanov of Kazan Federal University’s Center for Excellence in Personalized Medicine cautions that more mutations do not automatically mean greater danger or faster spread, and a new wave is not guaranteed. Mutations often arise in immunocompromised patients with prolonged infections.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らが新型コロナウイルスの超変異株の特徴を説明
triage.triage_reason: 新たな超変異株PJ.2.1がカナダ・米国・欧州で広がりつつあるが、対象国での発生は確認されておらず、重症度や免疫逃避についても専門家は慎重な見解を示しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア語メディアによる科学的解説記事で、変異株PJ.2.1はカナダ・米国・欧州で確認されているとされる。中国の研究者が命名に関与したとの記述はあるが、中国国内での発生を示す記述はないため、対象国（China含む）はverified_locationsに含めない。
