article.articleHeadline: 5 dấu hiệu cảnh báo bệnh cúm chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 warning signs that the flu is getting worse
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) remains a concern in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, as of 27 October 2026, where the CDC notes over 34,000 respiratory infection cases in the past week, up 64% from the four-week average; hospitalized samples show A/H1N1 accounting for about 77% of influenza positives. Warning signs of worsening flu: 1) difficulty breathing, rapid breathing, or SpO2 below 95% at rest; 2) chest pain or a rapid, pounding heartbeat; 3) vomiting, poor appetite or dehydration; 4) confusion, drowsiness, or seizures; 5) sudden loss of control of chronic diseases (heart failure signs; diabetic ketoacidosis; asthma or COPD flare). Seek urgent care if these occur, especially with age extremes or pregnancy. Bacterial pneumonia can follow, requiring tests and antibiotics if indicated. Prevention includes rest, fluids, hand hygiene, masks; vaccination from 6 months and yearly; vaccines include Vaxigrip, Influvac, GC Flu Quadrivalent, IVACFLU-S, targeting A/H1N1, A/H3N2, B/Victoria. Pregnancy vaccination advised any trimester.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが重症化する5つの警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（A/H1N1）の症例増加が報告されているが、健康啓発的な内容で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクを示す情報はなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市で呼吸器感染症例が過去4週平均比64%増加し、A/H1N1が陽性例の約77%を占めるとの報告。ただし記事内容は主に市民向けの注意喚起・予防啓発であり、重症度や死亡率についての具体的データは記載されていない。季節性インフルエンザの流行として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: No Nigērijas uz Šveici evakuēta ar Ebolas vīrusu inficēta sieviete
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus-infected woman evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October, an Ebola virus–infected woman was evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland. In Geneva she is hospitalized, while her Swiss diplomat husband in Nigeria is in isolation in Zurich; Swiss authorities say both hospitals are prepared and public risk is negligible. In Nigeria, 52 contacts are under surveillance and there are no further active Ebola cases after the evacuation. The infection was detected after the woman returned to Abuja from Uganda; exact exposure remains under investigation. Elsewhere, Kenya has nine cases and two deaths since the first October case, with 20 people released from quarantine and 98 more slated for release next week. The Democratic Republic of the Congo continues the largest outbreak, with over 9,900 cases and more than 4,800 deaths since May; WHO calls it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date and warns deaths could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of about 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染女性、ナイジェリアからスイスへ搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）では死者4,800人超・症例9,900人超に達し、WHOが「史上最速拡大のエボラ流行」と警告している。ナイジェリア・ケニア・スイスへの波及も確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアからスイスへの輸出症例だが、DRCにおける進行中の大規模流行（史上最速拡大との評価）が最も重大な公衆衛生上の懸念点である。ナイジェリア・ケニア・スイス・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 被指散播伊波拉病毒　剛果醫護人員遭暴力攻擊身亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese healthcare workers killed in violent attack after being accused of spreading Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a violent attack against healthcare workers in Tshopo Province. In Bafwasende town, a senior nurse, longtime staff at a local general hospital and active in Ebola prevention outreach, was killed when a group of youths armed with machetes and sticks accosted her and a colleague, a teacher assisting community education, while they assessed a land plot. The assailants accused them of spreading Ebola and contaminating water via toilets and rivers, and the attack escalated, leaving the nurse dead and the teacher injured and hospitalized. Local health officials expressed shock, noting the deceased was a well-known medical worker. After the assault, other healthcare staff sought shelter in the hospital and requested police protection amid fears of further attacks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス散布の疑いをかけられたコンゴの医療従事者、暴力攻撃を受け死亡
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、医療従事者への暴力攻撃が発生、対応能力への悪影響や地域拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: エボラ対応に対する地域住民の不信・誤情報が医療従事者への暴力に発展しており、アウトブレイク対応そのものへの支障が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Cattle Farmer's Arthritis Puzzle Traced to Probable Brucellosis
article.articleSummary: 58-year-old cattle farmer in China developed intermittent chills, dry mouth/eyes, and progressive inflammatory polyarthritis involving wrists, MCP/PIP joints, elbows, shoulders, knees, ankles and feet. Lab data showed very high CRP (up to 205 mg/L) and ESR (75 mm/h); autoimmune panels including RF and anti-CCP were negative. Extensive testing for TB, CMV and EBV was unrevealing. Musculoskeletal ultrasound confirmed synovitis; 18F-FDG PET/CT showed uptake around shoulders, hips and sternoclavicular joints, with additional spinal and rib-vertebral uptake; numerous FDG-avid lymph nodes were seen, plus C5 marrow signal changes. Right inguinal lymph node biopsy revealed reactive lymphoid hyperplasia with granulomatous inflammation. In light of long-term cattle exposure, Brucella serology was positive (Rose Bengal and Brucella IgG; standard tube agglutination 1:100). Working diagnosis: probable systemic brucellosis with inflammatory arthritis, granulomatous lymphadenitis and suspected cervical spondylitis. Blood and bone marrow cultures were negative; IgM data not provided; serology context cautions apply (1:100 threshold vs international 1:160).

triage.headline_ja: 牛農家の関節炎の謎、ブルセラ症の可能性にたどり着く
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の臨床症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者の症例報告（臨床診断の過程を記述）であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Attackers kill nurse, injure health worker responding to case - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: Two health workers responding to an Ebola alert in Bafwasende, a town in eastern DRC's Tshopo Province, were attacked: a nurse was killed and another health worker severely injured. The incident occurred as the DRC confronts the largest and deadliest phase of the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed condolences and called for safe, dignified work for responders. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi condemned the attack, stating health workers must be protected and that misinformation and fear must not fuel violence. The outbreak remains active across multiple provinces and 66 health zones. As of 24 October, WHO epidemiological update tallies 9,964 confirmed cases and 4,841 deaths, with 2,670 recoveries. The attack highlights ongoing security risks for outbreak response teams, with no details on infection source or laboratory confirmation provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:襲撃者が対応中の看護師を殺害、医療従事者を負傷させる - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模・最も致死的なブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ関連）の流行が継続しており、約1万人の感染者・4,800人超の死者を記録。加えて対応要員への襲撃という治安上の重大リスクも発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療従事者への襲撃事件を主題とするが、背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行自体が極めて深刻であり、既にWHOも関与する重大事案。続報でのアウトブレイク制御状況・治安状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria houdt 52 ebolacontacten in de gaten na evacuatie Zwitserse patiënt naar Zwitserland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria monitors 52 Ebola contacts after evacuation of Swiss patient to Switzerland
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Nigerian health authorities are monitoring 52 contacts of a Swiss Ebola patient who was evacuated to Switzerland after receiving initial care in Nigeria; no active Ebola cases remain in Nigeria. Nigeria activated its highest incident-management level and reinforced screening and isolation. Contact tracing proceeds for 21 days from last exposure, including medical staff and others who met the patient after she fell ill. The patient developed symptoms on October 7, sought care October 10 in a clinic, was admitted October 11, and laboratory confirmation followed on October 20. She was stabilized and flown to Geneva; her husband remains isolated in Zurich and counted as the 53rd contact. The case is linked to travel from Uganda via Entebbe on October 3, with investigators examining overlap with a Kenyan case; the outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Nigeria cites 2014 Lagos experience; resource constraints remain a challenge.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、スイス人患者のスイスへの退避後もエボラ接触者52人を監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの3項目が該当し、DRC由来のエボラ患者が国境を越えて搬送されるなど国際的波及が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はDRCで発生したアウトブレイクに由来し、ウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに患者が到達、その後スイスへ空輸された国際症例。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外し、起源国であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Triển khai tập huấn giáo viên, nhân viên y tế lan tỏa kiến thức phòng chống bệnh dại đến 65.000 học sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roll out training for teachers and healthcare workers to disseminate rabies prevention knowledge to 65,000 students.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention education drive rolled out by Boehringer Ingelheim Việt Nam under STOP Rabies aims to reach over 65,000 primary and secondary school students in 2026 across Tây Ninh and Đồng Tháp, with training for 240 teachers and school health staff. The program uses a Train-the-Trainer model, delivering age-appropriate materials (stories, handouts, activities) to empower educators to teach students who can share knowledge with families. In Tây Ninh, activities target about 30,000 students and 116 educators; in Đồng Tháp, about 35,000 students and 124 educators. The effort follows 2025 gains in Tây Ninh (30,000 students reached, 119 staff trained in 58 schools) and expands to Đồng Tháp. Rabies remains a major public health challenge: globally ~59,000 deaths per year (WHO). Vietnam recorded over 90,000 bite or scratch incidents and 323 rabies deaths in 2022–2025, with 54 deaths in the first nine months of 2026 across 21 provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 教員・医療従事者向け研修を展開し、65,000人の生徒に狂犬病予防知識を普及
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病であり本記事は予防教育プログラムの紹介だが、死亡者数データ（2026年9か月で54人、21省）が継続的な公衆衛生課題を示しており経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防教育プログラムの広報が主題であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。既存の風土病としての継続的な死亡報告（2022-2025年323人、2026年9か月で54人）が含まれるが、これは既知のベースライン状況を示すものであり、フルRRAの緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼野火燒不停！逾30萬人呼吸道感染 居民嘆：吸進去都是毒藥 | 四方報 | 全球 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesian wildfires continue to burn! Over 300,000 people have respiratory infections; residents lament: what you inhale is poison | Sifang News | Global | NOWnews Today's News
article.articleSummary: Wildfires in Indonesia's Kalimantan drive severe haze across seven provinces, triggering respiratory infections in more than 300,000 people from August to October, according to the Health Ministry. The capital of Central Kalimantan, Palangkaraya, reports over 11,000 affected. Smoke contains formaldehyde, hydrogen cyanide, ammonia, and PM2.5, which can penetrate the lungs and enter the bloodstream per WHO. Nusantara Atlas estimates wildfire destruction exceeding 1.9 million hectares in the first nine months; government has not confirmed this figure. To mitigate health risks, Indonesia operates nearly 500 free oxygen points nationwide, with about 300 in Central Kalimantan; oxygen-equipped buses have been deployed in Palangkaraya. Residents report red eyes, throat pain, and coughing; daily 20-minute commutes become torturous. A 57-year-old Sudarsono collapsed after firefighting exposure; 43-year-old Alexandra Surya Habsari sought nebulized therapy and oxygen at an NGO medical station. Cross-border haze prompts neighboring countries' protests and domestic calls for stronger fire control.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの森林火災が止まらない！30万人超が呼吸器感染、住民『吸い込むのは毒だ』と嘆く
triage.triage_reason: 本事象は森林火災による大気汚染（ヘイズ）が原因の非感染性呼吸器症状であり、病原体によるヒト-ヒト感染やアウトブレイクのリスクはないため、感染症EBSのシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事象は感染症ではなく森林火災によるヘイズ(煙害)が原因の環境健康問題。Unknown Illnessと分類されているが病原体によるものではなく、IHR/WPRO基準は環境公衆衛生事象として部分的に該当するが、感染症EBSの対象シグナルとしては見送り（DISMISS）が妥当。越境大気汚染として近隣国への影響はあるが、感染拡大リスクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Antequera doctors join DRC mission to combat Ebola and cholera epidemics | Sur in English
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Malaga province doctors with Doctors of the World joined a mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s South Kivu to bolster Ebola and cholera responses in water-scarce areas. Working in Miti-Muherca and Katana districts, they assist local staff facing shortages of protective equipment and personnel. At Lugendo health centre, lack of clean water impaired oral rehydration for cholera patients; an emergency water delivery was arranged. The mission aims to establish triage across 14 facilities to identify, isolate, and treat suspected Ebola, while screening for fever and malaria. A ten-point guide on infection prevention and patient management was drafted for daily use. Cholera persists with 20 public water chlorination points; plans include more storage tanks and rainwater harvesting. Katana reports a measles epidemic, with weekly cases declining after a vaccination campaign.

triage.headline_ja: アンテケラの医師団、エボラ出血熱とコレラの流行対策のためコンゴ民主共和国での任務に参加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国南キブ州でエボラ出血熱・コレラ・麻疹が同時に流行しており、国際医療チームが対応にあたっている。IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: スペインの医師団派遣は支援活動の文脈であり、感染症発生国はDRC南キブ州のみ。エボラ・コレラ・麻疹の複合流行で医療資源・水資源不足が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Niger Confirms Receipt Of N21.6m For Ebola Preparedness, Constitutes Emergency Committee
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Niger State, Nigeria, confirms receipt of 21.6 million naira from the federal government to intensify Ebola preparedness after the discovery of an Ebola case in Abuja. The Health Commissioner announces a Multisectoral Emergency Response Committee to bolster surveillance, isolation and cross-border monitoring, with no confirmed Ebola case in Niger. Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago has directed funds for a modern isolation centre. Federal funds extend to all states to support EVD preparedness. Niger will strengthen disease surveillance through local government teams, alert health facilities, review referral arrangements, and reinforce infection prevention to protect health workers and patients. Collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Health will boost surveillance at Minna airport and the Babana border in Borgu LGA. The WHO October 23 update cites 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths in the DRC as of Oct 20 across 66 health zones in eight provinces."}

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア・ニジェール州、エボラ対策準備のため2160万ナイラの受領を確認、緊急委員会を設置
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（9,704症例、4,687死亡）が継続中であり、ナイジェリアでもアブジャでの症例発見を受けた緊急対応体制構築が進められているなど、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ニジェール州のエボラ対策準備であるが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、WHO統計として引用されているDRCでの実際のエボラ流行（9,704症例、4,687死亡）は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に計上した。アブジャでの症例発見については詳細が記事本文になく、ナイジェリア国内での感染拡大の実態は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Whole-genome sequencing maps tuberculosis lineages and drug resistance
article.articleSummary: Indonesia, responsible for about 10% of global tuberculosis cases per WHO 2025, now has its most comprehensive whole-genome TB map to date. In a cross-sectional study, 1,281 Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates were sequenced from the 2017–2018 National Drug-Resistant TB Survey across 12 provinces, 40 districts, and 70 facilities. Following Xpert MTB/RIF screening and MGIT 960 phenotypic DST, 1,598 eligible specimens yielded analyzable genomes (80.2%). Illumina MiSeq sequencing with MTBseq detected four of seven global lineages: Lineage 4 Euro-American (43.1%), Lineage 2 (30.4%), Lineage 1 ancient (26.3%), and two Lineage 3 isolates—the first reported in Indonesia—from Central Java and South Sulawesi, both fully susceptible. Sublineages: L2.2.1 18.5%, L1.2.1 11.3%, L4.1.2.1 9.7%. Drug resistance centered on isoniazid (katG S315T; 7.5%) and rifampicin (rpoB S450L; 5%), with compensatory rpoC mutations I885V and L527V. New-case INH 9.51%, rifampicin 7.90%; retreatment INH 17.84%, rifampicin 16.70%.

triage.headline_ja: 全ゲノムシーケンシングによりインドネシア全土の結核系統と薬剤耐性を解明
triage.triage_reason: 2017-2018年の既存サーベイランスデータに基づく学術的な遺伝疫学研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2017-2018年の国家薬剤耐性結核調査データを用いた遺伝子解析研究の報告であり、急性の感染症イベントではない。結核自体は既知の風土病でありシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼野火燒不停！逾30萬人呼吸道感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia wildfires rage on! More than 300,000 people have respiratory infections.
article.articleSummary: Wildfires in Indonesia drive severe air pollution across at least seven provinces, triggering more than 300,000 respiratory infections from August to October. Central Kalimantan's Palangkaraya is the hardest hit, with over 11,000 medical visits for respiratory illness. The smoke contains formaldehyde, hydrogen cyanide, ammonia, and PM2.5, which can reach the lungs and bloodstream. The Health Ministry warns that long-term PM2.5 exposure increases disease and mortality risk. The Nusantara Atlas estimates fire destruction at over 1.9 million hectares in the first nine months, though the government has not confirmed the figure. In response, nearly 500 free oxygen and haze-treatment points have been set up nationwide, including about 300 in Central Kalimantan, plus oxygen-equipped mobile buses in Palangkaraya. Residents report eye irritation, throat pain, coughing, and daily commutes that feel like torture. Cross-border haze has sparked regional protests demanding stronger fire control.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの森林火災が収まらず、30万人超が呼吸器感染症に
triage.triage_reason: 森林火災由来の大気汚染により7州で30万人超の呼吸器感染が報告され、越境ヘイズによる地域的な公衆衛生影響と抗議活動も発生しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例は病原体による感染症ではなく、森林火災による大気汚染（PM2.5、ホルムアルデヒド等）が原因の呼吸器症状であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはないが、健康被害の規模と越境影響の観点からシグナルとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: משרד הבריאות עקב התפרצות אבולה באפריקה: הימנעו מנסיעה לקונגו ולמדינות סמוכות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: Ebola outbreak in Africa — avoid travel to the Congo and neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with over 9,800 confirmed cases and at least 4,750 deaths; cases also reported in Kenya and Nigeria, with no community transmission detected there. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May 2026, but not a pandemic, and no border closures or travel bans were advised. The Ministry of Health urges avoiding travel to the affected DRC provinces Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Sud-Ubangi, and Nord-Ubangi, and to limit nonessential travel to neighboring Uganda, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, and the Republic of Congo; Kenya and Nigeria travel should be reassessed. Returnees within 21 days of leaving DRC with fever >38C or other symptoms should stay home and call the MOH hotline *5400; do not seek medical care without prior coordination and must mention DRC exposure. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids of patients or the deceased, or via contaminated objects or animals; incubation 2–21 days, with symptoms including fever, muscle pains, vomiting, and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル保健省、アフリカでのエボラ流行を受けコンゴおよび周辺国への渡航自粛を勧告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ大規模流行（9,800例以上、死者4,750人以上）で、国際的拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリアに波及）と渡航制限勧告が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行とそれに伴う他国（ケニア、ナイジェリア等）への波及、渡航制限に焦点。対象国リストの中で実際の流行発生国はDRCのみ。ザンビアは渡航自粛勧告の対象国として言及されているが、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bánh mì Bà Được chi trả cho 175 người bị ngộ độc, nhiều người phản ứng mức bồi thường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mrs. Được’s banh mi: compensation paid to 175 people who were poisoned; many react to the amount.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella outbreak linked to Banh Mi Ba Duoc at 12 Duy Tan, Cam Thanh Ward, Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam, hospitalized 175 people. Symptom onset began Oct 10 with abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever; hospitalizations rose to 135 by Oct 12 and 175 by Oct 16. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang confirmed contamination, finding Salmonella spp. in 12 of 13 food samples; some samples also contained Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. On Oct 27, representatives paid compensation to 175 affected individuals, but about 40 refused, deeming payments inadequate for health damage, income loss, and days off work. The payout plan was revised to cover medical costs not paid by health insurance, plus wage loss (2,000,000 VND per day?; note: 200,000 VND per day) and meals (100,000 VND per day), with invoices for medicines. Some accepted the offer after fatigue; one recipient received 2.1 million VND. As of Oct 27, 2026, penalties for the shop had not been announced.

triage.headline_ja: バーズオックのバインミー食中毒、175人に補償金支払い 一部は補償額に不満
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食品媒介性サルモネラ食中毒事例であり、原因は特定・封じ込め済みで、現在は補償交渉の段階にある。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 175人が入院したベトナム・クアンガイ省の食中毒事例。原因食品（バインミー）からサルモネラ菌等が検出され、既に補償支払いの段階に入っている。死亡例や二次感染の報告はなく、局地的な食品衛生問題として扱うのが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera on passenger train as 25 test positive - Times of Zambia
article.articleSummary: Cholera on a passenger train in Chilanga, Zambia, triggers quarantine of about 500 passengers after 25 developed symptoms. The South-Bound Zambia Railways Limited train, originating from Kitwe and boarding in Kapiri Mposhi, halted near Mapepe at ~07:00 following an initial case with vomiting and diarrhea. Affected individuals were isolated and transported to Chilanga Health Cholera Treatment Centre; ages ranged from 1 year to 80. Health authorities mobilized 500 doses of cholera vaccine to vaccinate all passengers, alongside food, water, tents, toilets, and other supplies for stranded travelers. Nationwide, 68 new cholera cases with one death were reported yesterday, bringing cumulative cases to 1,488 and deaths to 29, with 103 patients still admitted. Containment measures continue as authorities monitor spread and determine next steps.

triage.headline_ja: 旅客列車内でコレラ発生、25人が陽性反応 - タイムズ・オブ・ザンビア
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア国内で大規模なコレラ流行が継続中であり、旅客列車内での集団発生により約500人が隔離される事態となっている。累計1,488症例・29死亡という規模は公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクを示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ザンビアでは既存のコレラ流行が継続しており、累計症例数・死者数から見て国内で大規模な公衆衛生危機となっている。列車内発生は人の移動による拡散リスクを示す具体例。国際的な拡大（他国への越境）の直接的証拠は記事になく、「国際的拡大リスク」はヒト-ヒト感染・人の移動による国内拡散の observation に基づく推定。

article.articleHeadline: A UAV Imagery Dataset of Potential Aedes aegypti Mosquito Breeding Containers - Scientific Data
article.articleSummary: A UAV imagery dataset documents potential Aedes aegypti mosquito breeding containers in urban and peri-urban Tamil Nadu, India, to support surveillance and control of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. Images captured at 50–65 meters above ground were photogrammetrically processed into orthomosaics and tiled into 512 × 512 images. Five container types were annotated with bounding boxes: coconut shells, drums, tires, water tanks, and other containers. The dataset is provided in COCO, YOLOv8, and Pascal VOC formats, with predefined training, validation, and test splits, enabling standardized benchmarking. A baseline object-detection experiment demonstrates usability for automated identification of breeding habitats in UAV imagery. This data descriptor advances public health research by enabling rapid analysis of urban container habitats, supporting vector surveillance and targeted vector-control strategies in Tamil Nadu; the work is published in Scientific Data with early-access DOI.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の潜在的な産卵容器に関するUAV画像データセット - Scientific Data誌
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、蚊媒介性疾患の監視支援を目的とした学術的なUAV画像データセットに関する研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や懸念を示す情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、蚊媒介性感染症の監視技術に関する研究データセットの紹介記事であるため、トリアージ対象外（発生地域としてインド・タミルナドゥ州が記載されているが、実際の症例発生報告ではないためverified_locationsには含めない）。

article.articleHeadline: पुणे में डेंगू आउटब्रेक! 8 संदिग्ध मौतें, रोजाना 1500 यूनिट ब्लड की जरूरत, अस्पताल में बेड से लेकर प्लेटलेट्स तक की कमी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak in Pune! 8 suspected deaths, daily need of 1,500 units of blood, shortage of beds to platelets in hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Pune, Maharashtra, with over 2,413 dengue cases recorded Jan 1–Oct 20 this year, and a 66% surge in August–October. Eight suspected dengue deaths reported, including an 8-year-old girl from Lohgaon. Hotspots are Kothrud, Nagar Road–Vadgaon Sheri, and Aundh–Baner. Daily platelet demand is about 1,500–1,600 units, while banks collect 700–800 units; donor shortages during festivals worsen gaps. Platelet counts in dengue patients are dropping toward 20,000/µL or lower, raising bleeding risk; platelets store for only five days. Private hospitals have 4,409 beds (670 ICU), with 333 beds reserved in municipal facilities. Free dengue testing via rapid kits in municipal and private hospitals; 1.4 million homes inspected. Authorities push aggressive vector control (fogging) and require data entry on the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP).

triage.headline_ja: プネーでデング熱アウトブレイク！疑い死亡8人、1日1500単位の血液が必要、病床から血小板まで不足
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州プネーでデング熱症例が急増（8月〜10月で66%増）し、疑い死亡8人、血液・血小板・病床の深刻な不足が報告されており、公衆衛生への影響が大きく医療体制が逼迫している。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に流行する疾患だが、今回は症例急増・死亡例・医療資源逼迫（血液/血小板/病床不足）が顕著であり、地域医療システムへの負荷が高い。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国内での感染拡大・管理状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'Afrique face à une épidémie d'Ebola "plus complexe que prévu", selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa faces an Ebola outbreak 'more complex than expected', according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is described by the WHO as more complex than expected, with over 10,000 cases and at least 4,600 deaths to date. There is no effective vaccine for the current strain; vaccine testing uses the Zaire strain, while two other vaccine trials are in development, including an mRNA-based approach. Transmission remains through contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever. The case fatality rate is about 50% in adults and up to 80% in children; MSF notes alarmingly low survival among children and highlights that kids are under-vaccinated and under-researched in campaigns. The outbreak extends across North Kivu in a war zone, complicating access and data reliability. Imported/exported cases include a Nigerian case (Swiss woman) with about 50 contacts; Kenya reported a second death on Oct 23. An earlier estimate cited 8,300 cases and 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカはWHOによれば「予想以上に複雑」なエボラ出血熱の流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万例・4600人以上の死亡に達し、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（スイス人女性の輸入症例）およびケニア（2人目の死亡確認）への拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。戦争地域（北キブ州）でのアクセス困難とデータ信頼性の問題も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra : neuf cas détectés à la prison centrale de Walikale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera: Nine cases detected at the Walikale Central Prison.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak detected in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with nine cases at Walikale Central Prison identified on Oct 25 and nine more cases at the Walikale General Referral Hospital where patients are receiving treatment. Officials are implementing measures to care for patients and limit transmission, aiming to break the contamination chain in the prison and prevent additional cases. The Walikale authorities urge the public to strictly follow barrier measures; cholera spreads primarily via contaminated water or food, underscoring the need to strengthen prevention, ensure access to potable water, and reinforce hygiene practices to curb the outbreak in this region. Current as of 27 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ：ワリカレ中央刑務所で9例検出
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州の刑務所でコレラ集団発生が確認されたが、規模は限定的で現時点では国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは不明。コレラの流行しやすさから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 刑務所という閉鎖集団空間での発生であり、水・衛生環境の管理不足がある場合は拡大リスクがある。DRCは既知のコレラ流行地域であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 10 ngày theo dõi, ổ dịch não mô cầu ở Hiệp Phước, TP.HCM không phát sinh ca mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ten days of surveillance: No new cases in the meningococcal outbreak in Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Ten days after the last meningococcal case (Oct 15) in Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, surveillance at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School ended on Oct 25 with no new cases. About 200 close contacts completed monitoring; none developed symptoms or tested positive. The week of Oct 14–20 saw five meningococcal disease cases, all group B: four students at Hai Bà Trưng Middle School and one student at Ngô Thời Nhiệm School (Bình Dương Ward). One student died. Rapid prophylactic antibiotics were given to high‑risk contacts overnight. Local health teams linked to communities were credited for rapid response; authorities plan to roll out continuous-health-care teams to all local health stations. Parents are urged to check vaccination status and have children receive meningococcal vaccines appropriate for age and health, with a question raised about administering group B vaccine while awaiting reminders for groups A, C, W, Y.

triage.headline_ja: 10日間の監視を経て、ホーチミン市ヒエップフォックの髄膜炎菌感染症の流行は新規症例なし
triage.triage_reason: 既にアウトブレイクは収束傾向(新規症例なし)だが、学校関連クラスターで死亡例も発生しており、今後の再燃や他地域拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 既に収束が確認されたアウトブレイクであり、地域内の学校クラスターでの管理下にある事例。死亡例(1名)が発生しているが、ワクチン接種呼びかけや迅速な予防的抗生物質投与など当局の対応は適切に機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Pamekasan tekan kasus demam berdarah dengan PSN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pamekasan Regency Government curbs dengue cases with PSN.
article.articleSummary: Pamekasan Regency, East Java, Indonesia, is stepping up dengue fever (DBD) control with mosquito nest eradication (PSN) and the 3M campaign (drain, cover, bury). As of 23 October 2026, 380 people tested positive for dengue from across 13 subdistricts, with 4 deaths. Age distribution includes 5–15 years (155 cases), 15–44 years (127), and over 45 years (37). DBD cases this year are lower than 2024 (844 cases, 8 deaths) and 2025 (467 cases, 0 deaths). Other measures include strengthening health-facility readiness (puskesmas, pustu, clinics, hospitals), mandatory multi-tier reporting via a dedicated app, and epidemiological investigations at case locations. Enhanced KIE communications involve cross-sector cooperation with TNI and Polri to broaden village-level outreach and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: パムカサン県政府、PSN（蚊の巣撲滅運動）でデング熱症例を抑制
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東ジャワ州パムカサン県における季節性・風土病的なデング熱の通常の発生状況であり、症例数は過去2年と比較して減少傾向にあり、地域当局による通常の対策（PSN、3M運動）で管理されている。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアの風土病であり、本記事は地域政府による通常の対策活動の報告。症例数は2024年（844例、死亡8名）、2025年（467例、死亡0名）と比較して2026年は380例・死亡4名と減少傾向にあり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola w Europie. Hospitalizowano zakażoną kobietę i jej męża
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Europe. An infected woman and her husband were hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Europe: A woman infected with Ebola, residing in Nigeria, and her Swiss diplomat husband were hospitalized in Switzerland after arriving from Nigeria. The wife had traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda; the husband is asymptomatic. Swiss authorities state the situation poses no public-health threat in Switzerland. The Democratic Republic of Congo continues to experience high Ebola transmission, with WHO reporting 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths. Kenya has reported nine cases; Uganda was declared Ebola-free in August. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, live or deceased, with a 2–21 day incubation (most commonly 8–10 days). In Switzerland, two prior Ebola patients treated there—1995 and 2014—survived. This case highlights ongoing Congo-region transmission and cross-border travel risks.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州でエボラ出血熱。感染した女性とその夫が入院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で高い感染・死亡数が継続する中、渡航を介してスイスへ感染者が持ち込まれるなど国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ国内の感染拡大状況（9,704例確定、4,687例死亡）が主題であり、国際的な渡航関連症例としてスイスで入院事例が発生している点が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: ไวรัส 'มือเท้าปาก' สายพันธุ์ดุ สร้างช่องโหว่ทะลวงเข้าสู่ระบบประสาท ก่อภาวะแทรกซ้อนรุนแรงในเด็ก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virulent strain of the hand-foot-mouth disease virus breaches the nervous system, causing severe complications in children.
article.articleSummary: Thailand-based researchers led by Dr. Anant Jongkaewwattana of NSTDA Biotech report in Nature Communications that Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71), the virulent hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) strain, breaches the blood-brain barrier to cause severe central nervous system complications in children. The virus hijacks extracellular vesicles (EVs) released by infected peripheral cells, which carry high levels of microRNA-30 and microRNA-34 to brain microvascular endothelium, suppressing Notch1 signaling and loosening endothelial junctions, enabling CNS invasion. Restoring Notch1 signaling with JAG1 in 3D cell models and newborn mice re-seals barriers, reduces brain viral load, and improves survival, without altering intestinal viral replication. In pediatric serum, elevated miR-30 and miR-34 correlate with severe neurological disease, suggesting early risk assessment and potential therapies focused on protecting/restoring the brain barrier.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の強毒株ウイルスが神経系に侵入経路を形成、小児に重篤な合併症を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイの研究機関によるEV-A71の病態メカニズムに関する基礎研究報告であり、実際の発生・流行事例の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究論文（Nature Communications掲載）の紹介であり、具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。タイで研究が行われたが、発生国としての報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Может ли вирус Шамонда привести к новой эпидемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could the Shamonda virus lead to a new epidemic?
article.articleSummary: France reports the world’s first human Shamonda virus infection, previously seen only in animals; experts question its potential to trigger an epidemic. In Russia, leading specialists say there is no real threat to the population; the virus is a zoonosis unlikely to cause a pandemic, with import risk reduced due to fewer contacts with Europe. Virologist Petr Chumakov notes ongoing surveillance and no immediate danger. Mikhail Gavriikin, a kinesiology physician and course author, cautions that Shamonda could reach other countries and infect many animals, but would require favorable climate; for healthy individuals the virus is largely harmless. Separately, Russia confirmed a Zika fever case: a woman returning from Bali to Moscow was hospitalized; Rospotrebnadzor states the infection is Zika.

triage.headline_ja: シャモンダウイルスは新たな流行を引き起こす可能性があるか
triage.triage_reason: フランスでの世界初のヒトSシャモンダウイルス感染例は対象国に該当せず、専門家も流行の可能性を否定している。ロシアでのジカ熱症例もバリ島渡航者の輸入例で、インドネシア国内での公衆衛生上の問題として記事の主題になっていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフランスでのShamondaウイルスのヒト感染初確認（専門家は脅威を否定）と、ロシアでのジカ熱輸入症例（バリ島渡航歴）。いずれも対象国（インドネシア等）での発生・流行を主題としておらず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Врач назвала симптомы лихорадки Зика и пути передачи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor identified the symptoms of Zika fever and its transmission routes.
article.articleSummary: Imported Zika fever case diagnosed in September 2026 in Moscow, Russia, in a woman who had returned from Bali; authorities say this does not indicate a domestic outbreak. Most Zika infections are asymptomatic; when symptoms occur they are mild and include a rash, low-grade fever, myalgia/arthralgia, headache, and conjunctival injection, typically resolving in 2–7 days. Pregnancy infection can cause fetal brain development issues such as microcephaly and may lead to miscarriage or preterm birth; rare neurological complication Guillain–Barré syndrome can occur in adults and children. Diagnosis relies on PCR and serology (IgM), with cross-reactivity for dengue; symptom-based differentiation from dengue and chikungunya is unreliable. Primary transmission is via Aedes mosquitoes; sexual transmission is possible, including from asymptomatic partners. Russia has Aedes albopictus on the Black Sea coast, but domestic spread is not confirmed. No specific treatment; rest, fluids, and paracetamol; avoid NSAIDs until dengue is excluded.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がジカ熱の症状と感染経路について説明
triage.triage_reason: モスクワでバリ島渡航歴のある女性の輸入ジカ熱症例1件が診断されたという解説記事であり、当局も国内アウトブレイクを否定している。流行拡大の証拠はなく社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は輸入症例1件を契機とした一般向け医学解説であり、バリ島（インドネシア）での感染拡大を示す情報はない。ロシア（モスクワ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya: 20 Ebola contacts released from quarantine
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease with nine confirmed cases and two deaths, all in one linked cluster, and no evidence of community transmission. The first Kenyan case was confirmed 6 October; the index patient, a man who worked in the DRC, flew home via Uganda on 3 October and died in Nairobi two days later. By 22 October, all contacts in Kenya and abroad had been traced. Twenty contacts were released from 21-day quarantine after remaining asymptomatic and completing final health assessments, with post-discharge precautions advised; 98 contacts remain in quarantine as of 27 October. Eight contacts developed symptoms and were laboratory-confirmed positive and transferred to the Nairobi Ebola treatment centre. WHO continues to assist Kenya in surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and infection prevention; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus disease, though early detection and supportive care improve recovery.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ接触者20人が検疫から解放
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の確定症例と死亡例があり、DRCからウガンダ経由でケニアへ国境を越えた感染拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 指標症例はDRCで就労していたがウガンダ経由でケニアに帰国し発症・死亡。実際の症例・死亡・感染拡大はケニア国内で発生しており、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRCでの症例発生は記事内で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Trasladan a Suiza a una mujer contagiada con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman infected with Ebola transferred to Switzerland.
article.articleSummary: A 42-year-old woman, wife of a Swiss embassy staff member, infected with Ebola is being treated at Geneva University Hospitals after returning to Nigeria from Uganda with her husband. The Swiss Health Ministry says she is stable and will be isolated; her husband remains isolated at the University Hospital of Zurich. She is the only confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria amid an Africa-wide outbreak. Nigerian authorities have identified 53 contacts. The patient’s condition reportedly deteriorated to multi-organ failure before evacuation, but authorities and the WHO say Nigeria has since managed the acute phase; Nigeria currently reports no active cases and continues contact tracing. The virus is Bundibugyo Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo causing over 4,600 deaths since May. Africa’s outbreak is described as complex, with cases in West, East, and Central Africa, nearing 10,000 confirmed cases. Symptom onset was Oct 7; care sought Oct 11 in Abuja; positive Oct 20; couple returned Oct 3.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に感染した女性がスイスに搬送
triage.triage_reason: DRCを含むアフリカ各地で拡大中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連し、国際搬送事例が発生。致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染やワクチン・治療法の不在など流行性・深刻性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はナイジェリアからスイスへの国際搬送事例だが、ナイジェリアとスイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されているDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（4,600人以上死亡）は対象国に該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 10.000 casos de ébola y bordea los 5.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases and nears 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections with 4,887 deaths as of October 25, 2026. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections and a case fatality rate of 48.6%. Recoveries total 2,684. Contact tracing performance is 81.6%. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the DRC, and transmission remains ongoing. No details are provided on infection source, and there is no information about imported or exported cases in the report. The data reflect continued public health surveillance and response to the epidemic in the region. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission and the need for continued control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が1万人を突破し死者数は5000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言された流行が継続中。致死率48.6%と高く、感染源や越境伝播に関する情報は記事中に不明。

article.articleHeadline: تليفزيون اليوم السابع يرصد تفشى إيبولا فى الكونغو الديمقراطية وجهود احتواء العدوى - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Youm7 TV tracks Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and efforts to contain the infection - Youm7
article.articleSummary: On 27 October 2026, Youm7 TV provides special coverage of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and efforts to contain the infection. The report highlights developments in the affected areas and intensified health measures to prevent spread to additional countries. It describes expanded testing, contact tracing, isolation of suspected cases, and strengthened epidemiological surveillance as core containment strategies. The coverage underlines fears of broader transmission within Africa, particularly across borders, and notes that health systems face challenges in rapid case detection and containment. Ebola virus, a highly lethal pathogen, has mortality rates that vary by strain and care availability. International health authorities continue monitoring and stress the need for rapid response and cross-border coordination to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Youm7テレビがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行と感染封じ込めの取り組みを追跡報道
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における公衆衛生上の重大性・国際拡大リスクを満たし、コンゴ民主共和国での流行継続と越境拡大への懸念が報じられているためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の疾患であり「異常/予想外」には該当しないが、致死率の高さと越境拡大リスクから重大な公衆衛生イベントとして扱う。具体的な感染者数・地域名・流行株の情報は記事に含まれず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Infections Surpass 10,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections, with the latest government report listing 10,060 cases. The eastern region remains affected as the outbreak intensifies. In Bafwasende, a town in Tshopo province, a nurse who had worked at the local general hospital and led community outreach was killed, and a teacher escorting outreach was wounded on Friday afternoon. Officials and a memo seen by Reuters describe the attackers as youths who accused the outreach workers of contaminating water and spreading Ebola through toilets and rivers. The violence highlights community hostility amid ongoing containment efforts and mounting caseloads, as the public health institute continues monitoring the situation and public health workers carry out outbreak response in Congo's eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万人を超える大規模アウトブレイクであり、コミュニティの敵意による暴力事件も発生しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染者数が1万人を突破し致死的な暴力事件（対応従事者殺害）も発生。地域住民の誤解・敵意（水や川を通じた感染拡大との誤情報）によりアウトブレイク対応が妨げられている点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Chi cục Chăn nuôi và Thú y kiểm tra công tác phòng, chống bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Livestock Production and Veterinary Medicine inspects the prevention and control of African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: On 27 October 2026, Thanh Hóa Department of Livestock Production and Veterinary Medicine inspected African swine fever (ASF) prevention in Tan Thanh commune, a mountainous area with 802 pig-raising households and over 3,700 pigs. Since 9 October, illness and deaths in Thành Nàng hamlet were confirmed as ASF virus via lab tests. By 21 October, two more outbreaks emerged in Thành Lãm and Luận Khê. By 26 October, ASF affected 14 households across 3 of 7 hamlets; 46 pigs dead or culled, weighing over 2.1 tonnes. Authorities urge urgent containment: isolate outbreaks, cull diseased and dead stock per biosafety rules, perform disinfection and decontamination, deploy checkpoints, and tighten surveillance of pig transport, trade, and slaughter; aim to declare Tan Thanh ASF-free by 30 November 2026. Nationwide, 14 communes/wards remain within 21 days of exposure, with 4,094 pigs culled (286.799 tonnes) across 318 households. Two inspection teams are supervising 16 border communes and gates.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜獣医局、アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の予防・防除対策を視察
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（豚のみ対象）でヒトへの公衆衛生影響はなく、ベトナムでは既知・管理下の家畜疾病であり社会的関心や国際拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラは動物感染症でヒトに感染しないため、公衆衛生上のリスクはない。当局による通常の防疫対応が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Из Нигерии в Швейцарию эвакуировали женщину, заразившуюся вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman infected with the Ebola virus was evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland.
article.articleSummary: Swiss Ebola patient evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland on Oct 26 is the first confirmed case in Nigeria during the current outbreak. The patient, a Swiss citizen, traveled with her husband, a Swiss diplomat in Nigeria, for medical evacuation to Geneva. In Nigeria, she is stable, conscious and communicative, though still potentially infectious; strict infection-control measures remain. In Switzerland, she is hospitalized at Geneva University Hospital; her husband is isolated at Zurich University Hospital. Nigeria continues contact tracing for 52 contacts; WHO Africa Regional Director Mohammed Janabi said there are no additional cases in Nigeria after the evacuation. The infection was detected after she returned from Uganda to Abuja; exposure circumstances are under investigation. Separately, Kenya reports nine Ebola cases with two deaths; on Oct 27, 20 quarantined contacts were released and 98 more are planned next week. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak persists with over 9,900 cases and 4,800 deaths since May, described by WHO as the fastest-spreading yet, potentially exceeding the 2014–2016 toll.»

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアからスイスへ、エボラウイルスに感染した女性が搬送された
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,900例・4,800人死亡という史上最速規模のエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、ナイジェリアでの初症例確認とスイスへの国際医療搬送、ケニアでの複数症例発生も重なり、国際的拡大・深刻な公衆衛生影響の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・スイス・ケニアでの症例だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは記事内で継続的な大規模アウトブレイクの主体として明記されているため対象国として採用。ナイジェリアでの感染経路（ウガンダ帰国後に検出）は調査中であり不明点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Ασθενής με Έμπολα στη Νιγηρία μεταφέρθηκε αεροπορικώς στην Ελβετία μαζί με τον σύζυγό της
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola patient in Nigeria was airlifted to Switzerland with her husband.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, a Nigerian Ebola patient was airlifted to Switzerland with her husband as authorities monitor 52 contacts. The woman is Nigeria’s first Ebola case in over a decade and is improving—stable, conscious, with labs near baseline; her diplomat husband is under quarantine. They arrived by air ambulance; she is hospitalized at Geneva University Hospital, while he remains at Zurich University Hospital. Officials say there is no public risk. WHO Africa regional director Mohammad Janaibi said the transfer reflects their citizenship. Nigeria will continue monitoring the 52 contacts; the country has no active Ebola cases. It remains unclear how she contracted the virus; authorities say she had traveled to Uganda, and Swiss authorities say she did not visit the DRC. Kenya has nine Ebola cases (two deaths) since October; the DRC outbreak has over 9,900 cases and 4,800 deaths, with Bundibugyo strain deemed the worst by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者、夫とともにスイスへ空輸
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年ぶりのエボラ症例が発生し国際搬送される異例の事態であり、DRCでは大規模流行（9900例超、4800人超死亡）が継続中でIHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア人患者のスイス搬送だが、感染経路は不明でウガンダ渡航歴ありDRC訪問は否定されている。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは進行中の大規模アウトブレイクとして言及されており対象国に該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Swiss woman with Ebola evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland
article.articleSummary: A Swiss national infected with Ebola and her husband arrived in Switzerland on Oct 27 after evacuation from Nigeria, where the index case is Nigeria’s first Ebola patient since 2014. The woman, infected with Bundibugyo Ebola, developed symptoms on Oct 7, was admitted to a private Abuja hospital on Oct 11, and is now being treated at Geneva University Hospital; her husband is in isolation at Zurich University Hospital. Nigeria reports 52 close contacts under monitoring; the 53rd contact is the evacuated husband, under Swiss surveillance. Nigerian officials say Nigeria currently has no active Ebola cases. The evacuation follows a multi-country outbreak linked to Bundibugyo Ebola, with the earliest suspected case in a DRC healthcare worker and outbreak declared May 15. Global counts cited: 9,995 confirmed cases and 4,845 deaths, mainly in DRC; Kenya 9/2; Uganda 20/2 (plus probable cases/deaths); France one recovered case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に感染したスイス人女性、ナイジェリアからスイスへ医療搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大の3つに該当し、国際医療搬送を伴う多国間アウトブレイクでWHO通知相当の事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 本事例はDRCを起源とするブンディブギョ型エボラの多国間アウトブレイク(DRCで9,995例確認・4,845死亡)で、ナイジェリアへの輸入例がさらにスイスへ医療搬送された。ナイジェリア・スイス・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、アウトブレイクの主な発生地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's fast-moving Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases as authorities race to slow the spread across Africa - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Congo has topped 10,000 confirmed cases, with authorities racing to slow the spread across Africa as of 2026-10-27. The fast-moving outbreak is characterized by sustained transmission across the region and heightened concern about cross-border spread within the continent. The report highlights the scale of infections and the urgent public health response needed to curb escalation, though it provides no details on deaths, infection sources, or specific containment measures. The information focuses on the magnitude of the outbreak and regional efforts to halt further transmission, signaling a critical ongoing emergency for Africa. The article does not specify the countries beyond Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが確定症例1万人を突破、当局はアフリカ大陸全体への拡大阻止を急ぐ

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola infections surpass 10,000, government says
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases, surpassing 10,000. The latest situation report from the public health institute, released by the government, puts the total at 10,060 and signals the scale of the Ebola outbreak in the country. The information is drawn from government data and Reuters reporting on Tuesday’s update, with the article attributed to Nilutpal Timsina. No death toll or additional clinical details are provided in the piece. The figure underscores ongoing surveillance of Ebola infections in the DRC and reflects the government's continued monitoring of confirmed cases.

article.articleHeadline: Срочно: Число подтвержденных случаев лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 10 тысяч

article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 27 October 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has registered more than 10,000 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases since the outbreak began in May. Medical authorities in the DRC published these data on Tuesday, highlighting the scale of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the country. The figure consolidates all laboratory-confirmed infections recorded to date across the DRC as part of the public health response. The report underscores the continuing public health challenge posed by EVD in the DRC, with authorities continuing surveillance, case investigation, and control measures in affected areas. The update comes from Kinshasa and reflects the national tally for the current outbreak that began in May.

This update underscores the ongoing Ebola epidemic in the DRC and the continued need for enhanced surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and public health response to contain the spread. The information corresponds to the publication date of 2026-10-27.

article.articleHeadline: MPSP investiga Hospital Salvalus por mortes de recém-nascidos causadas por infecções
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPSP Investigates Salvalus Hospital for Neonatal Deaths Caused by Infections.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Public Prosecutor's Office (MPSP) in São Paulo conducts a civil inquiry into Hospital Salvalus, located in the southern zone of the city, over neonatal deaths suspected to be caused by bacterial infections. The probe examines possible lapses in hygiene, patient-safety protocols, and the hospital's infection-control management, aiming to determine whether negligence or malpractice occurred in care. The hospital faced a similar investigation about a decade ago tied to infant deaths from infectious conditions, raising concerns about recurring structural or procedural sanitary weaknesses. The investigation is in the evidentiary phase, with authorities gathering technical evidence and testimonies to establish a causal link between hospital practices and the deaths, and to decide whether to file a public civil action or issue administrative recommendations. A formal response from Hospital Salvalus is awaited regarding the presented evidence and implemented controls.

triage.headline_ja: MPSP、新生児死亡の感染症原因でサルバルス病院を調査

article.articleSummary: North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 infections, government says. The Bundibugyo strain is referenced in coverage, with authorities and aid agencies intensifying containment. Health workers and humanitarian responders on the front lines are being vaccinated due to potential exposure to the virus, including contacts of suspected cases, as depicted by a photo dated 16 October 2026. The ongoing response focuses on case finding, contact tracing, and expanding vaccination campaigns to curb transmission in the DRC. The update published on 27 October 2026 underscores the outbreak’s scale and the need for continued surveillance, vaccination, and protection for exposed personnel in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を突破、政府発表

article.articleHeadline: Počet potvrzených případů eboly v Kongu překročil hranici 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed the 10,000 mark.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with 6,041 cases and 2,911 deaths reported; 1,366 people have recovered. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, is described as the largest in the country's history, exceeding prior 2018–2020 figures. The disease is spreading across six provinces and 60 health zones, with Ituri, North Kivu, and Haut-Uele most affected; no new affected zones in the last 24 hours. Emergency teams operate in six provinces amid security challenges, population displacement, healthcare worker strikes, and widespread movement. The Bundibugyo variant is responsible; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. Last week Congo received thousands of Ervebo vaccine doses and began vaccination, though the vaccine targets a different variant. Transmission occurs via contact with an infected person or contaminated materials; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確定症例が10,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が過去最大規模で複数州に拡大し、治安・人口移動・医療従事者ストライキ等の複合要因により国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 見出しでは10,000例超とあるが本文サマリーでは6,041例・死亡2,911人と記載があり、情報源間で数値の不整合が見られる。既承認ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在せず、使用中のErveboワクチンも流行株（Bundibugyo variant）に対して完全には対応していない点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Kota Tasikmalaya Capai 199 Pasien, Didominasi Anak-anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Tasikmalaya City total 199 patients, predominantly children.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) in Tasikmalaya City, West Java, Indonesia, reached 199 confirmed cases from January–October 2026, with one patient in intensive care and no deaths reported; the rest are recovering. Transmission is dominated by Aedes aegypti, affecting mainly children and adolescents, with 110 males and 89 females across 10 districts. Health officials cite weather and mosquito breeding, worsened by low community hygiene awareness. As the dry season begins, authorities push mass mosquito source reduction through PSN (Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk) and education via the G1R1J (One House One Jumantik) program. Residents are urged to consistently implement the 3M protocol (Drain, Cover, Bury) and maintain PHBS (clean and healthy living). This snapshot highlights an ongoing urban dengue outbreak with emphasis on vector control and community engagement to curb further case growth.

triage.headline_ja: タシクマラヤ市のデング熱症例、199人に到達 子供が中心
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一地域における季節性デング熱の通常範囲内の発生であり、死亡者もなく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、地方自治体による通常の媒介対策（PSN、G1R1J）で対応中。死亡者なし、重症者1名のみで深刻な公衆衛生インパクトとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Ebola - Uganda Orders 21-Day Quarantine for Citizens Returning From DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda orders a 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to curb Ebola spread, with quarantine costs borne by returnees and mandatory contact-detail forms; surveillance tightened at Entebbe International Airport and land borders. The move follows Ebola infections in Nigeria and Kenya. The DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths as of 20 October; Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda declared the Bundibugyo outbreak over in July after 20 infections and two deaths and says it has no active Ebola infections. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in over a decade on 20 October in a 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman married to a Swiss diplomat, who had visited Uganda in September and traveled to Nigeria on 3 October; the infection source is under investigation. About 60 Ugandan contacts linked to a Kenyan patient completed 21 days of monitoring and were discharged.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラ出血熱 - ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間の隔離を命令

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo supera los 10.000 casos de ébola y roza los 5.000 muertos - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases and nears 5,000 deaths - Diario de Santiago. News of Santiago de Compostela and Galicia.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%), with 2,684 recoveries, as of Oct 25, 2026, according to INSP. Contact tracing is 81.6% complete. Ituri and North Kivu are the hardest hit, with Beni, Mandima, and Bunia as high-transmission zones; Bafwasende (Tshopo) highlighted for response needs. The outbreak spans 66 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, Ubangui South, and Ubangui North. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no specific treatment; WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1 trials, while Congo began Ervebo vaccination in August and reports early cross-protection signals. Cross-border cases include Uganda (20 cases, 15 imported, 2 deaths; outbreak over Aug 26), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), and Nigeria (1 case). Transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数1万人・死者数5000人に迫る

The Ituri outbreak, as described, marks a record level of Ebola transmission for the Congo and indicates that this edition of the outbreak remains active.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 cases as authorities race to slow the spread in African countries - MyNorthwest.com
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus (no approved vaccine or treatment), has reached 10,060 laboratory-confirmed infections with about 5,030 deaths (roughly half) as of 2026-10-27 per the Ministry of Health. It is the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history, declared in May. The epidemic has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, centered in Ituri (epicenter) with activity in Bafwasende and other zones; cross-border spread has reached three regions, with cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria. Overall, five countries have been affected, including Uganda and France, though Uganda and France currently report no active cases. About 80% of new infections occur outside monitored contacts, and officials cite that about 95% of cases should arise from known contacts. Struggles include armed conflict, mistrust, inadequate infrastructure, and strikes over pay, with health workers targeted; routine services, maternal health, vaccinations, and schooling are disrupted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者数が1万人を突破 ― アフリカ諸国での感染拡大阻止に向け当局が対応を急ぐ

article.articleHeadline: 惠州农村免费流感疫苗开约！各县区接种门诊名单公布
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Booking opens for the free influenza vaccine in rural Huizhou! List of vaccination clinics by county/district announced.
article.articleSummary: Free influenza vaccination is now available in rural Huizhou, Guangdong Province, for the 2026–2027 autumn–winter season. The Huizhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention announced that one dose of trivalent influenza split vaccine will be provided free of charge to two groups: adults aged 65 and older, and students in compulsory education (primary and middle schools). Citizens can check vaccine availability and book online via the YueM app or mini-program. Vaccination is voluntary, informed, and free. The influenza vaccine is the most cost-effective preventive measure against influenza and severe illness; it requires 2–4 weeks after vaccination to develop protective antibodies and should ideally be completed before the peak season. Outpatient vaccination clinics by county/district are listed, with contact numbers for appointment or inquiries; clinic updates will reflect latest notices.

article.articleHeadline: Brytyjczycy alarmują! Co ujawniły doniesienia o dżumie w Rosji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Britons are sounding the alarm! What did reports reveal about the plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Mysterious death of an Irkutsk Institute employee and alleged Russian information suppression highlight weaknesses in international bio-threat response mechanisms. The Guardian-published opinions by Dr. Darren Mann and Prof. Kent Buse argue the problem is not only transparency in single countries but a systemic failure to enforce norms for sharing pathogens and countermeasures. The piece recalls the 1894 Hong Kong plague investigations and the bacterium Yersinia pestis to illustrate how access to biological materials has long depended on politics. It frames ongoing WHO pandemic treaty negotiations around a Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing annex, with poorer countries demanding binding guarantees to receive 20% of vaccines and medicines (half donated, half sold at cost) and wealthier nations preferring voluntary measures. Article 13 promises a more equitable PPE supply chain; talks remain stalled to 2027. Authors urge London to back independent verification, a public compliance registry, and entry into WHO UHPR.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Releases 20 Ebola Contacts From Quarantine
article.articleSummary: Twenty people linked to Kenya’s first Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case were released from quarantine after completing a 21-day monitoring period. The contacts, who remained asymptomatic, underwent final health assessments, received post-discharge precautions, and were discharged Monday. A further 98 contacts remain in quarantine as Kenyan authorities and the World Health Organization continue Ebola preparedness since the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared an outbreak on 15 May. Kenya’s Director General for Health, Dr. Patrick Amoth, said that after 21 symptom-free days they pose no risk of infection to anyone, a view echoed by WHO Kenya representative Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo, who stressed the protective benefit of quarantine for families and communities. The report emphasizes ongoing contact monitoring, with no additional cases confirmed in this update.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Ulankina noted that in adults the Zika virus is usually asymptomatic.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus infection is asymptomatic in about four-fifths of adults; the remainder experience a mild illness. According to Dr. Olga Ulankina, a physician at Hemotest laboratory, Zika can spread not only by Aedes mosquitoes but also via sexual contact and from pregnant women to their fetus. The primary vectors are Aedes mosquitoes, found in Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Brazil, and Caribbean islands. When symptoms occur, they may include transient fever, a faint rash, joint pain, red eyes, and mild headache. The most serious outcomes occur with maternal infection during pregnancy, as the virus can cross the placental barrier and disrupt fetal brain development, potentially causing microcephaly, limb contractures, vision and hearing problems, or miscarriage.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 cases as authorities race to slow the spread in African countries
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has topped 10,000 cases, spreading across 66 health zones in eight provinces since declared in May, making it the most geographically extensive Ebola outbreak on record. Relative to West Africa's 2014-2016 crisis (more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths), this outbreak has at least three times the cases and deaths observed so far and has extended beyond Congo to three African regions, with cases in Kenya and Nigeria and five countries including Uganda and France. About 80% of new infections are outside monitored contacts, indicating ongoing transmission chains; authorities say 95% of cases should come from known contacts to claim control. Half of deaths have occurred in people not admitted to treatment centers. The epicenter is Ituri province; responders face strikes over unpaid bonuses, violence against workers, and disruptions to health services, including maternal care and vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo übersteigt 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo exceeds 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, per Africa CDC. Ebola virus transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, causing high fever with diarrhea and bleeding. The outbreak also includes Bundibugyo variant cases in East Africa, with nine infections and two deaths in Kenya after a Congo-origin patient traveled through Uganda to Nairobi; Nigeria reports a Bundibugyo case in the wife of a Swiss diplomat, who fell ill after travel to Uganda, with infection source still under investigation and the patient evacuated to Switzerland. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a specific vaccine or therapy, complicating containment, and early symptoms can mimic malaria, delaying isolation. Since July, clinical trials of two antiviral therapies are underway, and studies assess whether Ervebo provides protection against Bundibugyo, though Ervebo is licensed for the Zaire strain.

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo supera los 10.000 casos mientras autoridades buscan frenar su expansión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 10,000 cases as authorities seek to curb its spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, reaching 10,060 with about half of patients dying. It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Response efforts confront armed conflict, poor roads, and community violence fueled by distrust and misinformation, complicating reporting and treatment. The outbreak has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, centered in Ituri, with cases also reported in Bafwasende (Tshopo). Across Africa, infections have reached Kenya and Nigeria, with Uganda and France among those exposed, though France currently has no active cases. About 80% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts, indicating ongoing transmission chains. The epidemic is straining health services, elevating maternal mortality as women avoid hospitals, disrupting routine vaccination, and prompting strikes among responders.

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases surpass 10,000 as fears grow of wider African spread
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 27, 2026, marking the largest and deadliest outbreak there since mid-May and the second-largest on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Kenya has reported its first Ebola cases this month, totaling nine after a Congo-traveling patient died in Nairobi; Nigeria is the fourth African country to report a case. The Swiss diplomat’s wife, who had not traveled to Congo, is believed to have contracted Ebola in Uganda, and both were flown to Switzerland. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June, mostly imported from Congo, but WHO declared Ebola-free in August. Ugandan officials say returning citizens with Congo travel history will be quarantined for 21 days. Health officials continue to investigate infection sources for some imported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : l'organisation HAA remet deux tonnes d'intrants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: the HAA organization hands over two metric tons of inputs.
article.articleSummary: Two metric tons of medical inputs were handed over by humanitarian organization Aide Humanitaire pour l'Afrique (HAA) on Oct 26 in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, to the provincial government and the Provincial Division of Health to bolster the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response. The consignment includes personal protective equipment, antibiotics, oral rehydration salts, and other essential supplies for health facilities. In a context of heightened vigilance for Ebola in the province, the aid aims to protect frontline healthcare workers and strengthen prevention and care for patients. HAA project lead Diane Tudi Ntumba described it as the first step in a broader support program, with training for health professionals and planned community outreach to improve adherence to preventive measures via local relay networks. The initiative supports provincial authorities to prevent spread and bolster the response in the Beni region.

article.articleHeadline: Modeling and Gaps Define HIV Surveillance in Sub-Saharan Africa
article.articleSummary: HIV surveillance in Sub-Saharan Africa (Ghana, Kenya, Lesotho, Malawi, Zimbabwe) shows heavy reliance on mathematical models to estimate incidence and mortality, with mortality data hampered by weak vital registration. A review of 66 documents informing national/global surveillance found each country uses 80–103 indicators, vs global guidance with 128 indicators. National indicators are dominated by integrated services and non-biomedical measures, notably HIV stigma/knowledge, ranging from 22.8% (Ghana, 21/92) to 64.1% (Lesotho, 66/103). Although plans name activities like community/facility mortality surveillance, HIV drug resistance surveys, and bio-behavioral surveys, these are often partially implemented or not documented. Malawi analyzes HIV-positive admissions vs. population size; Kenya shows pockets of improved mortality surveillance; all five countries embed behavioral factors in household surveys. A key finding is a mismatch between strategy and implementation, underscoring the need to reassess indicators/activities to reliably estimate the true HIV burden.

article.articleHeadline: ஃபிரிட்ஜ் பின்னாடி இப்படி ஒரு ஆபத்தா? வீட்டில் டெங்கு கொசுக்கள் வளரும் 10 இடங்கள் இவை தான்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Such a danger behind the fridge? These are the 10 places where dengue mosquitoes breed in the home.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, an illness spread by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that bite during the day, remains a home risk during the rainy season when water collects. The article lists 10 domestic breeding sites: 1) the tray behind the fridge, 2) plant pots and saucers, 3) items in the attic, 4) water storage tanks and drums, 5) air conditioners and coolers, 6) toilets and unused containers, 7) roof gutters, 8) small bowls and bird-water dishes, 9) window sills and balcony corners, 10) pet water bowls. Preventive steps include sealing and cleaning containers weekly, draining stagnant water, cleaning AC/cooler interiors, and monitoring long-unused vessels. Also relevant are window/door screens, daytime protective clothing, and promptly removing small water-holding items. Symptoms to watch for: fever, severe headache, eye/retro-orbital pain, body aches, vomiting; seek medical care. Alarm signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding, requiring hospital attention. Weekly water checks and personal/public hygiene help reduce breeding.

article.articleHeadline: Tierseuchen im Blick: Suche nach Lösungen im Landkreis Verden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Animal Diseases in Focus: Search for Solutions in the Verden District.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASP) remains a threat in Germany, with rising wild boar numbers heightening the risk in the Verden district, discussed by representatives from Rotenburg-Verden and Bremervörde-Zeven with local veterinarians. Avian influenza persists, though not at last year’s crisis level; outdoor poultry remain at risk from wild birds. The main transmission concern is discarded food waste along highways, necessitating more roadside waste bins, border controls, transport hygiene, and prevention of illegal meat imports, alongside stringent on-farm biosafety—hygiene, defined procedures, and restricted stall access. In cattle farming, from 1 January 2027, holdings with at least ten cattle must annually receive veterinary biosafety counseling and draft a biosafety management plan, a requirement raising implementation concerns. An ASP tabletop exercise (ASP-Planspiel) by LAVES is planned for next year to test responses and identify weaknesses, including potential regional fencing. Since 2020, exports of German pork to China have been restricted due to ASP, prompting calls for regionalization to ease market pressure; Hessen reports improvement, while NRW still records active zones.
