article.articleHeadline: Ебола измиче контроли у Конгу: више од 10.000 заражених, готово половина умрла
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spiraling out of control in Congo: more than 10,000 infected, almost half have died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 10,060 confirmed cases as of Oct 27, 2026, with roughly half resulting in death. Declared in May, it is the fastest-spreading and deadliest outbreak in the country, now spreading across 66 health zones in eight provinces from an initial three. Cases have been reported in five countries, including Kenya and Nigeria, with Uganda and France reporting no active cases. About 80% of new infections are in people not under surveillance, signaling undetected transmission chains. There is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health workers face armed conflict, poor infrastructure, equipment shortages, distrust, and misinformation; treatment centers are overwhelmed, and staff strikes over pay persist. A nurse was killed and another injured in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province during a suspected-Ebola intervention. The outbreak worsens immunization and maternal health services and disrupts schooling.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能に:感染者1万人超、約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万人超の感染、致死率約50%、8州66保健地域に拡大し国際的な感染報告もあることからIHR基準を複数満たし、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダ・フランスは活動症例なしと明記されているため除外。治安悪化、ワクチン・治療薬不在、医療従事者襲撃など深刻な状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases top 10,000 in fastest-growing outbreak in history
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, the fastest-growing outbreak in history per Africa's top health authority. The Bundibugyo variant has been confirmed in Kenya (nine infections, two deaths) after a patient traveled from Congo via Uganda to Nairobi; Nigeria reported its first case on Oct 20, a Swiss woman who entered from Uganda, with investigations ongoing to determine the exact infection source. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases in the current outbreak, all linked to a Congo-origin patient, with two deaths; Uganda had declared its outbreak over at the end of August after 42 days with no new cases. Transmission occurs through physical contact and contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, diarrhea and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、史上最速の拡大ペースで感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が複数国（コンゴ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）に国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダでも感染例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。致死率は約48.6%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉確診破萬例　防疫宣導人員遇襲1死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 10,000; one public health outreach worker killed in an attack.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 10,000 laboratory-confirmed cases—10,060 reported since the outbreak was declared in May. As of Oct 23, the case fatality rate is about 48.6%. Eight provinces are contending with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including Tshopo Province, where Bafwasende General Hospital operates. On Oct 23, a public health outreach nurse working to improve community Ebola prevention was killed by locals, who also attacked a teacher colleague who survived. The assailants, armed with knives and clubs, accused the workers of contaminating a water source. The incident underscores the difficulties of earning public trust and protecting healthcare workers amid ongoing transmission in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 民主剛果のエボラ確定症例が1万例を突破、防疫啓発担当者が襲撃され1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)確定症例が1万例を超え致死率約48.6%と深刻であり、8州に拡大、医療従事者への暴力も発生しており国際的拡大・管理困難性の観点からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約48.6%、8州に拡大中。医療従事者・防疫啓発担当者への襲撃事件が地域住民の不信・治安悪化を示しており、対応の困難さが増している。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本轮埃博拉疫情确诊病例超1万例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's latest Ebola outbreak exceeds 10,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of October 25, DR Congo's Ebola virus disease outbreak has reached 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 48.6%. The multi-province spread covers 8 of DR Congo's 26 provinces. The outbreak began on May 15 and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The World Health Organization characterized this outbreak in August as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The epidemic's impact extends beyond DR Congo into East Africa (Uganda and Kenya) and West Africa (Nigeria), signaling significant regional public health implications. The data highlight ongoing transmission with high mortality, underscoring the emergency across Central, East, and West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、今回のエボラ出血熱流行で確認症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.6%、1万人超の確認症例、複数州への拡大、史上2番目の規模とWHOが位置づける重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの地域的波及に言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。有効なワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる流行であり、ワクチン未承認である点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Tumaini, Vaksin Harapan Baru Atasi Wabah Ebola di Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tumaini, the New Hope Vaccine, Overcomes the Ebola Outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded to eight of 26 provinces as of Oct 23, 2026, with about 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths confirmed by Oct 21, 2026 per CEPI. Roughly 3.5 million people in affected areas face acute food insecurity. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for this Bundibugyo-driven Ebola event; CDC Africa has designated a continental public health emergency. A Phase 3 trial of Tumaini, a BDBV-specific vaccine, began Oct 23, 2026 in Bundia, DRC, to evaluate safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy. Tumaini uses ring vaccination, targeting contacts and including children. The vaccine competes with Ervebo (EBOV). Bundibugyo virus reservoirs include fruit bats; human transmission occurs via blood/secretions with an incubation of 2–21 days and early symptoms such as fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, and sore throat.

triage.headline_ja: トゥマイニ、アフリカのエボラ流行に対処する新たな希望のワクチン
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がWHOによりPHEICと宣言され、8州に拡大、致死率も高くIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言、CDC Africaも大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言。約9,552症例、4,602死亡、致死率約48%と非常に高い。新規ワクチン(Tumaini)の第3相試験が開始。食料不安も深刻化しており、人道的観点からも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDCongo registou mais de 10 mil casos e 4.887 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DR Congo recorded more than 10,000 cases and 4,887 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) declared May 15 has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, with 2,684 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.6%, based on INSP data up to 25 October. Contact tracing is 81.6%. Ituri and North Kivu are the hardest hit, with 32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours; eight of the DRC's 26 provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, Ubangi-Sud, Ubangi-Nord. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives this outbreak, described as the second deadliest and most contagious globally. No strain-specific treatment exists; two vaccines are in phase 1 trials, and Ervebo—already used in August for mass vaccination—shows promise against Bundibugyo in animals. The WHO has started clinical trials in the DRC. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で1万人以上の症例と4,887人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が8州に拡大し、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOによる臨床試験開始やワクチン展開(Ervebo)が行われており、国際的な支援・関与が既に進行中。致死率48.6%と高く、8州に拡大している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Wirus ebola w Szwajcarii. Żona dyplomaty trafiła do szpitala w Genewie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in Switzerland. The diplomat's wife was admitted to hospital in Geneva.
article.articleSummary: Ebola reached Switzerland when a woman infected with the virus was transported from Nigeria to Geneva on October 26, 2026 for treatment; her Swiss diplomat husband accompanied her and is under medical observation in Zurich, asymptomatic. The patient is hospitalized at Geneva University Hospital, and authorities say the entry poses no domestic public-health risk. The infection source remains unclear, with travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda, where Ebola outbreaks have occurred. This is the third time an Ebola patient has been treated in Switzerland (previous cases in 1995 and 2014, both survivors). In Africa, the outbreak persists: WHO data show 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since May; Uganda reported 20 cases in summer but was declared free in August; Kenya reported 9 cases. Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood and body fluids; incubation 2–21 days, commonly 8–10 days.

triage.headline_ja: スイスでエボラウイルス感染。外交官の妻がジュネーブの病院に搬送される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9,704症例、4,687死亡）を背景に、感染者がスイスへ搬送された国際的拡大事例であり、IHR基準の複数該当が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はスイスへの輸入症例だが、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源・アウトブレイク背景として言及されているDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみを対象国として計上。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Počet potvrdených prípadov eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike presiahol 10-tisíc - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 - Svet SME
article.articleSummary: Over 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with more than 4,600 deaths since the May declaration of the current outbreak. The northeastern Ituri province, centered on Bunia, is experiencing the largest Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Congo’s history. First clinical trial of the Ervebo vaccine—the vaccine licensed against Zaire ebolavirus—began in Bunia to assess if it confers protection against Bundibugyo; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines will soon join the testing. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. The Bundibugyo outbreak has surpassed the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak in scale. Globally, only the West Africa 2014–2016 epidemic was larger, with more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例数が1万人を超える - Svet SME
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が1万症例・4,600人超の死者に達し、過去最大規模の流行となっており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常事態であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tödliche Viruskrankheit: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo übersteigt 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatal Viral Disease: The Number of Ebola Cases in the Congo Exceeds 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Goma) reports 10,060 Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, with Africa CDC calling it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant has been detected in Kenya (nine infections, two deaths) and Nigeria (one patient, wife of a Swiss diplomat). The Kenyan case followed Congo travel via Uganda to Nairobi; the Nigerian patient was infected after visiting Uganda and flown to Switzerland. Ebola virus disease is life-threatening and spreads through contact with body fluids, causing fever, diarrhea, and bleeding. Bundibugyo has no specific vaccine or therapy yet, and early symptoms can resemble malaria, delaying isolation. Since July, two antivirals are in trials, and Ervebo is being studied for potential protection against Bundibugyo, though approved for Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的ウイルス疾患：コンゴのエボラ症例数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として記載。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスで有効なワクチン・治療法未確立、致死率も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội còn 29 ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết đang hoạt động
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi still has 29 active dengue fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Within 16–23 October 2026, Hanoi recorded 429 dengue fever cases across 94 wards, down 80 from the prior week; year-to-date dengue total reached 5,289 with zero deaths. Eighteen new dengue outbreaks were identified this week, bringing the total to 229 outbreaks, 29 of which remain active. Hand, foot and mouth disease tallied 153 cases (−77 week-on-week), with no fatalities; year-to-date totals stand at 6,397 cases and 99 outbreaks resolved. Measles added four cases this week, raising the 2026 total to 412. Adult tetanus reported one case in the week, totaling 16 with one death. COVID-19 registered one case this week, cumulative 1,675, with no deaths. Hanoi CDC continues collaboration for surveillance, investigation, and outbreak response; vector-control measures, environmental sanitation, and mosquito spraying are prioritized during the dengue peak season (Sept–Nov). Public urged to vaccinate on schedule and reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、依然29件のデング熱アウトブレイクが活動中
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は季節性のピーク時期における通常の流行状況で、死亡者もゼロと重篤性は低いが、症例数が多く継続的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ハノイCDCによる定期的な疫学週報であり、デング熱のピークシーズン（9〜11月）における通常の監視活動の一環。死亡者はデング熱・手足口病・COVID-19でゼロ、破傷風で1名。特段の異常な増加や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا المؤكدة في الكونغو تتجاوز 10 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections, with nearly half of the infected dying (about 5,030 deaths). The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is described as the fastest-spreading in history and the deadliest the country has faced. First identified in May, the outbreak continues as authorities strive to curb transmission across several African countries. There is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo virus. Response efforts are hampered by armed conflict, deteriorating road infrastructure, and community distrust and misinformation, complicating surveillance, safe burials, and containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの確認済みエボラ感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、感染者1万人超、複数国への拡大が疑われ、ワクチン・治療法未承認でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事では『複数のアフリカ諸国にまたがる』と記載されているが、具体的な対象国名の明示はなくDRCが主題。武力紛争・インフラ劣化・住民の不信感が対応を困難にしていると記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Congo meldt meer dan 10.000 ebolabesmettingen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports more than 10,000 Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,887 deaths, with the Bundibugyo variant circulating since May. The count rose from 9,964 cases reported last Friday, yielding a case-fatality rate near 49%. Ebola, a disease that can cause bleeding in the body, remains most severe in Congo, though it has appeared in other African countries. The outbreak has sparked unrest in the eastern region, where machete-wielding youths attacked health workers last week, accusing them of disseminating the disease by contaminating water.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染者1万人以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の感染者・5000人近い死者という大規模アウトブレイクであり、医療従事者への暴力など社会不安も発生しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクが5月から継続し、致死率約49%と非常に高い。医療従事者への攻撃など地域の不安定化も確認されており、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo übersteigt 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola cases in the Congo exceeds 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak was first detected in mid-May. The figures come from the DRC's health authorities, with Africa CDC calling it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. This indicates an ongoing, rapidly expanding crisis within the central African nation and highlights the scale of current transmission and mortality attributed to the Ebola outbreak. The report underscores the magnitude of the situation in the DRC as authorities monitor the evolving outbreak and continue to publish updated counts. Updates continue to be provided by national authorities and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が1万人超の感染・致死率約49%に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが『史上最速拡大のエボラ流行』と評しており、致死率も高い。続報・RRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de mayıs ayından bu yana süren Ebola salgınında doğrulanmış vaka sayısı 10 bin 60'a çıktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Ebola outbreak in the DRC that has been ongoing since May, the number of confirmed cases has risen to 10,060.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 10,060, with 4,887 deaths (case-fatality rate 48.6%). The outbreak, ongoing since May, now affects 66 health zones across 8 of the country’s 26 provinces. This Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak is the deadliest in the DRC’s history and the second-largest Ebola outbreak in Africa since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Public health authorities report sustained transmission and a high mortality burden across multiple regions, underscoring the challenges of controlling a nationwide outbreak with dispersed health zones. The figures reflect the evolving outbreak at the provincial level, highlighting the scale of the ongoing public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で5月から続くエボラ流行、確定症例数が1万60人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、致死率約48.6%、8州66保健地域に拡大しており、公衆衛生・国際拡大リスクともに深刻でありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪規模、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行に次ぐアフリカ第2位の大規模エボラ流行。複数州にわたる持続的な感染拡大が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: विदिशा में सात माह में एचआईवी के 15 नए मरीज मिले | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 15 new HIV patients found in Vidisha in seven months
article.articleSummary: Vidisha district in Madhya Pradesh reports 15 new HIV infections from April to October 2026, prompting intensified testing, counseling, and awareness efforts by health authorities. Since 2008, the district has recorded a total of 780 HIV-positive individuals. The report also identifies 340 people who inject drugs in the district. Intervention areas include Sherpura, Raipura, Mohangiri, Mandigate, and Station Road, with parts of Ganj Basoda implicated. Authorities appear to be prioritizing targeted outreach and risk-reduction strategies in these locales to curb transmission among people who inject drugs, as new infections continue to emerge over the seven-month period. The data reflect ongoing surveillance and community engagement to address the HIV burden in Vidisha. keywords: HIV, Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh, outbreak response, injection drug use.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィディシャで過去7か月間にHIV新規感染者15人が確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的なHIVの通常サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の対策枠組み内で対応可能と判断される。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は地方自治体の定例的なサーベイランスと注射薬物使用者への介入活動の報告。新規性・緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Westafrika - Zahl der Ebola-Infektionen im Kongo steigt auf mehr als 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Africa - Number of Ebola infections in the Congo rises to more than 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has surpassed 10,000 infections, with 4,887 deaths since mid-May, according to the government in Kinshasa. The highly contagious Ebola virus is transmitted via contact with body fluids and causes fever, diarrhea, and bleeding. For the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the Congo, there is no vaccine or specific therapy; vaccination in the country uses a vaccine whose protection has only been demonstrated for the Zaire strain. In October, infections were detected in Kenya with two deaths, and Nigeria reported its first infection. This update is dated 27 October 2026. The report was released by Deutschlandfunk.

triage.headline_ja: 西アフリカ - コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1万人超の感染・約4,887人の死亡に達し、さらにケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大していることから、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの感染確認は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際拡大リスクの根拠として重要。流行株（Bundibugyo）には有効なワクチン・治療法がなく、管理困難性が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Everything Nigerians must know now that Ebola patient has been flown out
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola infection since 2014, involving Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease detected in a woman who traveled from Uganda; case confirmed Oct 20 after she developed symptoms Oct 7 and was treated in Abuja. The index patient has left Abuja for Switzerland by air ambulance with an asymptomatic husband; authorities warn improved condition does not mean she is no longer infectious. Contact tracing expands to 53 primary contacts (44 linked to the treating facility; nine others including husband, driver, chef, clinic staff, and sampling team). Two additional suspected cases remain unconfirmed. Genomic analysis links the virus to a strain related to Kenya, with no confirmed epidemiological link to the DRC or other outbreaks; Uganda has increased screening and Uganda-DRC travel restrictions are noted. Nigeria’s NCDC approves ₦100,000 weekly for quarantined contacts (funding source unclear); surveillance at entry points and hygiene guidance remain essential as campaigns proceed and elections approach.”}{

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が国外搬送された今、ナイジェリア国民が知るべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで2014年以来初のエボラ確定例（ウガンダ由来・ブンディブジョ型）が発生し、国際的な患者搬送と接触者追跡（53名）が進行中であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生国はナイジェリア（感染源はウガンダ渡航歴）、患者はスイスへ空輸されたが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは遺伝子解析上の関連性が明確に否定されているため、発生地域として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo supera la barrera de los 10.000 casos de ébola y bordea los 5.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases and nears 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, 2026, making this outbreak the second deadliest and most contagious globally. Recoveries total 2,684 with a 48.6% case fatality rate; contact tracing stands at 81.6%. The eastern Ituri and North Kivu provinces are hardest hit, adding 32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours, with the outbreak affecting 66 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, and Ubangi South/North. Transmission remains high in Beni, Mandima, and Bunia. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no specific treatment; vaccines are in early-phase trials, and Ervebo campaigns began in August, with some cross-protective signals against Bundibugyo in animals. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths; Kenya has 9 cases (2 deaths) and Nigeria 1 case linked to the outbreak. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が1万人を突破し、死者数は5000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行(致死率48.6%)が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株による流行で特異的治療法がなく、ワクチンも早期段階の試験中であり継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Über 10.000 Fälle gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Over 10,000 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus is hard to contain, with the Congo outbreak reported to exceed 10,000 cases. East Africa reports nine infections in Kenya, including two deaths, linked to a patient who traveled from the Congo via Uganda to Nairobi. In West Africa, Nigeria reports a case in the wife of a Swiss diplomat who became ill after traveling to Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids, causing high fever, diarrhea, and bleeding. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no specific vaccine or therapy, and early symptoms can be misdiagnosed as malaria, hindering timely isolation. Since July, clinical trials are testing two antiviral therapies, and two additional studies are evaluating whether Ervebo, licensed for Ebola virus disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus, offers protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：1万人以上の感染例が報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万例超のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが発生し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。主たる発生地であるDRCのみを記載。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスには特異的ワクチン・治療法がなく、マラリアとの誤診による隔離遅延も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo steigt über 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo rises above 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa authorities report that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 officially confirmed cases, reaching 10,060 with 4,887 deaths to date. The case fatality rate is 48.6%, and contact tracing coverage stands at 81.6%. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no licensed vaccines. First cases were reported in May 2026 in Ituri Province, which remains the epicenter, accounting for 71.7% of all confirmed cases and 33.3% of new confirmed infections. The virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo provinces. Public health authorities continue surveillance, case management, and containment efforts to limit transmission in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、累計症例1万人超、複数州に拡大しワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、致死率が高く複数州に拡大していることから、既にWHO通知相当の重大イベントとみられる。続報でのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: إجلاء مريضة وزوجها الدبلوماسي السويسري من نيجريا وسط مخاوف من انتقال غير مكتشف للعدوى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Evacuation of a patient and her Swiss-diplomat husband from Nigeria amid fears of undetected transmission of the infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in over a decade, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no licensed vaccines or approved treatments. The patient is an Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, diagnosed with Ebola and evacuated by air to Geneva University Hospitals for treatment; her husband, a close contact, remains under isolation at University Hospital Zurich to rule out symptoms. Switzerland’s Federal Office of Public Health has prepared for advanced medical isolation for both. Nigerian Health Minister Mohammed Ali Bati said the patient’s condition improved and stabilized, enabling evacuation. Investigations into the infection source consider Uganda exposure, while Africa CDC Director-General Jan Kasia notes travel documents do not show a Congo visit, prompting rapid tracing of undetected transmission chains. The Congo outbreak has about 10,000 cases and 4,800 deaths, with sporadic cases in Kenya, leading Nigeria to tighten airport screenings.

triage.headline_ja: スイス人外交官夫人患者とその夫がナイジェリアから避難、感染の未検出拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで10年ぶりのエボラ症例が発生し、スイスへの国際的な患者避難と感染源不明の伝播連鎖調査が行われており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの症例およびスイスへの避難だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されるコンゴ（DRC）の大規模流行（約1万例・4800人死亡）は対象国に含まれるため記載。感染源調査はコンゴ訪問歴なしとされ、未検出の伝播経路の可能性が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 10 آلاف إصابة بإيبولا ونحو 5 آلاف وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records 10,000 Ebola cases and around 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of Oct 25, 2026, laboratory-confirmed cases reach 10,060 with 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%), 2,684 recoveries, and 81.6% contact tracing. The outbreak, declared May 15, spans eight provinces across 66 health zones, with Ituri and North Kivu the hardest hit (32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours). Notable transmission is in Beni (35), Mandima (11), and Bunia (8). Affected areas include Bafwasindi in Chobo. The outbreak is the second deadliest globally, surpassing the 2018–2020 Congo outbreak but behind 2014–2016 West Africa. The epidemic has reached Uganda (20 cases, including 15 imported from DRC with 2 deaths) and has linked cases in Kenya and Nigeria (one case each). Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding, transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数1万人、死者約5000人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死率48.6%・感染者1万人超・複数国への越境拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）が確認される重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（8州・66保健地域に拡大、史上2番目に死者数の多い流行）が主題。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例は国際拡大の証拠として言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 10,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases. As of October 25, 2026, the country reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, for a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak began in May and has affected 66 health zones across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces. The figures reflect the latest confirmed counts released by national health authorities on Oct 25. The ongoing outbreak highlights the continued transmission across multiple districts within the DRC since its start in May. The report provides a snapshot of the evolving situation as of Oct 25.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、26州中8州・66保健地区に拡大する大規模なエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 5月発生以来、26州中8州・66保健地区に拡大し、1万人超の症例・致死率48.6%という大規模流行。国際的な支援と監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: गाय-भैंस को लंपी रोग से बचाना है तो जान लें इसके लक्षण और बचाव के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you want to protect cows and buffaloes from Lumpy Skin Disease, learn its symptoms and preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease affects cows and buffaloes in India; hallmark symptoms are sudden, round, hard nodules appearing on the body, including the neck, head, legs, and other areas. Fever may accompany the nodules, with reduced appetite and water intake, lowered activity, and abrupt changes in routine or behavior. Some animals may have watery eyes and nose and drooling; leg swelling and weakness can occur, and milk yield can drop. Diagnosis relies on clinical signs and, if needed, laboratory tests. Transmission occurs via blood-sucking insects—flies, mosquitoes, ticks. Preventive measures include keeping barns clean, controlling pests, and separating infected animals to limit spread. Vaccination should be administered per a veterinarian’s advice. Early veterinary consultation is crucial; isolate affected animals and seek care promptly. Mentioned location: Agricultural Science Center, Sultanpur, India.

triage.headline_ja: 牛と水牛をランピースキン病から守るには、症状と予防法を知っておこう
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（牛・水牛）の動物疾病に関する一般的な症状・予防啓発記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はランピースキン病（LSD）の症状・予防に関する教育的内容であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。動物疾病でありヒト感染症ではないため、IHR/WPRO基準上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: عدد حالات الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو يتجاوز 10 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus infection cases in Congo exceeds 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola virus disease infections, with roughly half of patients having died, marking the fastest-spreading and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The surge is driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus), for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The outbreak began in May, and response efforts are hampered by armed conflict, poor road networks, and community violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. Authorities warn the crisis risks spreading to several African countries, complicating containment across borders. Data cited come from the Congolese Ministry of Health, underscoring the ongoing, highly challenging public health response in a volatile setting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染確定例、1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による史上最速・最も死亡率の高い流行で、越境拡大の懸念もありIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、武装紛争や住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている点、複数国への拡大リスクが指摘されている点から緊急のフルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果伊波拉累计确诊破万起 近半数患者死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 cumulative cases; nearly half of the patients have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 cumulative confirmed cases, with nearly half resulting in death (about 5,030 deaths), the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), with no approved vaccine or treatment. Spread has expanded from three initial health zones in May to 66 health zones across eight provinces and now involves three African regions. Confirmed cases have been reported in five countries, including DR Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France, indicating cross-border transmission. Public health responders face armed conflict, poor road conditions, mistrust, and misinformation, complicating reporting and care-seeking. Attacks on health workers persist; on Oct 24 in Tshopo Province a nurse was killed and another caregiver seriously injured while responding to a confirmed case.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、累計確定症例が1万件を突破 患者のほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC国内で拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスでも症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョウイルス(BDBV)による史上最悪規模の流行で、医療従事者への攻撃も発生しており情勢は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu odnela hiljade života: Više od 10.000 zaraženih, gotovo polovina preminula
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed thousands of lives: More than 10,000 infected, nearly half have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has reached 10,060 confirmed cases as of 2026-10-27, with nearly half of patients dying. Declared in May, the epidemic has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three at onset. The outbreak has also been registered in five countries, including Uganda and France (no active cases there); cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria. About 80% of new infections involve people not under health surveillance, signaling undetected transmission chains; authorities say roughly 95% of cases should be linked to known contacts to be considered under control. At least half of deaths were never admitted to treatment centers, underscoring access gaps. Health workers face violence, poor infrastructure, and distrust; a nurse was killed and another injured in Bafvasende, Chopo Province. The crisis disrupts routine health services, including child vaccination. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で数千人が死亡：感染者1万人超、ほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクが拡大し、致死率約50%、複数国への拡散が報告されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスでも症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リスト外（DRCのみ対象国）。承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、感染制御率（接触者追跡）が目標の95%に達していない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго около 5 тысяч человек скончались от лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, about 5,000 people have died from Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, with about 5,000 deaths, according to government data cited by the Associated Press as of Oct 27, 2026. Declared in May, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, making it the fastest-spreading and most deadly in the country’s history. Responders contend with armed conflict, poor roads, and community violence driven by mistrust and misinformation, hindering reporting of symptoms and access to care. About 80% of registered cases involve people not under surveillance, signaling ongoing transmission chains. The virus has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three at the outset. Treatment centers in some zones are overwhelmed, and healthcare workers have protested over delayed or unpaid wages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により約5000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、8州66保健ゾーンに及ぶ大規模アウトブレイクとなっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が承認されていないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる、同国史上最速・最多死亡のアウトブレイク。武装紛争や医療従事者の未払い賃金による抗議などが対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Število primerov okužbe z ebolo v DR Kongo preseglo 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infection cases in DR Congo exceeded 10,000.
article.articleSummary: On 27 October 2026, Kinshasa-based authorities said confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo had risen to 10,600, with 4,887 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May. The figures indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the country, with transmission continuing since the mid-May start; the article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or whether any cases were imported or exported. No regional distribution, symptoms, or treatment outcomes are discussed in the report. The update highlights the sustained burden of Ebola in DR Congo and the continued public health challenge posed by the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（感染者10,600人、死者4,887人）が継続中であり、重篤性・国際的拡大リスクともに高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約46%と高く、5月中旬以降継続中の大規模アウトブレイク。地域分布や感染経路、国際的な波及の詳細は記事に記載なし。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola arriva in Svizzera: una paziente ricoverata a Ginevra. E in Africa parte la sperimentazione del vaccino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola arrives in Switzerland: a female patient hospitalized in Geneva. And in Africa, the vaccine trial begins.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain reached Europe via a 42-year-old Nigerian woman diagnosed in Abuja on Oct 20 and transferred Oct 26 to Geneva University Hospital for isolation; her asymptomatic husband was hospitalized in Zurich. The transfer was preventive and conducted under biocontainment; Swiss authorities emphasize no risk to the population. Nigeria reports 52 contacts under surveillance with no new cases. Ebola transmission is not airborne; it occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, and symptoms (fever, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea) can resemble other infections, hindering early diagnosis. The case highlights hospital preparedness—resilient systems, rapid isolation, staff training, transport procedures, and lab connections. In Congo’s Bunia, Oct 23 marked the first participant in the Tumaini phase 2/3 vaccine trial against Bundibugyo; no vaccine is yet approved for this strain. Candidates include Ervebo (Zaire Ebola) and CEPI-supported vaccines from Moderna and Oxford/SIR, with ring vaccination to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がスイスに到達：女性患者がジュネーブで入院。アフリカではワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで診断されたエボラ(Bundibugyo株)患者がスイス・ジュネーブへ国際搬送された事例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例の発生国はナイジェリア、搬送先はスイスであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRC（Bunia）はワクチン治験実施地であり、エボラ発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Zahl der Fälle übersteigt 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Congo: Number of Cases Surpasses 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant has reached 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths as of October 2026, according to the DRC health institute via Reuters. This is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history and the second-largest and second-deadliest globally, surpassed only by the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016 (more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). Cases have also been reported in Kenya (9) and Nigeria (1), linked to travel from the DRC/Uganda; the Nigerian case involved the wife of a Swiss diplomat and was evacuated to Switzerland after likely Ugandan exposure. Uganda previously had 20 cases in May–June; the WHO declared the outbreak over in August, with 21-day quarantine advised for returnees. There is no licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or targeted therapy; Ervebo is being evaluated for cross-protection, and two antivirals are in trials since July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ史上最大・最悪のアウトブレイクとなり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大や渡航関連の二次感染も確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの症例波及は渡航関連の二次感染であり、発生地域の主体はDRC。ウガンダは既にWHOにより終息宣言済み（8月）のため、対象国リストに含まれているが本記事の主題としては過去の経緯として言及されるのみ。スイス・ケニア・ナイジェリア・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: حالات الإصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 10 آلاف حالة مؤكدة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 10,000 confirmed cases - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, per the latest report from the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Institute of Public Health (Reuters). The saga centers on the rare Bundibugyo strain, first declared mid-May, making it the largest and deadliest outbreak in DRC to date and second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (≈28,600 cases, >11,000 deaths) affecting Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month, raising nine cases after a traveler from DRC via Uganda; Nigeria has become the fourth African country to report a case. A Swiss diplomat’s wife, who had not traveled to Congo, is believed to have contracted the virus in Uganda; she and her husband were flown to Switzerland. Uganda previously recorded 20 cases in May–June, largely imported from DRC; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August, with authorities enforcing a 21-day quarantine for returning travelers from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が確認症例1万人を突破 - アルヨウム・サーベ
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が1万例・死亡者4,887人を超え過去最大規模となり、既にケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスへ国際的に拡大していることから、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）を主題とし、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスへの輸出例にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: How Uganda beat Ebola and what Kenya can learn
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak began with a 59-year-old Congolese man admitted May 11 at Kibuli Hospital in Kampala; he had traveled from the DRC via Hoima and presented with difficulty breathing, fever, abdominal pain, and nausea, then bleeding and died May 14. A sample tested positive May 15, making him the index case. Uganda recorded 20 cases, 18 recoveries, and 2 deaths (both Congolese). Fifteen infections were imported from DRC; five were Ugandan health workers. Across the border, Ituri Province reports 9,704 cases and >4,687 deaths. Bundibugyo has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda’s containment is praised as a model; factors include presidential leadership, rapid public briefings, and laboratories with sequencing that return results in 3–6 hours, enabling differentiation from Sudan/Zaire strains. An Incident Management Team chaired by a soldier directs a National Task Force with 11 sub-pillars and partners including US CDC, WHO, Africa CDC, USAID.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダはいかにエボラを克服したか、ケニアが学べる教訓
triage.triage_reason: DRC(イツリ州)由来のエボラ国際伝播がウガンダで確認され、医療従事者感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダの対応事例だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC(イツリ州)での大規模な症例・死亡数報告があり対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число заболевших Эболой достигло 10 тысяч. Эпидемия распространяется в три раза быстрее, чем предыдущая самая масштабная вспышка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of Ebola cases has reached 10,000. The outbreak is spreading three times faster than the previous largest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 28, 2026, centered in Ituri. The May 2026 outbreak is the second-largest in history and is spreading about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (28,600 cases, >11,000 deaths). Cases have been detected in DRC, Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, and France, with active transmission in DRC, Kenya, and Nigeria; Uganda and France report no active cases. Africa CDC scheduled an extraordinary online meeting of health ministers on Oct 28 due to Nigeria’s first confirmed case. Challenges include overwhelmed health systems, funding gaps, and community resistance rooted in beliefs. About 80% of new cases are identified outside known contact networks, hindering control; routine vaccination and maternal care are being disrupted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が1万人に到達。流行はこれまでで最大規模の前回アウトブレイクの3倍の速さで拡大中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染者が1万人を超え、過去最大級の流行を上回る速度で拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大とAfrica CDCの緊急会合開催が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリアでの初症例確認を受けAfrica CDCが緊急会合を開催しており、国際的な注目度・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reporta Más de 10 Mil Casos de Ébola y Casi 5 Mil Muertos por la Epidemia | N+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Reports More Than 10,000 Ebola Cases and Nearly 5,000 Deaths from the Outbreak | N+
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. It affects 66 health zones across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, Ubangi South, and Ubangi North. Transmission remains highest in Beni (35 cases), Mandima (11), and Bunia (8) in the last 24 hours; Ituri and North Kivu are the hardest-hit regions with 32 and 58 new cases in the past day. The outbreak is the second-deadliest and among the most transmissible globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (about 11,000 deaths, 28,000 infections). Vaccination efforts include a late-August Ervebo campaign in the DRC; two vaccines in phase 1 trials show safety, with several months of development ahead. WHO-backed trials are evaluating vaccines. Cross-border cases: Uganda (20 cases, 15 imported from DRC, 2 deaths by Aug 26), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1 case). The virus transmits via contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の症例1万件以上、死者ほぼ5000人を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（1万例超、死者約5000人）が8州66保健地域に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例も発生しており、国際的拡大・重篤性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行拡大が主題。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتخطى حاجز الـ 10 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in Congo surpass 10,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of October 27, 2026, official data from the Government of the Democratic Republic of Congo show Ebola virus disease infections in the country surpassing 10,000 confirmed cases. The update highlights ongoing health-system challenges in containing the outbreak and protecting affected populations. Local and international efforts are being mobilized to curb transmission in the regions affected by the epidemic. The report emphasizes the scale of the public health response required to manage surveillance, patient care, and containment measures amid a protracted outbreak. The figures underline sustained transmission and the need for continued coordination among national authorities and partners to limit spread and prevent further escalation in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラウイルス感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万人を超え、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と持続的な感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率や具体的な地理的拡大範囲、国際的な渡航制限の有無については記事に記載がなく不明。長期化するアウトブレイクであり、国際的な支援動員が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ熱感染者１万人超え　（共同通信）｜熊本日日新聞社
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo's Ebola virus disease cases exceed 10,000 (Kyodo News) | Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun
article.articleSummary: Headline notes Congo's Ebola virus disease cases exceed 10,000 per Kyodo News via Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun, dated 2026-10-27. The body, however, describes the KUMANICHI RECOMMEND article recommender system under development at Kumamoto University. The system aims to emulate human-like reasoning by assessing not only word similarity but also contextual usage to curate content for Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun's electronic edition. It warns that, during testing, unrelated articles may appear. The system relies on anonymized processed information to infer readers’ interests, removing identifiers such as names and addresses to comply with legal standards, with a disclosure page detailing this process. All content referenced resides within the Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun electronic edition. Keywords: recommender system, anonymized data, electronic edition, article curation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱感染者１万人超え　（共同通信）｜熊本日日新聞社
triage.triage_reason: 見出しはDRCでのエボラ出血熱感染者数が1万人を超えたという重大な数字を報じており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常事態に該当する。ただし記事本文は無関係なシステム説明に差し替わっており、詳細情報の確認のため続報・一次情報源の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文がBluedotの取得ミスにより熊本日日新聞社の記事推薦システムの説明文に置き換わっており、エボラ流行の詳細（感染拡大状況、国際的対応、渡航制限等）が確認できない。見出し情報（1万人超え）のみに基づく暫定評価であり、一次情報（WHO・CDC等）での裏付け確認が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis Tewaskan Tujuh Orang, Pencegahan di Kulon Progo Dikaji Pemerintah Pusat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis Kills Seven People; Central Government Reviews Prevention in Kulon Progo
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Kulon Progo district, Indonesia, totals 64 cases in 2026 with seven fatalities, signaling a dominant zoonosis risk prompting national review. Transmission occurs via rat urine, with farmers and day laborers most affected. Prevention centers on hygiene practices (PHBS) and early case finding, with prompt antibiotic treatment before sepsis improving outcomes. Kulon Progo is one of four national priority areas for assessing zoonosis and emerging infectious diseases (PIE), alongside Bali, East Java, and South Sulawesi. The Kemenko PMK assessment involved community discussions and district agencies; experts praised proactive community engagement. Officials stressed coordinated action between central and local governments and sustaining behavioral change to reduce environmental contamination and transmission. The study aims to identify effective prevention practices to strengthen responses in Kulon Progo and similar regions.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症で7人死亡、中央政府がクロン・プロゴでの予防策を検討
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症による死亡者数(7人)と重症化リスクがあり、中央政府が国家優先地域として予防策を検討するなど政府の関心が高いため、WPRO基準該当かつ社会的関心ありと判断。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はインドネシアで季節性に発生する風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。中央政府(Kemenko PMK)がクロン・プロゴ、バリ、東ジャワ、南スラウェシを人獣共通感染症対策の優先地域として評価中であり、政策的関心の高さからPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप बेकाबू: मामलों की संख... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo out of control: number of cases... | UNI Varta
article.articleSummary: As of October 27, 2026 in Bunia, Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, with about 5,000 deaths. Declared in May, this fastest-spreading outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment. The transmission spans eight of Congo’s provinces across 66 health zones, with reports of cases in Kenya and Nigeria. The absence of a licensed vaccine and effective therapy compounds the crisis, signaling severe public health challenges in the region. Ongoing surveillance and containment efforts face pressure from the high case load and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が制御不能に:感染者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例10,060件、死亡者約5,000人という大規模エボラ流行が発生し、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ国境を越えた感染拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及報告）がみられるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Polovina oboljelih od ebole preminula, lijeka nema
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Half of those infected with Ebola have died; there is no cure.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases, with about half dying, from Bundibugjo Ebola virus strain; no approved vaccine or treatment. Declared in May, the outbreak spans 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three at onset. Cases have been recorded in five countries, including Uganda and France; Kenya and Nigeria have also reported cases, though active cases are not present there now. About 80% of new infections involve people not under health surveillance, signaling undetected transmission chains. Africa CDC says at least 95% of cases should be linked to known contacts to be largely under control. Half of deaths were never admitted to treatment centers, indicating access gaps. Health workers face violence and shortages; centers are overwhelmed and staff have struck. In Bafvasende, Chopo Province, a nurse was killed during an Ebola response; another worker injured. Routine services, including vaccination and maternal care, are disrupted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者の半数が死亡、治療薬はない
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例10,060件、致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、複数国への国際的拡大と未検知の感染伝播が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内では66保健地区・8州に拡大し、医療従事者への暴力や医療崩壊、未検知感染連鎖（新規感染の約80%が監視下外）など深刻な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue khiến nam thanh niên nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever puts a young man in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old man from Tuyen Quang Province developed severe dengue fever with dengue shock syndrome and progressive respiratory failure, requiring intubation and VV-ECMO. On admission to National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, he was in critical condition: SpO2 about 80% on 100% oxygen, tachycardia 120–140 bpm, hypotension 80/40 mmHg despite vasopressors. Dengue confirmed with hepatic and renal dysfunction and coagulopathy. Diagnosed with dengue shock syndrome progressing to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS); monitored for gastrointestinal infection. VV-ECMO, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, and continuous renal replacement therapy were used. After 13 days of intensive care, ECMO and endotracheal tube were removed on 26 Oct 2026 at 15:00; patient awake and stable, progressing toward discharge. At the hospital, 18 dengue patients were under treatment. Dengue is transmitted mainly by Aedes mosquitoes; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding; avoid self-treatment and NSAIDs; vaccination guidance should be discussed with clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で若い男性が重体に
triage.triage_reason: 単一の重症デング熱症例報告であり、ベトナムでは季節性・地域流行性の疾患であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムにおいて季節性に流行する風土病であり、本記事は個別の重症例報告に過ぎない。院内に18名のデング患者がいるとの記載はあるが、集団発生や異常な増加を示す情報は提供されていない。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के 10,000 से अधिक पुष्ट मामले, अफ्रीकी देशों में संक्रमण रोकने की चुनौती बढ़ी | IBC24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases in Congo, the challenge of preventing transmission in African countries has increased | IBC24
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) with about half resulting in deaths, marking it as the deadliest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, is responsible. Since May, the outbreak has expanded from three health zones to eight provinces, reaching 66 health areas, with spillover into Kenya and Nigeria and infections reported in Uganda and France among five countries; Uganda and France currently have no active cases. Challenges include armed conflict, poor roads, mistrust and misinformation fueling local violence and resistance to care. About 80% of confirmed cases are not linked to known contacts; a 95% contact-tracing target is needed to consider containment. Strikes by health workers, a nurse killed, and strained cholera response, maternal health, immunization, and education accompany the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が1万人を超え、アフリカ諸国で感染拡大阻止の課題が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が確定症例1万人超・致死率約50%に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア等への国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスへの感染拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要発生国として確認される。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事中に明記されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, reached 10,060 cumulative confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%) as of 25 October 2026. In the latest tally, 96 new confirmed cases were reported across North Kivu (58), Ituri (32), and Tshopo (6). Community deaths numbered 40 (27 in North Kivu, 13 in Ituri); 6 confirmed deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers (4 North Kivu, 2 Ituri), bringing total deaths that period to 46. Ituri remains the epicenter with 71.7% of all confirmed cases and 33.3% of new cases. Fourteen patients recovered after testing negative twice (9 Ituri, 4 North Kivu, 1 Tshopo). No new health zones were affected in 24 hours; 66 of 178 zones (37.1%) across eight provinces have been affected since onset. Limited exportation: Kenya 9 cases, Nigeria 1, Uganda previously ~20 cases but declared outbreak-free in Aug 2026, plus at least one imported traveler from Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、確定症例数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例10,060例・死亡4,887例（致死率48.6%）に達し、8州66保健ゾーンに拡大、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。アウトブレイクの主体はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: L'epidemia di Ebola in Africa, circa 10.000 casi: al via lo studio Tumaini sui vaccini sperimentali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Africa, around 10,000 cases: the Tumaini study on experimental vaccines is underway.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists with 9,995 confirmed cases and 4,845 deaths as of October 24, 2026 per US CDC; RDC accounts for 9,964 cases and 4,841 deaths, while Kenya has 9 cases (2 deaths) from a single imported case, Nigeria 1 case, Uganda’s earlier outbreak of 20 cases (2 deaths) now concluded, and France reports a single imported, resolved case. WHO notes a case fatality near 48% and warns of rapid spread; May 2026 WHO PHEIC declaration underscores global concern. There is no vaccine approved for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is licensed for Zaire EBOV and not proven for Bundibugyo. The TUMAINI ring-vaccination trial began in Bunia, Ituri, testing Oxford’s chimpanzee adenovirus vaccine and Moderna’s mRNA candidate in a Phase 2/3 design, with initial efficacy data expected February–March 2027 and broader inclusion of pregnant women and children, led by Congolese authorities and CEPI.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行、約1万症例に ― 実験的ワクチンに関するトゥマイニ試験始まる
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模なエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行で、致死率約48%、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスでの症例は輸入例または既に終息した流行であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる流行地はDRC（特にイトゥリ州ブニア）。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo supera la barrera de los 10.000 casos de ébola y bordea los 5.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases and nears 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and nears 5,000 deaths, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 fatalities (case fatality 48.6%) through Oct 25; 2,684 recovered. Contact tracing stands at 81.6%. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, which recorded 32 and 58 new infections in the last 24 hours. The outbreak spans 66 health zones across eight provinces, with Beni (35), Mandima (11) and Bunia (8) hotspots. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally and second-most extensive in the DRC; no strain-specific therapies exist. WHO is testing vaccines; Ervebo is deployed for Zaire strains, while trials for Bundibugyo vaccines are underway. Cross-border spread includes Uganda (20 infections, 2 deaths; 15 imported from DRC), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), and Nigeria (1). Transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者が1万人を突破し死者は5千人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC全土66保健地区に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOがワクチン試験を実施中、Bundibugyo株による流行で既存のErvebo（Zaire株用）の有効性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: A történelem második legsúlyosabb ebolajárványa tombol: már több ezer halálos áldozata van a fertőzésnek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: History's second-deadliest Ebola outbreak rages: it has already claimed more than a few thousand lives.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths, marking it as the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. First reported in mid-May, it has become the largest and most severe in DRC’s history, exceeding the 2018–2020 wave. Cross-border spread is a focus: Kenya has recorded nine imported cases after a Congolese patient died in Nairobi; Nigeria confirmed a case—the fourth African country—connected to a Swiss diplomat’s wife who had not travelled to DRC, with investigations ongoing and treatment in Switzerland. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August; Ugandan returnees face a 21-day quarantine. The EU’s ECDC deems Europe at very low risk, mainly for evacuation. A Lancet Infectious Diseases model highlights a six-week gap from first case to alert, underscoring cross-border movement, healthcare infection-control weaknesses, and regional coordination; Uganda (94.2%) and South Sudan (69.3%) are flagged as high importation risks.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行が猛威を振るう：既に数千人の死者が発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万人超の感染・約5000人の死亡という歴史的規模に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア等への国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題とし、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスへの越境事例に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスは対象外）ため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: ВО КОНГО РЕГИСТРИРАНИ ПОВЕЌЕ ОД 10.000 СЛУЧАИ НА ЕБОЛА Најбрзорастечка епидемија на болеста во историјата - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 10,000 Ebola cases registered — the fastest-growing epidemic in the history of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 10,060 Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths in the current outbreak, described by Africa's leading health agency as the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history. The Bundibugjo variant has been confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria. Kenya has nine infections and two deaths after a patient traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Nairobi. Nigeria confirmed its first case on Oct 20, a Swiss national who entered Nigeria from Uganda; investigations continue to identify exposure. Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak, with two deaths, all linked to a patient from the DRC; Uganda had declared the outbreak over at the end of August after 42 days with no new cases. Transmission is through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids, causing high fever with diarrhea and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万人以上のエボラ症例を記録 ― 史上最速の拡大を見せる流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万例超・致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行が発生し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが流行の震源地として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Cases Surpass 10,000 as Virus Spreads
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections, with 10,060 cases reported, making it the deadliest outbreak in the DRC's history. Spread across eight provinces, Ituri remains the epicenter; WHO data through Oct 20 counted 9,704 confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths in the DRC. Attacks on health workers and limited access hamper containment. The outbreak has crossed borders, with imported cases in Kenya (early October) and Nigeria (Oct 20), triggering contact tracing and border surveillance and prompting incident-management and infection control measures. No approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo strain; public health guidance emphasizes supportive care, rapid case finding, case isolation, and sustained cross-border surveillance. Authorities and partners coordinate surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, and community engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大 感染者数1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がIHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 10.000 τα κρούσματα στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Over 10,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths from the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak, the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in DRC since mid-May. Globally, it is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, trailing only West Africa 2014–2016 (over 28,600 infections and >11,000 deaths). Cross-border spread is evident: Kenya has nine cases after a Nairobi death of a man who traveled from DRC via Uganda; Nigeria reported a case last week, the fourth African country with Ebola. A Swiss-diplomat’s wife, who had not traveled to DRC, is being investigated; Swiss authorities say she likely contracted it in Uganda. Uganda previously had 20 cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free in August, but now imposes a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan returnees from DRC to prevent re-importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で症例数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で1万人超の感染・約5千人の死亡を記録し、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイス）への国際的拡大とウガンダでの検疫措置という渡航制限も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスへの越境感染が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが本事例の主要発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: Broj potvrđenih slučajeva ebole u Kongu premašio 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 10,060, with 4,887 deaths since the outbreak emerged in mid-May, according to health authorities. Described as the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in history, the highly contagious Bundibugyo variant has been confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria: Kenya reports nine cases and two deaths, including a patient who arrived in Nairobi from Congo via Uganda. Nigeria confirmed its first case on October 20, a Swiss national who entered from Uganda; investigations are ongoing to identify where infection occurred. Uganda has recorded 20 confirmed cases linked to a single Congo patient, with two deaths, and declared the end of its outbreak at the end of August after 42 days without a new case. Transmission occurs through close contact and exposure to body fluids, causing fever, diarrhea, and bleeding.

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 10.000 τα κρούσματα 'Εμπολα - Σχεδόν 5000 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Over 10,000 Ebola cases - nearly 5,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (latest government data: 10,060) and 4,887 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The May-ongoing outbreak is the largest and most lethal in DRC to date, second only to the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic in scale and fatalities. Kenya reported its first case this month, later reporting nine cases after a man who died in Nairobi had traveled from Congo via Uganda. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report a case last week. Authorities are tracing unusual transmission linked to a Swiss diplomat’s wife; authorities believe infection occurred in Uganda, with the couple evacuated to Switzerland. Uganda previously had 20 cases in May–June but was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August; now, Ugandan officials say returning citizens who traveled to Congo will undergo 21-day quarantine.

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola cases pass 10,000 as fears grow of wider African spread
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola cases exceed 10,000: 10,060 confirmed and 4,887 deaths (DRC public health institute) as of Oct 27, 2026, with Bundibugyo strain. Since mid-May, the outbreak is the largest and deadliest in DRC, second-largest and second-deadliest on record behind 2014-2016 West Africa (28,600 cases, 11,000 deaths). Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month; nine cases total after a man who travelled from DRC died in Nairobi. Nigeria became the fourth African country to report an Ebola case last week. A Swiss diplomat's wife, who had not travelled to DRC, contracted the disease; the Swiss government says she likely contracted it in Uganda; she and her husband were flown to Switzerland. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June, mostly imported from DRC; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August; Uganda will quarantine returning citizens with DRC travel history for 21 days. Travel restrictions and quarantines are rising across Africa.

triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主たる発生地域であり、致死率も高く、既に2014-2016西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模となっている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Nam thanh niên 27 tuổi tử vong sau 2 tháng bị chó cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 27-year-old man dies two months after being bitten by a dog
article.articleSummary: Two months after a dog bite, a 27-year-old man in Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, died of rabies. The victim, G., from Bình Hà, Đa Kia commune, sustained a bite on his left ring finger and did not seek wound care or vaccination. Dog had bitten four of the family’s dogs, all of which died; the suspected rabid dog was captured, killed, and sold for meat. On Oct 15 he developed fever, chills, fatigue, loss of appetite, difficulty swallowing; he was admitted Oct 18 to Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital and diagnosed with rabies, dying Oct 19. An exposure case involved a child, Đ.Y., who was bitten by the same dog on Oct 15 and did not receive prophylaxis. Authorities urge prompt wound cleansing, vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin as indicated, and vaccination of people involved in slaughter/consumption. Rabies is nearly always fatal after symptoms, but preventable with timely post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: 27歳男性、犬に噛まれて2カ月後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける散発的な狂犬病死亡例であり、個別症例としては公衆衛生上の重大な国際的影響は低いが、予防行動の不徹底や曝露継続のリスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単発の狂犬病死亡例報道。曝露後の予防措置不履行が死亡原因であり、同一犬による別の曝露例（子供）も報告されているため、地域内での予防啓発の必要性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Заразнее, но вряд ли опаснее. Что известно о новом варианте коронавируса со "скачкообразной" мутацией
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More contagious, but unlikely to be more dangerous. What is known about the new coronavirus variant with a "leap-like" mutation.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a coronavirus variant derived from MC.10.1.7 (descendant of JN.1), first identified May 2, 2026 in Ontario, Canada, and subsequently detected in the United States, Spain, Singapore, and Australia. In a ScienceDirect study, PJ.2.1 entered 4 of 5 tested cell lines 1.5–2.5 times more efficiently than LP.8.1, indicating higher transmissibility. A bioRxiv preprint by a Chinese group shows markedly stronger binding to human ACE2 than co-circulating NB.1.8.1, XFG, and BA.3.2.2. Clinically, there is no evidence of a more severe COVID-19 course: no rise in pneumonia, ARDS, respiratory failure, hospitalization, ICU admission, or death. Older adults appear more affected (60+ or 70+ per source). Short-term threat is rapid spread, not virulence; vaccines remain available in Europe/US, while Russia reportedly does not vaccinate. Ongoing genomic and epidemiological surveillance is urged, with monitoring of PJ.2.1 subvariants for potential immune escape.

triage.headline_ja: 感染力は強いが危険性は低い可能性。『跳躍的』変異を持つ新型コロナウイルス変異株について判明していること
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1は伝播性の増加が示唆されるが、重症度上昇の証拠はなく、現時点で対象国での発生報告もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事中の中国への言及はACE2結合親和性を調べた研究グループの所属であり、実際の発症・流行地域ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。現時点で確認されている発生地域（カナダ、米国、スペイン、シンガポール、オーストラリア）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Όχλος οπλισμένος με ματσέτες σκότωσε νοσοκόμα που φρόντιζε ασθενείς με Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: An armed mob with machetes killed a nurse who cared for Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Armed youths with machetes killed a nurse responding to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, injuring another healthcare worker. The attackers accused the victims of spreading the disease by contaminating water sources. The nurse worked at the General Hospital in Bafwasende and helped raise awareness about the Bundibugyo strain, which the DRC Ministry of Health says has killed more than 4,800 people in the country since the outbreak began in May. The World Health Organization condemned the attack, with Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressing that health workers must be able to work with dignity and safety. In the region, health workers are currently housed at the hospital under police protection, and the army was deployed briefly. This incident follows a series of violent acts fueled by misinformation about the deadly virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：マチェーテで武装した暴徒がエボラ患者を看護していた看護師を殺害
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行(4800人以上死亡)に関連し、医療従事者への暴力という新たな深刻な展開がありWHOも懸念を表明しているため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者への暴力事件が主題だが、背景に進行中の大規模エボラ流行(5月以降4800人以上死亡)があり、対応活動への悪影響・治安悪化が懸念されるためピックアップと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Случаите на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 10 000, близо половината от заразените са починали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 10,000, with nearly half of those infected having died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) with about half of patients dying, marking the fastest-growing and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The May 2026 outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health teams face armed conflict, poor road infrastructure, and violence fueled by mistrust and misinformation, complicating reporting of symptoms and access to care. The outbreak is affecting several African countries as authorities strive to curb transmission. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic recorded over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. An accompanying image references a clinical-trials sample from Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, in October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が1万人を超え、感染者の約半数が死亡

article.articleHeadline: ECDC & CDC Updates On Ebola Multi-country outbreak 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus is driving a multi-country outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that began in May 2026 and has reached near 10,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The spillover has extended beyond the DRC to neighboring countries, with imported cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria in October 2026; Uganda has reported cases but the outbreak there has ended. Outside the DRC and adjacent areas, public health risk is considered low, though sporadic exported cases remain possible. Public health authorities—CDC and ECDC—issued updated outbreak briefings on 26 October, noting ongoing containment challenges amid complex regional circumstances. The situation is under ongoing surveillance and cross-border transmission dynamics are a key focus, with the WHO monitoring and providing additional context as updates continue.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCとCDCがエボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイク2026について最新情報を発表
