triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息済み、ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入症例のみで対象国リストに含まれないため、発生地域として主題となっているのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアはCEPR対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera la barrera de los 10.000 casos y se acerca al umbral de los 4.900 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 10,000 cases and approaches the 4,900-death threshold.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 cases and nears 4,900 deaths. The latest INSP bulletin reports 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, including 96 new cases and 46 deaths in the last day; case fatality rate 48.6%. About 2,684 recoveries and 81.6% contact-tracing follow-up. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 71.7% of cases, though its share dropped to 33.3% in the last day as the virus spreads to eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Ubangi North and Ubangi South. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, with projections to surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which had 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO. Kenya and Nigeria have confirmed cases linked to the DRC outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which has no vaccine or approved treatment; regional surveillance has been tightened.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万人の感染者を超え、死者数4,900人の閾値に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは1万人超の症例、致死率48.6%、8州への拡大、ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例確認という複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを主題としている。ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例確認、シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアへの言及は2014-16年西アフリカアウトブレイクとの比較のためであり、現在の発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。ワクチン・承認された治療法がないBundibugyo株によるものであり、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola en RDC supera los 10.000 infectados y se aproxima a los 4.900 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC surpasses 10,000 infected and approaches 4,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and about 4,900 deaths, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 fatalities, including 96 cases and 46 deaths in the last 24 hours. The case fatality rate is approximately 48.6%. Recovered: 2,684; contact tracing 81.6%. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 71.7% of cases, though last-day infections accounted for 33.3% there, indicating spread to eight other provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Ubangi North, and Ubangi South. This is the deadliest RDC outbreak, potentially surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths). Cases linked to the outbreak have appeared in Kenya and Nigeria. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. Authorities have intensified surveillance to contain transmission and prevent continental spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱感染者が1万人を超え、死者数は4900人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.6%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・承認治療薬がないBundibugyo株であり、西アフリカ2014-16流行を超える可能性が指摘されている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Vachira Phuket monitors two suspected MERS cases
article.articleSummary: Two suspected MERS cases under investigation at Vachira Phuket Hospital in Week 43 (Oct 19–25); test results pending; no confirmed MERS cases or deaths reported. Phuket Provincial Public Health Office has not issued announcements. MERS is a coronavirus first identified in 2012 in Saudi Arabia; transmission can be animal-to-human via close contact with camels or raw camel milk, and human-to-human via respiratory droplets, with outbreaks in healthcare settings. Incubation typically 2–14 days; symptoms include fever, cough, breathing difficulties, sore throat, muscle aches and fatigue; severe disease can cause pneumonia and respiratory failure. The hospital has implemented disease surveillance and public education. In the same week, 272 communicable-disease cases were under surveillance: influenza 96, acute diarrhoea 72, pneumonia 33 (one death); melioidosis accounted for the second weekly death; 12 COVID-19 and 11 SARS‑CoV‑2/RSV; other infections included dengue, syphilis, gonorrhoea, mpox under investigation. Geographically, 191 in Mueang Phuket, 41 in Thalang, 36 in Kathu; 4 from other provinces. For symptoms, contact Vachira Phuket Hospital at 076-361234; emergency 1669.

triage.headline_ja: ワチラプーケット病院、MERS疑い症例2件を監視
triage.triage_reason: MERS疑い症例2件が検査結果待ちで確定診断はまだ出ておらず、タイでは稀な疾患のため注視が必要だが、現時点で確定例・死亡例はなく情報が不足している。
triage.notes: MERSは確定例ではなく疑い症例2件で検査結果待ちの段階。サウジアラビアの言及はMERSの一般的な背景説明（2012年にサウジアラビアで最初に確認）であり、発生地ではないため除外。続報（検査結果確定）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: VIRUS BEZ LEKA POKOSIO GOTOVO 5.000 LJUDI! Medicinsku sestru iskasapili mačetama - haos zbog ebole u DR Kongo, smrtonosna zaraza se širi preko granica! (FOTO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus without a cure has claimed nearly 5,000 lives! A medical nurse was hacked to death with machetes — chaos over Ebola in DR Congo, the deadly outbreak is spreading across borders! (PHOTO).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugjo virus, with over 10,060 confirmed cases and nearly 50% mortality, marking the deadliest, fastest-spreading epidemic in the country’s history. The crisis spans 66 health zones across eight DR Congo provinces; about 80% of new cases occur in people not under surveillance. A hospital attack in Copo Province killed a nurse and seriously injured another health worker amid violence, strikes, and anti-health misinformation. Five countries are affected: DR Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France; Uganda and France report no active cases, while Nigeria reports infection in the Swiss diplomat’s wife after returning from Uganda. Kenya has high-alert border controls and 118 identified contacts, with eight positives (including health workers and family members); two Kenyan fatalities are linked to travelers from DR Congo (one in Nairobi, and a relative who developed symptoms in quarantine). No licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists; healthcare services are overwhelmed, with pregnant women avoiding hospitals and routine immunization halted.

triage.headline_ja: 治療法のないウイルスが約5000人の命を奪う！看護師がマチェーテで惨殺される－コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が混乱を招き、致死的感染が国境を越えて拡大！（写真）
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は10,060例・致死率約50%と深刻で、同国史上最悪・最速の流行とされ、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大や渡航制限（ケニアの国境警戒）も確認されており、IHR基準4項目中複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビアの大衆紙によるセンセーショナルな報道で、症例数・致死率等の数値は他の公式情報源との照合が必要。ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、フランスでの感染・曝露例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se nezadržno širi: več kot 10.600 okuženih, skoraj 4.900 ljudi je umrlo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading relentlessly: more than 10,600 people have been infected, nearly 4,900 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with confirmed cases reaching 10,600 and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May. The Africa CDC says this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date, driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine. Public trust issues and violence hinder the response. The Bundibugyo strain has also been detected in neighboring countries: Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Kenya has nine cases, including two deaths, with seven patients in isolation. Nigeria confirmed its first case last week, a Swiss citizen who had traveled from Uganda. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths. By late August, Uganda declared the outbreak over after 42 consecutive days with no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が止まらず拡大：感染者1万600人超、死者はほぼ4900人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速ペースのエボラ流行が発生し、死者数が多く近隣国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）へ国際的に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも症例が確認されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチンが存在しない点、暴力や住民の不信感が対応を妨げている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 1만명 넘어...절반 가까이 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 10,000, with nearly half having died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 10,000 confirmed cases, with 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%) as of Oct 25, 2026 (cumulative 10,060). Originating May 15 in Ituri, the transmission has spread through North Kivu and South Kivu to eight provinces and 66 health zones, reaching northwestern Ubangi. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccines or therapies exist; response efforts are hampered by armed conflict, distrust of health workers, and unpaid salaries. An Oct 24 attack in Ituri killed a nurse and injured another. Ongoing transmission persists at roughly 2,000 new cases per month. Cross-border cases include Kenya, where a man who had lived in DRC died after returning through Uganda (eight contacts confirmed), and Nigeria, where the wife of a Swiss diplomat infected and evacuated to Switzerland with her husband. Uganda reports no further confirmed cases, though Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi warns risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定症例が1万人を超える…約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の確定症例が1万人を超え致死率48.6%、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、国境を越えた感染拡大(ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイス)も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生事例。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行が主題。ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイス、ウガンダ、スイスは国際拡散の文脈で言及されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。武力紛争による対応困難、医療従事者への攻撃など対応能力に重大な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Broj slučajeva zaraze ebolom u DR Kongu prešao 10 tisuća
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths from a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak declared mid-May, the largest and deadliest in the country and the second-largest globally, behind West Africa 2014-2016 (28,600 cases, over 11,000 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Kenya has recorded its first Ebola case this month, with nine infections after a Nairobi death of a man who traveled from Congo via Uganda. Nigeria became the fourth African country with a case last week. In Nigeria, authorities are tracing exposure linked to the Swiss diplomat's wife who did not travel to Congo; Swiss authorities think infection occurred in Uganda. Uganda reported 20 May–June cases from arrivals from Congo; WHO said no active cases in August, while Ugandan ministers announce 21-day quarantines for returning citizens who had Congo exposure.

triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスへの拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRコンゴが主要な発生国であり、対象国として唯一該当する。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 10 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus with 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak is the deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest globally, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which had over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. Cross-border spread includes Kenya (nine cases, following its first infection this month, with a Nairobi death linked to Congo via Uganda) and Nigeria (a case in the wife of a Swiss diplomat who had not traveled to Congo, likely infected in Uganda; both evacuated to Switzerland). Uganda reported about 20 cases in May–June, most from Congo, and WHO declared it Ebola-free in August. Returning travelers from Congo face a 21-day quarantine.

triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万人超の感染・4,887人の死亡に達し、同国史上最悪・世界で2番目に大きい流行となっている。ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 10 000 Ebola-Fälle in Demokratischer Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating. There is no vaccine or specific therapy available for the circulating Ebola virus variant. Health authorities report the number of reported Ebola cases in the DRC has risen to 10,060. The rapid growth emphasizes the ongoing, fast-moving nature of the outbreak and the urgent public health challenge it poses in the country. The article highlights the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for this variant, indicating continued reliance on outbreak response within the Democratic Republic of the Congo. No timeframe for containment or vaccine development is provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が1万例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数が1万例を超え、ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しない変異株による急速な拡大が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil's poultry exports hit as second Newcastle case confirmed
article.articleSummary: Second Newcastle disease case confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil: a poultry farm in Coronel Freitas detected during intensified surveillance; depopulation of affected birds is underway. The Official Veterinary Service has launched an epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment within the restricted area established after the first outbreak on Oct 18 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency has been declared for Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The ministry notified the WOAH and trading partners. Separately, infection with avian paramyxovirus type 1 (PPMV-1) was found in pigeons outside the sanitary emergency area, but this is not considered a Newcastle outbreak per WOAH definitions. Brazil, the world's largest poultry exporter with around 37% of global market share, has faced temporary import restrictions: Mexico and Malaysia halted imports from across Brazil; China, Chile, and Saudi Arabia from the Santa Catarina region.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2例目のニューカッスル病確認、家禽輸出に打撃
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で2例目のニューカッスル病が確認され、複数国が輸入停止措置を取るなど貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「渡航・貿易制限」の2つに該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽(動物)における疾病であり、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていない。主に農業・貿易への影響が中心。中国・チリ・マレーシア・サウジアラビア・メキシコは発生地域ではなく輸入停止措置を取った国であるため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda orders 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposes a mandatory 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb Ebola spread, with intensified surveillance at Entebbe International Airport and land borders. Returning Ugandans must cover quarantine costs and complete contact-tracing forms. The measures come as reports of Ebola infections in Nigeria and Kenya prompt authorities to probe the possible link between the outbreaks and to scrutinize the source of Nigeria's first confirmed Ebola case in more than a decade. Uganda’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was declared over in July after 20 infections and 2 deaths, leaving the country with no active cases. Investigations into Nigeria's imported case continue, with conflicting accounts about the infected woman’s movements before testing positive and efforts to assess connections to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に21日間の隔離を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを起点に、ウガンダが渡航制限（隔離措置）を実施し、ナイジェリア・ケニアでも感染例が報告されるなど国際的拡大の懸念が強い。IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの渡航制限措置だが、感染源はDRCのアウトブレイクであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。ナイジェリアの輸入例とケニアとの関連性については調査継続中であり、今後の続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thai food study finds bacteria in raw enoki mushroom samples
article.articleSummary: Five raw enoki mushroom samples collected from Bangkok shops tested positive for Listeria monocytogenes, according to Thailand's National Food Institute, with all samples from domestically produced and Chinese-imported mushrooms confirming contamination. Although the five-sample study from April 2024 cannot quantify prevalence, it aligns with recent overseas recalls highlighting safety concerns. Enoki mushrooms, used in hotpot, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, stir-fries and grilling, pose listeriosis risk, especially to older adults, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals; symptoms include fever, muscle pain, diarrhoea and vomiting, and severe cases may cause bloodstream infections or meningitis. Listeria can grow at refrigerator temperatures, so chilling does not eliminate risk. Growing conditions—high humidity and dense clusters—facilitate contamination. May 2026 US FDA recalls and import restrictions on enoki from China/South Korea underscore persistent risk. The National Food Institute urges thorough cooking to at least 74°C and hygiene; the CDC advises restaurants not to serve raw enoki or garnish with it.

triage.headline_ja: タイの食品研究で生エノキタケサンプルから細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 実際のヒト症例報告はなく、2024年4月に実施されたエノキタケ5検体の食品安全性調査でリステリア菌が検出されたという内容であり、現時点でアウトブレイクの兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年4月に実施された食品安全性調査の結果報告であり、実際のヒト症例発生の報告はない。中国産エノキタケも検査対象に含まれていたが、発生地はタイのバンコクの市場であるため、Chinaはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 10,000
article.articleSummary: By 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 10,060 Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, per Reuters citing the Congolese Public Health Institute. The outbreak, declared in May, is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain and is the largest, deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC to date, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. The global record remains the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, with over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. Outside DRC, Kenya has nine cases this month; Nigeria reported its first case last week, the fourth African country with infection in the current outbreak. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June, largely imported from DRC; the WHO declared that Uganda outbreak over in August. No current cases in Uganda, though returning citizens are quarantined for 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱患者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで患者1万人超・死者4,887人に達し史上最大規模のエボラ流行となっており、ケニア・ナイジェリアなど複数国への国際的拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行を主題としており、Angola・Kenya・Uganda・Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率約48.6%と極めて高く、稀なBundibugyo株による過去最大のDRC国内流行。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les rumeurs alimentent la peur et retardent l'accès aux soins(OMS) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Rumors Fuel Fear and Delay Access to Care (WHO) - ACP
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province (Bunia), rumors about Ebola treatment centers are fueling fear and delaying care, according to WHO. A six-year-old with fever and vomiting initially received home remedies for presumed malaria and a traditional healer, deterred by rumors of deadly injections, before arriving at a health facility in a critical state; he died 48 hours later. From May–Sept 2026, WHO-supported analyses reviewed over 34,650 online contents (rumors and concerns). In Ituri, more than 1,000 rumors have been addressed through community dialogues and outreach to strengthen trust in response teams. The WHO urges accessible, reliable information delivered by trusted community figures to encourage rapid care-seeking and counter misinformation during the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：噂が恐怖を煽り、治療へのアクセスを遅らせる（WHO）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報告であり、死亡例や地域社会での誤情報拡散による対応遅延が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する誤情報・デマ対策に焦点を当てているが、進行中のアウトブレイクの一部として評価する必要がある。マラリアは本記事の主題ではなく、誤診断の文脈で言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱感染1万人超え　コンゴ、紛争で対策難航
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections exceed 10,000 as the Democratic Republic of the Congo's response is hampered by conflict.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 27, 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 cases with 4,887 deaths, concentrated in the eastern outbreak zones where ongoing conflict hampers response. The outbreak, which intensified since May 2026, prompted the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern in May. This outbreak ranks as the second-largest on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which reported over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. In addition to the DRC, infections have been confirmed in Uganda, with further cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria, underscoring cross-border transmission risks amid instability and limited access to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱感染1万人超え　コンゴ、紛争で対策難航
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEIC宣言済みで1万人超・死亡者5千人近くに達し、国境を越えた伝播（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Mehr als 10.000 Ebola-Fälle in Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 Ebola cases in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 10,060 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 4,887 deaths since its mid-May onset. Africa CDC says it is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Ebola virus disease is a life-threatening fever transmitted by close contact with bodily fluids, causing diarrhea and bleeding. The Bundibugyo variant has also been confirmed in Kenya (nine infections, two deaths) after a Congo-based patient traveled to Nairobi via Uganda. In Nigeria, a patient—the wife of a Swiss diplomat—became ill after a trip to Uganda; the Nigerian patient was evacuated to Switzerland and authorities are investigating the infection source. Since July, clinical trials have tested two antivirals; two additional studies are evaluating whether the Ervebo vaccine protects against Bundibugyo-type EVD. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万人を超えるエボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が10,060症例・4,887死亡に達し、ケニアおよびナイジェリア（経由スイス）への国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 10 000 cas confirmés, près de 4 900 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases, nearly 4,900 deaths
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases with 4,887 deaths since onset, per a Health Ministry update through Oct 25, 2026. Total: 10,060 confirmed cases and a 48.6% case fatality. Declared May 15, 2026, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. On Oct 25, 96 new cases were reported (58 in North Kivu, 32 in Ituri, 6 in Tshopo) with 46 deaths (40 community, 6 in treatment centers). Ituri remains the epicenter (7,211 cases, 3,370 deaths; 71.7% of national totals). North Kivu: 2,309 cases, 1,293 deaths (lethality 56%). Across 66 health zones in eight provinces, no new zones were affected. Recoveries total 2,684, with 14 additional recoveries on Oct 25. Surveillance is incomplete: 81.6% of 19,853 contacts followed; transport difficulties hinder care, e.g., two suspected cases at Biakato May could not be transferred due to lack of ambulances.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱の流行が確定症例1万件、死者約4,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例が1万人を超え、致死率48.6%という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、8州66保健区に拡大し監視体制も不完全なため、国際的拡大リスクと支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRC第17次エボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）。接触者追跡率81.6%と不完全で、輸送手段不足により治療アクセスに支障が出ている。北キブ州・イトゥリ州・ツショポ州にまたがり拡大継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Над 10.000 случаи на ебола во Конго, вирусот се прошири и во Кенија и Нигерија
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 10,000 Ebola cases in Congo, the virus has spread to Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Epicenter of the outbreak is the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola totals reach 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, marking Africa CDC as reporting the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date. The Bundibugyo variant has been confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria: Kenya reports nine cases and two deaths linked to a traveler from Congo who passed through Uganda to Nairobi. Nigeria confirms its first case on October 20, a Swiss citizen who arrived from Uganda; investigations continue to determine exact infection source. In Uganda, the current outbreak accounts for 20 cases and two deaths; Uganda declared the outbreak ended in late August after 42 days with no new cases. Transmission occurs via direct contact with an infected person or their bodily fluids, with symptoms including high fever, diarrhea, and bleeding, requiring rapid detection and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染1万人超、ウイルスはケニアとナイジェリアにも拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万人超の患者・致死率約49%の大規模流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際拡大の文脈として重要な情報であり、フルRRAでの評価対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в ДР Конго: Над 10 000 случая и рекордна смъртност
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: Over 10,000 cases and a record death toll.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 laboratory-confirmed cases (10,060) with about half of those infected dead, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. The May-declared outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. On-the-ground response is impeded by armed conflict, poor roads, local violence, and distrust/misinformation that hinder symptom reporting and care-seeking. As of Sept 28, confirmed cases were just over 8,000; by Oct 2, deaths exceeded 4,000. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak had over 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths, and the current DR Congo crisis is growing at least three times faster at a similar stage of spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱：感染者1万人超、史上最悪の死亡率
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、1万人超の感染、ワクチン・治療法未承認のバンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる史上最速・最悪の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれているが記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であり、対象国リストにAngolaは含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Erste Ebola-Patientin von Nigeria in die Schweiz evakuiert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola patient evacuated from Nigeria to Switzerland
article.articleSummary: First Ebola patient diagnosed in Nigeria, a Swiss woman, has been evacuated to Switzerland. She departed Abuja on Monday morning with her husband, a Swiss diplomat, aboard a specially equipped plane under strict protection; she will be treated at Geneva University Hospital, while her husband is isolated as a contact at Zurich University Hospital. Swiss authorities say there is no danger to the Swiss population, though the patient remains contagious and is clinically stable, conscious, and able to communicate. The exact site of infection is still under investigation. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 20; the patient, reportedly born in Uganda, had flown from Uganda. Africa CDC notes ongoing Ebola activity in East Africa: in the Democratic Republic of Congo, nearly 10,000 cases and about 5,000 deaths since mid-May; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths (outbreak ended Aug after 42 days with no new cases); Kenya has nine cases in Nairobi, including two deaths. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or body fluids; symptoms can appear within 21 days. The article outlines general symptoms but stops short of listing them in full.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアからスイスへ最初のエボラ患者が搬送
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの初のエボラ確定例がスイスへ国際搬送されたことに加え、DRCで約1万例・死亡約5000人という大規模な進行中流行があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・スイス・ウガンダ・ケニアでの状況にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの大規模流行（約1万例、死亡約5000人、5月中旬以降）が記事内で明示的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'ONU condamne le meurtre d'un infirmier engagé dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The UN condemns the murder of a nurse involved in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: UN and WHO condemned the attack in Bafwasende, Tshopo, northeast DRC, where an Ebola response nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured. Julien Harneis urged protection for health workers; Tedros Ghebreyesus echoed the call, stressing responders must work safely. The violence intensifies community mistrust and security barriers facing Ebola control, with earlier attacks, including tents burned at health centers in May. Separately, a Swiss national infected with Ebola in Nigeria was evacuated to Switzerland with her spouse; Nigeria reported no further cases, but 52 contacts are under surveillance—the first Nigerian Ebola case in 12 years. In DRC, the outbreak spans eight provinces and 66 health zones, with 9,816 confirmed cases, 4,757 deaths, 2,635 recoveries (CFR 48.5%); 1,130 patients are isolated or hospitalized. Kenya reports 9 cases (2 deaths); Uganda 20 cases (2 deaths) and was declared Ebola-free by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ対応に従事していた看護師の殺害を国連が非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラアウトブレイク（9,816症例、死亡4,757人、CFR48.5%）が継続中で、国際的な感染拡大（ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイス）と治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃が重なっており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイスでの症例・対応も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが本事例の主要発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia se extinde. Numărul cazurilor de Ebola din RD Congo depăşeşte pragul de 10.000 * Newsweek România
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is spreading. The number of Ebola cases in the DRC exceeds the 10,000 threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections, reaching 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths per government health data. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, began in mid-May and is now the largest and deadliest in the DRC, second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). Cross-border concerns mount: Kenya reported its first case earlier this month and subsequently nine total cases, after a man who traveled from DRC via Uganda died in Nairobi; Nigeria reported a case last week, the fourth African country to do so. A Swiss diplomat’s wife infected in Uganda (who had not traveled to DRC) was flown to Switzerland for treatment. Uganda, which had 20 cases in May–June mostly imported from DRC, was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August; returning Ugandan nationals will face a 21-day quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミックが拡大。コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が1万人の閾値を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例が1万人を超え、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイス）への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な国際的公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行を主題としている。ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスへの輸入症例が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない、またはDRCが発生源の輸入例であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。致死率は約48.6%（4887/10060）と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 1만명...절반 가량 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reach 10,000... roughly half have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 cumulative confirmed cases 165 days after the outbreak declaration on May 15, expanding from Ituri in the northeast to North Kivu and South Kivu, and recently to the northwestern South Ubangi Province, across eight provinces and 66 health zones. As of Oct 25, 2026, the DRC's National Institute of Public Health reported 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak ranks second in scale after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, though its early spread has been faster. Uganda, which declared Ebola on the same day, ended transmission by August, yet DRC still records about 2,000 new cases per month. Contributing factors include lack of approved vaccines or treatments for this virus lineage and accessibility challenges due to armed conflict restricting public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定患者1万人...約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%・累計1万人超・月2000人新規感染が続く大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは同日にエボラ宣言したが8月に終息しており、記事の主題は継続中のDRCでのアウトブレイク。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文に言及なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pune PMC Directs Private Hospitals To Report Dengue Cases Online
article.articleSummary: Pune Municipal Commissioner Naval Kishore Ram directed private hospitals to promptly report confirmed dengue cases through the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) as soon as diagnosis is made, with the same requirement extending to other diseases. The move will help Pune's health department track infections, assess trends and plan interventions in affected areas. The directive followed a PMC meeting with health department officials and private healthcare representatives. Dengue patients must receive timely treatment and be admitted when required; doctors and staff should explain the illness, warning signs, treatment options and preventive measures to patients and families, with home monitoring advised if not hospitalized. Dengue can cause platelet counts to fall, making ongoing monitoring important. The city will promote the Urban Health Scheme for economically weaker residents and help eligible patients access benefits. Insecticide spraying and public awareness campaigns continue to curb transmission; residents are urged to prevent standing water.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市当局、民間病院にデング熱症例のオンライン報告を指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例報告体制強化に関する行政的な通達記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化の報告はなく、通常の季節的対策の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はプネー市の行政的な症例報告体制強化策に関するもので、感染拡大の規模や重症度についての具体的データは記載されていない。デング熱はインドで季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、新規の異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Asymptomatic tuberculosis resists single tests, review argues for staged
article.articleSummary: China/Guangxi researchers review asymptomatic tuberculosis as a symptom-defined, method-dependent phenotype rather than a single disease stage. Estimates vary widely: 27–82% of prevalent TB is asymptomatic; adolescents (10–24) show 1% prevalence by screening but 62% of diagnosed cases are asymptomatic. Among adults, 82.8% report no persistent cough, 62.5% no cough, and 27.7% no TB symptoms. Symptom ascertainment bias is notable (Vietnam: 64.8% asymptomatic before diagnosis; 17.8% after disclosure). Sputum-based tests struggle in symptom-negative cases; pediatric subclinical TB often lacks microbiological confirmation. Imaging helps but is imperfect; normal radiographs do not exclude disease, CT is more sensitive but limited by reproducibility, and PET/CT can misclassify TB as cancer in some cohorts. Non-sputum biomarkers show limited validation (tongue-swab 35% sensitivity; five-gene transcripts AUC 0.75–0.77; CRP poorly distinguishes). The authors advocate staged, risk-stratified diagnostic pathways rather than standalone tests, with implications for China, Singapore, South Africa, Canada, and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 無症候性結核は単一検査では捉えきれない、段階的診断経路を提唱するレビュー
triage.triage_reason: これは学術的なレビュー論文であり、特定の国での急性アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の無症候性表現型に関する研究レビューであり、特定国での発生事例報告ではない。中国広西の研究者による診断手法の論評で、ベトナム・シンガポール・南アフリカ・カナダ等は研究データの引用元として言及されているのみ。対象国リストの中では中国・ベトナムが地名として出現するが、いずれも疾病発生地ではなく学術的言及に留まるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Belém combate avanço da dengue em meio a recordes de calor provocado pelo El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belém battles the spread of dengue amid record-breaking heat caused by El Niño.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Belém, Pará, Brazil reaches 1,261 confirmed cases in 2026 with 2,765 dengue notifications from January to September, compared with 950 confirmed and 2,771 notifications in all of 2025. El Niño-driven heat accelerates Aedes aegypti development, expanding breeding in small water-holding containers. The municipal health secretaryate SESMA reports a real outbreak risk and relies on LIRAa hotspot mapping, ovitrap surveillance, and field teams (ACE) conducting home visits, transmission-blocking actions, and deploying Larvicidal Dissemination Stations to move larvicide between containers. Household measures remain crucial: seal water tanks, eliminate standing water in containers, weekly yard cleanups, cleaning gutters and appliance trays, and permitting health agents access. Vaccination sites include CSE Marco (UEPA), Av. Rômulo Maiorana, 2558; UMS de Fátima (APS),  Rua Domingos Marreiros, 1816; Armed Forces Hospitals; reference centers Unama, Uremia, Unifamaz, Fibra, IASB; UBSs vaccinate per local hours. For guidance, Sesma’s Endemias line: (91) 98402-0894.

triage.headline_ja: ベレン市、エルニーニョによる記録的猛暑の中でデング熱の拡大と闘う
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の地域的なデング熱症例増加に関する報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、気候要因による媒介蚊増加と症例数増加が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジル・パラ州ベレン市における季節性・地域性のデング熱流行拡大に関する記事。市当局（SESMA）が既に対策（LIRAa調査、オビトラップ監視、予防接種、幼虫駆除）を実施しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle im Kongo steigt über 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo rise above 10,000
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola infections exceed 10,000 confirmed cases as of 27 October 2026, with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%). The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no licensed vaccines. The public health response shows an 81.6% contact-tracing rate. The first cases emerged in May 2026 in Ituri Province, which remains the epicenter, accounting for 71.7% of confirmed cases and 33.3% of new confirmed cases. The virus has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo provinces. Ongoing efforts focus on transmission containment and patient management, with no vaccination option available for this strain. The report emphasizes laboratory-confirmed cases and sustained surveillance across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数、1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が1万人を超え、致死率48.6%、ワクチン未承認という深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスには承認されたワクチンが存在せず、治療・封じ込めが困難。複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、バウエレ、チョポ）に拡大しており、国際的な技術・資金支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo a depășit 10.000 de cazuri. Aproape jumătate dintre persoanele infectate au murit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo has surpassed 10,000 cases. Almost half of those infected have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases as of October 27, 2026, with nearly half of those infected having died. Reuters and Associated Press report that this is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record and the deadliest in DRC history. The outbreak has spread to other African countries, while health authorities struggle to curb transmission. It is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no vaccine or specifically approved treatment. The article notes continued international concern as containment, surveillance, and cross-border reporting efforts intensify. Official releases corroborate the figures, underscoring the urgent need for enhanced regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が症例数1万人を超える。感染者のほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）が1万人超・致死率約50%に達し、他のアフリカ諸国にも拡大、国際的な懸念が高まっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は他のアフリカ諸国への拡大に言及しているが、具体的な対象国名は記載されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyo株による流行であり、致死率・感染拡大速度の観点から極めて深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola izmiče kontroli u Kongu: više od 10.000 zaraženih, gotovo polovina umrla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in Congo: more than 10,000 infected, almost half have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, with nearly half of patients dead. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three at the May declaration. It has been detected in five countries, including Uganda and France (no active cases there); cases have also appeared in Kenya and Nigeria. About 80% of new infections involve people not under health surveillance, indicating undetected transmission chains. Africa CDC says roughly 95% of cases should be linked to known contacts for the outbreak to be considered largely controlled. At least half of deaths were never admitted to treatment centers. Health workers face violence, insecurity, limited equipment, mistrust, and overwhelmed centers. In Bafvasende, Chopo province, a nurse was killed during an Ebola response operation, with another worker seriously injured. Routine health services are disrupted, including child vaccination and maternal care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能に：感染者1万人超、ほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1万例を超え致死率約50%、複数国への拡散・未検知感染連鎖が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主発生地はDRCのツショピ州を含む8州66保健区。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 10 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the DRC has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases. Medical authorities reported that as of Oct 25, 2026, the country recorded 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak, which began in May, has spread across 66 health zones in eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces. The dateline is Kinshasa; the report notes laboratory-confirmed cases and provides no details on infection sources or imported/exported cases. The figures indicate sustained transmission across multiple regions, underscoring an ongoing public health emergency requiring enhanced surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱確定症例数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.6%、8州66保健地域に拡大する大規模アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 5月発生以降、8州66保健地域に拡大し症例1万件超・死者約4887人、CFR48.6%と非常に高い。既にフルRRA相当の大規模アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Liczba przypadków zakażeń wirusem ebolą przekroczyła 10 tys.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: The number of Ebola virus infections has exceeded 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have exceeded 10,000, according to data published today by the Congolese Institute of Public Health. Since the outbreak began, 4,887 deaths have been reported. The World Health Organization has designated the May-detected wave as the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. The virus has spread beyond DR Congo's borders, signaling cross-border transmission and a broader regional impact. These figures underscore the severity and persistence of the outbreak, with ongoing transmission and international spread prompting continued epidemiologic surveillance and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラウイルス感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最大規模のエボラ流行で1万人超の感染、致死率約49%、国境を越えた拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが史上最大のエボラ流行と認定。国境を越えた伝播が報告されているが、具体的にどの国へ拡大したかは記事内で明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Một người tử vong do bệnh dại sau khi bị chó hoang cắn ở Đồng Nai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A person dies from rabies after being bitten by a stray dog in Dong Nai Province.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Dong Nai Province, Vietnam: A male patient, Đ.G. (born 1999) from Bình Hà, Đa Kia, developed rabies after a stray dog bite. The stray had bitten four of his pet dogs, all dying within four days. Đ.G. was bitten on the left ring finger; the wound was Grade III, and he did not seek wound care or receive vaccination. He killed the dog and sold it for slaughter in the fields. Another person was bitten on the chest by the same dog on the same day and remains healthy. Authorities disinfected home, the slaughter site, and nearby areas; exposed contacts urged to vaccinate. Dong Nai CDC called for contact tracing of those involved in slaughter and reinforced vaccination; authorities warn against self-treatment and advise clinical care after bites. Since early 2026, rabies risk remains high due to free-roaming dogs and low vaccination rates for dogs and cats.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省で野良犬に噛まれた男性が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで風土病化している狂犬病の単発死亡例であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病的に発生しており、野良犬の放置やワクチン接種率の低さが継続的なリスク要因として指摘されているが、本件は地域の公衆衛生当局が通常の対応（消毒・接触者追跡・ワクチン推奨）を行っている単発事例。

article.articleHeadline: Число заразившихся вирусом эбола в ДР Конго превысило 10 тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 10,060 confirmed cases and around 5,030 deaths, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest in the country’s history. The surge is driven by Bundibugyo, a rare variant with no licensed vaccine or proven therapy. The epidemic has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three at the start. Cross-border transmission is evident: Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths (20 of 118 contacts completed 21-day quarantine); Nigeria records its first confirmed case in a Ugandan-origin woman evacuated from Abuja to Geneva, with her husband quarantined in Zurich and 52 contacts monitored; one imported case in France. Uganda reports Ebola-free status since July but tightened borders; all returning from DRC face a three-week self-paid quarantine and strict checks. In Congo, response is hampered by conflict and distrust, with 80% of new cases outside known contact chains, and disruptions to maternal health and vaccination programs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模アウトブレイクがDRC国内8州66保健地区に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイス、フランスへの越境・輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生国はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Jean Kaseya, le médecin congolais qui pousse les chefs d'État africains contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Jean Kaseya, the Congolese doctor who rallies African heads of state against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain, began May 15 in Ituri and has killed more than 4,000 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cross-border spread to Kenya (nine confirmed cases as of Oct 20) and Nigeria (first case confirmed Oct 20). The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine. On Oct 23, Congolese doctor Jean Kaseya met Burundi President Évariste Ndayishimiye at Kiriri Palace in Bujumbura to rally African heads of state to accelerate the response; Africa CDC plans a virtual ministers of health meeting on Oct 28 ahead of a continental summit. Africa CDC declared a continental public health emergency for Ebola on May 18, 2026, three days after Kinshasa’s outbreak declaration. Donors disbursed about $962 million for the RDC response, with over $700 million unaccounted, prompting talk of a 'blacklist' for non-accountable partners. Kaseya urges African leadership with a concrete plan, budget, and accountable partners.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ対策でアフリカ首脳を結集させるコンゴ人医師ジャン・カセヤ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が4000人以上の死者を出し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州で始まったエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行について、DRC国内の状況とアフリカCDCによる大陸規模の緊急事態宣言、資金説明責任問題を中心に報じている。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό: Πάνω από 10.000 τα κρούσματα του ιού Έμπολα - dete.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 10,000 cases of the Ebola virus - dete.gr
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 cases, with 10,060 confirmed and 4,887 deaths, per government data relayed via Reuters. The Bundibugyo-strain epidemic began in mid-May and is the most extensive and deadly outbreak the Democratic Republic of the Congo has faced, surpassing the 2018–2020 crisis. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest and most lethal outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Cross-border concerns rise: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case earlier this month, totaling nine after a Nairobi death of a man who traveled from Congo via Uganda. Nigeria reported its first case last week, the fourth African country affected. A Swiss diplomat’s wife, infected likely in Uganda, was transported to Switzerland for care. Uganda reported 20 Congo-related cases in May–June and has imposed a 21-day quarantine for returnees from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラウイルスの症例が10,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が10,000症例・4,887死亡に達し同国史上最大規模となり、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。事象の中心はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Kes Ebola DR Congo cecah lebih 10,000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, as of Oct 27, 2026. Africa CDC says it is the fastest-spreading outbreak in Africa’s history. The Bundibugyo variant has been confirmed in Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths) and Nigeria (first Bundibugyo case on Oct 20; a Swiss woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria on Oct 3; she developed symptoms four days after arrival; source under investigation). Uganda reports 20 confirmed Ebola cases, including 2 deaths, linked to a Congo patient; Uganda had declared the outbreak over in late August after 42 days with no new cases. Bundibugyo spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause fever, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が複数国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）に拡大し、アフリカ史上最速の流行とされており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確に認められるため。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主たる発生地であり被害規模も最大。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : 63 nouveaux cas confirmés et 27 décès enregistrés en 24 heures
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: 63 new confirmed cases and 27 deaths recorded in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu Ebola outbreak: 63 new laboratory-confirmed cases and 27 deaths in 24 hours, per the 25 October 2026 epidemiological bulletin from the provincial response coordination (published 26 October). Beni health zone accounts for 40 new cases and 20 deaths; Oicha 8 cases/1 death; Butembo 4/2; Lubero 4 with no deaths. Katwa 2/2; Mutwanga 2/1; Mabalako 2/0; Musienene 1/1. Since the start of the 17th outbreak, North Kivu has 2,423 confirmed and 2 probable cases, with 1,424 deaths (case fatality around 59%). Recoveries total 328; 53 discharged without medical advice; 618 active cases under care. Of 34 health zones, 17 are affected; 203 of 684 health areas have reported cases (≈30%), including 203 of 333 hotspots (≈61%). On Oct 25, 69 suspected cases and 23 community deaths; 41 samples analyzed. Contact tracing remains challenging: 18,937 active contacts, 70% followed (13,194). Katwa leads with 695 cases/445 deaths; Beni 641/466; Butembo 363/199.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州エボラ出血熱:24時間で63件の新規確認症例と27人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（第17次）が、致死率約59%、累計2,400人超の確認症例という深刻な公衆衛生危機を呈しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイク（第17次北キブエボラ流行）の最新進捗報告。新規発生ではないが、感染拡大が継続し致死率が高く、コンタクトトレーシングのフォロー率も70%にとどまるなど制御上の課題が続いているため、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Τα κρούσματα του Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τις 10. 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola cases surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, with spillover into Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in mid-May and is the largest and deadliest in Congo to date, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak and ranking second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,600+ cases, 11,000+ deaths). Kenya reported its first case this month and nine total after a Nairobi resident who had traveled from Congo via Uganda died. Nigeria confirmed its fourth African case—the wife of a Swiss diplomat—believed infected in Uganda; she and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June, largely from Congo; WHO had declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. Uganda will quarantine travelers returning from Congo for 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（1万例超、死者約4,900人）が発生し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大とスイスへの患者搬送も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスへの波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: شمار مبتلایان به ابولا در کنگو از ۱۰ هزار نفر گذشت - خبرگزاری خامه پرس - فارسی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola infections and 4,887 deaths, per the national Public Health Institute. The mid-May outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is the largest, deadliest in Congo’s history, exceeding 2018–2020 figures. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and about 11,000 deaths, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). Kenya has nine cases after its first earlier this month; Nigeria became the fourth African country with Ebola cases last week. A linked Nigerian case involves a woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who had not traveled to Congo; Swiss officials suspect Uganda as the source. Uganda had been declared Ebola-free by WHO in August, but will quarantine travelers from Congo for 21 days if travel history exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死亡率も高く、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ疑い）への国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでのエボラ大流行（Bundibugyo株）を主題としており、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスにも言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Livestock sector records growth...despite FMD disruptions
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) outbreaks in Namibia triggered movement restrictions that disrupted September 2026 marketing, though year-to-date performance remained positive. Cattle marketing reached 217,007 head YTD, up 30.9% from 2025, while September 2026 marketing declined 27.2% MoM to 21,387 head. Live exports rose 58.8% YTD to 75,578 head; export-approved abattoirs processed 104,505 head (+34.6%), with B&C class abattoirs down 8.8%. Beef exports climbed 51.0% YTD to 14,348,192 kg; September exports were 1,624,743 kg, up 47.5% YoY. Sheep marketing YTD reached 611,407 head (+39.1%), with Sep 33,565 head; live sheep exports YTD 492,056 head (+56.0%), Sep 28,311 head (−39.4% MoM). South Africa remained the leading destination (46.9%), followed by Norway (25.0%) and Zambia (10.3%). Prospects for Q4 depend on containment success and uptake of alternative markets.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫による混乱にもかかわらず畜産部門は成長を記録
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の発生はナミビアが主体であり対象国に含まれず、記事内容も家畜市場・貿易統計の経済報告であり公衆衛生上の懸念や社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生国はナミビアであり対象国リストに含まれない。南アフリカ・ノルウェー・ザンビアは輸出先として言及されているのみで、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Hasil Tracing TBC Hingg Akhir Agustus, 290 Warga Rohul Suspek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB tracing results as of the end of August, 290 Rohul residents suspected.
article.articleSummary: As of the end of August 2026, 290 Rohul residents were identified as suspected tuberculosis cases after tracing by the Rohul Health Office and local Puskesmas in Pasir Pengaraian and surrounding districts. Tracing spanned 14 locations across several subdistricts, employing two methods: screening and Portable X-Ray. Portable X-Ray screened 655 people with 110 suspects; standard screening evaluated 1,400 people with 180 suspects. The combined total of suspects is 290. Suspects are receiving medications, and authorities will continue monitoring and retesting to confirm diagnoses. The information was provided by Rohul Health Office head dr. Bambang Triono and reported by Tribunpekanbaru.com on October 27, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 8月末までのTBCトレーシング結果、ロフル県住民290人が疑い例
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核サーベイランス活動の報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、既存の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ロフル県における地域保健局主導の結核疑い例トレーシング活動の通常報告。

article.articleHeadline: Switzerland Contradicts Uganda's Account Of Nigerian Ebola Patient's Travel History As Airport Link Raises Regional Alarm
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms one imported Ebola case in Abuja; patient developed symptoms Oct 7, tested positive and isolated; 44 contacts identified. Kenya reports its first Ebola case, who died in Nairobi on Oct 5 after traveling from the DRC via Uganda; Ugandan contact of the deceased remains unlocated. Swiss authorities dispute Uganda’s claim that the Nigerian patient visited DRC, stating the infected Swiss national (Ugandan-origin wife of a diplomat in Abuja) likely contracted the virus in Uganda, not DRC. Uganda says exposure location under investigation; WHO and Africa CDC have not confirmed DRC travel. Ebola is not contagious until symptoms appear, complicating airport-transit risk assessments. Investigators note Entebbe Airport transit on Oct 3 by both Nigerian and Kenyan cases; Africa CDC plans an extraordinary virtual meeting for Oct 28.

triage.headline_ja: スイス、ナイジェリア人エボラ患者の渡航歴に関するウガンダの説明に反論、空港経由の接触で地域的懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来とされるエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由で複数国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、スイス）に拡大し、死亡例・接触者追跡の不明者も発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当、国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしエボラ出血熱の発生源とされるDRCのみ対象国として計上。ウガンダでの感染経路（空港トランジット、接触者追跡）は続報で要確認。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго около пяти тысяч человек умерли от лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, about five thousand people died from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo records the fastest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, with 10,060 infections and about 5,000 deaths, according to the government. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no proven vaccines or therapies exist. Since May, the virus has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three initial foci. Hospitals are overwhelmed with demand and staff often go on strike due to delayed salaries. Conflict, damaged roads, and distrust hinder response, and roughly 80% of new cases are detected only when transmission chains are no longer traceable. The UN warned in August that Ebola is accelerating beyond response capacity, underscoring the need for a faster, more effective mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で約5000人がエボラ出血熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が8州66保健地域に拡大し、感染制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株によるコンゴ史上最速・最も致死的なエボラ流行。国連も対応能力を超えて拡大していると警告。国際的な医療支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Более 10 тыс. человек заразились Эболой в ДР Конго, половина из них умерли
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 people contracted Ebola in DR Congo, half of them died.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Health Ministry, cited by the Associated Press, reported 10,060 Ebola cases and more than 5,000 deaths. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri Province. Cases have also been detected in neighboring Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. In late August, the World Health Organization announced that transmission in Uganda was no longer spreading. These updated figures exceed earlier estimates of about 9,000 infections and 4,300 deaths, underscoring the ongoing, deadly outbreak centered in the DR Congo and its cross-border reach.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに1万人超が感染、うち半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは8月末にWHOが伝播終息を発表済み。致死率が約50%と極めて高く、症例数・死亡者数ともに前回推計を上回る深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Congolese Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) as of Oct. 27, 2026, with roughly half of those infected dying. Declared in May, it is the fastest-growing and deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history and has no approved vaccine or treatment. The virus has spread across Africa to three regions, with cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria, and across five countries overall, including Uganda and France, which currently have no active cases. Response teams face armed conflict, poor roads, and community mistrust and misinformation, hindering reporting and care-seeking. Laboratory confirmation is ongoing, highlighting cross-border transmission and the need for regional coordination amid security and access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最も急速かつ致死率の高いエボラ流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、複数国への国際的拡大（ケニア、ナイジェリアでの症例確認）が見られるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点、武装紛争や住民の不信感が対応を妨げている点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 10,000 as outbreak spreads across Africa
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 10,060 lab-confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, CFR 48.6%, across 66 health zones in eight of the country’s 26 provinces, with Ituri province accounting for 71.7% of cases and remaining near epicenter. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, was declared in the DRC on May 15 and has spread to five countries, including Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria; France reported one imported case. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. This outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Authorities continue cross-border surveillance and response, focusing transmission in Ituri while monitoring additional districts as cases persist.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、症例数1万人超え アフリカ全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の確診例、国際拡大（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへ波及）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内、特にイトゥリ州が流行の中心（71.7%）。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法なし。DRC史上最大・最も致死的な流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。

article.articleHeadline: Tiệm bánh mì khiến 175 người ngộ độc bồi thường cho khách
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bakery that caused 175 people to suffer food poisoning pays compensation to customers.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella, Escherichia coli, and Staphylococcus aureus contamination from bread at Bà Được Bakery in Quảng Ngãi led to 175 hospitalizations beginning Oct 10, after customers bought bread at the Duy Tân Street outlet in Cam Thành Ward. By Oct 27, a compensation session was held; most customers received between 1.5 million and over 2 million VND, in addition to hospital fees. Participants were also compensated for lost work time, meals, and travel, with standard rates of 200,000 VND per person per day for labor and 100,000 VND per person per day for meals. A family of eight hospitalized reportedly received about 28 million VND. Initial offers were criticized as insufficient, and some residents threatened legal action. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang confirmed the samples contained Salmonella, E. coli, and Staphylococcus aureus. Bà Được Bakery, with a history of more than 70 years, also operates two other shops in central Quảng Ngãi.

triage.headline_ja: 175人に食中毒を引き起こしたパン屋が顧客に補償
triage.triage_reason: 単一のパン屋における食中毒事例であり、原因は特定済みで既に補償段階に入っている。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクはなく、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性もない局所的な食品衛生事案。
triage.notes: 175人が入院したが、原因（特定のパン屋・サルモネラ菌等汚染）は既に特定され、補償交渉が進行中の事案。継続的な曝露リスクや感染拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Zahl der Infizierten steigt auf mehr als 10.000 - Ausbruch breitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: The number of infections has risen to more than 10,000 — the outbreak is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 infections, reaching 10,060 with 4,887 deaths since it began mid-May 2026 in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan. Africa CDC labels this the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo-type Ebolavirus is involved, a strain with no specific vaccine or therapy, complicating control. Since July, two antiviral treatments are in clinical trials, and studies assess whether the Ervebo vaccine (approved for the Zaire strain) offers protection against Bundibugyo. The outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with a first South Ubangi case reported in September, and cases may have started as early as February prior to official notification. Outside the DRC, Ebola cases confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria. This outbreak is the second-largest on record after 2014–2016 West Africa (more than 28,500 cases and over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：感染者数が1万人超に増加 ― 流行が拡大中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が1万人を超え、複数州やケニア・ナイジェリアにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリアでの感染例も報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。南スーダン・ウガンダも言及されるが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DRC surpass 10,000 as nurse treating patients is killed by machete-wielding mob
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola cases exceed 10,000, with 10,060 reported by the health ministry as of 2026-10-27, marking the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo strain, responsible for over 4,800 deaths in the DRC since its May start. A nurse responding to the outbreak in Bafwasende, Tshopo province, was killed by a machete-wielding mob; another health worker was injured amid violence fueled by misinformation, including water contamination accusations. WHO Director-General Tedros condemned the attack; UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis described the loss to patients as profound. Health workers in Bafwasende remain under police guard at the hospital, with the army briefly deployed. Kenya reports nine cases and two deaths; Nigeria confirms a case in Abuja (Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat) evacuated to Switzerland for treatment. Uganda earlier reported May/June cases and was declared free in August. The outbreak now has the widest geographic spread of Ebola in Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が1万人を超える中、患者治療中の看護師が暴徒に殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上最速の拡大を見せ死者4800人超、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大や医療従事者殺害事件も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの症例波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Случаите на ебола в Конго надхвърлиха 10 000, близо половината от заразените са починали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo have surpassed 10,000; nearly half of those infected have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, with confirmed cases surpassing 10,000 (10,060). About half have died, roughly 5,030 fatalities, making it the deadliest Ebola surge in the country. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Declared in May, responders face obstacles including armed conflict, poor road infrastructure, and local violence fueled by distrust and misinformation, hindering symptom reporting and healthcare seeking. The epidemic is affecting several African countries and stands as the most deadly in DR Congo history. By comparison, West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak had over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths; the report indicates the current outbreak has, for the same early period, at least three times as many infections and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超え、感染者の約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速・最悪規模のエボラ流行で致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認、武力紛争下での対応困難などIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではアンゴラなど周辺国への拡大にも言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyoウイルス株によるワクチン未承認の点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Nem bírnak a halálos járvánnyal: Európába evakuálták az Afrikában megfertőződött beteget
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They can't cope with the deadly epidemic: the patient infected in Africa has been evacuated to Europe.
article.articleSummary: Swiss citizen woman infected with Ebola virus disease in West Africa has been evacuated to Geneva University Hospital in Switzerland; her husband in Zurich was placed in quarantine. She had previously traveled to Uganda. Nigerian authorities say the patient is stable but still contagious, prompting strict security measures during transport. Nigeria is monitoring 52 contacts who were in touch with the couple; no further Ebola patients have been reported there yet, but outbreak vigilance remains high. The wider outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has since produced over 9,900 cases and nearly 4,800 deaths since May. The World Health Organization warns this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record and could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa toll. Kenya has reported nine infections and two deaths; dozens of people tied to cases are in quarantine as investigations continue into infection sources. Health systems across Africa face strain.

triage.headline_ja: 死の感染症に苦戦：アフリカで感染した患者が欧州に避難搬送される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが過去最速の拡大を見せ、9900例・4800人超の死亡を記録。スイスへの患者空輸やケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国発のエボラアウトブレイクが起点であり、同国が対象国リストに該当する唯一の発生地。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。WHOは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告しており、国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: Ultrapassada a barreira dos 10 mil casos numa das mais graves epidemias de sempre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: The 10,000-case barrier has been surpassed in one of the deadliest epidemics in history.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths, propelled by Bundibugyo strain; eastern provinces Ituri and North Kivu report 32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours; eight of 26 provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, South Ubangi, North Ubangi. The outbreak has reached neighboring Uganda and Kenya. WHO and Africa CDC declare a public international emergency. No specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; vaccination campaigns began in late August with Ervebo, the only vaccine deployed widely, originally for Zaire but showing protection against Bundibugyo in animals. WHO has started Phase 1 clinical trials in DRC for additional vaccine candidates. Disease features fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhage. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/コンゴ民主共和国：史上最も深刻な流行の一つで1万人の感染確認の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が1万例・約5000人死亡に達し、複数州に拡大、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播とWHO/Africa CDCによる国際緊急事態宣言がありIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of Congo surpass 10,000 as nurse treating patients is killed by mob
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 cases, reaching 10,060, the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with the Bundibugyo strain responsible for more than 4,800 deaths in the country since the outbreak began in May. A nurse assisting the response was killed by a group of machete-wielding youths in Bafwasende, Tshopo province; another health worker was injured as misinformation fueled violence that accused responders of contaminating water sources. WHO condemned the attack; health workers at the hospital are under police guard, with the army deployed. The spread has prompted concerns of export to neighboring countries: Kenya reports nine cases and two deaths; Uganda earlier had cases but was declared free in August; Nigeria reports its first case—Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat who travelled to Abuja and was evacuated to Switzerland; condition improved but remains infectious. The transmission marks the widest geographic spread of Ebola in Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万人を突破、患者治療中の看護師が暴徒により殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が史上最速ペースで1万例を超え、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア）への越境拡大と医療従事者への暴力事件が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア（9例、2死亡）、ナイジェリア（初症例、スイス外交官夫人）、ウガンダ（8月に終息宣言済み）への拡散も報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。感染源国であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Eboli w krajach Afryki. Do Europy trafiła jedna z pacjentek "zero"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in African countries. One of the patient zeros has reached Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, reaching 10,060, with about 4,500 deaths since May. Meanwhile a Nigerian patient zero and her Swiss-diplomat husband have been moved to Europe for care, hospitalized in Zurich and Geneva, Switzerland; Swiss authorities say public health risk is low. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate confirmed the 42-year-old left Abuja for Switzerland; her condition has markedly improved, she is stable and labs near normal, but strict precautions remain as she may still be infectious. Infection may have occurred during a two-week vacation in Uganda before returning to Nigeria. Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda have reported cases; Uganda was reportedly Ebola-free by WHO in August. The United States requires airline passengers to attest no Congo travel in the prior three weeks. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days, typically 8–10.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国でエボラ流行。「患者ゼロ」の一人が欧州に搬送される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が10,060例・死亡約4,500人に達し、患者がスイス（欧州）に搬送されるなど国際的拡大がみられ、米国は渡航関連措置を講じている。IHR基準に複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行を主題とし、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイス・米国にも言及があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: "В связи с ограничением авиасообщения". Донской Роспотребнадзор -- о риске распространения оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In connection with air travel restrictions. Don region's Rospotrebnadzor — on the risk of monkeypox transmission.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox has been detected among residents of Saint Petersburg, with five cases identified in the city. In Rostov Oblast, import risk is low due to restricted air travel with countries reporting cases; Platov Airport has been closed since 2022 and not planned to reopen. Border checkpoints screen arrivals with the Perimeter system to detect fever. Human-to-human transmission occurs via close contact; at-risk groups include people with multiple sexual partners, and maternal transmission during pregnancy or birth is possible. Animals can infect humans through bites, scratches, hunting, or meat handling. Reservoirs include African squirrels, dormice, and Gambian rats. Symptoms are rash, fever, sore throat, headache, muscle and back pain, weakness, and lymphadenopathy, typically 7–21 days after exposure and lasting 2–4 weeks, longer in immunosuppressed individuals. Exposure countries include DR Congo, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Nigeria, Ivory Coast, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Gabon, and South Sudan. Returnees should seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 「航空便の制限に関連して」――ドン地域のロスポトレブナゾル、サル痘（エムポックス）拡大リスクについて言及
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク、ロストフ州）における輸入性サル痘症例と渡航制限の説明であり、対象国（DRC等）は感染原産国として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生地域ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はロシア国内（サンクトペテルブルク、ロストフ州）でのMpox症例・渡航制限対応についてであり、DRC等のアフリカ諸国は感染原産地として一般情報として挙げられているのみで、当該国での発生報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana's Ebola Preparedness Under Scrutiny Amid Rising Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ghana’s Ebola preparedness is under scrutiny as Abuakwa South MP and Health Committee member Dr. Kingsley Agyemang warns the country is not adequately prepared for a possible Ebola outbreak. He urges stronger emergency response systems, border vigilance, and robust public education amid ongoing cross-border movement with Nigeria and significant land-border traffic. He highlights Aflao and other border towns, as well as communities in Greater Accra, as critical areas for preparedness, urging airport screening improvements and procedures to identify risks from disembarkation onward. He questions whether health facilities and resources, possibly remaining from COVID-19, are still available and usable. Public awareness is seen as insufficient; he calls for active media campaigns and district education. Emphasis on using COVID-19 lessons to bolster health infrastructure, public information, and pandemic planning to avoid complacency.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのエボラ対策、懸念の高まりで精査される
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生報告ではなく、国会議員による備え不足への懸念表明であり、現時点で感染拡大や公衆衛生上の実害は確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおける実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、政治家による備え不足への警鐘・提言記事。ナイジェリアは国境往来の文脈で言及されているのみで、同国でのエボラ発生事実は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie, farmacisti pronti a rispondere: le indicazioni Fip aggiornate sull'Ebola | Farmacista33
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemics: Pharmacists Ready to Respond — Updated FIP Guidelines on Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola guidelines updated by the International Pharmaceutical Federation (FIP) aim to strengthen pharmacists’ role in outbreak response, reflecting advances in virus knowledge, therapies, vaccines, and lessons from recent epidemics, including a dedicated operational appendix on the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The update targets community, hospital, and primary care pharmacists, emphasizing pre‑emergency preparation: staff training, reporting pathways, and procedures to protect workers and the public; enabling reliable information, vaccination support, and sustained access to medicines when health systems are stressed. It integrates WHO guidance on filovirus diseases and national protocols. Pharmacists should recognize risk and refer promptly rather than diagnose Ebola; prepare written operating procedures for suspected cases and, when feasible, a short‑stay area to minimize exposure. Prevention covers hand hygiene, PPE, environmental cleaning, and stock management of disinfectants and PPE; vaccination is discussed as an available tool with defined limits and competencies.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症流行:薬剤師が対応準備——エボラに関するFIP最新ガイドライン
triage.triage_reason: 2026年コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに言及しており、疾患の重篤性・国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 本記事はFIP（国際薬剤師連盟）のガイドライン更新を報じる二次情報だが、2026年DRCでのエボラ流行という実際の発生事実に言及しているため、続報・一次情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola survivor clinics strengthen the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola survivor clinics in the Democratic Republic of the Congo extend care beyond treatment centres.
