In Bunia, Ituri Province, the first survivor clinic has operated since 19 September 2026 and has cared for more than 400 survivors; a second clinic opened in Beni, North Kivu, on 17 October 2026. Since the outbreak began, more than 2,700 people have been declared cured and require post-recovery follow-up. Clinics provide general medicine, psychology and nutrition consultations, laboratory tests, and two-hour visits, focusing on managing long-term Ebola aftereffects such as joint pain, chronic fatigue, memory difficulties, stress and irritability. Biological surveillance is conducted due to possible persistence of virus in semen, with condoms provided. WHO emphasizes survivor follow-up helps prevent resurgence and addresses physical, psychological and nutritional needs. Community mobilization reports over 90% attendance for follow-up appointments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ生存者クリニックがエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（治癒者2,700人超）に関する情報であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や体液を介した再燃リスクがあることから継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ流行に対する生存者ケア体制の強化についての報告であり、新規発生や拡大を示す情報ではないが、流行自体の継続性（精液を介したウイルス残存リスク等）から経過観察・フル評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Более 10 тыс. человек заразились Эболой в ДР Конго, половина из них умерли
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 people contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, half of them died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has registered more than 10,000 Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, with about half resulting in death. The figure comes from Associated Press coverage citing DR Congo authorities. The brief offers no location breakdown within the country, no details on laboratory confirmation timelines, symptoms, or infection sources, and does not describe response measures. The report—issued from London on 27 October—notes that full texts require a paid subscription for access. This summary focuses on the reported scale and fatality of the Ebola situation in the DRC, signaling a substantial public health burden without providing further epidemiological details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に1万人以上が感染、半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%で1万人超の感染という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は規模と致死率のみの簡潔な報告で、地域別内訳、検査確認時期、感染経路、対応策等の詳細情報が欠如しているため、続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱の感染者1万人超え　コンゴ民主、紛争で対策難航
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections exceed 10,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as conflict hampers response.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 10,000 cases, with 4,887 deaths. The outbreak, centered in the country’s eastern provinces, began to surge in May 2026, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern that month. Ongoing armed conflict in the region has hampered containment and response efforts, complicating case finding, treatment, and vaccination campaigns. The current outbreak ranks as the second largest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic which infected more than 28,000 people and killed over 11,000. Neighboring countries have reported imported or locally acquired cases, with Uganda confirming cases and Kenya and Nigeria also reporting infections linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の感染者1万人超え　コンゴ民主、紛争で対策難航
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱が1万人超・死者4,887人に達し、PHEIC宣言済み、周辺国への拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 周辺国（アンゴラ、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）への感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。紛争による対策難航が流行の長期化・制御困難性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: อ.เจษฎา โพสต์ถึงวิธีแก้ของประชาชนเบื้องต้น หลังพบเชื้อลิสทีเรียในเห็ดเข็มทอง 100%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ajarn Jesada posts basic remedies the public can take after finding Listeria in 100% of enoki mushrooms.
article.articleSummary: Enoki mushrooms tested across Bangkok were found to harbor Listeria monocytogenes in 100% of samples, prompting public guidance. Listeria monocytogenes causes listeriosis, a gastrointestinal illness with fever, headache, and diarrhea, and can be severe for pregnant women, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. On 27 October 2026, Ajarn Jesada Den-Duangpriban posted basic public remedies, advising that thorough cooking of food is a key precaution to reduce infection risk in light of the contamination finding. The report highlights cooking as the practical measure for risk mitigation, with no reported case counts or laboratory confirmation details beyond the mushroom testing. Imported/exported case specifics are not provided. Keywords: outbreak precaution, food safety, public health guidance, listeriosis risk.

triage.headline_ja: ジェッサダー教授、えのきたけから100%リステリア菌検出を受け、市民が取るべき基本対策を投稿
triage.triage_reason: 食品（えのきたけ）からのリステリア菌検出という食品安全上の懸念はあるが、実際のヒト症例報告や感染拡大の情報がなく、現時点では注意喚起レベルの続報待ちと判断する。
triage.notes: 市販のえのきたけ全数からリステリア菌が検出されたという食品検査結果の報道であり、ヒトの症例報告は確認されていない。食品安全当局の対応や実際の感染例の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 64 Kasus Leptospirosis di Kulon Progo, 7 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 64 leptospirosis cases in Kulon Progo, 7 people died.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Kulon Progo, Indonesia — Kulon Progo Health Office recorded 64 cases and 7 deaths in 2026. Approximately 60% of patients are farmers, with other cases among day laborers; exposure linked to activity around homes, paddy fields, and standing water. Leptospira bacteria shed in the urine of infected animals, especially rats, contaminates soil and water, leading to infection via contact with contaminated water, soil, or contaminated food and drink. Human-to-human transmission is rare. Early detection and timely antibiotic treatment are crucial to prevent severe complications such as kidney and liver failure. Symptoms include fever, headache, and muscle pain after exposure to contaminated environments. Public health focus includes hygiene, environmental sanitation, rodent control, and protective footwear for at-risk workers; health facilities report adequate drug supply, but community awareness remains a challenge.

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴ県でレプトスピラ症64例、7人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・クロンプロゴ県で季節性のレプトスピラ症流行が報告され死亡例もあるが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく地域限定の環境曝露型感染症であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は雨季に毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の報告も季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。農業従事者・日雇い労働者における環境曝露（水田・汚染水）が主な感染経路で、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀。致死率は高めだが地域医療資源（薬剤供給）は十分とされており、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。続報での症例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Более 10 тысяч человек заразились Эболой в ДР Конго, половина из них умерли
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 people contracted Ebola in DR Congo, half of them died.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has registered 10,060 infections, with over 5,000 deaths, per the DRC Ministry of Health. Earlier tallies cited about 9,000 cases and 4,300 fatalities. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri province. Ebola cases have also been detected in neighboring Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. By late August, the World Health Organization reported that transmission in Uganda had ceased. The article does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. The data indicate a multi-country spillover with ongoing cross-border risk, underscoring the need for sustained public health surveillance and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に1万人以上が感染、うち半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染者が1万人を超え、致死率約50%と極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既に複数国への越境伝播が確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダへの波及も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダでの伝播は8月末時点でWHOにより終息確認済みと記載あり。致死率が約50%と非常に高く、症状・感染源の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Goiás registra 49 surtos da doença mão-pé-boca em 2026 - Jornal O+Positivo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás records 49 outbreaks of hand-foot-mouth disease in 2026 - O+Positivo Journal
article.articleSummary: Hand-foot-mouth disease outbreaks in Goiás, Brazil: 49 outbreaks with 282 associated cases from January–October 2026, per SES-GO. Goiânia reports three outbreaks with 14 suspected cases; in 2025 the capital had 29 outbreaks and nearly 300 cases. HFMD is a contagious viral infection mainly affecting children under five, though adults can be affected. Transmission occurs via saliva, respiratory secretions, feces, lesions, and contaminated objects, with daycare and school settings promoting spread. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, malaise, poor appetite, painful mouth ulcers, and rashes on hands and feet; lesions may appear on buttocks, knees, and elbows, and mouth ulcers can hinder drinking. No specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive with hydration. Seek care for persistent fever, drowsiness, irritability, or inability to drink. Prevention: frequent handwashing, cleaning toys and surfaces, not sharing personal items, and keeping sick children home; report cases to health services for surveillance and control.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、2026年に手足口病49件の集団発生を記録 - Jornal O+Positivo
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病はブラジル国内で例年発生する既知の小児感染症であり、症例数も前年と同程度で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 手足口病はエンテロウイルス71等による一般的な小児疾患で、ブラジル・ゴイアス州の地域的・季節的な発生報告。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本事例は通常の国内サーベイランス報告でありピックアップ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата е вон контрола во Конго: над 10.000 заразени, речиси половина починале
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is out of control in Congo: over 10,000 infected, nearly half have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) is out of control, with over 10,000 infected and nearly half dead. Declared in May, it is the fastest-growing and most deadly outbreak in Congo’s history. It has spread to 66 health zones across 8 provinces, up from 3 at onset. Cases have occurred in five countries, including Uganda and France (no active cases there), and also in Kenya and Nigeria. About 80% of new infections involve people not under surveillance, signaling undetected transmission chains. The Africa CDC says roughly 95% of cases should be linked to identified contacts to be under control. At least half of deaths have never reached treatment centers. Health workers face armed attacks, shortages, mistrust, misinformation, and strikes; a nurse was killed in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, during an Ebola response. Routine services, vaccination, and education are disrupted, and fear deters pregnant women from seeking care, with mortality among pregnant women doubled.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱は制御不能：感染者1万人超、ほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、複数国への越境例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスでも症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Tshopo州など）。

article.articleHeadline: Cases top 10,000 in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) has reached 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths since the mid-May identification, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids, and early symptoms include fever, diarrhea, and bleeding, which can resemble malaria and delay isolation. Kenya reports nine infections and two deaths linked to a traveler from DR Congo via Uganda to Nairobi. Nigeria confirms an infection in a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who fell ill after visiting Uganda; authorities are investigating the infection source and she has been evacuated to Switzerland. Imported/exported cases underscore ongoing global risk and the need for containment where the Bundibugyo virus circulates in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、症例数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1万人超・死者4,887人に達し、国際的な拡散（ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスへの輸出例）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主要発生地であり、承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がないこと、史上最速拡大とAfrica CDCが指摘している点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Вооружённая мачете толпа напала на борющихся с Эболой медиков
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An armed machete-wielding crowd attacked the medics battling Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Chopo Province saw an armed machete-and-baton attack on two local health educators during Ebola outreach, killing a nurse and wounding a teacher. The assault followed residents’ accusations that the workers spread Ebola via contaminated water. Hospital staff in Bafwasende are now in police-protected shelters as the army briefly deploys to the area. This incident reflects a broader pattern of violence against Ebola responders amid widespread misinformation that has undermined public trust. The outbreak—driven by the Bundibugyo strain—spans eight provinces in the DRC, with 9,964 confirmed cases and a case fatality rate of about 48.6% since May. The attack underscores the need for security for frontline workers and effective community engagement to curb transmission and safeguard health services.

triage.headline_ja: マチェーテで武装した群衆がエボラ対応の医療従事者を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: DRCで拡大中のエボラ流行（9,964例、致死率48.6%、8州に拡大）に加え、対応従事者への暴力事件が発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と対応能力への懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は8州に及び致死率約48.6%と高く、対応従事者への暴力が流行対応を妨げるリスクとなっている。コミュニティの不信感（汚染水による感染との誤情報）が暴力の背景にあり、治安対策と住民エンゲージメントの強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Случаите на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 10 000, близо половината от заразените са починали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpassed 10,000, with nearly half of those infected having died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports over 10,000 Ebola cases, with 10,060 confirmed infections and around 5,000 deaths, making it the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history and the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. The outbreak began in May and is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health workers face armed conflict, damaged road networks, and local distrust fueled by misinformation, hindering reporting of symptoms and access to care. Compared with the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (roughly 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths), the current crisis has registered at least three times as many infections and fatalities during a similar early phase. Transmission is ongoing across several African countries, underscoring the need for public health measures and countermeasures specifically for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱症例が1万人を超え、感染者の約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上最悪規模（1万人超の感染、約5000人死亡）かつワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRコンゴでの流行拡大を主題としており、Angolaについては『複数のアフリカ諸国で感染が継続』という曖昧な記述のみで具体的言及がないため verified_locations から除外した。史上最速・最大規模のエボラ流行であり、武力紛争や医療インフラ破壊、情報不信が対応を阻害している点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: UN, WHO condemn killing of nurse responding to Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus with no approved vaccine, has recorded over 9,760 cases and about 4,727 deaths since it was declared on May 15, spreading across eight provinces: Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi, Tshopo and Nord-Ubangi. A nurse responding to an Ebola alert was killed by protesters in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, prompting UN and WHO condemnation and calls to protect health workers. The UN urged a thorough investigation; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed condolences and stressed safety for healthcare workers. Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case involving a woman who visited Uganda; she and her husband (a contact) were evacuated to Switzerland; the woman is clinically stable, Nigeria has no current cases, and 52 contacts are monitored while Switzerland handles follow-up for the husband. Mohamed Janabi praised Nigeria's health teams and urged vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 国連とWHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応にあたっていた看護師殺害を非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,760例超・死亡4,727人に達する大規模エボラ流行が8州に拡大し、ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョウイルス）であることに加え、ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的な症例拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（8州拡大、死者4,727人）を主題とし、ナイジェリアでの輸入症例とスイスへの患者移送にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。医療従事者殺害事件も発生しており社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Regeneron agrees to $270m extension to supply Ebola medicine in US
article.articleSummary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has extended its US government contract, valued at about $270 million, to supply the Ebola therapy Inmazeb through 2031 under BARDA within HHS’s ASPR. The renewal maintains enhanced stockpiles of the three-antibody formulation (atoltivimab, maftivimab, odesivimab-ebgn) for national preparedness. Inmazeb received FDA clearance in 2020 to treat Orthoebolavirus zairense infections in adults and children, reducing mortality by roughly 55% in patients with low viral loads. Separately, Maftivimab monotherapy is in the PARTNERS trial evaluating against Bundibugyo virus during an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The WHO-sponsored study, supported by Africa CDC and coordinated by Oxford’s Pandemic Sciences Institute, is led in the DRC by INRB with ITM Antwerp involvement. Inmazeb is available via compassionate-use programs in the DRC and Guinea, and an agreement covers up to 500 doses to WHO for vulnerable countries, with Regeneron aiding healthcare worker protection through the Afya Foundation during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: Regeneron社、米国へのエボラ治療薬供給で2億7000万ドルの契約延長に合意
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は米国政府とRegeneron社の医薬品供給契約延長というビジネスニュースだが、DRCにおけるBundibugyoウイルス（エボラ関連）のアウトブレイクへの対応が付随情報として言及されており、新規シグナルというより既存事案の文脈のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事本文は主にRegeneron社の米国向け医薬品供給契約（BARDA/HHS）に関するビジネスニュース。DRCでのBundibugyoウイルスアウトブレイクはPARTNERS試験の文脈で言及されているのみで、新規発生情報としての詳細（症例数、死亡者数等）は記載なし。ギニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 美國丹麥爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US and Denmark report highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreaks were reported in Lolland, Denmark, and Jackson County, Minnesota, United States. Hong Kong’s Centre for Food Safety immediately ordered a suspension of imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the affected regions to safeguard public health. The Centre has notified Danish and US authorities and will monitor World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) updates, adjusting measures as the situation evolves. Government statistics show Hong Kong imported about 390 tonnes of chilled poultry meat from Denmark in the first half of 2026, and about 24,190 tonnes of chilled and frozen poultry meat plus around 20.2 million poultry eggs from the United States. No clinical details beyond outbreak reports are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とデンマークで高病原性鳥インフルエンザH5N1発生、香港は家きん製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の発生地はデンマークと米国であり、対象国リストに含まれない。香港は輸入停止という貿易対応を行っているのみで、同地域で感染事例が発生しているわけではないため、対象国に影響する公衆衛生シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はデンマーク(Lolland)と米国(Minnesota/Missouri)であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入停止措置を取ったのみで、感染事例の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal Reports 156 Dengue Cases So Far, Health Department Steps Up Prevention Drive
article.articleSummary: 156 dengue cases have been reported in Bhopal in 2026, prompting intensified mosquito-control and public awareness across 85 wards. Surveillance has expanded with 44 teams surveying households and removing larvae; five sentinel diagnostic sites—AIIMS Bhopal, Gandhi Medical College, BMHRC, JP Hospital and Civil Hospital, Bairagarh—monitor dengue. The risk rises during and after the monsoon, and transmission can persist if breeding sites remain. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that breed in small amounts of stagnant water, including discarded containers, tyres and flowerpots; mosquitoes are active by day. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, severe headache and pain behind the eyes, muscle/joint pain, nausea and skin rash, after 4–10 days and lasting 2–7 days. Warning signs—severe abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, rapid breathing, lethargy—require urgent care. Prevention: empty stagnant water weekly, cover water storage, use repellent and screens, and avoid relying on fogging alone.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでデング熱症例156件を報告、保健当局が予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱の通常の発生・対策に関する報道であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに特段の異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン時期の季節性デング熱流行であり、保健当局による通常の監視・対策活動の範囲内。重症例や死亡者数の報告はなく、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 中国驻乌干达大使馆提醒旅乌中国公民遵守乌方应对埃博拉疫情管控措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Embassy of China in Uganda reminds Chinese citizens traveling to Uganda to comply with Uganda's Ebola outbreak response and control measures.
article.articleSummary: One Nigerian traveler transited Uganda and was diagnosed with Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease after returning to Nigeria. Uganda’s health ministry, coordinating with Nigerian authorities, is reviewing the traveler’s history, itinerary, and possible contacts. In response, Uganda has upgraded public-health controls: banning transit through Uganda for anyone with DR Congo travel history; non-Ugandan officials with DR Congo residence history must undertake 21 days of self-paid quarantine; resuming mandatory information registration for all inbound travelers to enable tracing; and cracking down on illicit entry assistance for DR Congo nationals, with legal penalties for violators. The DR Congo Ebola outbreak remains poorly controlled, with ongoing spillover risk. The Chinese embassy in Uganda urges Chinese citizens to monitor developments, follow local measures, avoid unnecessary travel to Ebola-affected areas such as DR Congo, and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. Emergency contacts: Uganda +256-112; Chinese consular protection hotlines +86-10-12308 / +86-10-65612308; embassy protection line +256-703886882; Chinese aid medical team +256-756549325; China-Uganda Friendship Hospital +256-414289740.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐ウガンダ大使館、在ウガンダ中国人に対しウガンダのエボラ対応規制措置の遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに越境伝播した事例が確認され、ウガンダが渡航制限・検疫強化措置を導入しており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大な国際拡大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアで診断された患者はウガンダを経由した渡航者であり、感染源はDRCのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ型）とされる。ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大の実態として重要な要素である。中国は発生国ではなく大使館による注意喚起のみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas aumentam risco de contaminação por leptospirose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain Increases the Risk of Leptospirosis Infection.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises with heavy rains in the southeast region of Paraná, Brazil. Transmission occurs via water, mud, or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rats. In 2016–2025, 101 confirmed cases were recorded across ten municipalities in southeastern Paraná, with Fazenda Rio Grande reporting the most (46 cases) and Campo do Tenente reporting 1. Early symptoms include fever, headache, malaise, nausea/vomiting, and pronounced calf muscle pain; red eyes may occur. Severe cases can cause jaundice, reduced urine, bleeding, and respiratory distress; Weil syndrome (jaundice, renal failure, hemorrhages) may require ICU care. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contaminated water/mud, wearing impermeable boots/gloves after floods, securing food and waste, and rodent control. Treatment is antibiotic-based, most effective when initiated early; mild cases may be outpatient, severe cases require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: 雨量増加がレプトスピラ症感染リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州における季節性の風土病的注意喚起記事であり、過去10年間の累積症例報告で急性の異常発生ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性（雨季）のレプトスピラ症リスク啓発記事であり、2016〜2025年の10年間累計101例という低頻度の地域的風土病情報。急性のアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Novo foco de doença de Newcastle é identificado em SC, diz ministério
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New focus of Newcastle disease identified in Santa Catarina, says ministry.
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease focus identified at a poultry operation in Coronel Freitas, Santa Catarina, Brazil, with sanitary restrictions already in place in the region. Detection occurred during intensified surveillance within the emergency area; the new case lies inside the existing restricted perimeter, which has been slightly adjusted and remains under monitoring. The Official Veterinary Service has initiated emergency zoosanitary measures, including epidemiological investigation, surveillance, disease containment, and sanitary depopulation of the birds on the affected farm. Outside the restricted area, pigeons tested positive for avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1); per the World Organisation for Animal Health, this is not a Newcastle focus. The initial Newcastle outbreak was confirmed on October 18 in a commercial turkey breeding operation in Nova Itaberaba. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared for Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim to bolster surveillance, with updates available on the ministry’s public dashboard.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病の新たな発生地点を確認、農業省が発表
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）疾患であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクは報告されておらず、対象国（ブラジル）内の既存の規制区域内での発生のため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒト感染症としての報告はない。獣医当局による通常の防疫対応（隔離、監視区域設定、淘汰）が実施されており、既存の緊急事態宣言区域内での発生。公衆衛生危機管理の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: OCHA: Violencia y desconfianza socavan respuesta a ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OCHA: Violence and mistrust undermine the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Violence and mistrust undermine the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to OCHA. Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis laments the killing of a nurse in Bafwasende, Tshopo province, on 24 October and the injury of a school director aiding response efforts. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, these incidents have repeatedly disrupted operations. The latest occurred in Mangobo health zone, Kisangani (Tshopo), where a health centre was looted; a health worker was assaulted and briefly detained, and supplies were stolen. The United Nations is coordinating with national and provincial authorities to monitor incidents, strengthen protection of health facilities, and ensure that healthcare and humanitarian staff can continue delivering essential services safely.

triage.headline_ja: OCHA：暴力と不信がDRCにおけるエボラ対応を損なう
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクに対し、暴力・治安悪化が対応活動を阻害しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 5月15日に宣言されたエボラアウトブレイクが継続中。治安悪化（看護師殺害、医療施設略奪）が対応を阻害しており、既知の進行中アウトブレイクの悪化事例として継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: Ministério identifica novo foco de doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Ministry identifies new outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: New outbreak of Newcastle disease detected at a poultry farm in Coronel Freitas, Santa Catarina, Brazil. MAPA confirmed the case on 27 October 2026, immediately establishing a sanitary ring around the affected area to prevent spread. The initial focus was found on a farm with clear disease signs, prompting rigorous herd assessment. Newcastle disease is a viral, highly contagious illness in birds that can cause severe losses to poultry production. MAPA stresses strict adherence to control protocols and monitoring of nearby farms to protect poultry health and regional production in Santa Catarina. The detection raises concerns for the local economy, where poultry is a key activity. Authorities are coordinating with state and municipal agencies to reinforce surveillance and containment. Technical teams will conduct regular visits to neighboring properties to assess bird health and implement containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: 警報：農務省、サンタカタリーナ州で新たなニューカッスル病の発生を確認 - Fala Canedo
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の感染症であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は現時点で報告されていないが、ブラジルの養鶏産業・貿易への影響が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でありヒト感染症ではないため、公衆衛生リスクとしてのPICKUP判定には該当しない。家禽産業・貿易への影響の観点から動物衛生分野での注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: health matters newsletter: Hark! It's the season: for flu
article.articleSummary: Flu season underway as winter/monsoon arrive globally; precautions urged, vaccination recommended. France reports its first human Shamonda virus case, a livestock-associated pathogen; the severely immunocompromised patient died, with officials saying no broader health risk. In India, melioidosis caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei—found in soil and water in tropical/subtropical regions—can cause pneumonia, bacteremia, skin and soft-tissue infections, organ abscesses (liver, spleen), septic arthritis, and bone or kidney/muscle/prostate involvement, and may be underdetected. In Nigeria, a second Ebola death occurs among relatives of the country’s first fatal case; in DR Congo, an Ebola vaccine trial begins for the Bundibugyo strain. In the United States, an early flu season may pose higher risk for younger people; doctors urge vaccination. Delhi-NCR air pollution is forecast ahead of winter; Mumbai logged 231 days of good/satisfactory air quality in 2026 and has unveiled a winter pollution action plan.

triage.headline_ja: 健康ニュースレター：いよいよインフルエンザの季節到来
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザや既知の風土病（メリオイドーシス）、エボラワクチン治験など複数の話題を扱う総合ニュースレターであり、新規の重大シグナルとは言えないが、DRCのエボラワクチン治験とインドのメリオイドーシスへの言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数疾患・複数国を扱う週刊ニュースレターであり、単一の明確な新興感染症イベントではない。ナイジェリアのエボラ関連情報は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはワクチン治験開始の情報のみで新規症例報告はなし。インドのメリオイドーシスは既知の風土病としての一般的言及であり、具体的な集団発生データはない。

article.articleHeadline: Περισσότερα από 10.000 είναι πλέον τα κρούσματα του 'Εμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are more than 10,000 Ebola cases now in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo reports 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths as of 2026-10-27, per government data. The surge, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, is Congo’s largest and deadliest outbreak to date, surpassing 2018–2020 events; it is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak worldwide after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Kenya reported its first case this month, with nine cases after a Nairobi death of a man who had traveled from Congo via Uganda; Nigeria became the fourth African country to report a case last week. Investigators seek how the Swiss diplomat’s wife, who hadn’t traveled to Congo, contracted Ebola; Switzerland suspects Uganda as the source. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June, was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August, and Ugandan authorities say no current cases, though 21-day quarantines for returning travelers were announced.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（1万例超・死者4,887人）のエボラ流行が発生し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスでの症例/関連事例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染源調査（ウガンダ由来の可能性）も継続中。

article.articleHeadline: La cepa Bundibugyo del ébola amenaza con extenderse en África mientras se busca una vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola threatens to spread in Africa as a vaccine is sought.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain threatens Africa as Congo’s outbreak surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, marking the second-worst Ebola epidemic in the DRC. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the virus likely circulated since February and has spread to eight of 26 provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, Ubangui del Sud, Ubangui del Norte). The WHO warns it could become the worst outbreak; Tedros notes it as the fastest-spreading to date. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on Aug 26 after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, with Uganda later serving as a transit route for strains reaching Kenya and Nigeria. Kenya reported its first imported case on Oct 5; Nigeria confirmed an imported case in Abuja (Swiss citizen of Ugandan origin) linked genomically to a Kenyan case. France reported a linked case; three additional European exposures occurred in the Netherlands (one) and Germany (two). No targeted Bundibugyo vaccines exist; two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials, while DRC began Ervebo vaccination with some cross-protection signals in animals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン開発が進む中アフリカで拡大の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は1万人以上の感染、4,887人の死亡者を出し、複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、欧州）への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツへの輸入症例が報告されているが、いずれも評価対象国リストには含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生地域はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics' Joint Venture CoSara Diagnostics Completes Clinical Study and Regulatory Submission for Point-of-Care Tuberculosis Test, Sets Stage for Commercial Launch in India
article.articleSummary: CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. has completed a clinical performance study of the CoSara PCR MTB test on the CoSara PCR Pro instrument and submitted it to India's CDSCO for regulatory clearance. The 676-sample evaluation, including 233 MGIT-referenced pairs, yielded an average sensitivity of 97.3% and specificity of 96.0% across three test batches. India accounts for about 25% of the world's tuberculosis cases, underscoring its strategic importance for decentralized TB testing using real-time PCR with the Co-Primers technology, delivering results in roughly 30 minutes via a mobile app without centralized labs. An integrated mobile and cloud infrastructure is already deployed in India to support data management, including offline operation with later cloud synchronization. CDSCO clearance anticipated before year-end 2026, enabling CoSara to begin commercial sales in India; FDA 510(k) submission was filed in August, with two major regulatory submissions under review.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnostics社の合弁会社CoSara Diagnostics、ポイントオブケア結核検査の臨床試験と規制当局への申請を完了、インドでの商業展開へ
triage.triage_reason: 新規の結核発生事例ではなく、診断機器メーカーの臨床試験完了・規制申請に関する商業的ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規アウトブレイクではなく、診断薬企業の製品開発・規制承認に関する企業発表記事であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Dipanggil Prabowo, BRIN Bakal Percepat Riset Vaksin Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prabowo Called, BRIN to Accelerate Malaria Vaccine Research
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia—President Prabowo Subianto directed BRIN to accelerate malaria vaccine research to achieve vaccine independence. BRIN chief Arif Satria announced on 27 October 2026 that BRIN currently has four malaria vaccine candidates, among roughly five to six candidates nationwide. BRIN collaborates with the Ministry of Health and Bio Farma. With presidential backing, the program could be accelerated by about three years from the planned schedule, and production of the malaria vaccine would be fully supported by the President. He noted Indonesia hosts diverse malaria parasites, highlighting Plasmodium vivax, for which there is currently no vaccine. If Indonesia can produce the malaria vaccine domestically, it could contribute to global malaria control, given that malaria affects more than Indonesia and a vaccine is not yet available worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: プラボウォ大統領に招集され、BRINがマラリアワクチン研究を加速へ
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの感染拡大や症例急増を報じる内容ではなく、ワクチン研究加速に関する政策発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアワクチン研究開発に関する政策・研究動向の報道であり、現地での疾病発生状況（症例数、流行状況等）の記述はないため、対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo meldt meer dan 10.000 ebolabesmettingen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports more than 10,000 Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bundibugyo variant circulating and centered in Kinshasa and eastern regions. Official health authorities report 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths as of 27 October 2026, up from 9,964 infections last Friday, for a case fatality rate near 49%. The outbreak began in May, and Congo remains the hardest-hit country, where Ebola is a highly contagious disease that can cause bleeding. The surge has coincided with unrest in the east, where machete-wielding youths attacked health workers accusing them of spreading the disease by contaminating water. The article relies on official figures and notes ongoing transmission; no details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染者1万人超を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、感染者1万人超・死者4,887人の大規模アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 東部地域での医療従事者襲撃など治安悪化が対応の障害となっており、さらなる感染拡大・対応困難化のリスクが高い。致死率約49%は極めて高く、通常のエボラ流行と比較しても重大な事態。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया, डेंगीचा मुंबईला विळखा कायम!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria, dengue's grip on Mumbai remains!
article.articleSummary: Malaria and dengue fever continue to grip Mumbai, with rising cases despite calls for collective action beyond individual prevention. Municipal health authorities warn that increasing construction activity and stagnant water bodies provide mosquito breeding sites, necessitating public-health measures: removal of standing water, routine inspection at construction sites, waste management, and neighborhood sanitation. Some representatives question the quality of fumigation chemicals. Experts urge scientific vector-control methods and regular breeding-site elimination aligned with the mosquito life cycle. Post-monsoon conditions—lighter winds, higher humidity, and more standing water—sustain risk. Air pollution (PM2.5 and PM10) worsens respiratory symptoms, affecting children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with heart, lung, or diabetes. Those traveling from polluted areas should wear an N95 mask and avoid outdoor exercise on high-pollution days. In October’s first half, malaria/dengue cases declined versus September.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア、デングのムンバイへの猛威が続く！
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイで毎年発生する季節性のマラリア・デング感染で、10月前半は前月より症例が減少しており、国際的拡大や異常性は認められないが、継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 毎年ムンバイで発生する季節性のマラリア・デング感染症に関する地方自治体の公衆衛生対策の記事。10月前半は症例数が減少傾向にあり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu više od 10.000 zaraženih ebolom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 10,000 people are infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 infections, with about half of those infected dying. According to the Ministry of Health, there are 10,060 laboratory-confirmed cases and roughly 5,030 deaths, underscoring the epidemic as one of the fastest-spreading Ebola events. The outbreak was declared in May, and health authorities are intensifying efforts to curb transmission to several other African nations. The virus strain involved is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. The report calls for strengthened regional surveillance and cross-border measures to prevent further spread, amid a high fatality rate and ongoing efforts to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万人以上がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%・1万人超の感染者という大規模エボラ流行であり、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない株で越境拡大の懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、致死率約50%。近隣アフリカ諸国への拡大防止策が求められており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Случаите на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 10 000, близо половината от заразените са починали - Пловдив Нюз
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeded 10,000, with nearly half of those infected having died - Plovdiv News.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 10,000 cases, with 10,060 confirmed infections and about half resulting in death as of 27 October 2026. This marks the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in history and the deadliest in the DRC. The surge is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Health teams fighting to curb transmission face armed conflict, damaged road networks, and local hostility fueled by distrust and misinformation, hindering patient reporting and care-seeking. In comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused over 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths; the current crisis, for a comparable period since its onset, has registered at least three times higher numbers. The outbreak is affecting several African nations beyond DRC as authorities scramble to respond.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万人を超え、感染者の約半数が死亡 - プロヴディフ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%・1万人超の感染者数で過去最速拡大のエボラ流行、承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラにも言及する「発生地域」を含むが、サマリー本文ではDRC以外の具体的な感染確認国は明示されていないため、Angolaはverified_locationsに含めず。対象国リストにAngolaは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Nabire catat 763 kasus baru HIV hingga September 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nabire Regency Health Office records 763 new HIV cases through September 2026.
article.articleSummary: Nabire Regency Health Office, Central Papua, Indonesia, reports 763 new HIV cases from January–September 2026, raising the cumulative total since 1998 to 10,790. Data come from 32 puskesmas, one private clinic, and one district hospital, with rapid tests for screening; reactive results require confirmatory testing. A key challenge is loss to follow-up: some individuals with reactive results do not pursue confirmatory tests, and others diagnosed HIV-positive do not enter treatment and care services (PLHIV). Stigma, discrimination, limited outreach, and low voluntary testing awareness hinder detection and linkage to care. Nabire Dinas Kesehatan urges expanded education across communities, schools, and government sectors to boost early detection and reduce discrimination. Initiatives such as Nusantara Sehat placing health workers in puskesmas support testing. The effort aligns with Ending AIDS 2030 and the 95-95-95 targets to improve status awareness, ART coverage, and viral suppression, aiming to control HIV and sexually transmitted infections by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: ナビレ県保健局、2026年9月までにHIV新規感染763件を記録
triage.triage_reason: HIVの慢性的な累積報告であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 地域の慢性的HIV流行に関する定期報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。地元保健当局による継続的な教育・検査強化が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Ülkede salgın alarmı! Vaka sayısı 10 bini, can kaybı 4 bin 800'ü aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak alert in the country! Case count has surpassed 10,000, and the death toll has surpassed 4,800.
article.articleSummary: By 2026-10-27, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 10,060 laboratory-confirmed cases, 4,887 deaths, and 2,600 recoveries. About 80% of cases are detected outside known contacts, while Africa CDC states that control requires at least 95% of cases to be among known contacts. Approximately half of deaths occur among patients not admitted to treatment centers, signaling limited access to care or underreporting of symptoms. In Ituri province, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported before the country declared the outbreak on May 15. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara (Sudan) and Yambuku (DRC), with the name deriving from the Ebola River. The Bundibugyo variant, noted in May, has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で感染拡大警報！感染者数1万人、死者数4,800人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万例・死者4,887人に達し、致死率が高く、感染経路の追跡も不十分（接触者由来はわずか20%）であるため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある重大シグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコのメディアによる報道だが、内容はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo variant）のアウトブレイクに関するもの。Yambuku、Nzara、Burundi、Sudanは1976年の歴史的背景として言及されているのみで、現在のアウトブレイクの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Bundibugyo-Variante erreicht Kenia und Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Bundibugyo variant reaches Kenya and Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, DR Congo reports 10,060 Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, with Africa CDC calling it the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo variant has reached Kenya (9 infections, 2 deaths) and Nigeria (1 case: a Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who became ill after a trip to Uganda; infection source under investigation; patient evacuated to Switzerland). The outbreak began in mid-May; transmission occurs through direct contact with infected people and bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and diarrhea, with bleeding possible. Early symptoms can resemble malaria, hindering containment. Since July, two antiviral therapies are in clinical trials; studies are also assessing whether Ervebo vaccination can protect against Bundibugyro, though Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus. WHO flags Congo risk as very high; global risk remains low, and no travel bans are advised.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：ブンディブギョ株がケニアとナイジェリアに到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで10,060症例・4,887死亡、Africa CDCが「史上最速の流行」と指摘し、ケニア・ナイジェリア（経由でスイス）へ拡大するなど国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国として該当。WHOはコンゴのリスクを「非常に高い」としているが、グローバルリスクは低く渡航制限は推奨されていない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 10 آلاف حالة إصابة مؤكدة بـ"إيبولا "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 27, 2026. The outbreak, launched in May, is the fastest and deadliest in Congo’s history, spreading across three regions while lacking a licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. It has spilled beyond DRC into Kenya and Nigeria, with Uganda and France among the five countries reporting infections; currently, no active cases remain in Kenya, Uganda, or France. Kenya has nine cases, including a Nairobi death linked to Congo via Uganda. Uganda recorded 20 cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free by WHO in August. Nigeria recently reported a case, becoming the fourth African country affected. Relative to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, this event is described as at least threefold in cases and deaths since its declaration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確定症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は史上最速・最も致死的規模であり、複数国への国際的拡大とワクチン・治療法の欠如という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）を主題としており、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率約48.6%、ワクチン・承認治療法なしという点で極めて深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया-डेंगू का अटैक, जेई ने ली मासूम की जान!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria-Dengue Attack, Japanese Encephalitis Claims an Infant's Life!
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum, India — malaria, dengue, and Japanese Encephalitis (JE) outbreaks raise health concerns. MGM Medical College Hospital reports a six-year-old girl, Shakuntala Sabar of Bodam block, Mohanpur, who died from dual infection with malaria and JE, due to multi-organ failure despite care. In the Pediatric ICU, five malaria patients remain critically ill, one on a ventilator. Five new dengue-positive cases were confirmed district-wide: Sundernagar (two), Baridih (one), Telco (one), and Gamharia (one). Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal directed health centers, CHCs, and the district hospital to ensure drug stocks and prompt testing/treatment for fever cases. Officials underscore early symptom recognition (fever, headache, vomiting) and ongoing vector-control, water management, and sanitation to curb transmission. Published date: 2026-10-27.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア・デング熱が猛威、日本脳炎が幼い命を奪う！
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャムシェドプル地区での季節性のマラリア・デング・日本脳炎の発生で死亡例・重症例があるが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は低く、地域限定の風土病アウトブレイクとして続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: ジャールカンド州ジャムシェドプル（東シンブム県）における季節性のマラリア・デング・日本脳炎の地域的アウトブレイク。小児1名死亡、ICUに重症患者複数。地元保健当局が対応中で国際支援の必要性は明記されていない。グアテマラ・ウッタルプラデーシュ州などの地域情報はBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتجاوز 10 آلاف إصابة في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. ومخاوف من انتشاره بأفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 10,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with fears of its spread across Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the DRC has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections, with 4,887 deaths, in the Bundibugyo outbreak that began in mid-May. The tally of 10,060 confirmed cases marks the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history, second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,000 cases and ~11,000 deaths). There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies for Bundibugyo, heightening emphasis on early detection, isolation, supportive care, and robust contact tracing. Concerns mount over cross-border spread, with Kenya reporting nine cases (including fatalities) after a Congo–Uganda travel chain to Nairobi; Nigeria has a linked case. A Nigerian patient, wife of a Swiss diplomat, is suspected to have contracted it in Uganda; both were evacuated to Switzerland. Uganda, which reported 20 cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free in August, maintains border controls and a 21-day quarantine for returnees.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で感染者1万人超え…アフリカ全土への拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1万人超感染、死者約4887人）に加え、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境伝播が報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイスへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ケニア・ウガンダ・スイス・ナイジェリアは対象国外）。主たる発生国はDRCのみ対象国リストに該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認であり、致死率の高さと越境伝播の実績から緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 1st 4 participants vaccinated in DRC trial testing Ebola jab's effectiveness against Bundibugyo virus: WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC launched the TUMAINI trial to test whether the Ervebo Ebola vaccine can reduce severe disease and deaths from Bundibugyo virus. The first four participants were vaccinated, with the study beginning Friday. Ervebo is known to be safe and effective against Ebola caused by Zaire virus; its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unknown and the trial aims to assess reductions in severe illness or death, not infection. The ring-vaccination design enrolls people who have been in close contact with confirmed patients or exposed to the virus. Two vaccination rings are established; several more are being prepared. Eligible participants may be vaccinated 1–21 days after exposure; timing effects are not yet known. The platform trial, led by Congolese researchers and the National Institute for Biomedical Research, is supported by WHO and partners. Other vaccines considered include ChAdOx1 and Moderna's mRNA-1469; recommendations expected this week. Community interest is high.

triage.headline_ja: DRCの臨床試験で最初の4人がブンディブギョウウイルスに対するエボラワクチンの有効性を検証するワクチン接種を受ける：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョウ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクに対しリング接種を伴うワクチン試験が開始されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性が認められ、WHO・国際機関の関与と社会的関心の高さも確認できるため。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョウウイルスによる既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対するワクチン臨床試験（TUMAINI試験）開始を報じるもので、アウトブレイク自体の詳細（症例数・死亡者数等）は記載されていないため、フルRRAでの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: لقاحات جديدة تحت الاختبار.. تحرك دولي لمواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New vaccines in trials... International action to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launched a Phase 1 clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia) testing vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, after four participants were vaccinated in the first phase. The Tomaini trial vaccinates contacts of Ebola cases with the Ervebo vaccine, which is approved for Zaire ebolavirus, while its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains under study. Additional candidate vaccines from the University of Oxford and Moderna are also being evaluated, with results expected in months. There is currently no approved vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; vaccines are used under research protocols to assess safety and efficacy. The trial aims to evaluate several vaccines within a single clinical framework, prioritizing contacts and high-risk individuals to determine protective potential and strengthen preparedness for current and future outbreaks in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 新ワクチン治験開始…エボラ対策への国際的動き
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン治験開始に関する報道であり、現行の流行規模や重症度に関する情報は不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ebola ja supera els 10.000 casos a la RD del Congo en el segon pitjor brot de la història
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has surpassed 10,000 cases in the DRC in the second-worst outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 4,887 deaths and a case fatality rate of 48.6%. Ituri and North Kivu provinces remain epicentres, recording 32 and 58 new infections in the last 24 hours, respectively. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including high fever and vomiting as the outbreak expands. A vaccination campaign using the Ervebo vaccine began in late August and continues after encouraging results in animal studies. The World Health Organization has launched a clinical study to evaluate new immunological options and is actively pursuing two vaccines that have cleared Phase 1 trials in humans, though full development could take several more months. As of 27 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが1万人超、史上2番目に深刻な流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、1万人超の感染者・4,887人の死者を伴う大規模流行であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: イツリ州・北キブ州が流行の中心。WHOがワクチン臨床試験・新規免疫学的選択肢の評価を進めている。史上2番目に深刻な流行とされ、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 2nd LD Writethru: DR Congo Ebola cases top 10,000 as outbreak spreads across Africa
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%) as of Oct. 25 in the Bundibugyo virus outbreak that began May 15. The outbreak spans 66 health zones across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, with Ituri province as the epicenter accounting for 71.7% of cases. It is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak has spread to five countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria; France reported one imported case. Ongoing transmission challenges persist in eastern DRC, underscoring the need for sustained public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 【続報】DRCのエボラ出血熱症例数が1万人を超え、アフリカ全土で流行が拡大

triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへの拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoウイルスによる史上最大・最悪の流行であり、西アフリカ2014-2016年以来世界第2位の規模。

article.articleHeadline: RDC supera los 10.000 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, 2026, for a 48.6% case fatality rate. The outbreak spans 66 health zones across eight of the country’s 26 provinces, with Ituri Province in the east as the epicenter, comprising about 71.7% of cases. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared on May 15 in the DRC and has spread to five countries: the DRC, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France, which has reported an imported case. Unlike Zaire ebolavirus, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. This is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-most widespread globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱が1万人の感染者数を超える
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラアウトブレイク(1万人超、致死率48.6%)が複数国に越境拡大しており、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia e Ebolës në Kongo kalon 10,000 raste, vijojnë trajtimet e të infektuarve - Euronews Albania
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo surpasses 10,000 cases, treatments for the infected continue.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 cases, with the latest tally at 10,060, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, according to the health ministry. As fear of spread to other African countries grows, a nurse responding to the outbreak in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, was killed by an armed youth group; another health worker was wounded in a separate Friday attack. The assailants, armed with machetes and sticks, accused the staff of spreading the disease by contaminating water sources. The nurse had worked at Bafwasende General Hospital and helped raise awareness about Bundibugyo virus, which the ministry says has killed more than 4,800 people in the country since May. A local health official said the hostility was shocking and hard to believe as targeting a foreigner. The WHO condemned the assault, and Tedros urged safer, dignified conditions for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が1万人を突破、感染者の治療が継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は症例数1万人超・死者4800人超で史上最速の拡大ペースとされ、他国への拡大懸念や保健従事者への暴力も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事ではBundibugyoウイルス（エボラ属の一種）としており、死者数4800人超・症例1万人超と深刻。保健医療従事者への襲撃事件も発生しており、対応活動の継続性に懸念あり。他アフリカ諸国への拡大懸念が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДРК превысило 10 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of October 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, in a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak ongoing since mid-May. This marks the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic, and, by spread speed, second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak globally. No approved vaccine or disease-specific treatment exists for this rare strain. Conflict, poor roads, violence, distrust, and misinformation complicate response efforts. Health facilities are overwhelmed; workers have protested over pay delays. At least half of registered deaths occur without hospitalization, indicating underreporting and late care. Maternal deaths are rising as pregnant women avoid hospitals due to fear of infection and isolation. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; symptoms can resemble malaria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確定症例数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（1万例超、致死率約49%）が継続しており、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない希少株であること、医療体制崩壊や国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内のエボラ流行が主題であり、Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及がないため除外。マラリアは症状の類似性に関する言及のみで独立した流行情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de Ebola salgınında 8 eyalette 66 sağlık bölgesinde 10.060 vaka kaydedildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In KDC, during the Ebola outbreak, 10,060 cases were recorded in 66 health districts across 8 provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which began in May, has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases. As of 25 October, authorities report 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths, giving a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak is reported across eight provinces and in 66 health zones nationwide. The figures were released from Kinshasa and noted in a 27 October report. The article provides no details on infection source or any imported/exported cases. These numbers indicate widespread geographic distribution and high mortality within the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ出血熱の流行により8州66保健地区で10,060件の症例が記録された

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera la barrera de los 10.000 casos y se acerca al umbral de los 4.900 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has surpassed the 10,000-case mark and is nearing the 4,900-death threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 10,000 cases and nears 4,900 deaths, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths reported as of 27 Oct 2026. In the latest day, 96 cases and 46 deaths were recorded; case fatality rate stands at 48.6%. About 2,684 people have recovered; contact tracing is 81.6% complete. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 71.7% of cases, while the virus has spread to eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Upper Uele, Lower Uele, Ubangi North, and Ubangi South. This is the deadliest outbreak in DRC history, with projections comparing to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) that produced ~28,616 cases and ~11,325 deaths per WHO. The outbreak has triggered confirmed cases in Kenya and Nigeria linked to the DRC event, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which lacks a vaccine or approved treatment; regional surveillance has been reinforced.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が1万人を超え、死者数は4,900人に迫る

article.articleHeadline: Dọn nhà, diệt muỗi, tiêm vaccine để 'né' sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clean the house, kill mosquitoes, and get vaccinated to prevent dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging in southern Vietnam. Since January 2026, the southern region has reported 96,621 dengue cases and 19 deaths, with Phu Quoc recording over 1,000 cases (about 6.9 times the prior year). Eleven fatalities occurred in people over 15 years old. In Ho Chi Minh City, a 16-year-old girl with dengue shock syndrome required more than a month of intensive care, with treatment costs nearing 1 billion VND. Vaccination uptake is rising alongside vector control; VNVC centers report about a 50% month-over-month increase in dengue vaccine administration. The Japanese-origin vaccine is licensed by the Ministry of Health, given in two doses three months apart, and can be used in individuals previously infected and in those aged 4 years and older. Vaccination should accompany mosquito control measures, water container management, and regular cleaning of plant pots and ponds to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 家を片付け、蚊を駆除し、ワクチンを接種してデング熱を予防する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部でデング熱症例・死亡者数が増加しているが、デング熱は同地域の風土病であり、今回の報道は予防啓発記事の性格が強く、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。Phu Quocでの症例急増（前年比6.9倍）など一部地域の動向は要注視。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナム南部における季節性・風土病的流行であり、本記事はワクチン接種と防蚊対策を促す公衆衛生啓発の性格が強い。ただしPhu Quocでの症例急増や重症例（デングショック症候群、長期ICU治療）の報告があり、流行状況の推移を継続して注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia e Ebolës në Kongo kalon 10,000 raste, vijojnë trajtimet e të infektuarve
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo surpasses 10,000 cases; treatments for the infected continue.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 cases, reaching 10,060 according to the latest health ministry report, making this the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The surge comes as authorities report renewed violence against healthcare workers: a nurse at Bafwasende General Hospital in Tshopo Province was killed by a group of armed youths, and another health worker was wounded in a separate Friday attack. The assailants accused staff of spreading the virus by contaminating water sources. The nurse helped raise awareness about the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, which the health ministry says has killed more than 4,800 people in the country since the May outbreak began. WHO condemned the assault; Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged health workers to operate with dignity and safety. The attacks fuel fears of wider spread to other African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数が1万人を突破、感染者の治療は継続

article.articleHeadline: Kejar Kemandirian Obat, Pesiden Prabowo Minta BRIN Percepat Riset Vaksin Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pursue Pharmaceutical Independence, President Prabowo Asks BRIN to Accelerate Malaria Vaccine Research.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto has urged BRIN to accelerate malaria vaccine research and herbal medicines to boost domestic pharmaceutical independence. BRIN chief Arif Satria said the president seeks to shorten the vaccine development timeline by about three years, with four malaria vaccine candidates currently in BRIN and an estimated five to six candidates nationwide as of 27 October 2026. The effort prioritizes vaccines aligned with Indonesia’s malaria parasite, notably Plasmodium vivax, with domestic production expected to contribute to global malaria control. BRIN collaborates with the Ministry of Health and PT Bio Farma, and government support is anticipated to hasten progression to production. Prabowo also pressed for stronger drug autonomy through phytopharmaceuticals, with BRIN listing 19 herbal candidates advancing toward phytopharmaceutical status; several remain at Obat Herbal Terstandar (OHT). BRIN will coordinate with the Health Ministry and BPOM to accelerate testing and approvals.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬品自立を目指し、プラボウォ大統領がBRINにマラリアワクチン研究の加速を要請
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチン研究開発に関する政策的な報道であり、感染症の発生・流行・公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアワクチン開発政策に関する内容であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenko PMK aktivasi sistem informasi cegah penyakit akibat zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Activation of the information system to prevent zoonotic diseases by the Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Cultural Affairs
article.articleSummary: SIZE, the Zoonosis and Emerging Infectious Diseases Information System, was activated by Indonesia’s Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Culture Affairs (Kemenko PMK) with Kemenkes and Kementan, starting in Java–Bali (activation in Yogyakarta). The system integrates sectoral disease data, outbreak warnings, response logging, and analytical tools for zoonoses and new infectious diseases. Per Permenko PMK No. 7/2022, mandatory reportable diseases include zoonoses: rabies, avian influenza, anthrax, leptospirosis; and emerging infections: Nipah, Ebola, MERS-CoV, SARS, and COVID-19. Java–Bali were selected for initial rollout due to high population density (roughly 60% of Indonesians) and superior IT infrastructure, with mobility driving epidemic risk. The example cited is cattle movement between Bali and Java contributing to anthrax transmission risk. Following Java–Bali, SIZE will expand to other regions with data indicating potential threats, enabling coordinated, early prevention and response.

triage.headline_ja: 人間開発・文化担当調整省（Kemenko PMK）、人獣共通感染症予防のための情報システムを稼働
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、インドネシア政府による人獣共通感染症監視システムの稼働という行政的取り組みに関する記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ranchi News: विद्यालयों में बच्चों को बताए गए रेबीज से बचाव के उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ranchi News: Measures to Prevent Rabies Explained to Children in Schools
article.articleSummary: Rabies awareness drive in Khunti district, Ranchi, through schools, led by the Animal Husbandry and Health departments under Deputy Commissioner Mo Javed Husain. The campaign informs students about the causes, symptoms, transmission, and prevention of rabies, highlighting that bites or scratches from dogs or other suspected animals can transmit the fatal disease. Students are urged to promptly wash the wound with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and to seek medical care at a health facility. Medical guidance emphasizes that rabies vaccination and treatment are essential. The effort underscores rabies as a serious, potentially fatal disease and promotes urgent post-exposure actions to reduce risk. Ongoing awareness activities are being conducted across various schools in Khunti.

triage.headline_ja: ランチーニュース:学校で子どもたちに狂犬病予防策を指導
triage.triage_reason: 学校での狂犬病啓発活動に関する通常の予防広報記事であり、新規症例の発生や異常な流行を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の啓発キャンペーンに関する内容であり、具体的な症例報告やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていないため、対象国としての発生事例計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: TSUIL removes 26,048 mosquito breeding sites in Jamshedpur
article.articleSummary: TSUISL reports intensified dengue prevention in Jamshedpur (East Singhbhum, Jharkhand) April–September: survey of about 490,000 households identified and eliminated 26,048 mosquito breeding sites across its command area. Door-to-door checks of 489,601 houses found 14,193 indoor and 11,855 outdoor sites, all removed. Outside the command area, 2,654 breeding cases were reported to JNAC, with 2,115 notices issued. The house index fell from 2.7 (April–August) to 2.4 in September, below the 5 benchmark. Campaign measures included 212 awareness programs, 104 school street plays, and over 440,000 door-to-door interactions; 92 IEC drives collected discarded tyres and containers. Of 21 confirmed dengue cases in East Singhbhum, nine were from the TSUISL area. TSUISL emphasizes ongoing surveillance, awareness, and source-reduction.

triage.headline_ja: TSUIL、ジャムシェドプールで26,048か所の蚊発生源を除去
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防活動の報告であり、症例数も限定的（確認21例）でハウスインデックスも基準値以下に低下しており、異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（TSUISL）によるルーチンの蚊媒介対策・啓発活動の実施報告記事。デング熱の異常発生や急増を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونجو تتجاوز 10 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in Congo surpass 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded 10,060 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 4,887 deaths, per government data from the Institute of Public Health. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, began in mid-May and has become the largest and deadliest on record for the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak there. It ranks as the second-largest and deadliest Ebola wave globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that sickened about 28,600 and killed more than 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. International spread includes Kenya reporting its first case this month, followed by nine cases after a Nairobi man who had traveled from Congo died; Nigeria became the fourth African country to report infection. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June, mostly imported; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August, though Ugandan authorities plan 21-day quarantines for returnees from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者10,060人、死者4,887人）が継続中で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行自体が2018-2020年流行を上回る過去最大規模であり、致死率も約48.6%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Cases Top 10,000 as Violence Hits Health Workers
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 4,887 deaths through Oct. 25, according to Congo's National Institute for Public Health and the United Nations. Violence against health workers responding to the outbreak intensified in recent days, including the killing of a nurse. The government and United Nations are monitoring the toll and continuing the response to the outbreak in the DRC, despite security challenges. The figures were reported by both the government and the United Nations, underscoring the ongoing crisis and the pressures on frontline responders. The report notes United Nations involvement in monitoring the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が1万人超、医療従事者への暴力も激化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者が1万人を超え致死率約49%と深刻な公衆衛生上の危機であり、治安悪化により対応が困難化しているため国際的拡大・支援の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 致死率約48.9%（4,887/10,000）。治安悪化により保健従事者への攻撃が発生し、対応の継続性に懸念あり。国連も関与し監視中。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 10 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths reported by the Public Health Institute. The outbreak, linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, began in mid-May and has become the largest and deadliest Ebola surge in the DRC to date, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak. Globally, it ranks as the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, after West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic that infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000, primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Officials warned that the spillover risk to other African nations remains a concern as cases rise.
