article.articleHeadline: NVBDCP trains 40 MOs on vector-borne diseases
article.articleSummary: Forty medical officers in Kohima, Nagaland, completed a NVBDCP refresher on vector-borne diseases on October 27, covering malaria, dengue, kala-azar, Japanese encephalitis and chikungunya. The training aimed to strengthen clinical management, case notification, laboratory confirmation and integrated vector control. Sessions, led by experts from NCVBDC (Delhi) and the Regional Office Imphal, addressed malaria epidemiology and case management; dengue diagnosis, classification and surveillance; kala-azar diagnosis and treatment; JE immunisation and prevention; dengue and chikungunya epidemiology and control; and vector management targeting Anopheles, Aedes, Culex and sandflies. A lab/diagnostic component discussed specimen collection and confirmation; reporting via the IHIP VBD portal. A post-test assessed understanding. The program emphasized enhancing capacities for disease management, outbreak investigation and coordinated vector control in Nagaland.

triage.headline_ja: NVBDCP、媒介生物感染症に関する研修を40名の医療官に実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の研修・能力強化活動の報道であり、新規の発生や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はナガランド州での医療従事者向け研修プログラムに関する内容であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO launches clinical trial for Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the World Health Organization launched a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines, vaccinating four people in the first phase in Bunia. The trial, named TUMAINI, vaccinates contacts of infected individuals using the Ervebo vaccine, which has proven effective against Bundibugyo virus, a strain of Ebola. WHO experts are also evaluating two additional vaccines developed by the University of Oxford and Moderna; results may take several months. Authorities aim to expand the trial to provide protective vaccines for the population against current and future Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン臨床試験を開始したとの報道で、現在進行中または今後のエボラ発生への対応を示唆しており、致死率の高い感染症であるため公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験（TUMAINI）に焦点を当てているが、『現在および将来のブンディブギョ型エボラ発生』への言及があり、背景に実際のアウトブレイクが存在する可能性が高い。発生状況の詳細（症例数、死亡者数等）については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue chega a 16 bairros do Rio nesta semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Fight Against Dengue Reaches 16 Neighborhoods in Rio de Janeiro This Week
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's Municipal Health Secretariat conducts SVS na Rua inspections in 16 bairros (Santa Teresa; Laranjeiras, Botafogo, Pitangueiras, Pechincha; Santo Cristo, Lins de Vasconcelos; Andaraí, Honório Gurgel, Irajá, Campo Grande, Cosmos, Guaratiba, Pedra de Guaratiba, Santa Cruz, Paciência) from Oct 26–29 to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by locating and eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites. About 75% of breeding sites are found inside residences. By Oct 10, 2026, 9,728,581 property inspections were conducted and 1,330,015 containers treated or removed. In 2025, 12,296,072 visits yielded 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. The public can request inspections or report breeding sites via Central 1746; residents are urged to regularly check yards, plant pots, water tanks, and other sources of standing water to curb arbovirus transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで今週、デング熱対策が16地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: これはブラジル・リオデジャネイロ市の定例的なデング熱等のベクター対策・予防活動の広報記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事は通常の蚊媒介感染症予防活動の報告であり、症例数急増や異常事態の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Regeneron lands $270M in renewed US supply pact for approved Ebola med Inmazeb
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues as the fastest-spreading, second-largest outbreak on record, with 10,000 confirmed cases in the DRC as of 2026-10-27. The U.S. CDC reports no cases in the United States and characterizes the risk to Americans as very low. Regeneron has renewed a BARDA-backed pact to supply Inmazeb, its monoclonal antibody cocktail (atoltivimab, maftivimab, odesivimab-ebgn), to the U.S. government through 2031 for about $270 million. WHO guidelines from 2022 strongly recommended Inmazeb alongside Ebanga for Ebola therapeutics. Regeneron is evaluating maftivimab—the kit’s most potent virus-neutralizing component—for use against the current outbreak, including potential inclusion in the PARTNERS trial. The prior agreement, launched in 2020 to cover ten years, provided supplies for about $10 million upfront and roughly $67 million annually and was set to wrap up this year.

triage.headline_ja: リジェネロン、承認済みエボラ治療薬インマゼブの米国供給契約を2.7億ドルで更新
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例数1万人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国は治療薬供給契約の当事国であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。米CDCは米国内リスクを「非常に低い」と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Imposes Quarantine on Those Who Visited Congo in Bid to Fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda imposed a 21-day quarantine for Ugandan citizens who transited through Congo as Ebola precautions rise amid the Congo outbreak. Two people who passed through Congo tested positive, including a Swiss diplomat's wife; authorities are tracing 53 contacts and coordinating with Nigerian and international partners. Genomic sequencing and travel records are guiding the investigation; Ugandan officials say the Kenyan and Nigerian cases both passed Entebbe International Airport on the same day, but there is no evidence of direct contact between them. The Kenyan index-case contacts completed the 21-day monitoring period. Uganda has strengthened screening at Entebbe and land borders, and requires all travelers to fill a passenger locator form. The Congo outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo strain, with 9,816 confirmed cases and 4,757 deaths; no vaccine approved yet, but Ervebo trials are underway in Uganda and Congo, including a Bunia vaccination started Oct 23. WHO notes a nurse killed and another health worker injured in a response attack in Bafwasende.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対策としてコンゴ訪問者に検疫措置を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは大規模（9,816症例、4,757死亡）であり、既に複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（ブンディブギョ株）での継続的なエボラアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの輸入症例・検疫対応も報じられているが、これら3カ国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率が高く、医療従事者への攻撃も発生しており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Casi di contagio da Ebola in Congo superano quota 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, reaching 10,060 according to the government. This is the country’s worst outbreak and the second-largest globally, behind the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. The death toll has risen beyond 4,000. Ongoing insecurity in eastern provinces, attacks on health facilities, and cross-border spread into neighboring countries are hampering containment efforts, complicating surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and other response measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染者が10,000人超、死者4,000人超と過去最悪規模の流行となっており、越境拡大や治安悪化による対応困難が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事ではアンゴラへの越境拡大の具体的な症例数は言及されていないため、Angolaはverified_locationsに含めず（対象国リストにも含まれない）。治安悪化と医療施設への攻撃が対応を困難にしている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola supera los 10 mil casos y roza las 5 mil muertes por nuevo brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 10,000 cases and approaches 5,000 deaths in a new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and nears 5,000 deaths as of 27 October 2026. The Congo government reports 10,060 confirmed cases, with nearly half resulting in death (about 5,030). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is the most deadly and fastest‑growing in history, and has spread beyond the region to Kenya and Nigeria, with detections in Uganda and France though no active cases there currently. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention warns that Ebola is crossing borders and urges faster, better‑coordinated responses, greater solidarity, and decisive political leadership. About 2,600 patients have recovered in the Congo. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyro, and the World Health Organization cautions that the outbreak is far from over, despite some celebrations over recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、新たな流行で感染者1万人超え、死者も5千人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、1万人超の感染者、複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスへの拡散も報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないか、現在活動的な症例がないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラで、ワクチンが存在しない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Kein Ende in Sicht bei Ebola - mehr als 10.000 Fälle | Wissenschaft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No end in sight for Ebola — more than 10,000 cases | Science
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists at an unprecedented pace, with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths reported since mid-May, as of October 2026. Eight northern and eastern provinces (roughly 116 million people) are affected, with Ituri province accounting for about 71% of cases. Transmission continues via contact with body fluids; the case fatality rate is ~49%. Many deaths occur in community settings rather than in specialized centers (about two-thirds). The outbreak has crossed borders: Uganda has 20 cases (2 deaths); Kenya reports 9 cases (2 deaths) linked to a DRC patient; Nigeria confirmed its first case on October 20 linked to travel from Uganda; France and other European facilities have treated aid workers, including Berlin’s Charité. Displaced populations and insecurity hinder response, with attacks on responders. There are no Bundibugyo-specific vaccines or therapies; antiviral trials and vaccine studies are underway, and Ervebo’s cross-protection is under evaluation, though licensed for Zaire ebolavirus only.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、収束の兆しなし — 感染者1万人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約49%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数が該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・ドイツでの症例/治療報告は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDCongo ultrapassa 10 mil casos chega a quase 5 mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DR Congo surpasses 10,000 cases, nearing 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, with a case-fatality rate of 48.6% as of Oct 25, per the National Institute of Public Health. The outbreak, declared May 15, is the second deadliest and most contagious in the region, affecting eight of 26 provinces. Ituri and North Kivu are the hardest hit, together accounting for ongoing transmission, with 32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours. Total cases: 10,060; recoveries: 2,684; contact-tracing rate: 81.6%. Affected provinces include Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; WHO is testing vaccines, with Ervebo used in mass campaigns since August, and animal data suggesting cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The virus spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で症例数が1万人を超え、死者数は5千人近くに
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、1万症例超・8州に拡大する大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAに進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で特異的治療薬がなく、WHOがワクチン試験・大規模接種キャンペーンを実施中。8州に拡大し致死率約48.6%と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Entry Rules for South Sudan Travelers
article.articleSummary: Ebola entry rules apply to travelers who spent time in South Sudan in the prior 21 days. The outbreak centers in the DRC; CDC data to Oct 24, 2026: 9,964 confirmed DRC cases and 4,841 deaths; 20 in Uganda, 9 in Kenya, 1 in Nigeria, 1 in France; none for South Sudan. A first rule took effect Oct 11, 2026 for 30 days. A second rule starts Nov 3, 2026, requiring every passenger flying to the United States from abroad to sign a health statement. US citizens may return via three designated airports (IAD, ATL, JFK) with screening; foreign nationals are barred unless exceptions apply. South Sudan travelers undergo screening and 21-day monitoring; those from DRC require daily temperature checks. South Sudan reports no confirmed Ebola cases; June 2026 samples negative; WHO cautions against travel restrictions. Travelers to Juba should heed safety advisories.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン渡航者向けエボラ出血熱入国規則
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に9,964例・4,841死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、複数国への国際的拡大と渡航制限措置が発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを震源とするエボラアウトブレイクに起因する米国・南スーダンの入国規則に関する内容。南スーダン、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ発生地域として検証対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Des essais cliniques spécifiques aux contacts directs des cas positifs d'Ebola lancés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Clinical trials specifically targeting the direct contacts of Ebola-positive cases have been launched.
article.articleSummary: Bundibudyo Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with over 9,500 confirmed cases and more than 4,600 deaths as of October 26, 2026. The virus began in Mongbwalu, Ituri, and has reached Uganda, Nigeria, and Kenya (Kenya reporting 2 deaths, 8 cases). In Bunia, Ituri, on October 23, 2026, a third clinical trial named TUMAINI (Hope) was launched, targeting only direct contacts of laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases to test a vaccine specific to Bundibudyo. Led by Dr. Hugo Kavunga, this Phase II/III study aims to assess efficacy and safety over six months, with potential regional expansion. Earlier, in July 2026, the EBO-PEP trial evaluated post-exposure prophylaxis with Obeldsivir, MBP134, and Remdesivir. A mid-September 2026 Ervebo vaccination campaign against Bundibudyo is ongoing, reflecting concerted efforts to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ陽性者の直接接触者を対象とした臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例9,500人超、死者4,600人超に達する大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへも拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（9,500例超、死者4,600例超）とそれに対する臨床試験（TUMAINI試験）を主題としている。ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへの拡大が記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "دودة الثعلب الشريطية" تشعل الجدل في ألمانيا.. و"الصحة العالمية" تطور أنظمة الكشف المبكر |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Fox tapeworm" stirs up controversy in Germany, and WHO develops early-detection systems.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns about the fox tapeworm, Echinococcus multilocularis, a parasite that damages the liver and can cause alveolar echinococcosis, potentially fatal. In Germany, the infection has drawn attention, particularly among people who forage for berries or mushrooms. The parasite is 2–6 mm long; adult worms live in the small intestine of red foxes (Vulpes vulpes), occasionally in dogs and cats. The red fox is the main definitive host. The fox-tapeworm disease is among WHO’s 21 neglected tropical diseases and serves as an early-warning indicator. In Germany, 2024 saw 52 human cases reported by the Robert Koch Institute; previous years hovered around 40–45. Most cases were from Baden-Württemberg and Bavaria. Fox infections in wildlife range 33–50% by region. WHO advocates integrating surveillance with community health workers and strengthening health systems to meet 2030 targets; data gaps in outbreaks (e.g., Ebola in DRC) show the risk of delayed responses.

triage.headline_ja: 「キツネ条虫」がドイツで議論を呼ぶ…WHOは早期発見システムを開発
triage.triage_reason: 記事はドイツにおけるエキノコックス症（キツネ条虫）に関する内容であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。DRCのエボラは比較のための言及に過ぎず、具体的な発生情報ではない。
triage.notes: 主題はドイツでのエキノコックス症（動物由来、ヒトでは年間約50例程度）に関する記事。DRCのエボラは文中でデータギャップの例として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Democratic Republic of the Congo Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4 - Ebola Outbreak (Bundibugyo Virus), 30 September
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand. As of 30 September 2026, there are 8,300 cumulative confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (CFR 48.4%). Ituri remains the epicentre with 6,293 cases and 2,902 deaths (75.8% of all confirmed), followed by North Kivu (1,601/950) and Haut-Uélé (346/144); transmission also persists in Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, South Kivu and South-Ubangi, with Sud-Ubangi reporting cases for the first time. Seventeen health zones across seven provinces are affected; 63 health zones have confirmed cases, including 16 hotspots. In September alone, 2,050 new confirmed cases and 979 deaths were reported. UNICEF reports a scaled response across 63 health zones with 16 hotspot zones, deploying 3,469 community mobilizers and 11,513 frontline actors, increasing safe water delivery and IPC/WASH support, plus education kits. Funding needs total US$113.5 million; US$41 million has been mobilized, leaving a US$72.5 million gap.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFコンゴ民主共和国人道状況報告書第4号 - エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョウイルス）、9月30日時点
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョウウイルス）アウトブレイクが7州63保健地域に拡大し、死者4,018人に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 資金ギャップ(US$72.5M)が報告されており、国際的な支援体制の継続的強化が必要。新規州（南ウバンギ）への拡大も確認され、既存の大規模アウトブレイクのフォローアップとして継続監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Uz Šveici no Nigērijas atvesta sieviete, kura inficējusies ar nāvējošo Ebolas vīrusu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman brought to Switzerland from Nigeria who has been infected with the deadly Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease (EVD) case: a Swiss woman infected with Ebola, treated in Nigeria, was evacuated Monday with her husband, a Swiss diplomat, to Switzerland. Nigeria’s Health Minister Muhammed Pate said she, Nigeria's first confirmed Ebola case, is now stable, conscious, and able to communicate, though still potentially infectious; strict precautions remain. The husband is in isolation at Zurich University Hospital; the Swiss Federal Public Health Office confirmed their arrival on the medical evacuation flight. Nigeria continues to monitor 52 contacts of the patient. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Dzanabi said the evacuation occurred because both are Swiss citizens; Nigeria reports the patient’s condition improved after the acute phase, and there are currently no Ebola cases in the country. The woman had returned to Abuja from Uganda; Swiss authorities say she did not visit Congo and likely contracted the virus in Uganda, where cases were reported but containment announced.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアからスイスへ搬送された女性がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ確定例が発生し、スイスへの国際医療搬送が行われるなど国際的拡大とWHO・複数国政府の関与が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染地はナイジェリア（初確認例）およびウガンダ（推定感染地）であり、記事中でコンゴ（DRC）訪問は明確に否定されている。いずれも対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Prabowo Urges BRIN to Speed Up Malaria Vaccine Research
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-27, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto directed BRIN to accelerate malaria vaccine research to advance national vaccine self-sufficiency. BRIN Head Arif Satria told reporters at the Presidential Palace in Jakarta that BRIN is currently pursuing four malaria vaccine candidates, part of roughly five to six candidates under development across Indonesia, in collaboration with the Ministry of Health and state-owned Bio Farma. With explicit presidential backing, the research timeline could be condensed by up to three years. Arif highlighted Indonesia's Plasmodium vivax strains, noting no effective commercial vaccine exists worldwide; domestic development could contribute to global malaria control. The President's remarks stressed broader international impact and full backing for vaccine manufacturing to speed production should candidates prove successful. The briefing also noted ongoing BRIN projects in other areas, but malaria vaccine development remains the central focus.

triage.headline_ja: プラボウォ大統領、BRINにマラリアワクチン研究の加速を指示
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチン研究開発に関する政策的な発表であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア感染症の発生事例ではなく、インドネシア政府によるワクチン研究開発推進の政策発表であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Aldeias concentram 63% dos casos de chikungunya e 52% da dengue em Sidrolândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Villages account for 63% of chikungunya cases and 52% of dengue in Sidrolândia.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya and dengue outbreaks in Sidrolândia, Brazil, are heavily centered in indigenous villages, which account for 63.3% of chikungunya and 52.2% of dengue records through October 24, 2026 (period Jan 1–Oct 24). Among 207 lab-confirmed chikungunya cases, 131 occurred in aldeias, with Tereré reporting 61 (46.6% of indigenous cases; 29.5% of all cases). Dengue totals include 69 confirmed cases, led by Tereré with 17, followed by Córrego do Meio (12), Lagoinha (5) and Nova Nascente (2); these four communities together represent 52.2% of dengue in the municipality. A week-long vector-control mutirão in Tereré and Nova Nascente removed about 23 items capable of retaining water and delivered guidance to prevent standing water and Aedes aegypti breeding. Agencies involved included Vector Control, Economic Development and Environment, Civil Defense, Indigenous Health Base, and Indigenous Sanitation Agents. By September 2026, chikungunya reached 151 cases; 66 were recorded in 2025. Dengue had 149 notifications in 2025, and 69 confirmed cases in 2026. For information, contact Vector Control at (67) 99631-6638.

triage.headline_ja: シドロランジアにおけるチクングニア熱症例の63%、デング熱症例の52%が先住民集落に集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方自治体における既知の媒介蚊感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の局地的流行で、対策も実施中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の媒介蚊感染症であり、地方自治体レベルで既に媒介蚊対策（mutirão）が実施されている。重症度や死亡例の情報はなく、地域限定的な公衆衛生対応事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Sudah 745 Kasus, DPRD Pekanbaru Ingatkan DBD Bertambah di Musim Penghujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There Have Been 745 Cases, Pekanbaru DPRD Warns That Dengue Cases Are Increasing in the Rainy Season
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) in Pekanbaru, Indonesia, rose to 745 cases with three deaths as of early October 2026. The rainy season has intensified Aedes aegypti breeding and dengue transmission across districts, with Tuah Madani reporting 117 cases and one fatality, followed by Marpoyan Damai (109) and Bukit Raya (82). Deaths occurred in Sail and Kulim. Authorities warn that transmission can affect anyone during the dry-to-wet seasonal transition, stressing sustained prevention beyond slogans. The report notes the vector as the carrier of dengue, though laboratory confirmation details are not provided. To curb spread, officials advocate continuous 3M Plus measures—empty and scrub water containers, cover stored water, and reuse or recycle items that collect water—and Mosquito Nest Destruction (PSN). Community engagement, including RT/RW-led biweekly gotong royong, is urged to eradicate local breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: すでに745件、ペカンバル市議会は雨季にデング熱症例が増加すると警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ペカンバルで季節性デング熱の増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域的な公衆衛生対応として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱流行であり、地域議会(DPRD)が対策強化を呼びかけている。死亡者3名を含む745症例が報告されているが、既知の風土病パターンの範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果伊波拉｜护士被控"播毒"遭暴徒袭击亡　当地医护不敢回家
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: Nurse accused of "spreading poison" killed in mob attack; local healthcare workers do not dare to go home.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to surge in eastern DR Congo’s Tshopo Province, with the outbreak now 10,060 confirmed infections—the fastest growth to date. The health ministry says misinformation is complicating control, with residents alleging Ebola is a hoax or that health workers are spreading the virus. A nurse in Bafwasende, Tshopo, was killed last Friday by knife-wielding attackers during an outbreak-response visit; another responder survived after hospital care. The deceased was an experienced hospital professional who led local Ebola education campaigns. Security fears have left frontline staff reluctant to return home; healthcare teams remain at facilities, with troops briefly patrolling the area. UN Ebola emergency coordinator Julien Harneis calls the death a severe setback for patient care and outbreak response. Since May, the outbreak has caused over 4,800 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ｜看護師が「毒をまいた」と疑われ暴徒に襲撃され死亡　現地の医療従事者は帰宅を恐れる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が急拡大し（累計1万人超感染、死者4800人超）、誤情報による医療従事者への暴力事件が発生し対応に深刻な支障が出ており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連エボラ緊急調整官が事態悪化を警告しており、誤情報対策と治安確保が今後の対応の鍵となる。感染拡大が最速ペースである点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Số ca mắc tại CHDC Congo vượt 10.000, nhiều nước tăng cường giám sát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: The number of cases in DR Congo exceeds 10,000, with many countries strengthening surveillance.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, with eight of 26 provinces affected and Ituri in the east accounting for over 70% of cases. Ongoing transmission, worsened by conflict and displacement, hampers surveillance and treatment. WHO notes a rise in October after a September decline; CDC Africa says only about 12% of cases are identified among known contacts, leaving many transmission chains undetected. Cross-border spread since May includes Uganda, France and Kenya and Nigeria. Kenya: 9 cases, 2 deaths; 98 contacts monitored. Nigeria has no confirmed local cases but 52 contacts remain under surveillance after a traveler from Uganda was diagnosed and moved to Switzerland. Uganda previously ended its outbreak in July and has intensified border screening. Tumaini Phase 2/3 began Oct 23 in Bunia to test Bundibugyo protection; Ervebo licensed for another strain; Moderna and Oxford candidates prep for trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国の感染者数が1万人を超え、多くの国が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの感染者数が1万人を超え致死率も高く、複数国への越境拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、スイス）が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確である。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、フランス、スイスでの症例・接触者監視も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主要な発生国である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 10.000 cas en RDC, une épidémie qui met à l'épreuve les capacités de riposte de l'Afrique (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 10,000 Cases in the DRC, an Outbreak That Tests Africa's Response Capacities (General Report)
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, reaching 10,060 with 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%) as of Oct 25. The outbreak spans eight of 26 provinces and 66 health zones, with Ituri province in the east accounting for over 70% of cases. A resurgence began in early October after a late-September lull, while insecurity and restricted access hinder surveillance and response. Attacks on health workers, including a nurse killed in Tshopo, highlight frontline risks. Only about 12% of confirmed cases are detected among identified contacts, signaling undetected transmission chains. Cross-border spread is evident: Kenya reports imported cases (nine confirmed, two deaths) with 98 contacts under surveillance; Nigeria evacuated its first patient to Switzerland and has 52 contacts under surveillance, with an anticipated end by Dec 7 if no new cases. Uganda remains Ebola-free; genomic investigations are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で症例数1万人超、アフリカの対応能力を試す流行（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例が1万人を超え致死率48.6%と深刻であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア（輸入症例9例）、ナイジェリア（スイスへの患者搬送）への越境伝播が報告されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内ではイトゥリ州が症例の70%以上を占め、治安悪化により監視・対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор сообщил о завозном случае лихорадки Зика в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor reported an imported case of Zika fever in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Zika fever imported case detected in Russia. In September 2026, a woman who returned from Bali to Moscow was diagnosed with laboratory-confirmed Zika fever and hospitalized. Russia is not endemic for Zika. Rospotrebnadzor states that the risk of domestic transmission is excluded, as mosquitoes on Russian territory do not pose a high epidemiological threat. The agency monitors the situation automatically and has deployed domestic diagnostic test systems for rapid confirmation. This remains an imported case with no evidence of local spread; ongoing surveillance aims to prevent autochthonous transmission and to safeguard public health. Public health authorities emphasise continued enhanced infection surveillance and targeted tracing as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア連邦消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ロシアへのジカ熱輸入症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: バリ島からの渡航歴がある単発の輸入症例であり、ロシア国内での二次感染の証拠はなく、当局も国内伝播リスクを否定しているため、現時点でフルRRAに進める根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシアへの輸入症例としての報告であり、感染地とされるインドネシア（バリ島）での流行状況や症例数についての言及はないため、同国を発生国として確定することはできない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola franchit un cap alarmant en RDC : des milliers de cas confirmés et près de 5.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crosses an alarming milestone in the DRC: thousands of confirmed cases and nearly 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak was first reported in mid-May, according to health authorities. This marks the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo variant, highly contagious, has also been confirmed outside the DRC—in Kenya and Nigeria—indicating cross-border transmission. The situation underscores ongoing transmission within the DRC and regional spillover, with authorities monitoring imported and exported cases and maintaining daily updates to case counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが深刻な節目を突破：数千件の確定症例と約5,000人の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上最速の拡大を示し、1万人超の症例・5000人近い死者、さらにケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境伝播の事実はリスク評価上重要な情報としてnotesに記載。

article.articleHeadline: US safari bookings hold despite Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, US safari bookings to Kenya hold despite Ebola headlines and a Level 3 travel advisory. US tour operators report no tangible drop in Kenya bookings and note steady East Africa demand, though clients have questioned the situation. Kenya’s Ebola cluster stems from a single imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; subsequent cases were known contacts and largely in quarantine at testing. Kenyan health authorities responded swiftly with screening and contact tracing. Travel advisers emphasize providing context to reassure clients and pledge prompt updates if guidance changes. Industry voices: Katie Hoppenjans reports inquiries but no decline; Phoebe Weinberg notes none of her clients have concerns, citing positive arrival and border health screening observed by travelers in August–September.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のサファリ予約、エボラ懸念にもかかわらず堅調を維持
triage.triage_reason: DRCからの輸入症例を起点としたケニアでのエボラクラスター発生及びレベル3渡航勧告が出ており、国際的拡大・渡航制限の両基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラクラスター（DRCからの輸入症例が起点）とそれに伴う米国発サファリ観光への影響。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染起源国として言及されているため含めた。モザンビーク・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en África: el brote superó los 10 mil casos confirmados en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: the outbreak surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 Ebola cases since May, with 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%) as of October 25, spanning 66 health zones across eight provinces. Ituri province remains the main epicenter, housing about 71.7% of confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The epidemic has spread beyond DRC, reaching Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with France reporting an imported case; in total, five countries have reported cases (four in Africa). This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, underscoring ongoing high mortality and wide geographic reach.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱:コンゴでの流行が確認症例1万件を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最大規模のエボラ流行(症例1万件超、致死率48.6%)であり、近隣4か国・欧州(フランス)へも拡大しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランスへの症例拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल में डेंगू का बढ़ा प्रकोप, 23 दिनों में 5500 से अधिक लोग संक्रमित; कोलकाता-हावड़ा समेत कई जिलों में बिगड़े हालात
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak has intensified in Bengal, with more than 5,500 people infected in 23 days; conditions have worsened in several districts, including Kolkata and Howrah.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak intensifies in West Bengal with over 5,500 new cases in the first 23 days of October. Murshidabad, Howrah, and Kolkata are the worst-affected districts, with North 24 Parganas also heavily impacted. In Kolkata city, roughly 2,800 dengue cases were registered from January–October 2026; 1,270 new infections occurred in the last week of September, and during Durga Puja week, city cases rose about 15% above normal. About 25% of Kolkata’s total cases originate from the Kashipur-Belgharia area in North Kolkata. Some wards in Kolkata Municipal Corporation, Howrah, and Bidhanagar are marked as active transmission zones. Hospital burden is rising; Charnak Hospital reported last week an average of 8–10 dengue patients arriving daily and about 10 admissions. Authorities reviewed district conditions, emphasizing removal of standing water, destruction of breeding sites, enhanced testing, and timely diagnosis, with political calls for accountability.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州でデング熱の流行が拡大、10月の23日間で5,500人以上が感染；コルカタ・ハウラーなど複数地区で状況悪化
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で季節性デング熱が拡大し病院負荷も増加しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、インド国内の地域的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、今回の報告も地域的な季節流行の範囲内と考えられる。病院負荷増加や感染拡大地区の報告はあるが、国際的な公衆衛生リスクとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de quatro meses morre por meningite C no Sul de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four-month-old baby dies of serogroup C meningococcal meningitis in southern Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Four-month-old baby dies of serogroup C meningococcal meningitis in Pouso Alegre, southern Minas Gerais, Brazil. Death confirmed after tests at Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte; occurred October 21. This year Pouso Alegre has recorded three meningococcal fatalities (July 4, October 6, October 21). Lab confirmation by Funed; two prior cases were serogroup C, the third’s serogroup pending. The infant was treated in the municipal health network and died at Hospital das Clínicas Samuel Libânio in grave condition. Investigations have found no epidemiological link among cases to date. The child was not up to date with meningitis vaccination; vaccines include meningococcal C at 3 and 5 months, ACWY booster at 12 months, and ACWY for 11–14-year-olds. Ten professionals and 26 family members received chemoprophylaxis; contact tracing continues. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges with fever, headache, and neck stiffness, requiring urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南ミナスで生後4か月の乳児がC群髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一自治体（ポウゾ・アレグレ）で年間3例の髄膜炎菌感染死亡が確認されているが、疫学的関連は否定されており国際的拡大の兆候はない。地域的なクラスター化の可能性があるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 同一市内で年3件の髄膜炎菌感染死亡（うち2件血清群C確定）。疫学的関連なしとされるが、小規模クラスターの可能性があり地域保健当局が接触者への化学予防を実施済み。国際的な影響や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 10 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 4,887 deaths and 2,600 recoveries to date. About 80% of cases occur among people not listed as known contacts. Africa CDC says an outbreak is considered controlled only if at least 95% of cases are identified among known contacts. At least half of the fatalities were not hospitalized, indicating gaps in access to care or reporting. Ebola virus disease, a hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 near Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, near the Ebola River; the West Africa spread occurred in 2013-2014. The 2014-2016 epidemic in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone infected about 30,000 and killed over 11,000. On May 15, after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, the country declared an epidemic. For the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, there are no approved treatments or vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱確定症例が1万人、死者4,887人に達し、症例の80%が既知の接触者外で発生するなど感染制御が困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スーダン・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは1976年の初発例や2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の歴史的言及であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株には承認済みの治療薬・ワクチンがなく、既知接触者以外での感染が80%を占めることから制御困難な状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria causa três mortes por meningite registradas no Acre em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterium Causes Three Meningitis Deaths Recorded in Acre in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 22, 2026, Acre, Brazil, reports 18 confirmed meningitis cases in 2026, with Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcus) causing 8 cases (44.4%) and 3 deaths. Three pneumococcal meningitis deaths occurred among ages 50–64 (two) and 65–79 (one); Rio Branco registered 2 deaths and Xapuri 1. Pneumococcal meningitis leads Acre’s 2026 etiologies, followed by meningococcal meningitis with 3 cases; fungal meningitis led in 2025. The overall meningitis case-fatality rate in 2026 is 16.6%, the lowest since 2022 (22.2%). March 2026 had five confirmed cases, the series’ highest monthly value. One suspected Xapuri case remains under investigation. Vaccination is the most effective prevention; PCV10 and PCV20 are part of routine immunization under the National Immunization Program, with age-appropriate dosing. Emphasize hygiene and seeking care for symptoms; data may change as Sinan updates (Bulletin No. 21/2026).

triage.headline_ja: 細菌が原因、2026年アクレ州で髄膜炎による死者3人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域（アクレ州）における散発的な髄膜炎症例・死亡報告であり、致死率も低下傾向にあるが、継続的な発生状況のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 肺炎球菌性髄膜炎が主因で、ワクチン接種（PCV10/PCV20）が通常の予防接種プログラムに含まれており、地域レベルで管理可能と考えられる。致死率は過去より低下傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola à Beni : treize nouveaux patients déclarés guéris | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Beni: thirteen new patients declared cured | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Thirteen patients infected with Ebola virus disease have been declared cured and discharged from treatment centers in Beni, the provisional capital of North Kivu, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Jérémie Muhindo, head of the care pillar, stated that these recoveries demonstrate that Ebola can be cured when patients receive prompt treatment in a health facility. He urged rapid hospital presentation for any malaise or suspicious symptoms and called on the population not to yield to fear. Muhindo also stressed combating stigma against Ebola survivors and urged the community to reintegrate them with dignity to facilitate social reinsertion. With the outbreak persisting in the region, control efforts continue to emphasize early detection and rapid medical care, adherence to health guidelines, and timely access to health services for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | ベニのエボラ：新たに13人の患者が治癒と宣言される | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報（回復者13名の報告）であり、新規の異常事態や拡大を示す情報はないため、既存アウトブレイクの経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイクにおける治療成功例（13名の回復）を報じるポジティブな内容であり、新たなリスクの急増や国際的拡大の兆候は記載されていない。既存アウトブレイクの一部として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Photos show Congo's fight against Ebola as cases surpass 10,000 - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Congolese Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases, with nearly half of those infected dying (about 5,000 deaths). Declared in May 2026, it is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record and has spread to Kenya and Nigeria. Responders face armed conflict, poor roads, and public mistrust while confronting the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The situation is illustrated in a photo gallery curated by AP photo editors, capturing frontline efforts and affected communities. The outbreak remains ongoing as of 27 October 2026. Key challenges include security risks and gaps in prevention and treatment linked to Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: 写真で見るコンゴのエボラとの闘い、症例数が1万人を超える - WTOPニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）が1万人超・死者約5000人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が記載されているが両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョウイルスであり、致死率約50%と極めて深刻。武力紛争や住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Över 10 000 smittade med ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 10,000 infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases exceed 10,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa region), making this the deadliest and fastest-growing outbreak in the country’s history; nearly half of the infections have died (around 5,000 deaths). Cases have also been reported in Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, an RNA virus that causes hemorrhagic fever. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo variant, though development is underway. The report notes cross-border spread, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance and public health measures. Health authorities warn transmission remains ongoing, highlighting the urgency of containment and regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(1万人超感染、致死率約50%)が発生し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの症例報告も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株には有効なワクチン・治療法が現時点で存在しないとされ、致死率が高いため緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 10.000 ebola-tilfælde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10,000 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has reached about 10,000 confirmed cases and roughly 5,000 deaths, according to BBC's latest confirmed figures. The outbreak, which began in May, has spread to several countries, with Kenya and Nigeria reporting their first cases earlier this month. The violence associated with the outbreak continues: a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured in attacks by a group of youths who accused health workers of spreading the virus via water sources. In addition, a politician was beaten to death after promoting measures to curb transmission. Earlier in August, several Red Cross volunteers were attacked, and an ambulance was set on fire. Current updates highlight ongoing transmission and rising security risks for responders in the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱1万人感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例約1万人・死者約5千人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大、医療従事者への暴力など複合的な公衆衛生・治安上の深刻な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。医療従事者や政治家への暴力など、対応活動への深刻な妨害が発生しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : 13 patients guéris d'Ebola quittent les centres de traitement de Beni - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: 13 Ebola-recovered patients leave the Ebola treatment centers in Beni - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in North Kivu and Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In Beni, North Kivu, 13 patients declared cured were discharged from Ebola treatment centers on 27 October 2026 after about ten days of care; final samples tested negative. Among the survivors is Tsongo Sivasimire, a nurse who contracted Ebola while treating an infected patient; he completed a 14‑day course and now urges rapid care and cooperation with response teams to stop transmission. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo, head of the patient‑care pillar, notes the departures as a hopeful sign and stresses early diagnosis and adherence to medical advice to improve survival, while calling to curb stigma against survivors. Despite progress, the outbreak remains grave: North Kivu reported 58 new cases in 24 hours; Ituri carries the largest cumulative burden (>7,200). The INSP records a 56% case‑fatality rate, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, early detection, and non‑discriminatory community support to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:エボラから回復した患者13人がベニのエボラ治療センターを退所
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクが進行中で、北キブ州で24時間に58例の新規症例、致死率56%、イトゥリ州の累積症例数が7,200例超と公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事は回復者の退所という前向きなニュースを扱っているが、同時に北キブ州での新規58例、致死率56%、イトゥリ州の累積7,200例超という継続的かつ深刻なエボラアウトブレイクの状況を報告しており、既知の進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases -- DR Congo health authorities
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Africa's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, according to DR Congo health authorities. The DRC reports 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, making it the country's deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. The vast majority of infections are in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In addition to DR Congo, cases have been detected in Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda. The report notes that these are confirmed cases, highlighting ongoing transmission and the outbreak's wider regional reach across East and Central Africa. These data underscore prolonged transmission and cross-border spread, with Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda cited as countries reporting Ebola cases beyond DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行が1万人超の感染者数に ― コンゴ民主共和国保健当局発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が1万人を超え、致死率約49%、複数国（ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ）への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行拡大性が該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境拡大の観点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola | Plus de 10 000 cas recensés, la majorité en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | More than 10,000 cases recorded, the majority in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa-based health authorities report that more than 10,000 Ebola cases have been recorded across Africa, with the vast majority in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the epicenter of the ongoing outbreak. As of 27 October 2026, the DRC has documented 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths. The outbreak is described as among the deadliest on record. The Ebola virus has spread beyond the DRC to Nigeria and Kenya, with Uganda previously affected in the course of the outbreak. The latest figures, published on Tuesday by Congolese health authorities, highlight the scale of transmission within the region and the continued burden of this epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | 1万人超の症例が記録、その大半がコンゴ民主共和国

article.articleHeadline: Imparable el Ébola en RDC: supera los 10.000 casos y roza los 4.900 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unstoppable Ebola in the DRC: surpasses 10,000 cases and nears 4,900 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths (case-fatality rate 48.6%). In the last 24 hours, 96 new cases and 46 deaths were reported. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 71.7% of total cases, with eight provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Ubangi-Nord, and Ubangi-Sud. The outbreak has expanded within the DRC and produced linked cases in Kenya and Nigeria, prompting intensified regional surveillance. The causative Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Recoveries total 2,684, and contact tracing is at 81.6%. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in RDC history and could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths) per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 止まらないエボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で症例1万人超、死者4900人近くに
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.6%、症例1万人超・死者4900人近くに達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行が主題。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例拡大が言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyo株による史上最悪規模の流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ξεπέρασαν τις 10.000 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στο Κονγκό - Αυξάνεται η ανησυχία για εξάπλωση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases have surpassed 10,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — concerns about spread are rising.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) and 4,887 deaths, per government data. The outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo Ebola, began in mid-May and is the largest and deadliest in the DRC to date, second only to West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis (over 28,600 cases, 11,000 deaths). Kenya reported its first case earlier this month, with nine cases after a Nairobi death of a man who had traveled from the DRC via Uganda; Nigeria also reported a fourth case. Authorities are probing transmission linked to a Swiss diplomat’s wife—who did not travel to the DRC but is thought to have been infected in Uganda—and she and her husband were airlifted to Switzerland. Uganda had 20 cases in May–June, mostly from DRC; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August, and Ugandan officials say returning citizens will be quarantined for 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が1万人を突破 — 拡散への懸念が高まる

article.articleHeadline: Morte de atleta de 38 anos após exames que atendeu outros 13 pacientes acende alerta para possível bactéria em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a 38-year-old athlete after exams during which he treated 13 other patients raises alarm over a possible bacterium in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Daiane dos Santos, a 38-year-old futsal athlete, died of cardiorespiratory arrest on Monday Oct 26 at Hospital Doutor Waldomiro Colautti in Ibirama, Santa Catarina, after undergoing a colonoscopy at WS Centro Clínico & Diagnósticos. The same clinic treated 13 patients who had colonoscopy and upper endoscopy in the prior days; most did not require hospitalization, but by Oct 27 two remained admitted—one in a medical ward and one in the ICU. The cause of Daiane's death is under investigation; samples from patients were sent to Lacen for analysis. The WS clinic faces a precautionary ban on colonoscopy and endoscopy procedures, with regional health authorities assisting. The clinic's statement expressed sorrow and indicated ongoing investigations; clinicians cited potential bacterial, viral, or external factors and emphasized monitoring symptoms and seeking care if fever, abdominal pain, or mouth lesions appear.

triage.headline_ja: 38歳アスリート、内視鏡検査後に死亡 他13人の患者も診察、サンタカタリーナ州で細菌感染の可能性に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 単一クリニックでの検査後の原因不明の死亡と複数患者への感染疑いがあるが、現時点で原因病原体や感染拡大の確証はなく、地域限定的な院内感染の可能性として続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: 原因病原体（細菌・ウイルス・外因性要因の可能性）は調査中であり、Lacen（州検査機関）の結果待ち。クリニックは予防的に内視鏡・大腸内視鏡検査を停止中。現時点では単一施設内の事案で地域保健当局が対応しており、国際的な懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Malda Medical College & Hospital | উৎসবের আনন্দ ফিকে করে মালদায় জাঁকিয়ে বসছে জ্বর-সর্দি, উপচে পড়া ভিড় মেডিকেলে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malda Medical College & Hospital | The joy of the festival dims in Malda as fever and cold take hold, with an overflowing crowd at the medical college.
article.articleSummary: Festival season in Malda has brought a sharp rise in fever, cold, and cough at Malda Medical College & Hospital. About 40% of outdoor patients have fever with cold, with nearly half of fever cases in children. Large day–night temperature fluctuations and festival crowds fuel viral spread. The outpatient department now sees over 2,000 patients daily, with around 600 presenting fever and cold, and 300–350 of them children. This year, fever admissions at the hospital total 3,134, of which 886 also had cough. A week earlier, daily outpatients were about 1,500; on Oct 23, 2026, the tally reached 2,526. Pediatrician Gopal Panda notes many children with fever, cough and breathing symptoms, most linked to parainfluenza, adenovirus, and RSV. Parents are urged to avoid unsupervised cough syrups, maintain social distancing, stay hydrated, and offer sour fruits.

triage.headline_ja: マルダ医科大学病院 | 祭りの喜びも薄れるマルダ、発熱・風邪が蔓延し病院に患者殺到
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（RSV、パラインフルエンザ、アデノウイルス等）の増加であり、原因病原体が特定されておらず重篤性や異常性も明確でないため、フルRRAには進まず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の発熱・呼吸器症状の増加で、複数のウイルス（パラインフルエンザ、アデノウイルス、RSV）が混在している可能性があり、単一病原体による重大イベントとは判断しにくい。地域の医療機関の混雑状況は継続して注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC begins trial testing Ebola jab against Bundibugyo: WHO
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, World Health Organization says the four volunteers have received doses in a clinical trial (TUMAINI) testing whether the Ervebo Ebola vaccine can reduce severe illness and death from Bundibugyo virus using a ring-vaccination approach for exposed contacts. Begun on Friday, the study investigates whether Ervebo can lessen disease severity rather than prevent infection. Two vaccination rings are established and more are planned; eligible participants may be vaccinated 1–21 days after exposure, though timing effects remain unknown and results will take months. The trial is led by Congolese researchers and managed by the National Institute for Biomedical Research with WHO and partners, designed as a platform trial to evaluate multiple vaccine candidates. Advisory groups reviewed Bundibugyo-specific vaccines ChAdOx1 (Oxford/ Serum Institute of India) and Moderna's mRNA-1469, with recommendations expected this week. Community members were already approaching the trial site seeking enrollment, underscoring urgent need.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ブンディブギョ型エボラに対するワクチン治験開始：WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの曝露者を対象としたリング接種による臨床試験が開始されており、既存のエボラ流行への対応であることから公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン治験（TUMAINI試験）の開始を報じており、DRCで同ウイルスによる流行が継続中であることを示唆している。曝露後1〜21日でのリング接種が行われており、感染拡大防止と重症化予防の両面で国際的な注目が高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: ¡Alerta por el ébola! Brote supera los 10 mil casos y deja miles de muertos; ya cruzó fronteras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert! The outbreak has surpassed 10,000 cases and left thousands dead; it has already crossed borders.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases and about 4,887 deaths as of October 27, 2026. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history, with officials investigating new transmissions. The epidemic has crossed borders, with imported cases detected in Kenya and Nigeria; Uganda participated in travel routes, though it was declared Ebola-free in August. France previously registered a related case, and five countries have been affected at different times. Ebola spreads mainly through direct contact with blood or other body fluids of infected people (living or dead) or contaminated objects; animal transmission and exposure to infected materials are possible. Transmission occurs via skin breaks or mucous membranes, not through simple proximity or airborne spread. Public health authorities continue monitoring and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報！感染拡大が1万人を超え数千人が死亡、国境を越えて拡散
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪のエボラ流行が1万件超・死者約4887人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準(深刻性・異常性・国際拡大)に複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）伊波拉確診破萬近半死亡 該國歷來最致命 (22:23) - 20261027 - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: confirmed cases surpass 10,000 with nearly half dying, the deadliest outbreak in the country's history (22:23) - 2026-10-27 - International.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases with nearly half of deaths occurring in the community rather than treatment centers. The latest 46 fatalities include 40 in the community; authorities urge intensified early case identification, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and protection for frontline workers. In Bafwasende, Tshopo Province (north-central DR Congo), residents have accused health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading poison. Last weekend, a mob attacked responders, killing a nurse and seriously injuring a principal. The outbreak began on 15 May, with cases also reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo virus; vaccine trials began last week per AFP, Bloomberg, and Xinhua.

triage.headline_ja: 剛果（金）エボラ出血熱：確定例が1万人を突破し約半数が死亡、同国史上最も致死的な流行

article.articleHeadline: კონგოში ებოლას 10 000 შემთხვევა დაფიქსირდა
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 10,000 Ebola cases were recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 10,000 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 4,887 deaths, making it the largest outbreak in the country’s history. The circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no available vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak began in May 2026. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, and the disease often presents with non-specific symptoms that resemble malaria, hindering rapid detection. The overall case fatality is about 50%. The response is complicated by ongoing armed conflict, weak infrastructure, attacks on local populations, and widespread misinformation. In comparison, the 2014–2016 West African Ebola epidemic caused about 11,000 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The article notes confirmed cases but provides limited detail on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が1万件記録される
