article.articleHeadline: تفشّي إيبولا في الكونغو يتجاوز 10 آلاف إصابة وسط مخاوف من اتساع انتشاره في أفريقيا | وكالة النبأ الخبرية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 10,000 cases amid fears of its spread expanding across Africa | Al-Naba News Agency
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 10,060, with about half resulting in deaths, in a fast-spreading outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for this strain. Since it was announced in May, the outbreak has extended to 66 health zones across eight provinces, with cases now reported in Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria; Uganda and France reportedly have no active cases at present. Recoveries exceed 2,600. Data indicate the current outbreak is the deadliest in Congo’s history and, over the same stage, shows roughly threefold higher cases and deaths than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Response faces security, logistical, and trust deficits: health workers have been attacked, salaries delayed, and 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists. Maternal deaths have risen, routine vaccines disrupted, and cross-border coordination is being intensified, including a planned virtual African health ministers summit.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が1万人超の感染者に、アフリカ全土への拡大懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が1万例超・致死率約50%に達し、複数国への越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リスト外（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは現時点で活動的症例なしと報告）。DRCが主たる発生国であるためDRCのみverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola no Congo ultrapassam 10 mil em meio a temores de disseminação mais ampla na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo exceed 10,000 amid fears of a wider spread in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, reaching 10,060 with 4,887 deaths, per a government update. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, began in mid-May and is the largest and deadliest on record in the DRC, and the continent’s second-largest Ebola outbreak after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (more than 28,600 cases and 11,000 deaths). This month Kenya reported its first case, rising to nine total after a traveler who originated in Congo died in Nairobi; Nigeria reported its fourth case last week. A Swiss diplomat’s wife contracted Ebola, with authorities attributing the likely infection to Uganda. Uganda had 20 imported cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August; returning Ugandan citizens with Congo travel history face a 21-day quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万人を超え、アフリカでのさらなる拡大懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は史上最大規模（1万人超、死亡者約4,900人）で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的な感染拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事内ではケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスでの関連症例にも言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCが流行の中心地であり主題である。

article.articleHeadline: Nurse treating Ebola outbreak patients killed by machete-wielding mob
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) remains deadly. A nurse aiding treatment in Bafwasende was killed by a machete-wielding mob, alongside a second medical worker targeted by a group alleging health workers contaminate water sources to spread Ebola. Since May 2026 the outbreak has caused nearly 5,000 deaths and about 10,000 infections. In late September, a politician was beaten after speaking about Ebola on a radio show in Butembo; Marie-Celestin Karondwa, acting president of the UDPS, was attacked amid tensions over disease messaging. Violence against Ebola response teams and facilities is not uncommon, fueled by misinformation and claims that Ebola isn’t real. The report underscores ongoing dangers to frontline responders as outbreak control efforts continue in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱患者を治療していた看護師が、刃物を持った暴徒に殺害される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行（約1万人感染・5千人死亡）に加え、医療従事者や政治家への暴力が対応活動を妨げており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月以降、DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が大規模流行（感染約1万人、死亡約5000人）。誤情報に起因する医療従事者・政治家への暴力が対応を阻害している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi records over 390 Dengue cases in October, yearly tally nears one thousand
article.articleSummary: Delhi logged 92 dengue and 19 malaria cases in the week ending Oct 24, lifting 2026 totals to 993 dengue and 337 malaria. October so far lists 396 dengue and 94 malaria; no dengue or malaria deaths this year. Of the dengue cases, 86 were in MCD areas; six in NDMC, Delhi Cantonment and Railways. Najafgarh led with 17 cases; Central and South zones 13 each; West 8; Shahdara North 9; Civil Lines 2. For malaria, South zone had 7 cases; Central 4; Shahdara South 1; West 2. Cumulative dengue: MCD 881, NDMC 13, Delhi Cantonment 81, Railways 18. Malaria: MCD 329, Railways 6, Delhi Cantonment 2, NDMC 0. Chikungunya rose to 4 cases in the week, 38 year-to-date; no chikungunya deaths. Mosquito-control: over 346,000 houses sprayed and 1.1 million domestic-breeding checks; 7,811 breeding detections, 3,707 notices, 2,207 prosecutions, 1,101 penalties (Rs 138,400). Jan 1–Oct 17: over 3.5 million houses sprayed; 3.54 crore visits; breeding in over 2.1 lakh houses; 28,600 prosecutions; 18,300 penalties; fines over Rs 36 lakh.

triage.headline_ja: デリー、10月にデング熱症例が390件を超え、年間累計は1000件に迫る
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのデング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの季節性流行報告であり、死亡例なく当局による媒介蚊対策も継続実施中であるため、通常の季節的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デリー市当局（MCD、NDMC等）による定例の蚊媒介感染症サーベイランス報告。死亡例なく、重症度・異常性は確認されない。毎年の季節的流行パターンの一部とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 10.000 κρούσματα στο Κονγκό | AlphaTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Over 10,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | AlphaTV.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with around 4,900 deaths (latest figures: 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths). The surge, attributed to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and announced in mid‑May, has outpaced the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak. Globally, the outbreak remains smaller than the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016, which infected over 28,600. Cross‑border spread is evident: Kenya reports nine cases after a death in Nairobi linked to travel from Congo via Uganda; Nigeria confirms a fourth African case. A Swiss‑based wife of a Swiss diplomat, who did not travel to Congo, is believed to have contracted the virus in Uganda; she and her husband were airlifted to Switzerland. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June; WHO had declared Uganda Ebola‑free in August, but returning travelers are subject to a 21‑day quarantine and intensified contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で症例数が10,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例が10,000件を超え死者約4,900人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境・越州的な感染拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya sobe 218,46% e chega a 207 casos em Sidrolândia, mostra a Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya rises 218.46% and reaches 207 cases in Sidrolândia, according to the Health Department.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Sidrolândia, Brazil, surges 218.46% year over year, reaching 207 positive cases from 65 (Jan 1–Oct 13, 2026), while dengue positives decline to 69 from 84; overall notifications rise 790 to 1,144 (44.8%). Chikungunya positivity climbs to 18.10% (8.23% prior), dengue positivity falls to 6.03% (10.63% prior). No dengue deaths in 2026 up to Oct 13; one dengue death occurred in 2025. No chikungunya-related deaths were reported through Oct 13, 2026. The trend underscores intensified epidemiological surveillance and vector-control measures, including elimination of breeding sites and prompt investigation of suspected cases to curb transmission and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が218.46%増加、シドロランジアで207症例に達する（保健局発表）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市における季節性の媒介蚊感染症の症例増加であり、死亡例もなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため。
triage.notes: 地元自治体レベルの流行報告であり、既存の監視・媒介制御体制内で対応されている。死亡例なし。

article.articleHeadline: 热点问答｜刚果（金）埃博拉病例过万，疫情有何焦点
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hot Q&A | Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed ten thousand; what are the outbreak's focal points?
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 25, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths. The epidemic, declared in May, has spread to 8 of 26 provinces, with Ituri province in the northeast as the epicenter, accounting for over 70% of cases. Ongoing security issues, population displacement, and blocked aid routes hinder containment, while insufficient case finding, weak contact tracing, and limited timely treatment sustain transmission; only about 12% of cases are detected among known contacts. Cross-border concerns are rising: Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths; 98 contacts remain under observation; no community transmission yet. Nigeria confirmed its first case; genome links to Kenya; investigations suggest Ugandan origin via Entebbe airport. No licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; a Hope vaccine trial began in Bunia, with Ervebo and other candidates soon entering trials; success would be a landmark.

triage.headline_ja: ホットQ&A｜コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例が1万人超、流行の焦点は何か
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例が1万人・死者4887人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が確認されるなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率が高く（約48.6%）、治安不安や人口移動が封じ込めを阻害している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Зика после Бали: как тропический отпуск обернулся больничной койкой в Москве
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zika Fever After Bali: How a Tropical Vacation Ended Up in a Hospital Bed in Moscow.
article.articleSummary: Zika fever diagnosed in a tourist returning from Bali, hospitalized in Moscow, Russia. Symptoms appeared two days after arrival: rash on the neck, chest, abdomen and arms, plus fever. Rospotrebnadzor confirmed Zika infection after tests. The patient received five days of hospitalization with paracetamol and IV fluids; severe itching on day four subsided afterward. After discharge, epidemiologists contacted her to clarify travel routes to Bashkortostan for disinfecting transport. Zika virus spreads via Aedes mosquitoes and is circulating in South and Southeast Asia and the Americas. Russia has not detected local transmission; risk of domestic spread is considered excluded, with importations monitored via the Perimeter system and domestic diagnostics. No specific antiviral treatment exists; prevention centers on avoiding mosquito bites (repellents, covered clothing). Upon return, watch for fever, rash, myalgia/arthralgia, headache, or conjunctivitis and inform clinicians of countries visited to guide testing for exotic infections.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島帰国後のジカ熱：トロピカルな休暇がモスクワでの入院に至った経緯
triage.triage_reason: バリ島渡航後にモスクワで診断された単発の輸入症例であり、ロシア国内での二次感染は否定されている。アウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はロシア人観光客の単発輸入症例。感染地はインドネシア・バリ島とされるが、現地でのアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de paciente e internações após exames provocam interdição de clínica em SC; casos são investigados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a patient and hospitalizations after tests lead to a clinic's closure in Santa Catarina; cases are under investigation.
article.articleSummary: In Santa Catarina, Brazil, a 38-year-old woman, Daiane Deucher dos Santos, died after an endoscopy at WS Diagnósticos in Ibirama (Alto Vale do Itajaí), triggering a health investigation. Two other patients who had procedures at the private clinic remain hospitalized: one in intensive care and another in the ward. Early reports indicate a bacterial infection linked to the endoscopy, but the specific bacterium has not been identified. At least 10 additional patients who underwent exams at the clinic reported illness but recovered. The clinic’s endoscopy and colonoscopy unit was interdicted, and all services were halted. Investigations are being conducted by the Santa Catarina State Health Secretariat, the Ibirama Sanitary Surveillance, and samples have been sent to Lacen for analysis. The cause, infection source, and whether any materials were seized remain unconfirmed; the clinic has contacted patients and urged anyone with symptoms to seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の診療所で検査後に死亡・入院が発生し、診療所閉鎖；症例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: 内視鏡検査後に原因不明の細菌感染による死亡者とICU入院者が発生し、異常性と重大性（IHR基準2項目該当）が認められるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 単一の民間診療所（内視鏡・大腸内視鏡ユニット）に関連した医療関連感染の可能性が高く、原因病原体は未特定。地域限定的な事案であり、現時点で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、原因菌の特定と感染経路の確認が続報として注視すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola no Congo passam de 10 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (RDC) has surpassed 10,000 cases, with 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%), and 2,684 recoveries, according to INSP data through Oct 25. The Bundibugyo strain, with no specific treatment, drives the outbreak across eight eastern provinces, led by Ituri and North Kivu; 66 health zones are affected. In the last 24 hours, Ituri recorded 32 and North Kivu 58 new cases. The epidemic has reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with Uganda reporting 20 cases (15 imported from RDC) and 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases (2 deaths); Nigeria 1 case. Vaccination efforts include a late-August Ervebo campaign in DRC and WHO-supported phase 1 vaccine trials across candidates; two vaccines in development have shown safety in early testing. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が1万人を超え致死率48.6%と深刻であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されているためIHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCは対象国としてIturi州が主要発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Four Participants Vaccinated in DRC Trial Testing Ervebo Against Bundibugyo | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Four participants have received Ervebo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's TUMAINI Phase 2/3 trial for Bundibugyo virus disease, opened Oct 23 in Bunia, Ituri province, with WHO support and national leadership from the Congolese Ministry of Health. The study tests whether Ervebo reduces severe illness or death from Bundibugyo virus, not whether it prevents infection, per WHO official Meg Doherty. WHO notes Ervebo is licensed for Ebola virus disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus, and there is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo; evidence is insufficient to determine protection against Bundibugyo. CEPI states the trial aims to build evidence to protect affected communities and future outbreaks, with Bundibugyo-specific candidates from Moderna and the University of Oxford (developed with Serum Institute of India) expected to join, though no start date is announced. Results are anticipated in several months.

triage.headline_ja: DRCの臨床試験でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス病に対するエルベボワクチンを4名に接種
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョウイルス病に対するワクチン臨床試験が開始されたことを報じる内容で、アウトブレイクの規模・感染者数など公衆衛生上の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験(TUMAINI Phase 2/3)の開始を報じるものであり、実際のブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクの規模・症例数・死亡者数などの詳細は記載されていない。WHOとCEPIが関与し国家主導で実施されていることから一定の公的関心はあるが、感染状況の実態把握のため続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC: Ebola may delay 2027 elections if crisis escalates -- National Accord Newspaper %
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been tracked for months and has been imported into Nigeria, according to Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Dr. Jide Idris. As of 2026-10-27, there is no reason to postpone the 2027 general election, since the situation remains under control; any decision would depend on whether the outbreak expands into a major public health emergency. Nigeria's preparedness reflects heightened international travel, cross-border movement and port-entry activity that could bring the virus into the country. The NCDC is focusing on surveillance, contact tracing and other measures to prevent further spread, while rejecting concerns that disease control could be used for partisan gain. Officials will continuously review the situation and act based on public health realities if the outbreak worsens.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC:危機が拡大すれば、エボラが2027年選挙を遅らせる可能性 -- National Accord Newspaper
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱がナイジェリアへ越境輸入されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。選挙延期の可能性に言及されており政治的関心も高い。続報でナイジェリア国内の感染拡大状況・国際支援要請の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. الصحة العالمية تبدأ تجارب سريرية للقاحات إيبولا بونديبوجيو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo... WHO begins clinical trials of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines.
article.articleSummary: WHO begins phase I clinical trials of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, after vaccinating four people in Bunia in the first stage of the study. The trial, named Tomaini, targets vaccination of contacts of confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases using the Ervebo vaccine, which has demonstrated efficacy against this Ebola virus type. WHO science leader Meg Doherty notes that researchers are evaluating two additional vaccines developed by the University of Oxford and Moderna, with results expected after several months. Authorities aim to expand the trial to broaden protection for populations against the current and future outbreaks. The effort underscores the ongoing international response to Ebola diversity, focusing on exposure-based vaccination to curb transmission in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ…WHOがブンディブジョ型エボラワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブジョ型エボラアウトブレイクに対しWHOが接触者を対象としたワクチン臨床試験を開始しており、致死率の高い感染症の進行中のアウトブレイク対応であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブジョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン臨床試験（Tomaini試験）開始を報じており、DRCでの既存のエボラアウトブレイクに対する接触者ワクチン接種が主題。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・流行範囲の記載はなく、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Antallet af ebolatilfælde i DR Congo passerer 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DR Congo surpasses 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 4,887 deaths reported in the current outbreak. As of 2026-10-27, DR Congo's health authorities, cited by Reuters, tally 10,060 cases and 4,887 fatalities, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history and the second-largest and deadliest globally after West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic (more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths). The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Additional cases have been registered outside DR Congo, including in Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria, underscoring cross-border transmission during this ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が10,000症例・致死率約49%に達し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo variantに対するワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Allerta sanitaria in Uruguay: bloccate le importazioni avicole dal Brasile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sanitary Alert in Uruguay: Poultry Imports from Brazil Blocked.
article.articleSummary: Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) suspended entry and transit of live poultry and avian products from Brazil after an emergency outbreak was reported in Santa Catarina. The temporary blockade aims to prevent virus introduction and safeguard Uruguay's sanitary status, with strengthened border controls along northern crossings to curb informal or unauthorized movement. Exceptions cover only subproducts and industrial preparations subjected to high-temperature treatment and certified by official veterinary authorities under the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) guidelines. Authorities urged the Cupra and all poultry producers to heighten biosafety: isolate facilities, repair anti-pigeon nets, restrict access, enforce worker hygiene and dedicated work attire, and sanitize vehicles carrying feed and poultry. A 24/7 epidemiological surveillance system remains active; producers should promptly report abnormal mortality or symptoms. The goal is to protect the domestic industry and reassure consumers nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイで衛生警戒：ブラジルからの家禽類輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で家禽の緊急アウトブレイクが発生し、ウルグアイが予防的に輸入停止措置を講じるなど、国際的な貿易制限とサーベイランス強化が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 疾患名は『Unknown Illness』とされており、具体的な病原体（鳥インフルエンザ等）は記事上では明示されていない。ヒトへの健康影響については言及なし。発生地域としてUruguayも記載されているが、記事の主題はブラジル国内のアウトブレイクでありウルグアイは対応措置の実施国に過ぎないため、対象国リストに含まれないUruguayはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le cap des 10.000 cas dépassé en République démocratique du Congo - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the 10,000-case milestone surpassed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 cases in the ongoing outbreak, officially declared on May 15 and now about six months in. The latest INSP figures report 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, with roughly 2,684 recoveries and a case fatality rate near 50%. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes severe hemorrhagic fever. In Africa, the disease has caused more than 15,000 deaths over the past five decades. The worst DRC outbreak on record (2018–2020) killed about 2,300 people among 3,500 cases. The report underscores the scale of the current outbreak in the DRC, highlighting sustained transmission and high mortality as authorities monitor the situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で症例数が1万人を突破 - RTBFニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱が1万例・致死率約50%に達し、過去最悪の流行を大幅に上回る規模で、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 過去最悪(2018-2020年)の流行(3,500例・2,300死亡)を大幅に超える規模で、6ヶ月間で1万例超・致死率約50%と極めて深刻。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Unnao News: दो डेंगू पॉजिटिव मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unnao News: Two dengue-positive cases detected.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-positive cases detected in Unnao district, Uttar Pradesh, on Tuesday, per Chief Medical Officer. A 15-year-old girl from Safipur developed fever and tested positive for dengue at the district hospital; a 45-year-old man from Pariyar also tested positive and is being treated at Kanpur Medical College. Both infections were confirmed by laboratory testing conducted at the district hospital, with treatment for the man continuing at the Kanpur facility. The report, dated 2026-10-27, indicates ongoing dengue activity in Unnao and underscores continued clinical monitoring of cases in the district.

triage.headline_ja: Unnao News: デング熱陽性患者2名が検出
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の一地区における散発的なデング熱症例2件の報告であり、季節的流行の範囲内と考えられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの当該地域で季節性・地方流行性の疾患であり、本記事は2症例の散発報告に留まる。地域の保健当局による通常の症例監視の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie: Bereits mehr als 10.000 Fälle seit Mai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: More than 10,000 cases since May.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, the Ebola outbreak raging since May in Africa has surpassed 10,000 cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, according to health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is the worst Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history, with additional infections in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Transmission occurs through direct contact with body fluids of infected individuals. Symptoms include fever, muscle pains, and diarrhea, potentially progressing to internal bleeding and organ failure. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:5月以降の症例数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で致死率約49%、複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも感染例があるとされているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行で、致死率は約48.6%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情病例破萬　蔓延速度史上最快
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases, with the fastest rate of spread in history.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) with about half dying, making it the fastest-spreading and deadliest in the country's history. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. It has spread to three African regions, with Kenya and Nigeria reporting cases; Uganda and France have also identified infections but currently have no active cases. In Congo, at least 2,600 patients have recovered. Health workers face shortages of transport and supplies, delayed bonuses fueling strikes, and violence against staff in Ituri's Mongbwalu and Bafwasende in Tshopo. About 80% of cases arise from transmissions beyond known contacts; authorities say 95% should originate from known contacts before the outbreak is under control. An online meeting of Africa's health ministers is scheduled for Oct 28 to bolster response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数が1万件を突破　史上最速の拡大ペース
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がIHR複数基準に該当する深刻な流行であり、1万例突破・致死率約50%・複数国への拡大・ワクチン未承認など公衆衛生上の重大リスクを伴うため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告、ウガンダ・フランスでの感染確認が記載されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれる。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。アフリカ保健大臣会合が10/28に予定されており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê de quatro meses morre por meningite C em Pouso Alegre, no Sul de Minas - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four-month-old baby dies of serogroup C meningococcal meningitis in Pouso Alegre, southern Minas Gerais - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Four-month-old baby dies of meningococcal meningitis caused by serogroup C in Pouso Alegre, southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, the third meningitis-related fatality in the city this year. The death occurred on October 21. Earlier fatalities included a 30-year-old man (notified July 4) and a 67-year-old woman (notified October 6). All three cases were laboratory-confirmed by Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte; serogroup C was identified in two cases, while the serogroup for the latest case remained pending. The infant had not been up to date with meningitis vaccination and had missed the 3-month dose. Post-exposure chemoprophylaxis was offered to 10 health professionals and 26 family members. SUS vaccination guidance: meningococcal C vaccine at 3 and 5 months, ACWY booster at 12 months, and ACWY for adolescents 11–14; authorities urge vaccination updates.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南ミナスジェライス州ポウゾ・アレグレで生後4か月の乳児がC群髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一都市内での散発的な髄膜炎菌感染症による死亡例（年間3件目）であり、ワクチン未接種が主因とみられる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症例（死亡）が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地元自治体（Funed）による検査確認済み、接触者への予防内服も実施済みで管理下にある。国家規模の流行とは言えず、局地的事例として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo: Zahl der Ebolafälle steigt auf mehr als 10.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The number of Ebola cases rises to more than 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, with Africa CDC calling it the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus spreads via direct contact with body fluids, causing fever, diarrhea and bleeding; about 70% of new infections have no known contacts. Eight northern and eastern provinces are affected, led by Ituri. Uganda reports 20 cases with 2 deaths linked to Congo patients; WHO notes the outbreak there ended in August, though linked cases persist. Kenya has nine infections and two deaths after a Congo patient traveled via Uganda to Nairobi; Nigeria reports its first case on 20 October, the wife of a Swiss diplomat infected after a trip to Uganda and repatriated to Switzerland. Europe has imported cases. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or therapy exists; Ervebo targets only Zaire ebolavirus. Antiviral and vaccine trials began in July; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines could enter testing soon.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：エボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが1万例・死者4,887人に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへ感染拡大している重大な国際公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、スイスへの感染拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスには特異的ワクチン・治療法が存在せず、致死率が高く（約48.6%）、約70%の新規感染者で感染経路不明という点で流行制御の困難さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 10.000 cas recensés en Afrique, la RDC toujours à l'épicentre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 10,000 cases recorded in Africa, the DRC remains at the epicenter.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across Africa exceeds 10,000 cases, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) at epicenter. As of now, 10,060 people have been infected in the DRC and 4,887 have died; about 2,684 have recovered, for a case-fatality near 50%. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to eight provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu. The virus, transmitted by contact with bodily fluids and causing severe hemorrhagic fever, has crossed borders to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths) in October. Nigeria reports a single imported case: a 42-year-old Swiss woman in Abuja who traveled to Uganda; 53 contacts are being traced. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for this strain. Ervebo doses (Zaïre strain) have been given in the DRC in a trial. Health workers face security and mistrust, including a fatal attack in Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:アフリカで1万人以上の感染確認、コンゴ民主共和国が依然震源地
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで1万人超の感染者を出し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州等8州）を震源地として詳述している。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も記載があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يثير مخاوف كبيرة والاستجابة أصبحت أكثر صعوبة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo raises major concerns and the response has become more difficult - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a major concern as Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the response has grown harder due to funding cuts over the past 18 months. Speaking at the WHO European Regional Committee in Copenhagen (27–29 Oct 2026), he called for sustained international support to contain the outbreak. He also referenced a hantavirus cluster linked to the MV Hondius cruise, noting the UK notified WHO, Switzerland sequenced the virus, Spain coordinated passenger and crew disembarkation in Tenerife, and the Netherlands cared for crew under EU auspices. He flagged ongoing challenges—households facing high health costs, rising non‑communicable diseases, mental-health strain, and re-emergence of measles—amid climate stress and conflicts including Ukraine. Four policy demands: increase WHO funding next year; preserve reform, efficiency, neutrality; actively reform the global health architecture; complete negotiations on the Pandemic Instrument annex.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行は大きな懸念を引き起こしており、対応がより困難になっている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行について、WHO事務局長が資金不足により対応が一層困難になっていると警鐘を鳴らし、国際的支援の必要性を訴えている。重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事にはMV Hondiusクルーズ船に関連するハンタウイルスクラスターも言及されているが、関与国（英国・スイス・スペイン・オランダ）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。エボラ流行自体は既知の継続案件であり、本記事はWHO事務局長による資金・対応困難性に関する政治的声明が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Zaraženih od ebole više od 10.000, polovina preminula
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: More than 10,000 infected with Ebola; half have died.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases with nearly 50% case fatality. The outbreak, attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared in May and has no licensed vaccine or treatment. It is described as the fastest-spreading and most deadly Ebola epidemic in Congo’s history. Transmission has spread to 66 health zones across 8 provinces, up from 3 zones at declaration. The outbreak has spilled into neighboring countries, with cases registered in five countries including Uganda and France; however, there are currently no active cases in Uganda or France, and Kenya and Nigeria have reported cases. The data underscore urgent need for vaccines and therapeutics, as well as intensified public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ感染者1万人超、半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、10,000人超の症例、8州66保健地域へ拡大し複数国に越境伝播しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスへの症例波及が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない、または現在活動症例なしのため、主題となる発生国としてはDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 'إيبولا' يتجاوز 10 آلاف إصابة في إفريقيا... والكونغو الديموقراطية الأكثر تضرّراً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Ebola' surpasses 10,000 cases in Africa... the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most affected.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola has surpassed 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accounting for the vast majority since the outbreak was first detected in May. Cases have also appeared in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda, though Uganda’s outbreak was declared Ebola-free by late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which no vaccines or treatments are approved. The World Health Organization warns contain­ment is a complex, multi-country effort as transmission extends across East, West, and Central Africa, underscoring the heavy burden on the DRC and the lack of approved medical countermeasures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がアフリカで症例数1万人突破……コンゴ民主共和国が最も深刻な被害
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に複数国にまたがるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で、致死率が高く承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダでの症例が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダの流行は8月末に終息宣言済み。アンゴラ・モザンビークは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Svizzera, Amref: "Il virus viaggia nell'ombra fino a 21 giorni"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Switzerland, Amref: "The virus travels in the shadows for up to 21 days"
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, has reached Switzerland with a confirmed case after a prior case in France, illustrating cross-border transmission from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has recorded over 9,700 cases and more than 4,680 deaths. In Kenya, a traveler from Congo via Uganda sparked a Nairobi cluster of nine confirmed cases, with two deaths and 135 contacts under quarantine; four healthcare workers were infected. No vaccines or approved treatments exist for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire Ebola. WHO and Africa CDC have warned for maximum epidemiological alert, given no vaccine coverage, high cross-border movement, and diagnostic delays. Amref Health Africa is supporting Kenya's Ministry of Health and KNPHI, strengthening surveillance and prevention, training about 1,500 health workers, deploying 134 specialized staff to 10 entry points, and supplying PPE, with risk assessment and safe burials teams. Global health security requires transparency and One Health collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: スイスでエボラ出血熱、Amref「ウイルスは最大21日間潜伏して広がる」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ・ケニア経由で欧州（フランス・スイス）にまで越境伝播しており、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないことからWHO/Africa CDCが最大限の疫学的警戒を発令している重大な国際公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア・ウガンダ・スイス・フランスも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源・主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、同国のみをverified_locationsに記載した。なお本件はDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9,700例超、死者4,680人超）が中心であり、ケニアでのクラスター発生や欧州への越境伝播も特筆すべき展開。

article.articleHeadline: Paulínia confirma 1º caso de febre maculosa neste ano | Portal Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paulínia confirms first case of Rocky Mountain spotted fever this year | Portal Band
article.articleSummary: Paulínia, São Paulo, confirms the first Rocky Mountain spotted fever case of 2026. The patient, a 68-year-old man, has recovered. Infection likely occurred at a creek area along Rodovia Zeferino Vaz (SP-332) in Jardim Boa Esperança. Confirmation came from a counter-test by Instituto Adolfo Lutz. Epidemiological investigation is complete; acarological surveys will be conducted to detect the tick vector. Residents are advised that fever or other symptoms after visiting green areas or tick bites should seek a health unit and report exposure. Rocky Mountain spotted fever is transmitted by infected ticks; those frequenting forests, riverbanks, fishing spots, pastures, or capybara habitats should monitor for up to 14 days. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, and prostration; rash may appear late or not at all. In Amparo, four suspected deaths prompted a Public Health Emergency to intensify vector control.

triage.headline_ja: パウリニア、今年初の紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 単発の回復済み症例であり、地域限定のダニ媒介感染症で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: Amparoでの疑い死亡4例による公衆衛生緊急事態の発令が言及されているが、本記事の主題はPaulíniaの単発回復例であり、詳細情報不足のため続報注視が望ましいが現時点ではDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Ebola Outbreak Passes 10,000 Cases, Mostly In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections (10,060) and 4,887 deaths since it was detected in May, the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo. Most cases are in DR Congo, with detections in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. WHO warns containment across east, west and central Africa remains complex. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo species. Uganda was declared Ebola-free in late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Kenya has reported two deaths; Nigeria has one confirmed case—a Swiss woman who contracted the virus after a trip to Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland on Monday. Nigeria has identified 53 contacts to prevent further spread. The patient in Nigeria developed symptoms Oct 7, sought care in Abuja Oct 11, and tested positive Oct 20.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が1万人を突破 ― 大半はコンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（1万人超・死者4887人）のエボラ流行が続き、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ナイジェリアも対象国リストに含まれないため除外）。主な発生地はDRCのため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Nurse treating Ebola patients killed by machete-wielding gang in DRC | WTX News
article.articleSummary: Nurse treating Ebola patients in Bafwasende, Democratic Republic of the Congo, was killed by a machete-wielding gang amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak that has infected almost 10,000 people and caused almost 5,000 deaths since May. The assailants targeted the nurse and another medical worker, claiming health workers were spreading the disease by contaminating water sources. The nurse had been helping to raise awareness about the Bundibugyo strain. Health authorities are mobilising resources and security measures and countering misinformation, while the UDPS party condemned the murder and urged protection for responders. Violence against Ebola response teams is not uncommon in DRC. A similar September incident saw a politician beaten to death after discussing the outbreak on radio. No suspects have been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ患者を治療していた看護師が、ナタを持った集団に殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（感染者約1万人、死者約5000人）に関する報道であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と医療従事者への暴力による対応能力低下のリスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者への暴力事件を主眼としているが、背景にある大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの深刻さと対応阻害リスクが重要な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 10 mil casos de arboviroses são registrados no estado de Alagoas em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 cases of arboviral diseases are recorded in the state of Alagoas in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Alagoas, Brazil, recorded more than 10,000 probable arboviral infections from January 1 to October 14, 2026, with eight deaths. Dengue accounted for 7,366 probable cases (68.86% of arboviral infections) and three deaths; Chikungunya had 3,275 probable cases (30.61%) and five deaths; Zika reported 55 probable cases (0.51%), with no deaths. Through October 14, there were no suspected cases of Oropouche fever, Yellow Fever, West Nile fever, or Mayaro fever. Public health authorities emphasize ongoing vector control and prevention measures: eliminate standing water (e.g., in bottles, buckets), keep water tanks and pools sealed and clean, avoid aquatic plants and water-accumulating plant dishes, maintain gutters and drains, and properly dispose of tires, debris, and other waste.  Overall, dengue remains the leading arboviral disease in Alagoas during this period.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、ブラジル・アラゴアス州で1万件を超えるアルボウイルス感染症が記録される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アラゴアス州における例年のデング熱・チクングニア熱等の季節性サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで毎年流行するエンデミック疾患であり、本記事は地方自治体の定例的な年次統計報告（1月1日〜10月14日累計）。致死率も低く(8/10,000超)、特段の異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto atual de ebola no Congo já é o mais letal do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the deadliest in the country.
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the deadliest in the country, with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, caused by the Bundibugyo strain and announced in mid-May. It ranks as the second-largest and second-deadliest global outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). International spread includes Kenya reporting its first case this month, bringing total to nine, and a man who traveled from Congo via Uganda dying in Nairobi. Nigeria has recorded a fourth case; authorities are investigating a woman, wife of a Swiss diplomat, who did not travel to Congo. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June, mostly imported from Congo; WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. Ugandan authorities require a 21-day quarantine for returnees with Congo travel history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の現在のエボラ出血熱流行、同国史上最も致死率の高いものに
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模・最多死者数のエボラ流行が継続中であり、ケニアやナイジェリアへの国際的な感染拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行が主題。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ebola na RD Congo superam 10 mil em meio a novos testes de vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 10,000 amid new vaccine trials.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 10,060 (confirmed) with 4,887 deaths and over 2,700 recoveries. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is the largest and most deadly in DR Congo’s history and the second-largest worldwide, now reaching an eighth province. Bunia hosts an INRB-managed Tumaini vaccine trial evaluating Ervebo for cross-protection against Bundibugyo; four individuals have been vaccinated. Cross-border risk rises as Kenya reports its first case, later nine infections after a Congo traveler died in Nairobi having passed through Uganda; Nigeria confirms presence as the fourth regional country. The World Food Programme delivers aid and logistics, seeking $214 million over six months to sustain health facilities amid a hunger crisis affecting about 3.5 million people (97% in need of urgent food aid).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が1万人超、新たなワクチン治験実施中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行がケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準にも該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは越境症例として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため、またはDRCからの輸入症例であり主要発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが発生の中心地として該当。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận hơn 10.000 ca nhiễm Ebola, gần một nửa bệnh nhân tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC reports more than 10,000 Ebola cases, nearly half of the patients have died.
article.articleSummary: 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 27 October 2026, with nearly half of patients dying, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has expanded from an initial three health zones to 66 health zones across eight provinces, and spread to three regions of Africa. Confirmed cases have been reported in Uganda and France, with Kenya and Nigeria also reporting cases. There is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The response faces security challenges, distrust, and misinformation that hinder reporting and care. A recent attack in Tshopo province killed a nurse and seriously injured another health worker, underscoring risks to frontline staff amid the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ感染者1万人超を報告、患者の約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで10,060例の確定症例、致死率約50%、同国史上最悪のエボラ流行となり、ウガンダ・フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認、治安上の課題（医療従事者への攻撃）も報告されており、対応に国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases, mostly in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Africa has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths in the DRC since first detected in May; about 2,684 have recovered. Most cases are in Ituri and eastern North Kivu, amid armed conflict and low trust in authorities. Cases have also appeared in Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Uganda (previously Ebola-free after 20 cases, 2 deaths), and Nigeria, which reports a single case: a 42-year-old Swiss woman who traveled from Uganda and was evacuated to Geneva; 53 contacts are being traced. The outbreak’s fatality rate in the DRC is near 50%. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; Ervebo trials are underway to assess cross-protection. WHO warns the response faces a complex, continent-spanning challenge; security incidents include a nurse killed and a health worker wounded in Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者数1万人を突破 — 大半はコンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyoエボラ出血熱が10,060症例・致死率約50%に達し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア（スイス人患者経由）へも拡大。WHOが大陸規模の複合的課題と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスでの症例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。紛争地域（Ituri、北キブ）での治安悪化や医療従事者への攻撃も報告されており、対応の複雑さを増している。

article.articleHeadline: Bereits mehr als 10.000 Ebola-Fälle im Kongo - Chronik | stol.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already more than 10,000 Ebola cases in the Congo - Chronicle.
article.articleSummary: DR Congos Ebola outbreak exceeds 10,000 cases, the fastest-growing and second-largest on record after the 20142015 West Africa crisis. Ebola virus disease from Bundibugyo ebolavirus causes fever, diarrhea and bleeding, spreading via contact with bodily fluids. Eight provinces in the north and east are affected; Ituri accounts for the majority of confirmed cases and borders Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan, and CAR. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths linked to a Congo patient; the Ugandan outbreak was declared over in August, though new linked cases have appeared. Kenya reports 9 infections (2 deaths) since October after a Congo patient traveled to Nairobi; Nigeria reports its first case on October 20 tied to a diplomats wife who had visited Uganda. CFR around 49%; 1,539 beds; two-thirds of deaths occur in communities. Violence against health workers continues, including a caregiver killed in Tshopo. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or therapy yet; antivirals and Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are in trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者がすでに1万人超 - 年表 | stol.it
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が1万人を超え史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な人の移動を伴う感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率約49%、ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに特化したワクチン・治療薬は未確立で、医療従事者への暴力も継続中。

article.articleHeadline: BRIN Diminta Percepat Riset Vaksin Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Urged to Accelerate Malaria Vaccine Research.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-27, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto urged accelerating malaria vaccine development to three years earlier than the target. At the Presidential Palace in Jakarta, he directed BRIN head Arif Satria that government support should speed research toward production, focusing on four malaria vaccine candidates BRIN is pursuing. The acceleration aims to bolster national health self-reliance and enable Indonesia to contribute to global malaria control. A key challenge is Plasmodium vivax, for which there is currently no vaccine. BRIN is also advancing 19 herbal medicine candidates toward standardized herbal medicine (OHT) with potential progression to phytopharmaceuticals (fitofarmaka). The effort highlights domestic research bridging vaccine development and plant-based therapeutics, backed by government support to move from research to production.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN、マラリアワクチン研究の加速を要請される
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチン研究開発の加速を求める政策的な呼びかけであり、具体的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアワクチン研究開発加速に関する政策・研究動向の報道であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases In Bhopal Reach 156, Health Department Intensifies Prevention Drive
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Bhopal reports 156 dengue cases in 2026, with health authorities intensifying prevention. Residents should seek medical advice for high fever, eye pain, joint and muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, or rashes rather than self-medicating. The district has stepped up mosquito-control measures, door-to-door inspections, and public awareness across 18 vulnerable areas, after surveying about 375,000 households and inspecting roughly 2.7 million containers to identify breeding sites. Preventive actions include removing stagnant water and breeding substrates such as water coolers, flowerpots, discarded tyres, and uncovered storage containers; larval destruction and insecticide spraying continue. Fever surveys and larval eradication are complemented by malaria and chikungunya surveillance. Five facilities—AIIMS Bhopal, BMHRC, Gandhi Medical College, JP Hospital, and Civil Hospital (Bairagarh)—offer dengue testing via ELISA to enable early diagnosis and management, supporting a controlled outbreak trajectory.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでデング熱患者156人に増加、保健当局が予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱の通常の発生・対応状況であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体が積極的に予防・サーベイランス体制を強化しており、制御されたアウトブレイクと記事内で評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les cliniques de suivi renforcent la prise en charge des guéris - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: follow-up clinics strengthen the care of survivors - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola survivors in the Democratic Republic of Congo are benefiting from new follow-up clinics that strengthen post-recovery care in Bunia (Ituri Province) and Beni (North Kivu Province). The Bunia survivor clinic has operated since September 19, 2026, and has already seen more than 400 people who recovered from Ebola. A second facility was established in Beni to monitor survivors. Services include medical consultations, psychosocial and nutritional support, and laboratory tests to detect late complications after recovery. Survivors can experience joint pain, persistent fatigue, and psychological issues requiring comprehensive care. Health authorities and partners aim to ensure continuity of care after discharge from treatment centers, monitor health status, reduce stigma, support reintegration, and prevent virus persistence in certain biological fluids through ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:フォローアップクリニックが回復者のケアを強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ既知流行に関する回復者フォローアップ体制の報道であり、新規感染拡大や急性期対応を示す内容ではないが、エボラという疾患の性質上、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の新規発生ではなく、既存の回復者ケア体制の強化に関する内容。ウイルスの体液中残存監視への言及はあるが新規感染拡大の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: África 7 días - El ébola salta a Nigeria: ¿puede frenarse su expansión transfronteriza?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa 7 Days - Ebola jumps to Nigeria: can its cross-border spread be halted?
article.articleSummary: Ebola has jumped to Nigeria, the first confirmed case there in twelve years. The imported patient arrived in Abuja on 3 October from Uganda, after a two-week stay there; the exact exposure location remains unknown. The outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has reached Kenya, with four African countries now reporting Ebola. Nigerian authorities and Africa CDC have urged heightened preparedness, warning that geographic distance offers no protection. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi called for regional vigilance as cross-border transmission becomes a major concern. The episode underscores gaps in surveillance and response, and frames debates on containment, spillover risk, and health inequities across countries in outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ7日間 - エボラがナイジェリアに波及：国境を越えた拡大は阻止できるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、WHO/Africa CDCが地域的警戒を呼びかけるなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な感染拡大はDRC発生源からウガンダ経由でナイジェリアへ、さらにケニアにも及んでいるが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。越境伝播の進展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: 9.600 cas enregistrés à la 42ème semaine - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 9,600 cases recorded as of week 42 - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of week 42 (Oct 2026), 9,600 cumulative Ebola cases and over 4,500 deaths (case fatality ~48%), with more than 2,500 recoveries and contact tracing around 87%, per Kinshasa-based INSP briefing. The outbreak spans eight provinces, with South Kivu showing no new cases for months and three other provinces also reporting no cases in the period. Response efforts will focus in five health zones representing nearly 80% of cases, notably Mandima, Katwa, and Rwampara, to intensify interventions and reverse the epidemic trajectory. An intra-action review (RIA) in Tshopo province will mid-term evaluate the response to the 17th Ebola episode, identify challenges, and adjust intervention strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：第42週時点で9,600症例を記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、累計9,600症例・致死率約48%と深刻な状況にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行で、8州にまたがり9,600症例・4,500人以上の死亡、致死率約48%。Mandima・Katwa・Rwamparaなど5つの保健ゾーンに対応を集中。南キブ州など一部州では新規症例なしだが、依然として広域での対応継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se dispara en el Congo: más de 10.000 contagios y casi 5.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surges in the Congo: more than 10,000 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%). Ituri province remains the epicenter, housing 71.7% of cases and 33.3% of new infections, as 66 of 178 health zones are affected (37.1%). Since the WHO Oct 20 report of 9,704 cases and 4,687 deaths, counts rose by 356 cases and 200 deaths. Symptoms include fever, extreme weakness, vomiting, and diarrhea; rapid diagnosis and access to specialized care are critical. A high proportion of deaths occur outside facilities, highlighting challenges in access, security, displacement, transport, and community trust. Contact tracing covers 79.7% of identified contacts, below the 95% target. Economic and health system strain grows with ongoing transmission; 2,684 recoveries reported to date, while no new zones were affected in the last 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急増：感染者1万人超、死者ほぼ5000人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%の大規模エボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: コンタクトトレーシングが目標の95%に届かず79.7%にとどまるなど、アクセス・治安・人口移動の課題が感染拡大継続の要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 10 000 ebolatartunnan määrä ylittyi Afrikassa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections exceeded 10,000 in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in Africa exceed 10,000, with the majority in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and nearly 5,000 deaths. The latest outbreak began spreading in the Congo in May, and Congolese authorities report that roughly half of those infected have died. Cases have also been identified in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The World Health Organization warns that containment remains highly challenging. The circulating virus is the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. As of 27 October 2026, health authorities continue monitoring and response efforts across affected countries to curb transmission, with global health authorities closely watching the evolving outbreak. The report highlights ongoing risk of further spread within Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ感染者数が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行がコンゴ発で複数国に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOが封じ込めの困難性を警告しており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads to Multiple Countries, the Importance of NV-387 Oral Gummies Treatment Cannot be Understated - Phase II Clinical Trial Advancing Towards the Second Part, Says NanoViricides
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus (Ebola-BDBV) outbreak spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Kenya and Nigeria, with Uganda reporting no new cases recently; a Swiss national evacuated and more than 350 patients enrolled in PARTNERS infusion trials. By October 27, 2026, DRC confirmed 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths, highlighting rapid cross-border transmission and the role of superspreaders (single patients generating 8+ secondary cases). NV-387 Oral Gummies advances in the Phase IIA Ebola treatment trial in DRC, enrolling since September 23, 2026, with about 20 patients and a 28-day survival endpoint; completion of IIA will lead to Phase IIB. NV-387 is described as the only oral drug in Ebola-BDBV trials. Tumaini vaccine trial includes Ervebo (EVD Zaire), ChAdOx1-BDBV, and Moderna BDBV-mRNA candidates with ring vaccination planned; concerns noted about unmatched vaccines and antibody-dependent enhancement, emphasizing need for effective treatments. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Ebola-BDBV at present.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが複数国に拡大、NV-387経口グミ治療薬の重要性が増す─フェーズII臨床試験が第2部へ前進、NanoViricides社発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、1万例超・死亡者約4900人という深刻な被害規模が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。ただし出典が製薬企業のプレスリリース記事であり、公式機関（WHO/Africa CDC等）による数値の裏付け確認が必須。
triage.notes: 本記事は製薬企業NanoViricides社のプレスリリース的性格が強く、報告されている症例数・死亡者数（DRCで10,060例、死亡4,887人）やケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大情報は一次情報源（WHO、Africa CDC等）での確認が取れていない。スイス、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、DRCのみを記載した。情報の信頼性確認を優先しつつ、深刻性が高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 10 آلاف حالة والوفيات تقترب من 4900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 10,000, with deaths approaching 4,900.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 10,060 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak began in May, the deadliest on record for the country. Bundibugyo ebolavirus infections have also been detected in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The World Health Organization warns Africa faces a complex containment task as the outbreak spans East, West, and Central regions. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though authorities in DRC have begun a vaccine trial to bolster response efforts. Uganda had been declared Ebola-free by WHO in late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Kenya reports two fatalities and had no cases before Oct 6; Nigeria confirms a single case—a Swiss national who contracted in Uganda with her husband, linked to 53 contacts. Response centers on surveillance, isolation, contact tracing, health education, and frontline PPE.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1万人を超え、死者数は4900人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）流行が1万例・死者4887人に達し過去最悪規模となり、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへも拡大、ワクチン未承認で国際的な封じ込め支援が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイス（感染者の国籍）は記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kein Ende in Sicht bei Ebola - mehr als 10.000 Fälle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No end in sight for Ebola — more than 10,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak with 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May. It is the fastest-growing and second-largest Ebola outbreak to date; the 2014–2015 West Africa epicenter had over 11,000 deaths. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; Ebola causes life-threatening fever with diarrhea and bleeding. More than 70% of new infections occur in people without known contacts. Cases have also been identified in Uganda (20), France (1), Kenya (9), and Nigeria (1). The case fatality rate is about 49%, with 1,539 beds in dedicated centers. Ongoing conflict and large displaced populations hinder response; attacks on aid workers have been reported, including the killing of an MSF nurse in Tshopo and another injured. For Bundibugyo ebolavirus, no specific vaccine or therapy exists yet; two antivirals are in trials since July, and vaccines against Bundibugyo are being evaluated, with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) tests planned for cross-protection in coming weeks per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、終息の兆し見えず―症例数1万人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万例超・死亡者約4,900人の急拡大するエボラ流行が続き、他国(ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア)にも症例が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確に該当する。
triage.notes: フランス、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでの症例は輸入例または周辺国への散発的拡大であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。主要な流行はDRC国内（Tshopo州等）で発生。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS lance un essai de vaccins alors que la barre des 10 000 cas est franchie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO launches a vaccine trial as the 10,000-case threshold is crossed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 10,000 confirmed cases as the WHO launches Tumaini, a vaccine trial to evaluate two Bundibugyo-specific candidates. Trial in Bunia, Ituri Province, begins with four participants using ring vaccination of contacts and high-risk exposures. Two candidates, ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna), are assessed for safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity under INRB leadership, with co-investigators Dr. Hugo Kavunga and Dr. Jean-Pierre Van Geertruyden. Results expected in coming months to guide use in the current outbreak and future outbreaks; ring vaccination was used in Guinea in 2015. As of Oct 25, 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths (CFR 48.6%), 2,684 recovered; Ituri 7,211 cases, 3,370 deaths; North Kivu 2,309 cases, 1,293 deaths; 66 health zones across eight provinces since May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:症例数1万人突破を受けWHOがワクチン試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1万例を超え致死率約48.6%と極めて深刻で、国際的拡大リスクやWHOの介入（ワクチン試験開始）がみられ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（8州66保健地域、Ituri州・North Kivu州が中心）が主題。ギニアは2015年の過去事例として言及されているのみで、現行の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد في أفريقيا.. أرقام قياسية في الكونغو ومخاوف عابرة للحدود
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads across Africa... record numbers in Congo and cross-border concerns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain since mid-May, making it the fastest-spreading and second-deadliest outbreak after West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic that sickened over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000, primarily in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Cross-border concerns: Kenya reports its first case earlier this month, totaling nine cases, after a Nairobi-bound man travelled from Congo via Uganda. Uganda recorded 20 cases in May–June, mostly imported from Congo; WHO later declared Uganda Ebola-free in August. In Nigeria, the current outbreak produced its first case, a Swiss woman evacuated to Switzerland (Geneva hospital) with her husband, a Swiss diplomat; Nigeria monitors 52 contacts with no current infections. Switzerland's Federal Office confirms care arrangements at Geneva and Zurich facilities. WHO Africa regional director said the evacuation aimed to curb transmission, stressing sustained vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカで拡大…コンゴで記録的な数値、国境を越える懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万人以上の感染・約4,887人の死亡という過去最大規模に達し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア（スイスへの退避例）への越境拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模流行を中心に報じており、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスへの関連症例も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ξεπέρασαν τα 10.000 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths since May, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. The outbreak has spread widely, stressing health services. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated objects; patients are highly contagious when symptomatic, underscoring the need for rapid diagnosis and isolation. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which the WHO reported no approved vaccines or specific therapies at the time, limiting treatment options. Neighboring countries report cases: Kenya (two deaths) and Nigeria with one imported case; Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths but was declared Ebola-free by late August, though importation risk persists. Nigeria’s case involved a Swiss citizen infected after travel to Uganda; 53 contacts were traced. WHO warns cross-border control is complex, urging strengthened surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者数が10,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上最悪規模（1万人超感染、死者約4900人）に達し、既にケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: La cepa Bundibugyo del ébola amenaza con extenderse en África mientras se busca una vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola threatens to spread in Africa as a vaccine is being sought.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases with 4,887 deaths (case fatality 30–50%), signaling potential wider spread. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second worst in history; officially declared May 15 in Ituri (east) but circulating since February, now in eight of 26 provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. AU and WHO actions include vaccine development; two candidates are in Phase 1 trials. Uganda previously faced a linked outbreak that ended Aug 26 with 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Kenya has confirmed its first imported case (Oct 5) and nine additional cases, with two deaths; no community transmission. Four imported European infections among humanitarian/healthcare workers in France, the Netherlands, and Germany, with no community spread. No approved treatments; Ervebo vaccination trials in DRC since late August show promise against Bundibugyo in animals, with human vaccines expected to take months.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱、ワクチン開発が進む中アフリカで拡大の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（1万例超、死者4,887人）が8州に拡大し、ケニアや欧州（フランス・オランダ・ドイツ）への越境伝播が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツでも症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ケニア・ウガンダ・欧州諸国は対象外）。記事の主たる発生地はDRCのみ。DRC国内の8州（Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, South Ubangi, North Ubangi）に拡大している点が重要。
