triage.notes: 動物疾患（家きん）であり、ヒトへの直接的な健康リスクは報告されていない。ブラジルの家禽輸出に影響する可能性があるため、貿易関連の懸念は残る。

article.articleHeadline: Bacterial targets dominate respiratory infections in hospitalized Chinese
article.articleSummary: Between December 2023 and December 2025, researchers at Nantong University’s Affiliated Hospital tested 5,808 patients hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections (ARTI) using multiplex qPCR for 16 pathogens. At least one pathogen was detected in 3,129 patients (53.87%); single-pathogen detections were 2,103 (36.21%), and mixed detections 1,026 (17.67%). The most frequent bacterial targets were Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, and Haemophilus influenzae. Molecular detection cannot distinguish active infection from colonization, and results reflect a single Chinese hospital, not community rates. Six pathogens (Mycoplasma pneumoniae, adenovirus, human metapneumovirus, H. influenzae, parainfluenza virus III, influenza B) were more common in lower vs upper respiratory infections after correction; M. pneumoniae and H. influenzae remained linked to lower infections in multivariable analysis. M. pneumoniae peaked in children 6–17 years (30.92%). Mixed detections often involved S. aureus with K. pneumoniae. Influenza A showed winter peak (21.31%). Post-COVID-19 relaxation, notes age heterogeneity and seasonal patterns in China.

triage.headline_ja: 入院中の中国人患者における呼吸器感染症は細菌性標的が優勢
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院での後ろ向き研究論文であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な集団発生を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は2023年12月～2025年12月にかけての単一病院(南通大学附属病院)の呼吸器感染症病原体に関する学術研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jacareí realiza ações de combate à dengue nesta semana; veja cronograma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jacareí carries out dengue control actions this week; see the schedule.
article.articleSummary: Jacareí, Brazil, conducts dengue control actions this week to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding and prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. Activities include visits to homes, larval density assessments (LDA) during inspections, and the Operação Cata-Treco cleanup campaign to remove items that can collect water, alongside ongoing LDA across neighborhoods. The LDA screens containers and collects larval and pupal samples for analysis, a quarterly activity in multiple city areas. The Cata-Treco schedule runs Tue 27 through Fri 30 in locations including Jardim Esperança, Nova Jacareí, São Judas Tadeu, Jardim do Portal, Parque Califórnia, Balneário Paraíba, Cidade Jardim, Jardim América, Jardim Panorama, Vila Garcia, and Vila São Simão. Residents should place discarded materials on the curb before the operation starts (by 6:50). Nebulization is planned in Jardim Panorama and Conjunto São Benedito at sites with confirmed or suspected cases, following safety protocols. Dengue vaccination for ages 10–14 is available at 19 health units.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカレイ市、今週デング熱対策活動を実施；スケジュールはこちら
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱予防・清掃活動の告知記事であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は確認済み/疑い症例地点での燻蒸や幼虫調査など通常のベクター対策活動を伝える内容で、流行の急拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC says 2027 elections may be postponed if outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Nigeria reports an imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case confirmed in Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) on October 20, with the index patient evacuated to Switzerland on October 26. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) says authorities are monitoring identified contacts and exposures, and evacuation does not signal outbreak's end. The wider Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria had anticipated possible importation due to movement and international travel. The 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections, scheduled for January 16, 2027, could be postponed if the outbreak widens into a public health risk, though no current need to do so is indicated. Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said the outbreak could be declared over December 7 if no further confirmed or probable cases occur and a 42-day countdown is validated by NCDC and WHO; a new case could reset the countdown.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：2027年選挙は流行が悪化すれば延期の可能性とナイジェリアCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行に関連し、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例が確認され国際的拡大が現実化しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアへの輸入症例（対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、流行の発生源であるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。スイスへの患者搬送は治療目的であり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo supera los diez mil casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses ten thousand cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing and deadliest in the country’s history. Declared in May, it is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. About half of confirmed cases have died. Response teams face armed conflict, poor roads, and community resistance fueled by distrust and misinformation, impeding reporting and treatment. By comparison, the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak had over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. The virus has spread beyond DRC to three regions, with cases in Kenya and Nigeria; five countries have reported cases, including Uganda and France, both with no active cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes the outbreak is far from over, but every life saved is a success.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、1万人超の症例数に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万例を超える歴史的規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率約50%、複数国への国際的拡大（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランス）も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（ブニア）での流行拡大を主題としている。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランスでも症例報告があるが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれる。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる史上最速・最悪規模の流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に深刻。武装紛争や地域住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO expresses hope as cases surpass 10,000, deaths near 5,000 in DRC
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo virus disease Ebola outbreak: 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, per the DRC Ministry of Public Health. Declared May 15, it is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohammed Janabi expressed cautious hope, noting over 2,600 recoveries and progress in vaccine and treatment trials, lab testing, infection prevention, surveillance to halt transmission. Kenya and Nigeria report infections linked to the outbreak; Kenya has nine cases and two deaths, while Nigeria's first case in over a decade was confirmed on Oct 20 in FCT, involving a traveler from Uganda. Genomic sequencing shows Nigeria and Kenya viruses differ by one mutation; no confirmed source yet. Tumaini vaccine trial in Bunia began Oct 23 to test Ervebo and Moderna/Oxford candidates against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で症例が1万人を突破、死者は5千人に迫る中、WHOが希望を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が継続中で、死者数が約5,000人に迫り、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な感染拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでも感染例が確認されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。アンゴラは発生地域に記載されているが記事本文で言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le cap des 10 000 contaminations, près de 4 900 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola epidemic surpasses the 10,000-infection mark, nearly 4,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 27, 2026, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths, with 2,684 recoveries. Identified mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight provinces, led by Ituri and North Kivu. Violence and weak health infrastructure hinder response, including an attack on health workers in Tshopo and suspension of services. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo; no specific licensed vaccine exists, though Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) is being evaluated in DRC. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. Cross-border concerns persist: Uganda reported 20 infections and two deaths before transmission ended in August; Nigeria traced a case in a Swiss returnee from Uganda, with 53 exposed; Kenya has reported cases. The WHO warns that geographic spread complicates control. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the region caused about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が感染者1万人超、死者約4,900人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が1万人以上の感染者・5000人近い死者を出し、8州に拡大、複数国への越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアでの症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化と脆弱な医療体制が対応を阻害しており、WHOも地理的拡大による制御困難を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : mise en service de la base opérationnelle de la Croix-Rouge - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: commissioning of the Red Cross's operational base - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, hosts the commissioning of a Red Cross operational base to support the response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak in the DRC. Funded by the International Committee of the Red Cross, the facility will coordinate relief, assess community needs, distribute aid, and manage local social action, with two teams of Red Cross volunteers permanently stationed to conduct dignified and secure burials in accordance with universally adopted health protocols. Keys were handed from Franck Gefeu, Red Cross provincial head for Tshopo, to Galon Boyame, focal point for dignified burials, while Jean Kitoko serves as head of the base. A site visit and simulation exercises preceded the ceremony, establishing a local node to accelerate field operations during the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでのエボラ出血熱：赤十字の活動拠点が稼働開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応拠点設置に関する記事であり、エボラは重篤な公衆衛生リスクを有し国際的拡大の懸念もあるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の第17次エボラアウトブレイク対応における赤十字の活動拠点設置に関する続報であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではない。既存のRRA評価があれば更新を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 131 Ancient Hittite Tablets Reveal Previously Unknown Epidemic 3,400 Years Ago
article.articleSummary: 131 clay tablets from Kayalipinar at Samuha in central Turkey reveal an epidemic that struck the Hittite Empire around 1400 BC. The inscriptions describe an outbreak with high fever spreading between cities and disproportionately affecting children and infants, including the death of an infant princess. The discovery brings the Samuha corpus to 184 tablets (131 new plus 53 found in 2025). The tablets document religious responses to disease—prayers and rituals to appease the gods—and mention bird divination as a method to interpret omens. The epidemic is described as distinct from the better-known Mursili II plague (1321–1295 BC). It occurred during Tudhaliya II’s reign amid Kaska attacks that made Samuha an important military center. The broader context, including Hattusa fragments like the Treaty of Kadesh, and AI-assisted handwriting dating, sheds light on Hittite society beyond the capital.

triage.headline_ja: 131枚の古代ヒッタイト粘土板が3400年前の未知の疫病を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 紀元前1400年頃の歴史的・考古学的な疫病に関する記事であり、現代の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代ヒッタイト帝国（紀元前1400年頃、現在のトルコ）における歴史的疫病の考古学的発見に関するものであり、現代の感染症イベントではない。疾患名『Plague』はBluedot APIの誤分類と思われる。発生地域にIndiaが含まれるが、記事本文には一切言及がなく無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'acceptation des équipes d'enterrement digne et sécurisé marque une avancée (Société civile) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: acceptance of safe and dignified burial teams marks an advance (Civil Society) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Across Kunda, a locality in Irumu Territory, northeastern Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease (EVD) control is advancing as communities increasingly accept Safe and Dignified Burial (SDB) teams as of 27 October 2026. Local civil-society coordinator Jean Mpaka notes that SDB teams now arrive regularly when a case requires intervention, and ongoing community sensitization is improving understanding of disease severity and prevention measures. Activities with the provincial civil-society coordination aim to interrupt transmission chains. Mpaka calls on residents to strictly observe barrier measures, including regular handwashing and avoiding risky physical contact, and to refrain from unsafe handling of corpses. He urges rapid reporting of any suspected cases to enable transport to an Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) for appropriate care. This development signals progress in community engagement essential to outbreak response in Kunda, Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：安全かつ尊厳ある埋葬チームの受け入れが進展（市民社会）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報告であり、致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるKunda（インド）やUttar Pradeshは記事内容と無関係の誤ジオコーディングと判断し除外。記事はDRCイツリ州Irumu準県Kundaでのエボラ対応（埋葬チーム受け入れ進展）に関する内容であり、既知のアウトブレイクの継続報告。

article.articleHeadline: അതിവേഗം പടര്‍ന്ന് എബോള; കോംഗോയില്‍ രോഗബാധിതരുടെ എണ്ണം പതിനായിരം കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading rapidly; the number of those infected in Congo has crossed ten thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) have surpassed 10,000, with 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths reported by the government. The outbreak is the fastest-spreading in the country’s history, expanding from three initial regions to eight provinces and 66 health zones; spillover cases continue outside Congo. About half of the confirmed cases have died. The circulating virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, identified on May 15. A vaccine for this strain has entered trials, but no effective vaccine has yet been identified, according to the World Health Organization. Cross-border transmission is ongoing, with travelers returning from Congo to Uganda subject to a 21-day quarantine at their own expense. The report underscores rapid spread, wide geographic reach, and ongoing import-export considerations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが急速に拡大；コンゴの感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が1万人を超え致死率約50%と深刻で、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの波及）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。コンゴ国内の流行が主題であり、国史上最速の拡大・8州66保健地域への拡大・有効ワクチン未確立という点で緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: New Silk-Based Material Offers Hope In Dengue Fight
article.articleSummary: Silk fibroin film embedded with silver nanoparticles killed 100% of Aedes aegypti larvae and pupae in laboratory tests, offering a novel larval-control strategy against dengue in Pune, India. The silver-based silk nanocomposite, reported in Nature Scientific Reports by Dinesh Amalnerkar, Ravindra Chaudhari and team, immobilises nanoparticles in the silk matrix to curb environmental release; no noticeable effects on non-target fish observed in lab. Gold-based variant yielded 86–98% mortality. While promising, researchers cautioned that real-world safety, cost, and effectiveness across diverse water-storage sites require further evaluation before municipal use. Pune sees rising dengue activity; PMC logged 2,291 cases Jan 1–Oct 20, with inspections of ~14 million homes and ~28.3 million water containers; larvae found in 18,885 containers across ~13,000 homes, prompting intensified anti-larval operations, fogging, and public reminders to cover containers and dry weekly.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい絹素材がデング熱対策に希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は蚊幼虫駆除用新素材の研究成果だが、プネーでのデング熱症例増加（2,291件）という実態情報も含まれるため、流行状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主に新素材（絹ナノコンポジット）の研究報告であり、デング熱自体の緊急性評価ではない。ただしプネー市での症例数増加と大規模な幼虫対策活動が継続中であることから、地域の季節性デング流行として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : fermeture momentanée d'un centre après contamination du personnel soignants - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: temporary closure of a center after contamination of healthcare workers - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three healthcare workers at Christ-Roi Health Center in Kabondo commune, Kisangani, Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, tested positive for Ebola virus disease, prompting a temporary closure ordered by authorities. The infected staff include two general practitioners and one nurse, who were moved to a treatment center for care. Investigations are underway to identify contacts, including patients recently treated at the facility and their companions. The incident underscores the vulnerability of healthcare workers amid an Ebola outbreak in Kisangani and reflects broader disruptions to health services in the city, following weeks after the Dsmet Hospital of Kisangani halted activities in Makiso commune.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：医療従事者の感染を受け、センターが一時閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の医療従事者への院内感染が発生し、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大や医療体制崩壊のリスクが高く、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: キサンガニでは既にエボラ流行が進行中であり、医療施設内感染の連鎖（Dsmet病院に続く2件目）は感染拡大と医療崩壊のリスクを示唆する。濃厚接触者調査の結果など続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Health Worker Killed in DRC as Ebola Cases Approach 10,000
article.articleSummary: Two community health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, engaged in Ebola awareness, were attacked by youths wielding machetes; one was killed and the other wounded. In the area of the latest assault, health workers are sheltering at the general hospital under police guard. U.N. spokesperson Daniela Gross de Almeida emphasized that such violence and mistrust hinder the Ebola response and obstruct access to essential health services. National authorities report the outbreak’s confirmed Ebola cases nearing 10,000, underscoring the persistence of transmission and the risks faced by frontline responders. The incident highlights dangers in community outreach activities and the broader challenge of maintaining trust and safety as the outbreak continues in the DRC as of 2026-10-27.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ症例数が1万人に迫る中、保健従事者が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の確定症例が1万人に迫り、医療従事者への暴力が対応を妨げている状況は公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高く、フルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 症例数が1万人に迫るという大規模な流行状況に加え、保健従事者への暴力事件が対応活動を妨げている点が特記される。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mahagi : quatre personnes quittent le centre de traitement de logo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mahagi: four people leave the Logo treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola virus disease patients, including a teenager, were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center in the Logo health zone of Mahagi territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Discharge occurred at a ceremony in front of the Rimba health zone central office in Ngote, Panduru, announced by Dr. José Piracel Ng'omoko, chief medical officer of Rimba. He thanked the families and Malteser International for support. Mahagi’s military administrator, Colonel Jacques Disanoa, called for strengthened community-based surveillance and enhanced risk communication by the CREC team. As of 26 October 2026, Mahagi reports a cumulative 58 Ebola cases with 30 deaths, 26 recoveries and 2 escapes, across the Rimba, Logo, Aungba and Kambala health zones, with more than 1,500 contacts under surveillance."

triage.headline_ja: マハギでのエボラ出血熱：ロゴ治療センターから4人が退院 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（累計58例、30死亡）に関する続報であり、致死率の高さとヒト-ヒト感染の継続、国際支援団体の関与からフルRRAでの継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイクの進捗報告（退院・累計症例数更新）。2名の『逃亡』事例があり、接触者追跡・地域サーベイランスの課題が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : soixante-trois nouveaux cas confirmés dont quarante dans la zone de santé de Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Sixty-Three New Confirmed Cases, Including Forty in the Beni Health Zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: 63 new confirmed Ebola cases were recorded in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 40 in the Beni Health Zone. The provincial response bulletin reports total confirmed cases at 2,423 and 1,424 deaths (case fatality rate 59%), with 328 recoveries and 618 active cases. Additionally, 53 patients were discharged without medical advice, and 2 probable cases (one in Kyondo and one in Beni) are noted. Seventeen of thirty-four health zones are affected, covering 203 of 684 health areas (30%), with hotspots comprising 203 of 333 areas (61%). On the day, 69 suspected cases were registered, with 23 deaths among suspects. Forty-one samples were collected; 18,937 contacts are active, of whom 13,194 were followed that day (70% follow-up). This marks the ongoing 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. Authorities emphasize awareness and adherence to barrier measures, and instituted a one-month minimum service requirement for provincial administration.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州でエボラ出血熱：新たに63例の確定症例、うちベニ保健地域で40例 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行において、致死率59%、累計死者1,424人という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC第17次エボラ流行の継続報告。17/34保健地域に拡大、接触者18,937人を追跡中であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高い状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 10.000 cas confirmés dans huit provinces - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 10,000 confirmed cases in eight provinces - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases across eight provinces, per a National Public Health Institute report cited by ACP on 27 October 2026. As of 25 October 2026, 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths have been recorded in Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. Ituri remains the epicenter with 7,211 cases and 3,370 deaths. Vaccination reaches 9,414 people; 16,205 contacts were followed in 24 hours, with contact tracing at 82%. The outbreak has also touched neighboring countries, with cases reported in Nigeria, Uganda, and Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で8州にわたり確認症例1万人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC8州に拡大し、周辺国（ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア）にも症例が波及しており、国際的拡大・重大な公衆衛生影響の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例報告は記事に言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。これら周辺国への越境拡大は国際的拡大リスクの根拠として考慮した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Cases Exceed 10,000
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases with 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%) since it began on May 15. In the last 24 hours, 96 new cases and 46 deaths were reported in North Kivu, Ituri, and Tshopo. Ituri remains hardest-hit, accounting for 71.7% of cases; eight provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Sud Ubangi, and Nord-Ubangi. Over 2,500 people have recovered; contact tracing is about 87%. Response efforts focus on five health zones—Mambasa (Ituri), Beni, Katwa, Bunia, and Rwampara—with a mid-term review in Tshopo this week to guide the next phase. Regional spread includes Kenya’s first case on Oct 6 linked to Congo travel; Nigeria reports a related strain, while Uganda had 20 cases in May–June but no active cases. Attacks on health workers in Bafwasende complicate response amid a displacement crisis of over 6.1 million people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が1万例・致死率48.6%に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの波及が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。保健医療従事者への攻撃や630万人超の避難民発生など、対応を一層困難にする要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de Ébola en el Congo Supera los 10 Mil Casos Confirmados - Diario CAMBIO 22 - Península Libre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases - Diario CAMBIO 22 - Península Libre
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, the fastest-growing and deadliest in the country’s history, with about half of patients having died and roughly 2,600 recovered. The outbreak, declared in May, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Response efforts are hampered by armed conflict, poor roads, and community distrust; about 80% of new cases come from outside monitored contacts, indicating ongoing transmission chains. The disease has spread to 66 health zones across eight provinces, up from three zones at declaration. Cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria; Uganda and France have had cases but currently no active ones. Health workers have faced strikes over unpaid bonuses and violence, including a fatal attack in Bafwasende, while a video of discharged patients in Ituri provided rare moments of relief.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、確認症例1万件を突破 - Diario CAMBIO 22
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が10,000例を超え致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数州・国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告、ウガンダ・フランスでの過去症例にも言及しているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないか、現在活動なしとされるため主要発生国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ワクチン未承認の新規株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）であり、武力紛争下での対応困難、医療従事者へのストライキ・暴力も発生し管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: VJTI Engineering Student Dies Of Dengue Complications, Demands Grow For Campus Hygiene Inspection And Fogging
article.articleSummary: Kumar Vedant Pawar, a VJTI engineering student at the Wadala campus in Mumbai, died on October 22 in Nashik after developing severe dengue complications following illness in mid-October. Diagnosed with advanced dengue and slipping into a coma after admission, his death elevates concerns over campus sanitation and mosquito breeding conditions. Officials say stagnant water, open drainage, and uncleaned campus periphery create ideal breeding grounds, prompting petitions to the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation for on-site inspections, targeted larviciding, and extensive fogging across VJTI grounds. Local political leaders, including Shiv Sena representatives, demand accountability and a formal inquiry into administrative lapses preceding the tragedy. While authorities warn of vector-borne risks, there is no stated outbreak figure beyond this fatal case; the infection source is tied to the campus environment, and no imported/exported cases are noted. The context follows the 2026-10-27 reporting date.

triage.headline_ja: VJTI工科大学生がデング熱合併症で死亡、キャンパスの衛生検査と薫蒸を求める声が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 単一の学生死亡例であり、キャンパス内の蚊媒介環境に関する地域的な懸念だが、アウトブレイク規模や感染者数などの情報が不足しているため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: インドではデング熱は季節的に流行する風土病であり、本記事は単一症例の死亡とキャンパス衛生問題に焦点を当てた地域ニュース。全国的なアウトブレイクを示す数値データは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: კონგოს დემოკრატიულ რესპუბლიკაში ებოლას შემთხვევებმა 10 000-ს გადააჭარბა - ინფიცირებულები არიან მეზობელ ქვეყნებშიც: ბოლო ცნობები აფრიკიდან
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 10,000 — infections are also reported in neighboring countries: latest updates from Africa.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths since mid-May, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, against which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Africa CDC notes it as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. An infected person traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Nairobi, Kenya, where nine infections have been confirmed, including two fatalities. Nigeria also recorded one case in the wife of a Swiss diplomat who had visited Uganda; investigators are tracing the infection source, and the patient was transferred to Switzerland for treatment. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or other body fluids and causes fever, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding; early symptoms can resemble malaria, delaying isolation and care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が1万人を超える ― 近隣諸国でも感染者：アフリカ最新情報
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万例・死者4,887人を超え、史上最速の拡大と報告されており、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的な感染拡大も確認されているためIHR複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、スイスでの感染例も記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスは対象国外）。主要な発生国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる史上最速の流行である点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Opasni parazit širi se Europom: Moramo se pripremiti za "bolest X"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous parasite spreading across Europe: We must prepare for "Disease X".
article.articleSummary: Alveolar echinococcosis, caused by the fox tapeworm Echinococcus multilocularis, is present in Europe and detected in Germany, where 52 human infections were recorded in 2024. In Bavaria and Baden-Wuerttemberg, fox infection rates range from 33% to 50% depending on area. Human cases are rare but can cause life-threatening liver disease. The parasite's spread signals neglected tropical diseases that reveal healthcare-system gaps; WHO lists 21 such diseases in its early-warning framework. The article emphasizes that Disease X—a currently unknown pathogen—could trigger a major outbreak; preparation requires not only vaccines and drugs but strengthened laboratories, surveillance, data collection, and international cooperation. Local health workers are crucial for early detection, such as monitoring unusual mortality. Ebola in the DRC is cited to illustrate data reliability issues; US funding cuts have weakened health networks in some African countries.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な寄生虫がヨーロッパで拡大：私たちは「疾病X」に備えなければならない
triage.triage_reason: 主要な出来事はドイツ（非対象国）における多包虫症（エキノコックス症）の発生状況に関する一般的な警鐘記事であり、対象国での具体的な感染症アウトブレイクは報告されていない。DRCのエボラはデータ信頼性の例として言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツにおける狐由来の多包虫症の拡大と、将来の未知の病原体『疾病X』への備えの必要性を論じる一般的な保健政策記事。DRCのエボラはデータ信頼性問題の例として触れられているのみで、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。対象国における具体的な感染症イベントは確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Centro europeu envia equipa de peritos à Nigéria devido à propagação da epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: European Centre Sends a Team of Experts to Nigeria Due to the Spread of the Epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts an EU response, with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) sending a team of experts to Nigeria. Arriving in Abuja this week, the team—led by a senior epidemiological intelligence specialist—will advise the EU delegation and assist Nigerian authorities, focusing on surveillance, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and outbreak preparedness. Nigeria confirmed on 20 October a Bundibugyo Ebola case in a traveler who departed Uganda on 3 October; 44 contacts are being monitored. Kenya reported nine cases by 23 October, including one death, with the first case imported from DRC and eight secondary infections; 135 contacts monitored. The ECDC has tracked the outbreak since May, including airport exit-screening assessments in DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. EU risk to Europe remains very low; no travel restrictions are advised, but vigilance is urged. Congo INSP reports over 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths, with 10,060 total cases, 48.6% fatality, 2,684 recoveries and 81.6% contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：欧州疾病予防管理センター、流行拡大を受けナイジェリアに専門家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国発のエボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへ越境伝播し、1万人超の症例と致死率48.6%という深刻な状況にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを発生源とするエボラ流行がナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダンへ拡大している状況を報告。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola franchit la barre des 10 000 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola crosses the 10,000-case threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases with 4,887 deaths as of October 27, 2026 (latest tally: 10,060/4,887). This remains the most deadly Ebola outbreak ever recorded in a single African country. Originating with the official start on May 15, the outbreak has crossed borders into Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, with Uganda imposing a 21-day quarantine on arrivals from DRC. Frontline response is hampered by insecurity and unpaid salaries for health workers; in Tshopo province, an nurse was killed by youths accusing him of contaminating a water source. Germany pledged €27 million to support the effort, stressing that all staff in Ebola treatment centers must be paid. Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe of INRB remains hopeful that cases will decline through strengthened contact tracing and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱、感染者数1万人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪のエボラ流行が1万例・死者4887人を超え、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境している。IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大、渡航制限）に該当し社会的関心・国際支援も明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。治安悪化・医療従事者未払い・医療者殺害等、対応能力への深刻な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Etawah Auraiya News: डेंगू के सात और टाइफाइड के चार मरीज निकले पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Etawah Auraiya News: Seven dengue patients and four typhoid patients tested positive.
article.articleSummary: As of October 27, 2026, Etawah and Auraiya districts in Uttar Pradesh report dengue and typhoid among fever patients. District hospital OPD saw 1,090 patients; over 60 fever cases were admitted, including 30 children. Dengue testing (38 samples) yielded 7 positives, all admitted. Typhoid testing (96 samples) produced 4 positives. Malaria testing (80 samples) was negative. Common symptoms include cough, cold, fever, and breathing difficulties during seasonal change. Doctors urged special attention to children and the elderly and advised seeking medical advice if symptoms persist. No malaria cases detected; ongoing fever surveillance and targeted treatment for confirmed dengue and typhoid cases in Etawah and Auraiya.

triage.headline_ja: エタワ・オーライヤーニュース:デング熱7人、腸チフス4人が陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の特定地域における季節性のデング熱・腸チフスの通常範囲内の発生報告であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の季節性感染症（デング熱・腸チフス）のルーチンサーベイランス報告。マラリアは陰性。地元医療機関で対応可能な規模。

article.articleHeadline: Emisiones, Ucrania, ébola, trabajo doméstico... Las noticias del martes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emissions, Ukraine, Ebola, domestic work... Tuesday's news.
article.articleSummary: Global CO2 concentration reached a record 426.8 ppm in 2025 (≈153% of preindustrial levels), with methane and nitrous oxide also at historic highs. The World Meteorological Organization warns that this buildup accelerates warming and fuels heat waves, tropical cyclones, and heavy rainfall; roughly half of yearly CO2 remains in the atmosphere. In Ukraine, intensified Russian bombardments threaten a hard winter, risking electricity, heating, and water for millions; ACNUR reports 5.2 million refugees outside Ukraine and security incidents against aid workers. The WHO launched the TUMAINI trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo to test vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, starting with Ervebo and potentially Oxford and Moderna vaccines by mid-November. About 80 million people work in global domestic service; 83.1% are informal, mostly women, earning around 53% of other workers’ wages, with long hours, prompting calls for formalization and protection.

triage.headline_ja: 排出量、ウクライナ、エボラ、家事労働...火曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチン試験開始が報じられているが、現行アウトブレイクの症例数・死亡者数など詳細情報がなく、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックをまとめたニュースダイジェストであり、エボラに関する情報はWHOがDRCでTUMAINI試験（Ervebo等のワクチン候補）を開始したという内容のみ。現行アウトブレイクの規模や症例数の詳細は記載なし。ウクライナは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Fatehpur News: बच्चों को दी डेंगू से बचाव की औषधि
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatehpur News: Medicine given to children to prevent dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Fatehpur, Om Ghat area in the Bithora block, witnessed Indian Red Cross Society chairman Dr. Anurag Srivastav distributing free homeopathic medicines to children from Bhargu Ved Vidyalaya and other schools to prevent dengue fever and other infectious diseases and to boost immunity, coupled with a hygiene-awareness drive. The initiative targeted students in Fatehpur’s schools, and was attended by Swami Vijnananand, Ashok Kumar, RM Trivedi, Jaha Khatun, Himanshu Sonkar, Hemant Tripathi, Raj Kumari, Abhinav Srivastav, and Suresh Srivastav. The article highlights preventive public health and cleanliness education as of 27 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ファテープル・ニュース：デング熱予防のため子供たちに薬を配布
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の報道であり、異常な発生や重症化、拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の赤十字によるデング熱予防のためのホメオパシー薬配布と衛生啓発活動を報じるもので、実際の感染拡大や症例増加についての記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Porto Velho capacita profissionais para o controle da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho City Hall Trains Professionals for Tuberculosis Control
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Porto Velho City Hall promotes tuberculosis control training for professionals from the Street Clinic (Consultório na Rua) and the POP Center (Centro POP). Organized by the Division of Epidemiological Surveillance (DVE) and the Municipal TB Control Program, with Associação Beradeiro, the session targets people in social vulnerability and homelessness. It focuses on active screening for respiratory symptoms and strengthening links between health teams and patients to prevent interruption of TB treatment. Mayor Léo Moraes stressed integrating health and social services to extend care to this population, noting that linking the Street Clinic and the POP Center brings support directly to patients. Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso emphasized data-driven planning and indicator monitoring to streamline timely, high-quality TB services, aiming to optimize case identification and ensure continuous treatment throughout the course.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ヴェーリョ市役所、結核対策のため専門職向け研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策研修活動の報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の通常対策プログラム・研修活動に関するものであり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Babu mai ɗauke da cutar Ebola a Najeriya -- WHO - Aminiya
article.articleSummary: WHO says there is currently no confirmed Ebola carrier in Nigeria. A woman who carried Ebola was flown out of Nigeria to Switzerland with her husband, while several others are isolated for monitoring. WHO Africa regional head Mohamed Janabi stated on X that only one woman had returned from travel carrying Ebola and she left the country yesterday (Monday). Nigeria’s Health Ministry had earlier said her condition had improved and she was not in danger, though not cured. Janabi praised Nigeria’s rapid response and noted that no carriers remain in the country, with 52 contacts under observation to prevent resurgence. A team of experts is arriving to assist in investigating the source of Bundibugyo Ebola, noting the patient did not travel to Congo. The investigation aims to identify the infection source and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアにエボラ感染者はいない ― WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）患者がナイジェリアからスイスへ空輸され、感染源不明のまま調査が進行中であり、国際的な人の移動を伴う重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: 本事案はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）およびスイス（同）で発生しており、DRCは感染者が渡航していないと明記されているため対象国リストに該当する発生国は存在しない。ただしエボラという重大感染症の国際移動事例であり、WHOアフリカ地域事務局が関与する公衆衛生上重要な事案として全体像の監視は必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's latest Ebola outbreak exceeds 10,000 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: DRC’s latest Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths since the virus was first detected in May. The cluster is caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of Ebola, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Uganda, a neighbor to the outbreak area, was declared Ebola-free by the World Health Organization in late August. Kenya, which had reported no cases before October 6, has recorded two deaths, signaling cross-border spillover risk. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids. The numbers underline a high-mortality, vaccine-lacking outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with potential propagation to adjacent countries, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, infection prevention, and sustained cross-border public health coordination, as of 2026-10-27.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの最新エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、確認症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ種、承認ワクチン・治療法なし）が1万例を超え、ケニアへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは8月にエボラ非流行宣言済みのため除外。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、越境感染リスクとして記録すべき重要情報。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 30 mil aves serão sacrificadas após identificação de novo foco da Newcastle em granja comercial de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 30,000 birds will be slaughtered after identification of a new Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak identified at a commercial turkey farm in Coronel Freitas, Western Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting sanitary depopulation of over 30,000 birds from the farm’s nucleus after positive tests. The farm houses more than 70,000 turkeys; only one nucleus tested positive, while birds in other nuclei are at slaughter age and may be used for meat. Positive results were detected during analyses by regional health teams in Nova Itaberaba, where the Emergency Sanitary Operations Center operates. The outbreak follows a second focus confirmed earlier at another Coronel Freitas farm. Surveillance covers four municipalities: Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias. Sampling includes commercial farms and turkeys reaching 21 days old; as birds reach that age, they join monitoring. Newcastle disease can be asymptomatic; absence of signs does not rule out infection. Measures aim to contain the virus and preserve markets, enabling resumption of exports.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の商業養鶏場で新たなニューカッスル病感染が確認され、3万羽以上が殺処分される見込み
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生（家禽）に関する事案であり、ヒトへの直接的な健康影響は報告されていないが、貿易・輸出への影響が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事案はヒトへの感染事例ではなく家禽（七面鳥）における動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。ただし輸出市場への影響や複数自治体での監視体制強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu : 1 424 décès liés à Ebola, le centre de traitement de Beni débordé | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: 1,424 Ebola-related deaths, the Beni treatment center overwhelmed | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 2,423 confirmed cases and 1,424 deaths reported as of 25 October 2026. In Beni, the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) is overwhelmed, built for 20 patients but recently housing about 40, prompting plans to reorganize spaces and expand capacity. Provincial data show 63 new cases and 27 deaths on 25 October, up from 39 cases and 20 deaths the day before; 17 of 34 health zones are affected. Challenges include community resistance, population movement, and misinformation; the WHO notes disruption of awareness activities and an unsafe burial in Païda, complicating transmission control. Despite difficulties, 13 patients recovered in Beni, while teams continue contact tracing and risk communication to limit further transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы стремительно увеличивается в африканской стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola victims is rapidly increasing in an African country.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Confirmed cases exceed 10,060 with 4,887 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health of the DRC. The outbreak, ongoing since mid-May, is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history and second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic in scale. No approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo. The situation is worsened by armed conflict, poor road networks, violence against authorities, distrust, and misinformation. Roughly half of recorded deaths occurred in people not hospitalized, suggesting substantial underreporting. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids and can go unnoticed since initial symptoms resemble malaria; the virus can cause severe hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの某国でエボラの死者数が急速に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、致死率が高く、治療薬・ワクチンも未承認であり、武力紛争や報告不足により国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー上では言及がなくDRCのみが主題であるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: MGAP suspendió el ingreso de productos avícolas desde Brasil tras confirmarse un foco viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MGAP Suspended Imports of Poultry Products from Brazil After a Viral Outbreak Was Confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil prompted Uruguay's MGAP to suspend the import and transit of poultry products and animals susceptible to Newcastle from Brazil, including products and byproducts manufactured after September 6, 2026. The outbreak was confirmed by Brazil's MAPA on October 18, 2026 and notified to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) on October 20. The focus is a commercial turkey farming facility in Nova Itaberaba, Brazil, triggering movement bans and ongoing eradication/containment efforts. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease causing respiratory, digestive, or nervous signs and can increase mortality. Uruguay reports no poultry Newcastle cases since 1984. Preventive measures emphasize biosecurity: dedicated clothing and footwear, avoiding contact with wild birds, thorough cleaning and disinfection of facilities and equipment, structural checks, bird-proofing sheds, mesh and closures, and controlled entry of people, vehicles, and materials.

triage.headline_ja: MGAPはウイルス感染源が確認された後、ブラジルからの家禽製品輸入を停止した
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生による貿易制限事例だが、動物疾病でありヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されていないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本疾患は鳥類のウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの感染・公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは報告されていない。ウルグアイは輸入停止措置を取ったのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: West and Central Africa: Latest Events at a glance (20-26 October 2026)
article.articleSummary: REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO: Severe flooding in Likouala Department affects about 43,000 people; government launches emergency response, including an air-bridge to deliver food, medicines and emergency supplies, with relocation plans underway. NIGER: Fire at an IDP site in N'Guigmi, Diffa Region on 21 October affects roughly 100 households; ongoing needs intensified by funding shortfalls and colder weather, requiring urgent protection, food security and health support. DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO: Ebola response endangered by violence—nurse killed in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province (24 Oct); Kisangani health centre looted; nationwide cases near 10,000. Cholera worsens, with >55,000 suspected cases since January; Tanganyika Province hardest hit, 6,300+ infections (up ~1,000 vs 2025); Kalemie facilities overwhelmed and displacement sites at risk. UN and partners provide treatment, medical supplies and water chlorination; more resources urgently needed.

article.articleHeadline: Research report: Occupational brucellosis among livestock farmers in
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis risk among ruminant farmers in Northeastern Thailand assessed in a cross-sectional study of 385 farmers from Nakhon Ratchasima, Buriram and Surin (Oct 2024–Jul 2025). Despite 65.5% reporting satisfactory knowledge, only 20.0% showed comprehensive favorable preventive practices spanning personal and farm-level measures. Protective behaviors varied: all avoided raw milk and placental products, but only 38.7% wore gloves during high-risk tasks; 61.6% wore boots. Multivariate analysis found structural and informational factors—rather than knowledge per se—most strongly predicted good practices. Certified farms (Good Farm Management) had aOR 2.60 (95% CI 1.06–6.39); brucellosis-free certification aOR 5.35 (95% CI 1.63–17.54). Merely hearing the term "brucellosis" linked to favorable practices (aOR 2.74, 95% CI 1.00–7.46). Authors advocate integrated One Health strategies: training, disease alerts, and certification schemes, given knowledge alone is insufficient. Cross-sectional design limits causal inferences.

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова оценила вероятность эпидемии лихорадки Зика в РФ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernyshova assessed the probability of a Zika fever epidemic in the Russian Federation.
article.articleSummary: Imported Zika fever case in Russia: a Russian woman returning from Bali was infected, confirmed by Rospotrebnadzor. Dr. Nadezhda Chernyshova explained that Russia can only have imported Zika cases because the vectors transmitting Zika are two mosquito species not present in Russia; these species are present on Bali, allowing infection abroad and import to Russia. There is no person-to-person transmission and no transmission via other insects, so local transmission or epidemics in Russia are unlikely. The case underscores that only imported Zika cases may occur domestically. Chernyshova previously discussed the Shamonda virus, noting its first documented human infection in France.

triage.headline_ja: チェルヌィショワ医師、ロシア連邦におけるジカ熱流行の可能性を評価

article.articleHeadline: Suiza aísla en Ginebra a una paciente con ébola repatriada desde Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Switzerland isolates a patient with Ebola in Geneva who was repatriated from Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient, a 42-year-old Swiss woman diagnosed with Ebola, repatriated from Abuja, Nigeria, is isolated at Geneva University Hospital (HUG) in Switzerland. She arrived on a medical flight and is clinically stable, under continuous isolation after severe illness that included multi-organ failure in Nigeria; her condition has improved but she remains potentially contagious. Her husband, a diplomat resident in Abuja, is in preventive isolation in Zurich as a close contact, with no symptoms or positive tests to date. Swiss health authorities emphasize the case poses no population risk. Both HUG and University Hospital Zurich (USZ) maintain high biosafety containment facilities since 2019 for such crises. Nigeria reports no active confirmed cases, though 53 close contacts are under surveillance to rule out transmission. The Africa Ebola context continues toward 10,000 cases and 4,900 deaths, with the Democratic Republic of Congo most affected, per WHO Africa region director Mohamed Janabi.

triage.headline_ja: スイスがナイジェリアから帰国したエボラ患者をジュネーブで隔離
triage.triage_reason: 先進国（スイス）でのエボラ輸入症例という異常事態であり、重症化（多臓器不全）と国際的な患者搬送を伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria control campaign launched in six municipalities of Amazonas state
article.articleSummary: Malaria control campaign launched in six Amazonas state municipalities—Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa and Río Negro—carried out as a day of comprehensive care to prevent, diagnose and treat malaria. Health teams intensified deployment in hard-to-reach communities to ensure timely response. During the event, essential medical supplies, antimalarial medicines, and rapid diagnostic tests were distributed to enable immediate care for detected cases. In addition, in the Mavaca parish of Alto Orinoco municipality, an immunization distribution day reinforced the national vaccination schedule, protecting children and adults against various preventable diseases. The effort aligns with social protection policies and strengthening of the public health system.

triage.triage_reason: 通常のマラリア予防・治療キャンペーンに関する報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。発生地域もベネズエラのアマソナス州であり対象国に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Despliegan jornada contra la malaria en seis municipios del estado Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They roll out a malaria-control campaign in six municipalities of the Amazonas state.
article.articleSummary: On 27 October 2026, a malaria-control campaign was rolled out across six Amazonas state municipalities—Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa, and Río Negro—through an integrated care day for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. The response targeted hard-to-reach communities with intensified deployment of health personnel to ensure timely detection and management of malaria cases. The operation distributed essential medical supplies, antimalarial medications, and rapid diagnostic tests to secure immediate care for detected cases. In Mavaca parish, Alto Orinoco, a concurrent immunization drive reinforced the national vaccination schedule, protecting children and adults against various preventable diseases. The initiative underscores ongoing public-health efforts to reduce malaria burden while strengthening immunization coverage in remote areas of the Amazonas state.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola grijpt verder om zich heen in Congo: ruim 10.000 mensen besmet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in Congo: more than 10,000 people infected.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports more than 10,000 Ebola cases and about 4,900 deaths, per national authorities. Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak yet, with 9,964 cases counted last Friday. The Bundibugyo variant drives transmission, with a case fatality around 48%; true totals may be higher due to under-testing and care-seeking delays. The outbreak began in May and has strained health services, disrupted vaccination and education, and fostered fear and violence against health workers. Pregnant women avoiding facilities have doubled maternal mortality in some provinces. There is no specific vaccine or proven treatment for Bundibugyo; two vaccines are in clinical trials, and researchers are evaluating whether Ervebo, approved for Zaïre ebolavirus, offers protection against Bundibugyo. Imported/exported cases: Kenya reports nine infections and two deaths after a Congo-origin patient traveled via Uganda to Nairobi; Nigeria reports one case linked to travel from Uganda, treated in Switzerland; about 2,600 recoveries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラがさらに拡大：感染者1万人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超の感染・約4900人の死亡という大規模アウトブレイクで、ケニアやナイジェリアへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・ウガンダは渡航関連の二次感染先であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主たる発生国として唯一該当。致死率約48%のBundibugyo株で、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立という点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: RDC supera los 10.000 casos de ébola y suma casi 4.900 muertes - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 10,000 Ebola cases and totals nearly 4,900 deaths - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, yielding a 48.6% case fatality rate. This remains the second-deadliest and most transmissible global outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis. Transmission covers 66 health zones across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, led by Ituri and North Kivu, with Bafwasende, Beni, Mandima and Bunia among the most affected. Recovered total stands at 2,684; contact tracing is 81.6% complete. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no specific treatment; WHO is testing two experimental vaccines in early-phase trials, while Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) is used in vaccination campaigns but is not tailored to Bundibugyo. Uganda’s outbreak ended Aug 26 (20 cases, 15 imported, 2 deaths), with linked cases in Kenya and Nigeria. Priorities: early detection, safe burials, and protection of response teams.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ症例が1万人を超え、死者数はほぼ4,900人に達する - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が10,000症例・致死率48.6%に達し、8州66保健地域に拡大する重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、国際的な波及（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに関連症例）も確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は既に終息(8/26)、ケニア・ナイジェリアは輸入関連症例のみで主流行地ではないため対象国リストに含めず。主要発生地はDRCのみ。致死率48.6%と非常に高く、Bundibugyo株には特異的治療法がない点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola ultrapassa 10 mil casos e chega a quase 5 mil mortes na África | Mundo e Ciência | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 10,000 cases and reaches nearly 5,000 deaths in Africa | World and Science | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths (case-fatality 48.6%) based on data through October 25. Declared May 15, the epidemic is the deadliest in the DRC and the second deadliest globally, affecting eight of 26 provinces, led by Ituri and North Kivu (32 and 58 new cases in the last 24 hours). Provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, Ubangi del Sur, and Ubangi del Norte. The virus has spread to Nigeria and Kenya after reaching Uganda; Nigeria reports a single confirmed case in a Swiss woman who contracted it in Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland. Kenya has recorded two deaths since October 6. Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the WHO at the end of August. Bundibugyo strain lacks specific treatment; Ervebo vaccine is used in the DRC, with phase 1 trials in humans showing safety and potential cross-protection in animals, underscoring a complex containment task as the outbreak expands westward.

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: segundo foco é confirmado em Coronel Freitas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: second outbreak confirmed in Coronel Freitas.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has confirmed a second outbreak focus in Santa Catarina's western region, at a turkey broiler operation in Coronel Freitas. Health authorities (Cidasc) report ongoing surveillance with property inspections and containment measures. As of October 24, over 160 commercial and 317 subsistence properties were inspected, and 78 samples collected. The investigation yielded encouraging results: 15 commercial farms tested negative and were cleared for slaughter after laboratory confirmation of the absence of the virus. Cidasc stresses biosafety in poultry facilities—protecting against wild birds, pest control, and disinfection of vehicles and footwear—to safeguard Santa Catarina's poultry industry. Continued hygienic controls and monitoring are emphasized to prevent further spread and potential implications for regional poultry trade.

triage.triage_reason: 動物(家禽)における疾病事例であり、人への健康影響は報告されていないが、ブラジルの家禽産業・貿易への影響可能性があるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 cases as authorities race to slow the spread
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 10,000 confirmed cases as of 2026-10-27, per the Congo Ministry of Health. The fast-moving outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola event in history and the deadliest on record in the country. Of the 10,060 confirmed infections, nearly half have died, underscoring the severity of the crisis. The epicenter is Bunia, with transmission extending into multiple African countries. Government data indicate ongoing efforts by authorities to slow spread amid containment measures, as health systems respond to the unprecedented surge. The article relies on official figures and provides no further details on laboratory confirmation methods, specific infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The outbreak’s scale signals an urgent need for sustained public health interventions, surveillance, and regional coordination to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Madurai corporation intensifies action as dengue cases rise
article.articleSummary: Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India, is seeing a seasonal rise in dengue with the northeast monsoon. Government hospitals report an average of three dengue and about ten viral-fever cases daily. At Government Rajaji Hospital, seven dengue patients are treated in a 40-bed ward. Madurai corporation has logged 38 dengue cases this month so far, up from 20 in Oct last year, with authorities stressing no outbreak yet but escalating preventive measures. About 1,200 dengue-breeding check (DBC) workers have been deployed to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Special mobile medical units operate daily in the afternoons, complementing morning camps at 16 Urban Primary Health Centres (UPHCs). On Monday, UPHC camps screened 726 people for fever and vector-borne symptoms; Tuesday saw 1,595 residents seeking care at 33 UPHCs. Corporation commissioner Gaurav Kumar urged residents to keep homes clean and promptly seek medical checkups for persistent fever.

triage.notes: 地方自治体（マドゥライ市）による季節性デング熱対応の通常報道であり、外部支援の必要性や国際的拡大のリスクは示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова: В России возможны только завозные случаи лихорадки Зика
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernysheva: In Russia, only imported cases of Zika fever are possible.
article.articleSummary: A Moscow resident who had returned from Bali was diagnosed with Zika fever in September, as reported by Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor. Therapist Nadezhda Chernysheva explained that Russia can only experience imported Zika infections because only two mosquito species transmit Zika, and these vectors do not inhabit Russia. The mosquitoes carrying Zika are present on Bali, allowing infection abroad and importation to Russia. Zika is not transmitted person-to-person or via other insects, so there are no local cases or outbreaks in Russia. Consequently, Russia’s Zika situation is limited to imported cases, not epidemics.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Save the Children, circa due bambini al giorno sono rimasti orfani dall'inizio dell'emergenza. - politicamentecorretto.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Save the Children says around two children a day have been orphaned since the beginning of the emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, declared May 15, 2026, has infected over 10,000 people and caused 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%), marking the country’s worst Ebola surge and the second-largest globally. More than 2,700 children have been infected; hundreds have died, with a 72% fatality rate among children under five. The crisis has orphaned or separated over 1,900 children, averaging nearly two new orphans per day since onset. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a specific approved vaccine, necessitating strengthened surveillance, prevention, community engagement, infection control, isolation, and care access. The outbreak has spread from one health zone to 66 zones across eight provinces, amid conflict, displacement, and fragile health systems. Save the Children reports nearly 200,000 people reached (including >100,000 children) and is opening Centers of Observation and Assistance in Bunia to support exposed children.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:セーブ・ザ・チルドレン、緊急事態発生以来1日あたり約2人の子どもが孤児になっていると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大流行（感染者1万人超、死者4,887人、致死率48.6%）が8州66保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 本件は既に承知のDRCエボラ大流行（イトゥリ州中心、2026年5月15日宣言）に関する人道的影響（子どもの孤児化）の続報。既存のRRA対象イベントの可能性が高いため重複確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PMC steps up dengue response as state cases rise 28%, deaths jump to 11
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Maharashtra rose about 28% in 2026, with Pune dengue deaths increasing from 2 to 11. Pune municipal commissioner Naval Kishore Ram met private hospitals to ensure admission and urged registration of suspected and confirmed cases on the IHIP portal; he called for awareness campaigns and to inform patients about urban poor schemes to avoid treatment delays. As of Oct 21, statewide dengue stood at 13,955 (vs 10,924 last year). Mumbai reported 4,180 dengue and 11,749 malaria (five dengue deaths); Pune had 3,154 dengue. Malaria cases rose 13% to 21,371, with deaths at 10. Districts: Gadchiroli malaria 4,068 (six deaths); Palghar dengue 314. PCMC logged 90 dengue cases in October. 66% of cases are in civic bodies; fogging and 200-home urban surveys are planned, amid warnings that El Niño may heighten dengue risk requiring fever testing and attention to warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市、デング熱症例が州全体で28%増加、死者数が11人に急増したことを受け対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュートラ州における季節性のデング熱・マラリアの症例増加であり、インドでは毎年見られる風土病の変動範囲内と考えられるが、死亡者数の増加や症例増加率を踏まえ、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアはインドにおける既知の風土病であり、毎年雨季後に症例が増加する傾向がある。本記事は地方自治体レベルでの対応強化を報じており、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の兆候はない。ただし死亡者数の増加（デング11人、マラリア10人）とEl Niñoによるリスク増大の指摘があり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola toujours hors de contrôle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is still out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak remains out of control, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) officially detecting it six months ago on May 15. More than 10,000 Ebola patients have been reported, the vast majority in the DRC, with spread to Kenya and Nigeria; Uganda had earlier cases, and Kenya logged nine cases in October (two deaths). In the DRC, 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths have been recorded, about 2,684 recoveries, and a case fatality rate near 50%. The outbreak began in Ituri and has reached eight provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu in the east. A Nigerian case involved a 42-year-old Swiss woman, wife of a Swiss embassy employee in Abuja; she traveled to Uganda and was evacuated to Switzerland, with 53 contacts identified. Genomic sequencing links the Kenyan and Nigerian cases to Beni-related strains; Africa CDC notes a mutation but not increased lethality, while border controls are lagging.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、依然として制御不能
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超の感染・致死率約50%、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイス）への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案である。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola Cases Exceed 10,000 with Nearly 5,000 Deaths
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct 25, 2026, per NIPH via EFE. Case fatality 48.6%; 2,684 recovered; contact tracing 81.6%. The epidemic spans 66 health zones across eight provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu the hubs of transmission; 24‑hour increases include 32 new cases in Ituri and 58 in North Kivu (Beni 35, Mandima 11, Bunia 8). It is the second deadliest and most contagious outbreak on record, surpassing the 2018–2020 Congolese outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Bundibugyo has no approved specific treatment; two vaccines are in Phase 1, including Ervebo for the Zaire variant, not yet proven effective against Bundibugyo. Cross-border spread includes Uganda’s outbreak end on Aug 26 (20 infections, 2 deaths); Kenya and Nigeria report linked cases. WHO risk: Congo very high, neighbors high, globally low; PHEIC declared May 16. NIPH calls for stronger detection, tracing, safe burials, and protection of response teams.

article.articleHeadline: Jornada sanitaria distribuye insumos contra la malaria en Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Campaign Distributes Supplies to Combat Malaria in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, in Amazonas state, Venezuela, the State Health Directorate and the Malaria Elimination Program conducted a special medical-supply drive to combat malaria. The effort delivered antimalarial treatments, rapid diagnostic tests, and essential medical supplies to the jungle municipalities of Autana, Alto Orinoco, Atabapo, Manapiare, Maroa, and Río Negro. Medical outreach also included the distribution of vaccines in the Mavaca parish to consolidate the national vaccination schedule among communities furthest from the regional center. Through these actions, health authorities aim to keep diagnostic posts equipped for timely responses to residents of the region. The campaign was coordinated with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), which praised the regional strategy, highlighting gains in staff training and in the supervision of jungle healthcare in Venezuela.

article.articleHeadline: AH&VS Organises Awareness and Sensitisation Session on African Swine Fever for Students of ANCOL
article.articleSummary: On Oct 27, 2026, in Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, AH&VS conducted an ASF awareness session for Andaman College students at the ANCOL Campus. The Senior Veterinary Officer explained African Swine Fever as a highly contagious viral disease of domestic and wild pigs with high mortality; there is no vaccine or specific treatment, and biosecurity is essential. Transmission occurs via contaminated feed and swill, pork products, and the movement of people, vehicles, and equipment. ASF does not infect humans and poses no direct human health risk. Emphasis was placed on vigilance and preventive measures to protect pig populations, including indigenous Nicobari and Andaman pigs. Students were urged to act as ambassadors, avoid feeding kitchen waste to pigs, ensure pork products are checked, and report any unusual pig illness or mortality immediately.

article.articleHeadline: إطلاق تجربة لتقييم لقاحات ضد إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Launch of a trial to evaluate Ebola vaccines
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo to evaluate Ebola vaccines of the Bundibugyo strain, aiming to determine their effectiveness in preventing infection and limiting transmission. Initiated in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, the study is led by the DRC government and managed by the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) with local and international researchers. The trial uses a ring vaccination approach, vaccinating contacts of confirmed cases to assess vaccines’ protective impact. Ervebo has demonstrated efficacy against Zaire ebolavirus, but its ability to prevent Bundibugyo infection remains unknown, and it is the first vaccine to be evaluated in this trial due to its availability in the country. The work is coordinated with input from WHO vaccine-trials lead Dr. Meg Doherty, who spoke via video from Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの効果を評価する治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチン治験がリング接種方式で確認症例の接触者を対象に実施されており、現地で進行中のアウトブレイクの存在が示唆されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験開始が主題だが、確認症例への接触者を対象とするリング接種が行われていることから、DRC・イツリ州で進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの存在が強く示唆される。詳細な症例数・死亡者数等の情報が不足しているため、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgınında vaka sayısı 10 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola outbreak cases has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 10,060 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and spans 66 health zones across 8 of the DRC’s 26 provinces, marking it as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Data indicate ongoing transmission with a substantial mortality burden across affected regions. The report notes laboratory confirmation for case counts but does not detail infection sources or any imported/exported cases. Health authorities continue to monitor and respond to this outbreak, underscoring the severity of Ebola in Central Africa.

article.articleHeadline: Чем опасна лихорадка Зика и чем она отличается от Денге и Чикунгуньи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is Zika fever and how does it differ from dengue and chikungunya?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, an imported Zika fever case was reported in Russia: a Moscow resident who returned from Bali, diagnosed in October; risk of domestic spread is fully excluded because Aedes mosquitoes are not present in Russia. Zika symptoms include abrupt fever, rash, conjunctivitis, myalgias and arthralgias; the virus is primarily transmitted by Aedes bites but can also spread sexually, from mother to fetus, and via infected blood transfusion. Incubation is 3–14 days; illness typically 2–7 days. No vaccine for Zika exists. The case underscores particular danger for pregnant women due to potential teratogenic effects on the fetus. By contrast, dengue causes severe myalgias and potential hemorrhagic forms; chikungunya causes prolonged joint pain. Vaccines exist for dengue in endemic countries; vaccines for Zika are not available, chikungunya vaccines are in development. Russia has domestically developed test systems for rapid Zika diagnosis; travelers are advised to protect against mosquito bites abroad.

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura reforça ações de prevenção à dengue nos cemitérios - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall reinforces dengue prevention measures in cemeteries - Rio de Janeiro City Hall
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro City Hall strengthens prevention of dengue, Zika and chikungunya ahead of All Souls’ Day (November 2). Twenty cemeteries will be inspected Oct 26–29 and again Nov 3–6 to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Health Surveillance teams will remove or treat water-holding containers, including flower vases, that could harbor larvae. Post-holiday inspections aim to eliminate breeding sites left by visitors. Cemeteries include Memorial do Carmo, Jardim da Saudade (Sulacap), São Francisco Xavier (Caju), Israelita, São João Batista, Murundu, Pechincha, Piabas, Guaratiba, São Francisco de Paula, Inhaúma, Ingleses, Cacuia, Irajá, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, and others. As of Oct 10, 2026, 9,728,581 property inspections and 1,330,015 deposits treated/eliminated; in 2025, 12,297,072 visits and 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. Citizens can request inspections or report suspected breeding sites by calling Central 1746.

article.articleHeadline: Poliomielite: Brasil não alcança meta de cobertura ideal e especialista reforça urgência da vacinação diante dos desafios de cobertura no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poliomyelitis: Brazil fails to reach the ideal vaccination coverage target, and a specialist reinforces the urgency of vaccination amid the country's coverage challenges.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis remains Brazil’s polio-free status since 1994, with no wild poliovirus cases since 1989 and the Americas certified polio-free in 1994. Yet vaccination coverage fell to 88.28% in 2026, below the 95% target, raising herd-immunity concerns amid ongoing global poliovirus circulation and parental vaccine hesitancy. Poliovirus is transmitted mainly via the orofecal route; about 90–95% of infections are asymptomatic, and roughly 1% progress to acute flaccid paralysis, potentially causing permanent motor disability and respiratory complications. Brazil’s National Immunization Program switched from oral to Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV), with doses at 2, 4, and 6 months and a booster at 4 years. Surveillance combines immediate, compulsory reporting of suspected acute flaccid paralysis and environmental monitoring of sewage to detect silent circulation. Endemic transmission persists in Afghanistan and Pakistan, underscoring importation risk and the need for rigorous vaccination, per specialist guidance.

article.articleHeadline: Чернышова о риске возможной эпидемии Зика в РФ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chernyshova on the risk of a possible Zika epidemic in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia faces low risk of a Zika epidemic because Aedes aegypti and A. albopictus are tropical/subtropical vectors; sustained transmission is unlikely in most Russian regions. Zika also transmits vertically and sexually; casual household spread is not sustained. Most infections are asymptomatic or mild: subfebrile fever, rash, conjunctivitis, arthralgia, myalgia, headache; incubation days to two weeks. Rare complications include Guillain-Barré syndrome and congenital anomalies such as microcephaly when pregnant. Diagnosis: RT-PCR in blood/urine early; serology (IgM/IgG) later, but cross-reactivity with other flaviviruses complicates interpretation. No specific antiviral; supportive care; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs until dengue ruled out. Prevention for travelers: repellents (DEET, picaridin, IR3535), long sleeves, nets, air conditioning; eliminate standing water. Pregnant or planning pregnancy should delay travel to endemic regions (East/Southeast Asia, Latin America, warm Africa) and seek obstetric guidance on monitoring after return. Those exposed should discuss sexual precautions; vaccines are not in mass use; report symptoms to Rospotrebnadzor.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola, nearly half of them have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 infections, with nearly 5,000 fatalities. The DRC’s health ministry lists 10,060 cases and more than 4,900 deaths; earlier figures reported about 9,000 infections and 4,300 deaths. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri province. Across borders, cases have been reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. By the end of August, the World Health Organization announced that Uganda had no new Ebola cases. The report, based on statements from authorities cited by The Associated Press, emphasizes cumulative totals and geographic spread, including cross-border activity, while indicating Uganda’s status as of late August. No further clinical details, laboratory confirmation specifics, or infection sources are provided in the article.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで1万人超の感染・約5000人の死亡という甚大な公衆衛生インパクトを示し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: PAM atende sábado das 8h às 14h para reforçar vacinação contra Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAM operates Saturday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. to boost vaccination against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination drive in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 7,614 doses received and 5,756 administered; a first batch had been returned earlier for expiration. The municipal health secretariat will run a Saturday immunization session at PAM from 8:00 to 14:00 to reach a target of 40,000 people, though fewer than 6,000 had sought vaccination so far. Dourados has experienced significant Chikungunya activity in 2026, with 10,780 notifications, 5,284 laboratory-confirmed cases, 5,317 probable cases, and 19 deaths; 79 confirmed in pregnant women. Week 41 indicates ongoing transmission and the need for continued control. Doses expiring this weekend (Oct 31) prompt guidance from the state on reverse logistics for disposal. Vector-control measures include eliminating standing water, sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, and proper disposal of materials to reduce Aedes aegypti spread.

triage.headline_ja: PAM（地域保健センター）、チクングニア熱ワクチン接種強化のため土曜日8時から14時まで対応

triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種呼びかけが主題だが、背景として2026年にドウラードス市で大規模なチクングニア熱流行（10,780件通知、19死亡、妊婦感染79件）が継続している点が重要。地域的流行の規模・重症度からフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Co-Diagnostics se rapproche du lancement commercial de son test de dépistage de la tuberculose en Inde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Co-Diagnostics nears the commercial launch of its tuberculosis screening test in India.
article.articleSummary: Co-Diagnostics advances toward commercial launch of its tuberculosis screening in India via CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. after submitting to the Indian CDSCO for regulatory authorization of the CoSara PCR Mycobacterium tuberculosis test on the CoSara PCR Pro instrument. The regulatory filing follows a July 2026 clinical evaluation in selected Indian laboratories, assessing 676 patient samples with 233 MGIT-paired comparisons. The diagnostic demonstrated an average sensitivity of 97.3% and average specificity of 96.0% across three lots versus the MGIT reference standard, with consistent performance across lots. India, home to roughly a quarter of the world’s tuberculosis infections per WHO 2025 Global TB Report, is a key market. The portable CoSara PCR Pro employs Co-Primers for real-time PCR results in ~30 minutes, with a mobile app and localized mobile/cloud architecture enabling decentralised use without constant internet, syncing when connected. Regulatory approval expected in Q4 2026, enabling sales before year-end 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Co-Diagnostics社、インドでの結核検査の商業展開に向け前進
