article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle afeta exportações de carne de aves do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease affects Brazil's poultry meat exports.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak detected in Santa Catarina, Brazil, on October 18 triggered expanded restrictions on Brazilian poultry meat and other avian products. In response, Malaysia and Mexico suspended imports from Brazil, while China halted imports of products from Santa Catarina. The piece underscores the impact on Brazil’s poultry export trade and outlines the sanitary protocols being adopted to manage the crisis. To discuss the disease and the general sanitary measures, the article features Ricardo Santin of the Brazilian Animal Protein Association (ABPA). The article frames expert guidance on containment, surveillance, and biosecurity amid ongoing trade disruptions, and notes the need to communicate safeguards for imported/exported poultry products as authorities work to contain Newcastle disease.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病がブラジルの鶏肉輸出に影響
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の感染症であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響や症例報告はなく、主に貿易制限に関する内容であるためトリアージ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染はまれかつ軽症（結膜炎程度）とされる。本記事は貿易・経済的影響（マレーシア・メキシコ・中国の輸入停止）が主題であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina leva Uruguai a fechar portas para carne de frango brasileira | Cliquef5 - Noticias de Primavera do Leste e Campo Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina leads Uruguay to close its doors to Brazilian chicken meat | Cliquef5 - News from Primavera do Leste and Campo Verde
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreaks confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil trigger Uruguay to suspend imports and transit of poultry meat and derivatives from Brazil as of 26 September 2026, with official confirmation by the Ministry of Agriculture. The restriction covers products produced on or after 6 September 2026 and allows only heat-treated poultry meat and eggs, plus animal-feed or industrial derivatives (e.g., feathers, feather meal, processed meals) that have undergone the required heat treatment. Uruguay joins Mexico in imposing a total ban on Brazilian avian products; Malaysia is evaluating similar measures. Brazil’s industry cites regionalization with key partners: China restricting purchases to Santa Catarina plants; Saudi Arabia limiting sanctions to the outbreak's immediate vicinity. Internationally, certification for Santa Catarina shipments remains suspended to Kazakhstan, Chile, China, Paraguay, Peru, Turkey, Ukraine, and the Eurasian Economic Union, while over 50 countries maintain bans within a 10-km radius of the outbreak. Some nations allow shipments if heat-treated.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生により、ウルグアイがブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の家禽ニューカッスル病発生を受け、ウルグアイ・メキシコ等複数国が輸入禁止・制限を実施し、各国農業当局の関心が高いため、貿易影響の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（鳥類）の動物疾病であり、人への健康被害は報告されていない。主たる懸念は国際貿易制限（複数国の輸入停止）であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。発生国はブラジル（サンタカタリーナ州）のみで、他国は輸入制限措置を講じている立場であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Entre défi épidémiologique et impératif de confiance communautaire face au virus d'Ebola - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Between the epidemiological challenge and the imperative of community trust in the face of the Ebola virus - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: DRC confronts the largest Ebola Bundibugyo-strain outbreak recorded in a single country, with more than 10,000 confirmed cases and about 4,900 deaths, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak has triggered regional and international alerts and raises fears of a multi-country spread. Response is hindered by structural weaknesses and on-the-ground resistance: recurring strikes by healthcare workers over pay and care challenges, and community suspicions that have led to assaults on health workers in enclaved areas. During a Kinshasa visit, German Deputy Foreign Minister Serap Güler urged greater financial support, noting that protecting caregivers and logistics are core containment levers. Scientific leadership by Jean-Jacques Muyembe and INRB persists, with the Tumaini vaccine trial launched in Bunia in Ituri as a phase 2/3 study, along with development of new candidates. Resolution hinges on therapeutic advances, rigorous epidemiology, and rebuilding trust with local populations.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラウイルスに直面する疫学的課題とコミュニティの信頼確保の必要性の狭間で - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ・ブンディブギョ株による単一国最大規模の流行（確定例1万人超、死者約4,900人）が継続しており、国際的な懸念と支援要請が生じているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はIturi州Bunia及びKinshasaでの対応活動に言及しているが、流行自体はIturi・North Kivuに集中。DRC国内のみの発生として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in 2026 is the fastest-spreading on record, with >10,000 infections since the May declaration and ~5,000 deaths. It is the largest geographic-spread outbreak, spanning from Nigeria to Kenya. About one-third of deaths are children; under-5 mortality among the infected is roughly 75%. Laboratory confirmation has been hampered by Bundibugyo Ebola, a species not calibrated in existing tests, though there are now two dozen diagnostic labs and over 50 treatment centers with ~2,000 beds. Two-thirds of deaths occur in the community, indicating delayed care-seeking. The virus likely circulated in February/March before May; factors include conflict in northeastern DRC and slower international funding and support, including U.S. aid cuts. Community distrust in North Kivu (~85%) and rampant rumors hinder response. Common symptoms include fever, headache, and body aches; emphasis on early care and trusted responders to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が記録を更新 ― そして痛ましい節目を迎えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に過去最速・過去最大規模の地理的拡大を示すエボラ流行が進行中で、死亡者数も多く国際的拡大・資金不足などの懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事ではナイジェリア・ケニアへの拡大も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行が主題として確認された。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in the DRC: More Than 10,000 Confirmed Cases in Eight Provinces - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 10,060 confirmed cases across eight provinces—Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, South Ubangi and North Ubangi—with 4,887 deaths. Ituri remains the epicenter with 7,211 confirmed cases and 3,370 deaths. Vaccination has reached 9,414 people, while 16,205 contacts were monitored within 24 hours, achieving an 82% contact-tracing rate. Data from the National Institute of Public Health as of October 25, 2026, cited by ACP, indicate ongoing transmission across multiple provinces and note the epidemic has also affected Nigeria, Uganda and Kenya. The report highlights the multi-provincial scope of the outbreak and the public-health response, including vaccination and contact tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱：8州で確認症例1万件を超える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（確認症例10,060人、死亡4,887人）が8州に拡大し、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアにも波及したとされており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大のリスクが明確に認められるため。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يفتك بالكونغو الديمقراطية: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 10,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths across eight provinces since mid-May. The outbreak is the fastest-spreading on record and the 17th in the DRC in 50 years, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Response is hampered by armed conflict, poor roads, and distrust and misinformation. The virus has reached East, West, and Central Africa, with Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria reporting related cases. Uganda previously recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths and was declared outbreak-free in late August. Nigeria reports one imported case: a Ugandan-Swiss woman, with symptoms Oct 7, care in Abuja Oct 11, confirmed Oct 20, and transfer to Switzerland with her husband. Kenya has two deaths; its first case was detected Oct 6, imported from DRC via Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で猛威：感染者1万人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染者1万人超・死者4887人という大規模アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン未承認の希少株（ブンディブギョ株）による急速拡大、かつウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大が確認されておりIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、スイスへの症例波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率約48.6%と極めて高く、武力紛争や不信感・誤情報が対応を困難にしている点も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in the DRC: Follow-up Clinics Strengthen Care for Survivors - ACP
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Ebola survivor follow-up clinics strengthen care after recovery. Since September 19, 2026, the Bunia clinic has treated over 400 Ebola survivors; a second facility in Beni, North Kivu, provides medical follow-up. Operated with WHO guidance, clinics offer medical consultations, psychological and nutritional support, and laboratory tests to detect post-recovery complications. Survivors may experience joint pain, persistent fatigue, and psychological disorders requiring care. WHO notes follow-up helps monitor health and mitigate risks of virus persistence in bodily fluids. Dr. Brys Busanga, WHO focal point for survivor follow-up, and Dr. Roland Kasamaga, Bunia clinic coordinator, emphasize comprehensive care after discharge from Ebola Treatment Centers to prevent complications and aid social reintegration amid stigma. This initiative strengthens continuity of care in northeastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：フォローアップクリニックが生存者へのケアを強化

article.articleHeadline: Badaun News: उलैया गांव में फिर फैला बुखार, डेंगू संक्रमित मिला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Badaun News: Fever spreads again in Ulaiya village; dengue infection detected.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is detected in Ulaiya village, Ambiyapur Block, Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, India, after a brief lull. A dengue-positive case emerged as health authorities intensified surveillance. On Tuesday, 120 fever patients visited village health camps; 80 were tested with RDT kits, yielding one dengue-positive result. District Surveillance Officer Dr. Tahsin ordered door-to-door fever screening in Ulaiya, to be conducted on Wednesday. Malaria Officer Amit Tiwari directed fogging and anti-larvae spraying by malaria personnel, with a aim to maximize vector-control efforts across villages to prevent mosquito-borne diseases. The response underscores ongoing outbreak management and expanded screening and fumigation to curb dengue transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in the DRC: 9,600 Cases Recorded in the 42nd Epidemiological Week - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): during the 42nd epidemiological week, 9,600 cumulative cases and over 4,500 deaths have been reported, yielding a case fatality rate of about 48%. More than 2,500 people have recovered, and contact tracing stands at roughly 87%. The outbreak spans eight provinces, with notable progress in South Kivu where no new cases have been reported for several months; three other provinces also reported no cases during the period. Response efforts will be concentrated in five health zones that account for nearly 80% of cases, notably Mandima, Katwa, and Rwampara, to intensify interventions and reverse the trend. An intra-action review will be held in Tshopo Province to assess progress midway through the response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak and adjust strategies. Kinshasa, 27 October 2026.

triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行として継続中。8州に拡大、致死率約48%と高く、5つの保健ゾーン（Mandima、Katwa、Rwampara等）に対応を集中。南キブ州では新規症例なしの進展あり。

article.articleHeadline: 感染RSV 或致長期後遺症 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV infection may lead to long-term sequelae | am730
article.articleSummary: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection is a major, year-round concern in Hong Kong, with no antiviral cure and high infant hospitalization risk. High-risk groups include people aged 60+, adults 50+ with chronic heart or lung disease, and children under 2. Each year, about 2–3 of 100 infants ≤6 months are hospitalized for RSV; by age two, roughly 90% are infected, and 40% of first infections become lower respiratory tract infections. Severe infancy RSV can trigger long-term sequelae such as recurrent wheeze and asthma for years; avoiding infection in the first year may reduce later asthma risk by about a quarter. Prevention centers on hand hygiene, surface disinfection, and masks in crowds. Prophylaxis options include maternal vaccination at 32–36 weeks, infant monoclonal antibodies, and older-adult vaccines. Spain's Galicia reports a 90% drop in infant RSV hospitalizations after long-acting antibodies; meta-analyses show 71–83% reductions in lower respiratory tract infections and hospitalization with monoclonal antibodies.

triage.headline_ja: RSV感染が長期後遺症を引き起こす可能性 | am730

triage.notes: 記事は香港における季節性RSV感染症の一般的な医学解説記事であり、スペイン・ガリシア州の予防接種効果データも紹介されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港はChinaに統合して計上。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Health Service urges vigilance as Ebola prevention campaign intensifies
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus vigilance intensified in Ghana as the Ghana Health Service (GHS) launches a reinforced public awareness campaign to prevent importation amid recent outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, and Nigeria. Transmission is via direct contact with blood and other body fluids of an infected person. Public guidance urges people not to touch the body fluids of someone with suspected Ebola, and underscores that trained care workers must use appropriate protective equipment. The GHS advises anyone with direct contact with a suspected case or their body fluids to seek medical attention immediately, rather than waiting for symptoms to appear. The alert emphasizes staying informed and adhering to preventive measures to reduce risk, as part of ongoing efforts to safeguard Ghana from Ebola importation.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス、エボラ予防キャンペーン強化を受け警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ケニア・ナイジェリアで複数のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが同時発生しており、ガーナが輸入防止のため警戒を強化していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻さが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナの予防キャンペーンが主題であり、ガーナ国内での実際の感染例は報告されていない。実際のアウトブレイクはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）で発生しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les modes de transmission au centre d'une sensibilisation communautaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Modes of Transmission at the Heart of a Community Awareness Campaign - ACP
article.articleSummary: 27 October 2026, Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo—Ebola remains the epicentre of the current outbreak in Ituri, prompting a UNDP-led community awareness campaign on transmission modes and prevention. The strategic dialogue gathered women, youth, and local leaders to discuss how the virus spreads and how to prevent infection, complementing clinical interventions with non-medical response strategies. The initiative stressed that accurate information empowers communities to understand risks and adopt preventive measures. Attended by provincial authorities and a representative of the Ituri governor, the workshop aims to strengthen community engagement in the Ebola response and broaden prevention and awareness activities in the province.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱：感染経路をめぐる地域啓発活動の中心課題 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報告であり、重篤な公衆衛生リスクと国際的拡大の可能性からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の一環としての地域啓発活動報告であり、UNDP主導で州当局も関与していることから、継続的な国際支援の必要性が示唆される。新規発生ではなく既知のアウトブレイクの続報である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola OIM - RDC : cartographie de préparation des épidémies réalisée à Kinshasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola IOM - DRC: Epidemic preparedness mapping carried out in Kinshasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2026: An IOM-RDC population mobility mapping conducted August 5-20, 2026, identifies Kinshasa as a major national and cross-border mobility hub, connected to provinces and Brazzaville via waterways, roads, rail, and air. The exercise aims to strengthen epidemic preparedness, with emphasis on cholera—already one of the year’s most concerning outbreaks in the capital—and the risk of Ebola virus disease introduction (the 17th EVD outbreak). The study targeted six health zones: Maluku I, N'sele, Masina I, N'djili, Gombe, Limete. It mapped 15 mobility axes, 11 priority entry points, 3 strategic sites for potential sanitary checkpoints, and 39 priority gathering points for risk communication, surveillance, and infection prevention. Findings will guide targeted traveler screening, disease surveillance, infection control, risk communication, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・IOM - DRC：キンシャサで疫病流行への備えマッピングを実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事は新規感染拡大や症例報告ではなく、IOMによる人口移動マッピングという予防的取り組みの紹介であり、第17次エボラ流行への言及はあるが具体的な新規症例データがないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はIOM-RDCによる人口移動マッピング調査（2026年8月5-20日実施）の報告で、コレラが現在最も懸念される流行とされ、エボラ（第17次流行）は越境リスクとして言及されているのみ。コンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）は接続都市として言及されるが発生地ではないため対象外。新規症例等の疫学データはなし。

article.articleHeadline: Risk grows of continental spread of Ebola after case is reported in Nigeria - BT News
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk grows as Nigeria confirms its first case, a 42-year-old Ugandan-Swiss woman in Abuja who fell ill four days after returning from a 2.5-week Uganda vacation on 3 October and was isolated on 20 October after a positive test. This case makes Nigeria the fourth African country with a confirmed Ebola infection since the Congo outbreak began in mid-May. The outbreak is the Bundibugyo strain, linked to 4,803 deaths among 9,876 confirmed cases across eight eastern DRC provinces; Ituri has seen heavy transmission with community spread since February, prior to formal declaration on May 15. Uganda’s Ebola-free status is under renewed scrutiny after Nigeria’s case, with claims she traveled to DRC contradicted by WHO and the Swiss ministry. Investigations consider a possible link to a Kenyan businessman infected in DRC who traveled to Kampala and then Nairobi; eight contacts, including four health workers, were infected, with airport exposure at Entebbe/Kampala under review.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでのエボラ症例報告後、アフリカ大陸規模の拡大リスクが高まる - BT News
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がナイジェリアに輸入され、ウガンダ・ケニアを含む複数国で感染連鎖が疑われており、IHR基準の複数（重大性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはNigeria・Uganda・Kenyaが含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストに該当しないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源である東部DRC（Ituri州）のみverified_locationsに含めた。致死率約49%（4,803/9,876）と非常に高く、国際的な人の移動を介した拡大が確認されている点で重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДРК превысило 10 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths reported by the National Institute of Public Health. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has persisted since mid‑May and is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history, exceeding the 2018–2020 outbreak. By speed of spread it has outrun previous events; globally it is the second‑largest by cases and deaths, behind only 2014–2016 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. The response is hampered by armed conflict, poor roads, violence against authorities, and misinformation. Hospitals are overloaded; many deaths occur without hospitalization, and pregnant women are dying at higher rates as fear of infection deters care. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and symptoms can resemble malaria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、死者4,887人に及ぶDRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行であり、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、武力紛争により対応が困難化しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にLiberia・Guinea・Sierra Leoneが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現在の流行はDRC国内に限定されているため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura aprimora estratégias de identificação e tratamento da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall enhances strategies for identifying and treating tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TB control efforts in Porto Velho, Brazil, targeting people experiencing homelessness and social vulnerability, were strengthened through a capacity-building training for professionals from Consultório na Rua and Centro POP. Promoted by Semusa's Division of Epidemiological Surveillance (DVE) and the Municipal TB Control Program in partnership with Associação Beradeiro, the session focused on early detection of respiratory symptoms, active case finding, and ensuring continuity of tuberculosis treatment. By integrating street outreach and social assistance services, the initiative aims to bring care directly to those facing access barriers and improve adherence. City officials emphasized data-driven planning and service coordination; Mayor Léo Moraes highlighted the integration of health and social services to extend reach. Ivonete Ferreira noted that stopping treatment prematurely remains a major challenge, underlining the need for patient-centered care and sustained follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所、結核の識別・治療戦略を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策強化に関する行政施策の報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ホームレス・社会的脆弱層向けの結核対策プログラムに関する通常業務の報道。アウトブレイクや異常事態の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: ابتلای بیش از ۱۰ هزار نفر به ابولا در کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 people infected with Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has intensified, with confirmed infections surpassing 10,060 and deaths reaching 4,887. Reuters reported a worsening crisis and a sharp rise in fatalities, indicating sustained transmission across the country. The article notes that total confirmed cases have crossed the 10,000 mark. It provides no detail on affected provinces, transmission chains, or infection sources, nor any information about imported or exported cases. The report highlights the ongoing outbreak and the urgent need for strengthened public health response, surveillance, and containment efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者1万人以上に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が1万人超、死者約4,900人と報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と持続的な感染拡大が示唆されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が約48.6%と非常に高く、感染規模・死亡者数ともに重大。影響を受けた州や感染経路、国際的拡大の有無については情報不足のため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria reporta primer caso de ébola en más de 10 años
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports its first case of Ebola in more than 10 years.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 October 2026, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in more than a decade, part of an outbreak that originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and is spreading across Africa. The confirmed case prompts immediate public health actions, with authorities tracing contacts and implementing containment to curb transmission. Ebola’s high mortality heightens concern in regions with fragile health systems, where swift spread is possible. The development arrives amid lingering COVID-19 impacts across several African countries, prompting international vigilance. Officials emphasize rapid, coordinated responses to prevent a wider public health crisis as Nigeria and other affected states monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、10年以上ぶりにエボラ出血熱の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を起源とするエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがアフリカ全域に拡大し、ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりの症例が確認された。国際的拡大・異常性・重篤性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初発例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの起源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra à Walikale: une équipe d'urgence dépéchée aaprès neuf cas enregistrés à la prison centrale - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in Walikale: An Emergency Team Dispatched After Nine Cases Recorded at the Central Prison - ACP
article.articleSummary: Nine cholera cases, including two deaths, were recorded at Walikale Central Prison in North Kivu, DRC, triggering an emergency response. A rapid team from the provincial government and health division evacuated patients, screened inmates for additional cases, and implemented prevention measures such as handwashing and movement restrictions around the prison. Authorities are considering a temporary cholera treatment center at Walikale prison, with IV fluids and other supplies shipped with support from ICCN and Africa CDC. MSF/Hollande is on the ground; partners are urged to intensify support as the outbreak extends to five health zones and access to Walikale remains difficult. Suspected cholera cases were reported in Pinga. The region also faces an Ebola outbreak since May 15, 2026, mobilizing health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ワリカレのコレラ:中央刑務所で9例確認後、緊急チームが派遣される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州の刑務所でコレラ9例（死亡2例）が発生し、5つの保健地区に拡大、同地域ではエボラ出血熱の流行も継続中であり、国際支援要請も出ているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 同地域では2026年5月15日からエボラ出血熱の流行も継続中であり、コレラとの複合的な公衆衛生危機となっている点に注意が必要。アクセス困難地域での対応能力評価が今後の焦点となる。

article.articleHeadline: Rio mira focos do Aedes aegypti em cemitérios às vésperas de Finados | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro targets Aedes aegypti hotspots in cemeteries on the eve of All Souls' Day | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro targets Aedes aegypti hotspots in cemeteries ahead of All Souls' Day, inspecting 20 sites from Oct 26–29 and Nov 3–6 to eliminate breeding habitats in flower vases and water-filled containers. Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Health teams will identify water-accumulating deposits, empty, discard, or treat them with larvicide; post-holiday follow-up will focus on vases left by visitors. Cemeteries include São Francisco Xavier (Caju), Jardim da Saudade (Sulacap), São João Batista, Memorial do Carmo, Ricardo de Albuquerque, Inhaúma, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, and others. Prevention programs run year-round at residences and at sites such as tire shops, junkyards, scrap depots, construction-material outlets, and bus garages. Up to Oct 10, 2026, the municipal health department performed 9,728,581 inspections and treated or eliminated 1,330,015 potential breeding sites; in 2025 there were 12,297,072 visits and 1,684,674 treated containers. Residents can report concerns via Central 1746.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、万霊節を前に墓地でネッタイシマカの発生源対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: これはリオデジャネイロ市による定例的なデング熱等媒介蚊の予防・駆除活動の報道であり、新規の異常な発生や症例急増を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）予防のための行政の定例的な清掃・駆除活動を報じたもので、新規症例数やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases in Congo as deaths near 5,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 4,900 deaths across affected countries as the virus continues to spread beyond national borders. In the DRC, health officials report 10,060 confirmed cases and 4,887 deaths as of Oct. 25, per the Congolese Ministry of Health. More than 2,600 patients have recovered. The report signals ongoing regional transmission, underscoring the need for sustained cross-border surveillance and public health response. The article provides counts but does not detail clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation procedures, infection sources, or specific cross-border links. No information is given on imported or exported cases beyond the broad note of cross-border spread. Data reflects figures through Oct. 25; published 2026-10-27.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の発生、1万例を超え死者は5,000人に近づく
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染者が1万人を超え死者約4,900人（致死率約49%）に達し、国境を越えた拡大が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニアへの拡大の可能性が示唆されているが、具体的な症例数や確定情報は記載されておらず、ケニアは対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。臨床症状や感染経路の詳細は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fever Alert Prompts Zamfara to Expand Ebola Checks at Travel Hubs | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance active in Nigeria as Zamfara State expands screening at Gusau International Airport and major motor parks after a traveler from Saudi Arabia exhibited high temperature; no confirmed Ebola diagnosis reported. Nigeria’s NCDC confirms one Bundibugyo Ebola case in Abuja (FCT); 53 contacts identified with no deaths among confirmed cases; patient improved while in isolation. A suspected Rivers State case tested negative. 21-day contact follow-up continues from each last exposure, with clinicians from prior Ebola responses aiding. WHO data note 9,704 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,687 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of Oct. 20 across 66 health zones in eight provinces, plus imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria. Africa CDC plans a virtual meeting of African health ministers on Oct. 28 to discuss regional response.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱警報を受け、ザムファラ州がエボラ検疫を交通拠点で拡大 | EconoTimes
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9,704例・4,687死亡）が継続し、ナイジェリアへの輸入例や国境を越えた拡散、WHO・Africa CDCによる地域対応協議など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリア（ザムファラ州・アブジャ）での輸入例対応だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中の大規模アウトブレイクの背景情報として明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ケニア・サウジアラビアも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: சங்கரன்கோவிலில் காய்ச்சலால் கல்லூரி மாணவா் உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: College student dies of fever in Sankarankovil.
article.articleSummary: A 20-year-old college student, Santosh, son of Uma Sankar, from Manathankoil Street in Sankarankovil, Tamil Nadu, died after contracting dengue fever. He was a first-year BCA student at a college near Srivilliputhur and received treatment at Sankarankovil Government Medical College Hospital before his condition worsened and he was transferred to Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital, where he died a few days ago. With dengue fever prevention work intensified in the Tenkasi district, residents are anxious about the illness. Health officials have begun area-wide surveys and urged enhanced dengue-control measures to stem potential spread. The death underscores ongoing dengue concerns in the region, with officials urging residents to cooperate with vector-control efforts and seek early treatment for fever.

triage.headline_ja: サンカランコーヴィルで発熱により大学生が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発のデング熱死亡例であり地域的な大規模流行の明確な証拠はないが、当局が地域調査・防除対策を強化しており注視が必要。
triage.notes: 地域限定（タミルナードゥ州テンカシ県周辺）の単発死亡例報道。デング熱は季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、現時点では大規模アウトブレイクの証拠はないため、続報を注視するWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Korle Bu steps up Ebola preparedness, plans additional training for 100 staff - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital centers on expanding readiness for a potential outbreak. The facility plans to train 100 additional healthcare workers and strengthen emergency response systems, including rapid response teams and triage procedures. An Epidemic Management Committee and a Central Rapid Response Team will coordinate outbreak activities, while disease surveillance will be enhanced with department-wide alerts. Existing trainings will be complemented by extended public health training for management teams to improve crisis coordination. Chief Executive Dr. Yakubu Seidu Adam directed earmarking dedicated funds for outbreak response to ensure rapid access to resources. Simulations will be intensified to test readiness, and physical barriers will be installed at isolation areas to reduce cross-contamination when handling agitated patients suspected of exposure. Measures aim to protect healthcare workers, patients, and the public.

triage.headline_ja: コルレブ病院、エボラ対策を強化 ― 追加で職員100名を訓練
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生報告はなく、病院の予防的な準備態勢強化に関する記事であるため、シグナルとして取り上げる根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナの病院における将来の流行に備えた準備活動（職員訓練、資金確保、隔離エリア整備等）を報じたものであり、実際のエボラ症例発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RDC roza los 10 mil casos y se convierte en el más mortífero del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears 10,000 cases and becomes the deadliest in the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) nears 10,000 confirmed cases, making it the deadliest outbreak in the country. The latest update reports 9,064 confirmed cases and 4,841 deaths; in the past 24 hours, 88 new infections and 38 deaths were recorded, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.6%. About 2,670 patients have recovered. Close-contact tracing stands at 87.1%. Declared in mid-May, this outbreak is the most lethal in DRC’s history, surpassing 2018–2020. Projections suggest the trajectory could approach West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, which caused 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Ebola virus disease is caused by pathogens in the genus Orthoebolavirus; natural reservoirs include fruit bats, with human transmission via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or fluids of infected animals or patients.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行、症例数が1万人近くに達し、国内で最も死者の多い流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が過去最大規模・最多死者数となり、致死率48.6%と深刻であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）伊波拉確診破萬宗 - 20261028 - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola confirmed cases exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 cumulative confirmed cases. As of Oct 25, 2026, the Health Ministry reports 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths (case fatality rate about 48.6%), affecting 8 of 26 provinces—the largest and deadliest outbreak to date. Latest reporting shows 46 new deaths, 40 occurring in the community rather than treatment centers. The Institute urges intensified early detection, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and protection for frontline workers. Residents of Bafwasende in the north-central Tshopo Province allege health teams contaminated water sources. UN and Congolese officials say last Saturday a crowd attacked responders, killing a nurse and wounding a principal. The outbreak, detected May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed targeted vaccine or therapy yet, though a vaccine trial started last week. Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria have also reported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の確定症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが累計1万人・CFR約48.6%に達し、史上最大最悪規模。複数国への拡大、医療従事者への暴力、ワクチン未承認など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク拡大と医療従事者への暴力、ワクチン試験開始の動き。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, malaria cases on risk
article.articleSummary: Week ending Oct 24 in Delhi reports 92 dengue and 19 malaria cases, taking the year totals to 993 dengue and 337 malaria; October tallies are 396 dengue and 94 malaria with no deaths. Of dengue cases, 86 were in MCD areas; six were reported by NDMC, Delhi Cantonment and Railways. Malaria weekly total is 19; October total 94. Dengue hotspots in MCD zones: Najafgarh 17; Central and South 13 each; West 8; Shahdara North 9; Civil Lines 2. Malaria hotspots: South 7; Central 4; Shahdara South 1; West 2. Cumulative dengue: MCD 881, NDMC 13, Delhi Cantonment 81, Railways 18 (total 993). Malaria: MCD 329, Railways 6, Delhi Cantonment 2; NDMC 0. Chikungunya adds 4 cases (total 38). Mosquito-control: 3.46 lakh houses sprayed, 11 lakh visits; breeding in 7,811 houses; 3,707 notices; 2,207 prosecutions; 1,101 penalties; fines Rs 1,38,400. Jan 1–Oct 17: 35 lakh sprayed; 3.54 crore visits; breeding in 2.1 lakh houses; 1.4 lakh notices; 28,600 prosecutions; 18,300 penalties; fines Rs 36 lakh.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱・マラリア患者数が増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: デリーにおけるデング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの季節性流行状況の定例報告であり、死亡例もなく、例年見られる範囲内の公衆衛生統計報告のため。
triage.notes: デリー市当局による蚊媒介感染症の定例週次・年間統計報告。死亡例なし、行政による防除活動（殺虫剤散布、罰金徴収等）も通常通り実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: SC registra terceiro foco da doença de Newcastle em aves; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SC records third outbreak of Newcastle disease in birds; understand.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak reaches a third commercial farm in Nova Erechim, Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of Oct 27, 2026. The 9,600-bird unit is nine km from the second focus in Coronel Freitas. Surveillance extends within nine km and a 60-day zoosanitary emergency covers Águas Frias. Nova Itaberaba remains under sanitary embargo and its focus ended; Coronel Freitas has completed culling and burial of turkeys, with cleaning ongoing. So far, 133 commercial properties and 551 backyard holdings have been inspected; four sanitary barriers remain, with disinfection, sampling, and biosafety guidance. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection of domestic and wild birds; signs include respiratory, nervous, and digestive symptoms. The last Brazilian case was July 17, 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, controlled and ended by OIE 90 days later. Exports from Santa Catarina and Brazil are suspended.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で家禽のニューカッスル病の第3例目の発生確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽間のニューカッスル病流行で輸出停止等の貿易制限が生じているが、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されておらず、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは低いため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（ニワトリ・七面鳥）間のウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害の報告はない。ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での養鶏業への経済的影響（輸出停止）が主な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола продължава да се разпространява: случаите в Африка надхвърлиха 10 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread: Ebola cases in Africa exceed 10,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths have been reported, with the virus first detected there in May, making this deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, with no approved vaccines or treatments. Cases in Kenya, Nigeria and Uganda signal cross-border spread across Africa. Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the end of August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Kenya reported its first case on October 6, with two deaths. Nigeria confirmed its first case in a Swiss citizen who contracted the virus after traveling to Uganda; 53 contacts were identified, and the patient was evacuated to Switzerland after returning on October 3, with symptoms on October 7 and a positive test on October 20. Transmission is via bodily fluids; delays between arrival, symptoms and confirmation raise concern for wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、依然として拡大中:アフリカの症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超・死亡者約4,900人という史上最悪規模の流行で、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という状況があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでの史上最悪規模の流行かつ複数国への越境伝播という点で国際的関心が極めて高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases, mostly in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: By 27 October 2026, Africa’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases, with 10,060 infections and 4,887 deaths in the DRC since May; 2,684 recoveries. The vast majority are in Ituri and eastern North Kivu, but the outbreak spans eight provinces and more than 66 health zones. Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda have reported cases; Uganda was declared Ebola-free in late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. In Nigeria, a 42-year-old Swiss woman who traveled from Uganda tested positive and was evacuated to Geneva; 53 contacts have been identified. Genomic sequencing links Kenyan and Nigerian cases, signaling cross-border spread. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo species, though Ervebo vaccine testing is underway to assess cross-protection. WHO and Africa CDC call the containment task complex across the continent.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数1万人超え、大半はコンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に症例1万件・死亡者4,887人に達し、複数国（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、スイス）へ越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生地であり唯一の対象国該当。ワクチン・治療薬未承認（Bundibugyo種）である点も重症リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reports Over 10,000 Ebola Cases, Sparking Concerns of Wider Spread
article.articleSummary: DRC reports over 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases this week with nearly 4,000 deaths, raising concerns of cross-border spread and wider continental transmission. Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda have also reported numerous recent cases. The CDC notes the outbreak is spreading substantially faster than previous Ebola outbreaks and is now the second-largest on record, with complexity from weak health infrastructure, ongoing violence, and a persistent lack of trust in public health initiatives. U.S. travel guidance urges citizens who have been in DRC to remain outside the country for 21 days before entering the United States, including travelers with intermediate stops. WHO highlights Ebola's variable symptoms, including fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and bleeding; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days, and laboratory confirmation is required. Treatments are limited and mortality high; avoidance of exposure remains key. The situation demands close international public health attention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万人以上のエボラ症例を報告、拡大懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超の症例・約4000人の死亡者が報告され、複数国への越境拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの症例報告は記事中で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国は渡航指針の文脈のみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Uruguai suspende importação de aves de todo o Brasil após caso de Newcastle | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uruguay suspends imports of poultry from all of Brazil after a case of Newcastle disease | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was confirmed Oct 18 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, housing about 6,000 birds. In response, Uruguay temporarily suspended imports of poultry meat and other avian products from all of Brazil for items produced after Sept 6, with exceptions for products treated to inactivate the virus and meeting sanitary/certification requirements. The measure, communicated by MAPA to exporters and updated Oct 27, 2026, follows Mexico’s earlier suspension of certain Brazilian poultry products. Other trading partners have imposed regional restrictions focused on Santa Catarina, including Chile (specific products), China (import declarations), Paraguay, Peru (export-eligibility), Türkiye, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, and Argentina (regionalization-based limits). The actions illustrate international containment efforts after the Newcastle disease focus in Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイ、ニューカッスル病の症例確認を受けブラジル全土からの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの商業七面鳥農場で確認されたニューカッスル病による複数国の家禽輸入規制だが、同疾患はヒトへの公衆衛生リスクがほぼなく、動物（家禽）疾患としての貿易影響に限定されるため。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽（鳥類）の疾患で、ヒトへの感染はまれかつ軽微（結膜炎程度）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とはみなされない。複数国（ウルグアイ、メキシコ、チリ、中国、パラグアイ、ペルー、トルコ、カザフスタン、マレーシア、アルゼンチン）が貿易上の予防的措置を講じているが、これは農業・貿易分野の対応であり、感染症危機管理としての公衆衛生シグナルには該当しない。発生国はブラジルのみで、他国は規制措置の実施国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ébola superan los 10.000 en la República Democrática del Congo ante fallas en el rastreo de contactos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 10,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid failures in contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-27, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 10,000 with 4,887 deaths (case fatality 48.6%), making this the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Confirmed cases reach 10,060 since the outbreak was declared in May. Severe gaps in early detection and contact tracing persist, with only about 12% of confirmed cases identified among known contacts, allowing transmission chains to continue undetected. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is circulating across eight provinces: Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Lower Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi. WHO Africa regional office emphasizes sustained control measures, greater access to affected areas, and community engagement to rebuild trust. Of 66 health zones affected, 50 have reported at least one new case in the last 21 days. Africa CDC plans a high-level virtual meeting with health ministers; Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria have reported linked cases since May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、接触者追跡の失敗によりエボラ感染者数が1万人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で、複数国への感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリアで関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Jamshedpur News: 4.89 लाख घरों का सर्वे, मच्छर पनपने के 26,000 स्रोतों को खत्म किया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamshedpur News: Survey of 489,000 houses, 26,000 mosquito-breeding sources eliminated.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention in Jamshedpur, India, led by Tata Steel Jamshedpur and Tata Steel UISL with active citizen participation, has kept the current dengue season largely under control. A total of 489,601 homes have been surveyed, and over 26,000 mosquito-breeding sources have been eliminated (14,193 indoor, 11,855 outdoor). The House Index, tracking Aedes mosquito breeding, averaged 2.7 from April to September and fell to 2.4 in September, both well below the target of 5. The initiative conducted 212 awareness programs across communities and educational institutions, including 104 school street dramas. Field teams have engaged residents in more than 440,000 health- and dengue-prevention conversations, reinforcing that prevention starts at home with brief weekly precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルニュース:48万9000軒の家屋調査、蚊発生源2万6000カ所を除去
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱予防活動の成果報告であり、流行拡大や異常事態を示す内容ではなく、現状は制御下にあるとされている。
triage.notes: デング熱シーズンは制御下にあり、予防活動の成功を伝える内容。感染拡大や重症例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Terceiro foco da doença de Newcastle é identificado no Oeste de SC e área de vigilância é ampliada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third Newcastle disease outbreak identified in Western Santa Catarina, and surveillance area expanded.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak re-emerges in Western Santa Catarina, Brazil, with a third focus identified in Nova Erechim during active surveillance, involving 9,600 birds that were asymptomatic. Surveillance radius expanded by about 9.5 km to curb spread. Previously, foci were detected in Nova Itaberaba (first confirmed Oct 18, 2026) and Coronel Freitas (second confirmed Oct 24, 2026). From Oct 20–26, 2026, authorities inspected 133 commercial properties and 551 backyard holdings, maintaining four sanitary barriers to disinfect vehicles. Activities include ongoing bird monitoring, sampling, and guidance to owners on biosecurity, with cleaning and disinfection of facilities and movement controls as needed. Newcastle disease is a viral infection affecting domestic and wild birds, causing respiratory and neurological signs, reduced production, and mortality; absence of symptoms does not exclude infection. Producers advised to practice biosafety, limit access to facilities, and report suspected cases to Cidasc or the e-Sisbravet system.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州西部でニューカッスル病の第3の発生地が確認され、監視区域が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の疾病であり人への健康影響は想定されないが、ブラジル国内で複数の発生地が確認され監視区域が拡大しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは極めて低い。家禽産業・貿易への影響の可能性はあるが、記事からは人への健康影響言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: SGC TV: Porto Velho registra queda nos casos de dengue em 2026, mas combate ao Aedes aegypti segue essencial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SGC TV: Porto Velho records a drop in dengue cases in 2026, but the fight against Aedes aegypti continues to be essential.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, the capital of Rondônia, Brazil, reports a continued decline in dengue, chikungunya, and Zika cases. As of October 19, 2026, dengue cases dropped to 57 (2026) from 212 in 2025 and 584 in 2024; chikungunya registered 27 (through Oct 19, 2026) vs 61 in 2025 and 20 in 2024; Zika showed 0 in 2026 up to Oct 19, after 16 (2024) and 5 (2025). The May–June 2026 second Rapid Index for Aedes aegypti (Liraa) categorized Porto Velho as medium-risk for infestation. Despite improvements, prevention remains essential, focusing on eliminating standing water and breeding sites. Public participation is crucial to disrupt Aedes aegypti reproduction. Semusa, the Municipal Health Secretariat, maintains surveillance and community education, with vector-control agents identifying potential breeding sites and guiding actions in higher-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: SGC TV: ポルトベーリョ、2026年のデング熱症例数が減少するもネッタイシマカ対策は依然として重要
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱いずれも症例数は減少傾向にあり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 症例数が前年・前々年より減少しているポジティブな内容の記事であり、新たな脅威のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情再傳暴力：護理師遇害 醫護人員遭重創 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence erupts again in the Congo Ebola outbreak: a nurse killed, healthcare workers seriously injured.
article.articleSummary: Violence against Ebola responders escalates in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo: Last Saturday in the town of Bafwasende, eastern Congo, a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured when armed attackers targeted staff en route to an Ebola alert. WHO condemned the attack, stressing it hinders efforts to control what is described as the world’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. WHO Africa Regional Director Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi urged that misinformation and fear not fuel violence. Since May, Congo has logged over 9,800 Ebola cases and more than 4,700 deaths. Persistent hostility to health teams stems from distrust in government handling and corruption allegations linked to outbreak responses. Earlier in May, tents at two medical centers were burned; last month, a Congo politician supporting government measures was beaten to death. Rescue and body-removal teams have faced kidnapping threats and other intimidation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行で再び暴力発生：看護師死亡、医療従事者重傷
triage.triage_reason: WHOが『世界最速で拡大するエボラ流行』と位置づける大規模アウトブレイク（9,800例超、死者4,700人超）に加え、対応従事者への暴力が頻発し対応を阻害しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: コミュニティの不信・誤情報に起因する医療従事者への暴力が流行対応を阻害している点が特徴的。致死率や感染拡大のリスクに加え、治安・社会的要因が複合的に関与している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola në Afrikë, mbi 10 mijë raste dhe afro 4,900 viktima në Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa, over 10,000 cases and about 4,900 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,060 confirmed cases, with 4,887 deaths reported as of 2026-10-27. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no specific vaccine is approved. A vaccine trial has begun in the DRC as health authorities intensify case finding, contact tracing, and measures to prevent transmission. The World Health Organization has reported related cases in neighboring African countries, raising concerns about cross-border spread. Ebola is a severe infectious disease that typically presents with high fever, weakness, muscle pains, and, in severe cases, bleeding. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected individuals or corpses. The situation highlights the need for enhanced surveillance and regional coordination to contain the outbreak and prevent exportations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行、コンゴで1万件超の症例と約4,900人の死者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ(Bundibugyo種)流行が継続し、死亡者数も多く近隣国への越境拡大懸念があるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAに進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: WHOが近隣諸国での関連症例を報告しているが、具体的な国名は記事中に明記されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ebola passam de 10 mil no Congo, informa governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 10,000 in the Congo, government reports
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 10,000 cases, with 10,060 confirmed and a case-fatality rate around 50%. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved treatments or vaccines. Congo's Ministry of Health reports it is the fastest-growing outbreak in Africa’s history and the deadliest in the country, as authorities try to contain spread to neighboring nations. Since May, the outbreak has registered at least three times more cases and deaths than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic within the same period. About 80% of cases are identified outside known contact lists, indicating undiscovered transmission chains; CDC Africa says at least 95% of cases should be among known contacts for control. Health-system impact includes deaths outside treatment centers, attacks on workers, hospital fear, and disruption of vaccination and routine services. It spans 66 health zones across eight provinces; began in May with three zones affected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の感染者数が1万人を超える、政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行で、感染経路不明のケースが8割に達し国際拡大・制御不能のリスクが高いためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文では隣国への拡大懸念としての言及のみで主題ではないため除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による史上最速拡大・最悪の致死的流行とされ、接触者追跡不能な感染連鎖が多数存在する点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ民主でエボラ感染1万人、過去最速ペース　国境越えた感染懸念：朝日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10,000 Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at the fastest pace on record; concerns about cross-border transmission: Asahi Shimbun
article.articleSummary: As of October 27, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 infections—the fastest pace on record—with a case fatality rate near 50%. The outbreak is centered in eastern Ituri Province, but cross-border transmission has been documented in Kenya and Nigeria, heightening concerns of regional spread; Uganda has also reported cases. The World Health Organization had designated Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. By mid-August, the outbreak exceeded 5,000 infections; by late October, numbers reached over 10,000. Africa CDC urges intensified continental cooperation, with an online ministers’ meeting planned for October 28. Public distrust of authorities and violence against healthcare workers hinder the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主でエボラ感染1万人、過去最速ペース　国境越えた感染懸念：朝日新聞
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラがDRCで過去最速ペースで1万人超に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されWHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ただし越境感染は国際拡大リスクの重要な要素として評価に反映した。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cómo la sequía y las infecciones TORCH afectan la salud fetal?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How do drought and TORCH infections affect fetal health?
article.articleSummary: TORCH infections—toxoplasma, rubella, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex, and syphilis—transmitted from mother to fetus, are linked to markedly higher neurodevelopmental risk. A Swedish study of 3.7 million births (1987–2021) identified 975 congenital TORCH cases. Over 30 years, TORCH-exposed children had about 3× higher autism risk, >7× higher odds of intellectual disability, and up to 30× higher risk of severe intellectual disability, versus unexposed peers; TORCH accounts for about 1.2% of severe intellectual disability and 0.034% of autism cases in Sweden. Comparisons with affected children’s unexposed siblings yielded similar results, suggesting factors beyond shared family context. Academic performance was poorer in TORCH-exposed children absent diagnosed autism or ID. Preventive measures include avoiding toxoplasma exposure (food handling), rubella vaccination pre-pregnancy, CMV hygiene, and treating herpes or syphilis during pregnancy. A separate Brazilian study links gestational drought to higher preterm birth (≈2%, up to 5% in severe cases) and fetal growth restriction.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつとTORCH感染症は胎児の健康にどのような影響を与えるか？
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究の紹介記事であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ対象の感染症シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はスウェーデンの出生コホート研究とブラジルの干ばつ・早産研究に関する学術的レビューであり、特定国での感染症アウトブレイク発生を報告するものではない。スウェーデン・ブラジルとも対象国リストの観点でも実際の感染症発生イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Identificado terceiro caso da Doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third case of Newcastle disease identified in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Third Newcastle disease outbreak focus detected in Santa Catarina, Brazil, in the municipality of Nova Erechim. The incident involves 9,600 birds that showed no symptoms. The farm’s commercial status and bird species are not confirmed; previous outbreaks in Nova Itaberaba and Coronel Freitas affected turkey-producing farms. The third focus was identified through active surveillance conducted by Cidasc (Companhia Integrada de Desenvolvimento Agrícola de Santa Catarina), indicating ongoing monitoring and response to an in-state outbreak. No human illness is reported, and surveillance seeks to prevent spread and inform control measures. The article notes that earlier outbreaks occurred on commercial turkey farms; whether this new focus involves another poultry type remains unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリナ州でニューカッスル病の第3例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家きんのみに影響する動物疾病で人への感染報告はなく、既知の継続監視下での発生であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例はニューカッスル病（鳥類感染症）であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州の州機関（Cidasc）による能動的サーベイランスで検出された家きん農場の第3例。家きん貿易への影響可能性はあるが、記事内に具体的な貿易制限の記載はなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Tin tức quốc tế sáng 28.10: Diễn biến mới dịch Ebola, gần 5.000 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International News, morning of Oct 28: New developments in the Ebola outbreak, nearly 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 infections and nearly 5,000 deaths, with 10,060 cases and 4,887 fatalities reported since the outbreak began in May. Most cases are in the DRC, with additional infections identified in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. This marks the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak spans eastern, western, and central Africa, posing a complex containment challenge. A major obstacle is the lack of an approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving this surge. The report underscores ongoing surveillance and the need for strengthened public health responses to limit transmission across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 朝の国際ニュース10月28日：エボラ出血熱の新たな展開、死者数5,000人近くに
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（1万人超感染、死者約5千人）が発生し、複数国への拡大と有効なワクチン・治療法の欠如という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事ではケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも感染例が確認されたとあるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、国際的な封じ込め対応が課題とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 4.840 décès sur 9.964 cas confirmés , H24info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 4,840 deaths out of 9,964 confirmed cases, H24info.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: 4,841 deaths among 9,964 confirmed cases; case fatality rate 48.6%. Of those, 2,670 recovered and 1,008 hospitalized or in quarantine. Ituri remains the epicenter with 72% of cumulative cases; Nord-Kivu fatality rate 56.1%. Overall, 66 health zones across eight provinces have been affected. Health authorities urge sustained vigilance, enhanced surveillance, and intensified investigations of suspected cases, restoring contact tracing in zones with gaps to interrupt transmission and prevent community spread. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. Early doses of Ervebo (Zaïre strain) have been administered to frontline volunteers in a clinical trial. Declared mid-May in Ituri, the outbreak has spread to eight provinces; cases have occurred in Kenya and Nigeria, though linkage remains unconfirmed. If confirmed, it could surpass the 2018–2020 RDC outbreak (about 2,300 deaths, 3,500 cases).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確定症例9,964例中4,840人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%の大規模エボラ流行が8州66保健地区に拡大し、国境を越えたケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告もあり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例は本流行との関連性が未確認（linkage remains unconfirmed）のため、verified_locationsには含めずDRCのみを記載。ブンディブギョ株によるもので承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、2018-2020年流行を上回る可能性が指摘されている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يفتك بالكونغو الديمقراطية: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 10,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) with about 4,887 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading and most lethal outbreak in the country, affecting eight provinces. The outbreak began mid-May and has spread to Uganda, then Kenya and Nigeria; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths and later declared the outbreak over by late August. Kenya has recorded 2 deaths, with its first case on Oct 6 imported from the DRC via Uganda. Nigeria reported a single imported case: a woman of Ugandan origin with Swiss nationality, who developed symptoms Oct 7, sought care in Abuja Oct 11, and was confirmed Oct 20 as Bundibugyo ebolavirus; she and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland. Key challenges include armed conflict, poor roads, distrust, and misinformation hampering response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で猛威:感染者1万人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1万人超の感染者・約4,887人の死者を出し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大、WHOがPHEICを宣言しておりIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要発生国としてWHOのPHEIC宣言対象。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 10.000 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στην ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 10,000 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed Ebola cases, reporting 10,060 cases and 4,887 deaths from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, marking the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country to date and the second-deadliest since West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. The mid‑May outbreak has raised cross-border concerns as Kenya reported its first case earlier this month and nine total cases after a Nairobi death linked to travel from Congo via Uganda; Nigeria became the fourth African country to report a case last week. Investigations focus on a Swiss diplomat’s wife, likely infected in Uganda and later evacuated to Switzerland. Uganda previously had 20 cases in May–June and was declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August; the Ugandan health minister now mandates a 21‑day quarantine for Ugandan citizens returning from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が1万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例が1万人・死者約4,887人に達し過去最大規模の流行となっており、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境・国際拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・スイスでの症例確認があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主要発生国であるDRCのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола се незадрживо шири Конгом: Више од 10.000 заражених, готово половина преминула
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads uncontrollably through Congo: More than 10,000 infected, almost half have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 10,060 confirmed cases, with nearly half of those infected dead. The epidemic, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no approved vaccine or treatment. It is the fastest-spreading and most deadly Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history, spreading across eight provinces and 66 health zones (up from three zones at declaration). It has been detected in five countries, including Uganda and France, with no active cases there currently; cases have also been reported in Kenya and Nigeria. About 80% of new infections originate from people not under surveillance, indicating undetected transmission chains. The African CDC notes that at least 95% of cases should be linked to known contacts to signal control. Health workers face violence, conflict, poor equipment, and strikes over pay; in Bafwasende, Chopo Province, a nurse was killed during an intervention and another worker seriously injured. Routine health services, vaccination, and schooling are disrupted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで制御不能に拡大：感染者1万人超、ほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し複数国への伝播が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも症例報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。未検出の感染連鎖が多く（新規感染の80%が追跡対象外）、ワクチン・治療薬未承認である点から深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Terceiro foco da Doença de Newcastle é identificado em Nova Erechim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third focus of Newcastle disease identified in Nova Erechim.
article.articleSummary: Third Newcastle disease focus identified in Nova Erechim, western Santa Catarina: 9,600 birds on the farm infected but asymptomatic, discovered through active surveillance. Surveillance radius expanded by about 9.5 km, with sanitary actions continuing at the site. Nova Itaberaba hosts the first focus where a sanitary embargo is in place. Coronel Freitas, location of the second focus (confirmed Oct 24), has completed depopulation and burial of turkeys, with ongoing cleaning and disinfection. From Oct 20–26, authorities inspected 133 commercial properties and 551 small-holder properties. Four sanitary barriers remain active with vehicle inspection and disinfection; teams monitor flocks, collect samples, and advise producers on biosafety. The operation is coordinated by MAPA and Cidasc via Coezoo, with state and federal agencies and Icasa participating, aiming to eradicate foci and protect Santa Catarina aviculture.

triage.headline_ja: ノバ・エレチンでニューカッスル病の第3の発生地が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）でヒトへの直接影響はないが、ブラジル養鶏業への経済的影響と拡大が継続しており、貿易制限リスクの観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本疾患は家禽の動物感染症であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは報告されていない。ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州での養鶏業への影響と、関連する貿易制限（輸出停止等）の可能性に留意が必要。MAPA・Cidascによる封じ込め対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة بإيبولا في إفريقيا معظمها في جمهورية الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10,000 Ebola infections in Africa, most of them in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 10,000 Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) recording 10,060 confirmed infections and 4,887 deaths since the outbreak began in May. Most cases are in the DRC, but the WHO describes the response as complex as the outbreak extends into East, West, and Central Africa. A major hurdle is the lack of approved vaccines or therapies for the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving this outbreak. In addition to the DRC, Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda have reported cases; Uganda had Ebola-free status by late August after 20 infections and two deaths. Nigeria confirmed one case in a Swiss national who contracted the virus during a trip to Uganda; lab tests on Oct 20 confirmed Bundibugyo, and 53 contacts were identified. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; fluids include blood, saliva, tears, sweat, vomit, urine, feces, semen, and breast milk. Fruit bats are the likely reservoir; mosquitoes are not involved.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ感染1万人超、大半はコンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に1万例超・死者約4900人の大規模エボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへも拡大。稀なブンディブギョ株に有効なワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはAngola・Mozambique・Kenya・Uganda・Nigeriaも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で明示されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚20名埃博拉病例接触者解除隔离，刚果（金）疫苗试验带来新希望
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Twenty contacts of Ebola cases in Kenya have been released from isolation; Congo (Kinshasa) vaccine trial brings new hope.
article.articleSummary: Kenya released 20 Ebola contacts from isolation after 21 days of monitoring; none developed symptoms, with evaluations and follow-up guidance provided. Health officials and WHO said finishing 21 days without symptoms poses no infection risk and supports community protection. Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 6—a Kenyan who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo, returning via Uganda and dying in Nairobi two days later. By Oct 22, all contacts had been traced and isolated. By Monday, eight contacts were symptomatic and lab‑confirmed as Ebola, bringing Kenya’s total to nine cases and two deaths; no evidence of community transmission. WHO praised the rapid response; no licensed vaccines or specific therapies exist; supportive care improves outcomes. In Bunia, DRC, the TUMAINI platform began evaluating vaccines against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, including Ervebo and candidates ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469; results expected in months; trial led by DRC authorities and the national institute.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ接触者20人が隔離解除、コンゴ（金）ではワクチン試験が新たな希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（Bundibugyo種）がケニアへ越境し複数死亡例が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、WHOも関与していることからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア（感染確認国）およびウガンダ（経由国）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源・ワクチン試験実施国であるDRCのみを計上。ケニアでの9症例・2死亡は国際伝播の実例として重要。

article.articleHeadline: 콩고 에볼라 확진 '1만 명' 넘어...아프리카 4개국으로 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 10,000... spreading to four African countries.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 10,000 confirmed cases (10,060) with 4,887 deaths and 2,684 recoveries across eight provinces; no approved vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo virus. Kenya reports 9 cases and 2 deaths; the index patient traveled from Congo through Uganda to Nairobi and died Oct 5. A second death, a 65-year-old woman who is a relative of the first patient, is reported; 20 contacts completed 21-day monitoring and were released, while 98 remain isolated with phased releases planned from Nov 3. Nigeria confirms its first case (Oct 20), a 42-year-old Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja; the virus is genetically similar to the Kenyan case, and the couple left Uganda Oct 3; the husband is isolated in Zurich. Uganda questions WHO’s end-of-outbreak claim; cross-border containment continues. MSF notes vaccine trials starting in Bunia, with Ervebo in use and Moderna/Oxford candidates to follow. The US will buy Regeneron’s Inmazeb through 2031; CDC says no US cases and low risk; a new travel rule requires a Congo-absence certificate for arrivals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ確診者「1万人」超え...アフリカ4カ国に拡散
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が1万人超の感染・死亡者4,887人に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへ国際的に拡散、渡航制限措置も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・米国・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが流行の震源地であり主題として明確。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya se expandió en las Américas: la OPS reportó casi 214.000 casos y Centroamérica encendió alertas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya spread across the Americas: PAHO reported nearly 214,000 cases and Central America sounded the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya spreads across the Americas as PAHO reports 213,919 suspected cases and 88 deaths in 2026, with 78,481 lab-confirmed. Brazil has the largest burden (135,962 suspected, 56,759 confirmed; 58 deaths). Bolivia reports 48,079 cases and 45 deaths; Argentina 12,383 suspected; Suriname 16,623 suspected; French Guiana surpasses 2,000 confirmed autochthonous cases. In Central America, Honduras confirms community transmission on the Nicaragua border after an imported case; Costa Rica rises from 8 to 690 suspected in 2026 with local transmission in Guanacaste and Alajuela. Nicaragua reports 283 diagnosed in the week ending Oct 10. In Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, 10,817 cases and 31 deaths year-to-date, including 122 pregnant women. Transmission is via Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; illness features sudden fever and painful joints; can progress through acute, post-acute, and chronic phases. OPS urges enhanced surveillance, diagnostics, vector control, and guidance for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が中南米で拡大：PAHOが約21万4000例を報告、中米で警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準が3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際的拡大）し、ブラジルを含む複数国での大規模流行・死亡例が報告されているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は中南米全域（ブラジル、ボリビア、アル�ゼンチン、スリナム、仏領ギアナ、ホンジュラス、コスタリカ、ニカラグア）の流行を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルは症例数・死亡数ともに最大で、妊婦感染例も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: ZRL TRAIN DEPARTS MAPEPE FOR LIVINGSTONE AFTER CHOLERA SCARE - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Cholera scare prompts Zambia Railways to halt the Mapepe-to-Livingstone train in Mapepe, Chilanga District, as passengers were screened and vaccinated as a precaution after reports of suspected cholera. The train departed Mapepe around 01:20 hours once health checks and vaccination were completed, and water across all nine coaches was restored after a genset fault disrupted supply. Technical faults had required repairs in Kabwe and Lusaka’s Misisi area earlier, which have been addressed. The prolonged stop prioritized passenger safety, with screening, vaccination, and observation continuing before clearance to proceed. Officials from the Ministry of Health, Ministry of Transport and Logistics, Disaster Risk Management Division, and Zambia Railways Limited coordinated the response, including Dr Kennedy Lishimpi, Eng. Fredrick Mwalusaka, Norman Chipakupaku, and Mwendabai Mwalusi Bulaya. Chilanga Town Council reports 475 passengers were vaccinated on Monday evening prior to departure.

triage.headline_ja: コレラの懸念を受けザンビア鉄道の列車がマペペからリビングストンへ出発
triage.triage_reason: 疑いコレラ例への予防的対応（乗客スクリーニング・ワクチン接種）であり、確定症例や死亡者の情報がなく深刻度は不明。ザンビアはコレラ流行の既知国であり異常性も低いが、集団曝露の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は疑い例に対する予防的措置（スクリーニング・ワクチン接種475名）を報じており、確定症例数や死亡者数などの詳細情報は含まれていない。保健省・運輸省・鉄道当局が連携して対応済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura confirma novo foco da doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture confirms new outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: New outbreak of Newcastle disease confirmed at a poultry farm in Nova Erechim, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock said the focus was identified within the sanitary emergency area already designated for the region. Detection occurred during intensified surveillance in the emergency area. The Official Veterinary Service has activated emergency zoosanitary response protocols, including epidemiological investigation, enhanced surveillance, and containment measures to prevent further spread. No case counts or mortality figures are provided. The announcement emphasizes ongoing proactive surveillance and rapid response to protect poultry health in Santa Catarina, with actions aligned to established emergency procedures. The report does not specify the infection source, but indicates containment within the affected farm and surrounding area as a priority.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病の新たな発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における動物疾患であり人への直接的な公衆衛生影響は現時点で不明だが、既存の衛生非常事態区域内での新規発生であり、養鶏産業・貿易への影響の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本疾患は動物（家禽）の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。発生国ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とする。貿易制限リスクは家禽輸出に関連する可能性があるためYesとした。

article.articleHeadline: Após caso de Newcastle em SC, PR intensifica barreiras e diz que não há foco no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina, Paraná tightens barriers and says there is no outbreak in the state.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus detected in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, prompting Paraná state authorities (Adapar) to tighten sanitary surveillance and border controls to prevent entry and spread. Despite the focus in Santa Catarina, Paraná reports no outbreak and current surveillance has not detected Newcastle disease or Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in the state. Movement controls for live birds were expanded at border posts and within the interior, with inspectors verifying sanitary documentation, origin and destination, compliance with transport requirements, and vehicle cleaning and disinfection. Official Veterinary Service teams will continue farm inspections and rapid investigation of any suspicions. Paraná remains the country’s largest producer/exporter of chicken meat, about 35% of national production; 2025 output ~5 million tons, exports ~2.05 million tons, revenue around US$3.53 billion. Adapar urges reinforced biosecurity measures near the detected focus.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受け、パラナ州は検疫体制を強化し「州内に感染拡大はない」と発表
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）のニューカッスル病発生であり、現時点でヒトへの影響は報告されていないが、ブラジルの主要鶏肉輸出州への拡大懸念から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、ヒト感染症ではないため公衆衛生への直接的な深刻性は低い。ただし、家禽貿易・輸出への影響と地域拡大防止策の観点から動物衛生面でのモニタリングが必要。
